catalog: Songs of Zion (SDAH English & Tamil Hymnal)

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Praise to the Lord, the Almighty, the King of creation!
O my soul, praise Him, for He is thy health and salvation!
All ye who hear, now to His temple draw near;

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Who o'er all things so wondrously reigneth,
Shieldeth thee under His wings, yea, so gently sustaineth!
Hast thou not seen how thy desires e'er have been Granted in what He ordaineth?

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Praise to the Lord, who doth prosper thy work and defend thee;
Surely His goodness and mercy here daily attend thee.
Ponder anew what the Almighty can do, If with His love He befriend thee.

translations.title: All creatures of our God and King

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: All creatures of our God and King,
Lift up your voice with us and sing: Alleluia!
O burning sun with golden beam And silver moon with softer gleam:

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: O rushing wind and breezes soft,
O clouds that ride the winds aloft: Oh, praise Him!
O rising morn, in praise rejoice,
O lights of evening, find a voice.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: flowing waters, pure and clear, Make music for your Lord to hear.
O fire so masterful and bright,
Providing us with warmth and light.

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: Let all things their Creator bless,
Oh, praise the Father, praise the Son,
And praise the Spirit, three in One!

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Let us all adore Him, And with awe appear before Him.
Soul, in silence fear Him, Humbly, fervently draw near Him.
Now His own who have known God,

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Let my soul, like Mary, Be Thine earthly sanctuary.
Come, indwelling Spirit, With transfigured splendor;
Love and honor will I render.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Gladly we surrender Earth's deceitful treasures,
Pride of life and sinful pleasures: Gladly,
Lord, we offer Thine to be forever,
Soul and life and each endeavor.
Thou alone shall be known Lord of all our being,

translations.title: Praise, My Soul, the King of Heaven

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Praise, my soul, the King of heaven;
To His feet thy tribute bring.
Who like thee His praise should sing?
Praise Him, praise Him, Alleluia, Praise the everlasting King.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Praise Him for His grace and favor To our fathers in distress.
Praise Him, still the same forever,
Slow to chide and swift to bless;
Praise Him, praise Him, Alleluia, Glorious in His faithfulness.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Tenderly He shields and spares us;
Well our feeble frame He knows.
In His hands He gently bears us, Rescues us from all our foes.
Praise Him, praise Him, Alleluia, Widely as His mercy flows.

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: Angels, help us to adore Him: Ye behold Him face to face;
Sun and moon, bow down before Him: Dwellers all in time and space.
Praise Him, praise Him, Alleluia, Praise with us the God of grace.

translations.title: All My Hope on God Is Founded

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: All my hope on God is founded;
He doth still my trust renew.
Me through change and chance He guideth, Only good and only true.
God unknown, He alone Calls my heart to be His own.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Pride of man and earthly glory, Sword and crown betray his trust;
What with care and toil he buildeth,
Tower and temple fall to dust.
But God's power, hour by hour, Is my temple and my tower.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Splendor, light and life attend Him,
Love doth stand at His hand;
Joy doth wait on His command.

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: Still from man to God eternal, Sacrifice of praise be done.
High above all praises praising, For the gift of Christ His son.
Christ doth call one and all: Ye who follow shall not fall.

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: O worship the Lord in the beauty of holiness,
With gold of obedience, and incense of lowliness,
Kneel and adore Him: the Lord is His name.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Low at His feet lay thy burden of carefulness,
High on His heart He will bear it for thee,
Comfort thy sorrows, and answer thy prayerfulness,
Guiding thy steps as may best for thee be.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Fear not to enter His courts in the slenderness Of the poor wealth thou wouldst reckon as thine;
Truth in its beauty, and love in its tenderness,
These are the offerings to lay on His shrine.

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: These, though we bring them in trembling and fearfulness,
He will accept for the name that is dear;
Mornings of joy give for evenings of tearfulness,
Trust for our trembling, and hope for our fear.

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: The Lord in Zion reigneth, let all the world rejoice,
And come before His throne of grace with tuneful heart and voice;
The Lord in Zion reigneth, and there His praise shall ring,
To Him shall princes bend the knee and kings their glory bring.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: The Lord in Zion reigneth, and who so great as He?
The depths of earth are in His hands;
O crown His Name with honor, and let His standard wave,
Till distant isles beyond the deep shall own His power to save.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: The Lord in Zion reigneth, these hours to Him belong;
O enter now His temple gates, and fill His courts with song;
Beneath His royal banner let every creature fall,
Exalt the King of heaven and earth, and crown Him Lord of all.

sections.label: சரணம் 1
lines: சீயோனில் கர்த்தர் ஆள்வார்; புகழ் துதி கேட்போம்.

sections.label: சரணம் 2
lines: சீயோனில் கர்த்தர் ஆள்வார்; அவர் போல் தேவன் யார்?
முடிசூட்டி, நாமம் போற்றும் அவர் கொடி ஓங்கும்.
நீர் சூழ் மா ஆழத்தில் தீவும் மீட்பின் ஆற்றல் பெறும்.

sections.label: சரணம் 3
lines: சீயோனில் கர்த்தர் ஆள்வார்; காலம் நேசர் சொந்தம்.
ராயர் கொடிக் கீழ் வணங்கும் உயிர்கள் எல்லாம்
கர்த்தர் விண்மண் எல்லாம் ராஜா மேன்முடி சூட்டுவோம்.

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Seeyonil Karththar Aalvaar; Pukazh Thudhi Ketpom.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Seeyonil Karththar Aalvaar; Avar Pol Thevan Yaar?
Mutisootti, Naamam Potrum Avar Koti Ongum.
Neer Soozh Maa Aazhaththil Theevum Meetpin Aatral Perum.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Seeyonil Karththar Aalvaar; Kaalam Nesar Sondham.
Raayar Kotik Keezh Vanangum Uyirkal Ellaam
Karththar Vinman Ellaam Raajaa Menmuti Soottuvom.

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: We gather together to ask the Lord's blessing;
He chastens and hastens His will to make known.
The wicked oppressing now cease from distressing.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Beside us to guide us, our God with us joining,
So from the beginning the fight we were winning;
Thou, Lord, were at our side, all glory be Thine!

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: And pray that Thou still our defender wilt be.

translations.title: Let All the World in Every Corner Sing

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Let all the world in every corner sing, My God and King!
The heavens are not too high, His praise may thither fly;
The earth is not too low, His praises there may grow.
Let all the world in every corner sing, My God and King!

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Let all the world in every corner sing, My God and King!
The church with psalms must shout, No door can keep them out;
But, above all, the heart must bear the longest part.
Let all the world in every corner sing, My God and King!

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Come, Christians, join to sing, Alleluia!
Loud praise to Christ our King;
Let all, with heart and voice, Before His throne rejoice;
Praise is His gracious choice: Alleluia!

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Come, lift your hearts on high;
He is our Guide and Friend;
His love shall never end: Alleluia!

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Life shall not end the strain;
On heaven's blissful shore His goodness we'll adore, Singing forevermore, Alleluia!

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: The God of Abraham praise, Who reigns enthroned above;
Ancient of everlasting days, And God of love;
I bow and bless the sacred name, Forever blest.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: At whose supreme command From earth I rise, and seek the joys At His right hand;
I all on earth forsake, Its wisdom, fame and power;
And Him my only portion make, My shield and tower.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: The whole triumphant host Give thanks to God on high;
"Hail, Father, Son, and Holy Ghost!" They ever cry;
All might and majesty are Thine, And endless praise.

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Joyful, joyful, we adore Thee, God of glory, Lord of love;
Hearts unfold like flow'rs before Thee,
Hail Thee as the sun above.
Melt the clouds of sin and sadness, Drive the dark of doubt away;
Giver of immortal gladness, Fill us with the light of day!

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: All Thy works with joy surround Thee,
Earth and heav'n reflect Thy rays,
Stars and angels sing around Thee,
Field and forest, vale and mountain,
Chanting bird and flowing fountain Call us to rejoice in Thee.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Wellspring of the joy of living,
Christ our Brother - All who live in love are Thine: Teach us how to love each other,
Lift us to the joy divine.

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: New songs of celebration render To Him who has great wonders done.
Love sits enthroned in ageless splendor: Come, and adore the mighty One.
He has made known His great salvation Which all His friends with joy confess: He has revealed to every nation His everlasting righteousness.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Let every instrument and voice Peal out the praise of grace abounding Calling the whole world to rejoice.
Trumpets and organs, set in motion Such sounds as make the heavens ring;
All things that live in earth and ocean,
Make music for your mighty King.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Rivers and seas and torrents roaring,
Honor the Lord with wild acclaim;
Mountains and stones look up adoring,
And find a voice to praise His name.
Praises be His that never cease: Just is our God, whose truth victorious,

translations.title: Let Us Praise the Name of the Lord

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Let us praise the name of the Lord!

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Go ye into all the world.

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: My Maker and my King, To Thee my all I owe;
Thy sovereign bounty is the spring Whence all my blessings flow;
Thy sovereign bounty is the spring Whence all my blessings flow.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: The creature of Thy hand, On Thee alone I live;
My God, Thy benefits demand More praise than I can give.
My God, Thy benefits demand More praise than I can give.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Lord, what can I impart When all is Thine before?
Thy love demands a thankful heart;
Thy love demands a thankful heart;

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: O! let Thy grace inspire My soul with strength divine;
Let every word each desire And all my days be Thine.
Let every word each desire And all my days be Thine.

translations.title: All People That on Earth Do Well

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: All people that on earth do dwell, sing to the Lord with cheerful voice.
Him serve with mirth, his praise forth tell; come ye before him and rejoice.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Know that the Lord is God indeed; without our aid he did us make; we are his folk, he doth us feed, and for his sheep he doth us take.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: O enter then his gates with praise; approach with joy his courts unto; praise, laud, and bless his name always, for it is seemly so to do.

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: For why! the Lord our God is good; his mercy is forever sure; his truth at all times firmly stood, and shall from age to age endure.

translations.title: Lord of All Being, Throned Afar

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Lord of all being, throned afar,
Thy glory flames from sun and star;
Center and soul of every sphere Yet to each loving heart how near!
Yet to each loving heart how near!

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Thy quickening ray Shed on our path the glow of day;
Thy softened light Cheers the long watches of the night,
Cheers the long watches of the night.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Our midnight is Thy smile withdrawn;
Our noontide is Thy gracious dawn;
Our rainbow arch, Thy mercy's sign;
All, save the clouds of sin, are Thine,
All, save the clouds of sin, are Thine.

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: Lord of all life, below, above Whose light is truth, whose warmth is love,
Before Thy ever-blazing throne We ask no luster of our own,
We ask no luster of our own.

sections.label: Verse 5
lines: Grant us Thy truth to make us free And kindling hearts that burn for Thee;
Till all Thy living altars claim One holy light, one heavenly flame!
One holy light, one heavenly flame.

translations.title: O Morning Star, How Fair and Bright

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: O Morning Star, how fair and bright!
You shine with God's own truth and light,
You have won Our hearts to serve You only!
Great and Glorious, all victorious, Rich in blessing!
Rule and might o'er all possessing!

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Lord, when you look on us in love,
At once there falls from God above A ray of purest pleasure.
Your Word and Spirit, flesh and blood,
Refresh our souls with heav-'nly food.
Let Your mercy warm and cheer us!
For You teach us God's own love through You has reached us.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Almighty Father, in Your Son You loved us, when not yet begun Was this old earth's foundation!
Your Son has ransomed us in love To live in Him here and above: This is Your great salvation.
Keeps us Yours and fails us never!

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: O let the harps break forth in sound!
Our joy be all with music crowned, Our voices gaily blending!
For Christ goes with us all the way ' Today, tomorrow, every day!
Great is He, the King of glory!

translations.title: O Sing a New Song to the Lord

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: O sing a new song to the Lord For marvels He has done;
His right hand and His holy arm The victory have won.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: With harp, and voice of psalms Unto Jehovah sing;
Let trumpets and the echoing horn Acclaim the Lord our King!

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Let seas with all their creatures roar,
And let the rivers clap their hands,

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: Before the Lord: because He comes, To judge the earth come He;
He'll judge the world with righteousness, His folk with equity.

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Rejoice in His word, Ye angels of light;
Ye heavens, adore Him By whom ye were made,

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Praise Him upon earth, In tuneful accord: Ye sons of new birth;
Praise Him who hath brought you His grace from above,
Praise Him who hath taught you To sing of His love.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: O praise ye the Lord, All things that give sound;
Loud organs His glory Forth tell in deep tone,
And sweet harp, the story Of what He hath done.

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: Thanksgiving and song To Him be outpoured All ages along: For love in creation,
For grace of salvation, O praise ye the Lord!

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: In light inaccessible hid from our eyes,
Most blessed, most glorious, the Ancient of Days,

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Unresting, unhasting, and silent as light,
Thy justice, like mountains, high soaring above Thy clouds, which are fountains of goodness and love.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: To all, life Thou givest, to both great and small;
In all life Thou livest, the true life of all;
We blossom and flourish as leaves on the tree,
And wither and perish - but naught changeth Thee.

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: Great Father of glory, pure Father of light,
Thine angels adore Thee, all veiling their sight;
O help us to see 'Tis only the splendor of light hideth Thee!

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: God is our Song, and every singer blest Who praising Him finds energy and rest.
All who praise God with unaffected joy Give back to us the widom we destroy,
Give back to us the widom we destroy.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: God is our Song, for Jesus comes to save;
While praising Him we offer all we have.
New songs we sing, in ventures new unite,
When Jesus leads us upward into light,
When Jesus leads us upward into light.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: This is our Song no conflict ever drowns;
Who praises God our human wrath disowns.
Love knows what rich complexities of sound God builds upon a simple common ground,
God builds upon a simple common ground.

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: God is our Silence when no songs are sung,
When ecstasy or sorrow stills the tongue.
Glorious the faith which silently obeys Until we find again the voice of praise,
Until we find again the voice of praise.

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Now the joyful bells a-ring, All ye mountains of the Lord!
Lift our hearts like birds a-winging,
All ye mountains, praise the Lord!
Now our festal season bringing Kinsmen all to bide and board,
All ye mountains, praise the Lord!

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Dear our home as dear none other;
Where the mountains praise the Lord!
Gladly here our care we smother;
Where the mountains praise the Lord!
Here we know that Christ our brother Binds us all as by a cord: He was born of Mary mother Where the mountains praise the Lord!

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Cold the year, new whiteness wearing,
All ye mountains, praise the Lord!
Peace, good will to us a-bearing,
All ye mountains, praise the Lord!
Now we all God's goodness sharing Break the bread and sheath the Sword: Bright our hearths the signal flaring,
All ye mountains, praise the Lord!

translations.title: Every Star Shall Sing a Carol

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Every star shall sing a carol;
Come and praise the King of heaven By whatever name you know.
God above, Man below, Holy is the name I know.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: When the King of all creation Had a cradle on the earth,
God above, Man below, Holy is the name I know.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Come and praise the King of heaven By whatever name you know.
God above, Man below, Holy is the name I know.

translations.title: Praise the Lord, His Glories Show

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Praise the Lord, His glories show, Alleluia!
Saints within His courts below, Alleluia!
All that see and share His love, Alleluia!

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Earth to heaven and heaven to earth, Alleluia!
Tell His wonders, sing His worth, Alleluia!
Age to age and shore to shore, Alleluia!

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Praise the Lord, His mercies trace, Alleluia!
Praise His providence and grace, Alleluia!
All that He for man hath done, Alleluia!
All He sends us through His Son.

translations.title: Praise the Lord! You Heavens Adore Him

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Praise the Lord: you heavens, adore Him;
Praise Him, angels in the height;
Sun and moon, rejoice before Him; praise Him, all you stars of light.
Praise the Lord, for He has spoken; worlds His mighty voice obeyed.
Laws which never shall be broken for their guidance He has made.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Praise the Lord! for He is glorious; never shall His promise fail.
God has made His saints victorious; sin and death shall not prevail.
Praise the God of our salvation! hosts on high,
Heaven and earth and all creation, laud and magnify His Name.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Worship, honor, glory, blessing, Lord, we offer as our gift.
Our glad songs to You we lift.
All the saints in heaven adore You; we would join their glad acclaim;
As Your angels serve before You, so on earth we praise Your name.

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Your festal banner wave on high, The cross of Christ your King.

sections.label: Refrain
lines: Rejoice, rejoice, rejoice, Give thanks and sing.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: With voice as full and strong As ocean's surging praise,
Send forth the sturdy hymns of old,

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: With all the saints of earth,
Pour out the strains of joy and bliss,

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: Yes, on through life's long path, Still chanting as ye go;
From youth to age, by night and day, In gladness and in woe.

sections.label: Verse 5
lines: Praise Him who reigns on high, The Lord whom we adore, The Father, Son and Holy Ghost, One God forever more.

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Praise we the Lord, who made all beauty For all our senses to enjoy;
Owe we our humble thanks and duty That simple pleasures never cloy;
Praise we the Lord, who made all beauty For all our senses to enjoy.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Praise Him who loves to see young lovers,
Fresh hearts that swell with youthful pride;
Thank Him who sends the sun above us,
As bridegroom fit to meet his bride;
Praise Him who loves to see young lovers,
Fresh hearts that swell with youthful pride.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Praise Him who by a simple flower Lifts up our hearts to things above;
Thank Him who gives to each one power To find a friend to know and love;
Praise Him who by a simple flower Lifts up our hearts to things above.

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Sing praise to God who reigns above, the God of all creation, the God of power, the God of love, the God of our salvation.
With healing balm my soul He fills, and every faithless murmur stills;
To God all praise and glory!

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: What God's almighty power hath made His gracious mercy keepeth;
By morning glow or evening shade,
Within the kingdom of his might, Lo! all is just, and all is right: To God all praise and glory!

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: The Lord is never far away, throughout all grief distressing, an ever present help and stay, our peace and joy and blessing.
As with a mother's tender hand,
His chosen band: To God all praise and glory!

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: Then all my gladsome way along,
I sing aloud thy praises, that men may hear the grateful song my voice unwearied raises: Be joyful in the Lord, my heart! both soul and body bear your part!
To God all praise and glory.

translations.title: Holy God, We Praise Your Name

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Holy God, we praise Your name;
Lord of all, we bow before You!
All on earth Your scepter claim, All in heaven above adore You;

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Hark! the loud celestial hymn Angel choirs above are raising,
Fill the heavens with sweet accord: Holy, holy, holy, Lord.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Holy Father, Holy Son, Holy Spirit, three we name You;
While in essence only one, Undivided God we claim You;
And adoring bend the knee, While we own the mystery.

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Tell out my soul, the greatness of the Lord: Unnumbered blessings, give my spirit voice;
Tender to me the promise of His Word;
In God my Saviour shall my heart rejoice.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Tell out, my soul, the greatness of His name: Make known His might, the deeds His arm has done;
His mercy sure, from age to age the same;
His holy name, the Lord, the Mighty One.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Tell out, my soul, the greatness of His might: Pow'rs and dominions lay their glory by;
Proud hearts and stubborn wills are put to flight,
The hungry fed, the humble lifted high.

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: Tell out, my soul, the glories of His word: Firm is His promise, and His mercy sure.
Tell out, my soul, the greatness of the Lord To children's children and forevermore.

translations.title: When in Our Music God is Glorified

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: When in our music God is glorified,
And adoration leaves no room for pride, It is as though the whole creation cried: Alleluia!

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: How oft, in making music, we have found A new dimension in the world of sound,
As worship moved us to a more profound Alleluia!

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: And did not Jesus sing a psalm that night When utmost evil strove against the light?
Then let us sing for whom He won the fight: Alleluia!

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: Let every instrument be used for praise;
Let all rejoice who have a voice to raise;
And may God give us faith to sing always: Alleluia!

translations.title: Sing a New Song to the Lord

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Sing a new song to the Lord, He to whom wonders belong.
Rejoice in His triumph and tell of His power.
O sing a new song to the Lord.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Now to the ends of the earth See His salvation is shown.
And still He remembers His mercy and truth,
Unchanging in love to His own.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Sing a new song and rejoice.
Let voices in chorus with trumpet and horn,
Resound for the joy of the Lord.

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: Join with the hills and the sea, Thunders of praise to prolong.
In judgement and justice He comes to the earth O sing a new song to the Lord.

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Wake the song of joy and gladness;
Sing to Him whose care has brought us Once again with friends to meet,
And whose loving voice has taught us Of the way to Jesus' feet.

sections.label: Refrain
lines: Wake the song, wake the song,
The song of joy and gladness,
Wake the song, wake the song,

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Joyfully with songs and banners, We will greet the festal day;
Shout aloud our glad hosannas, And our grateful homage pay.
We will chant our Savior's glory while our thoughts we raise above,
Telling still the old, old, story,

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Thanks to Thee, O holy Father, For the mercies of the year;
May each heart, as here we gather,
Breathe upon us, Holy Spirit, Sweetly draw us near to God.

sections.label: சரணம் 1
lines: துக்க நினைவை யகற்றித் தொனியாய்ப் போற்றிப் பாடு.
நண்பர் ஒன்றாய்க் கூட நன்மை செய்த தேவனைத் துதி;
எம்மை அவர் அன்பின் சத்தம் ஏவிற்றே ஏசு பாதம்.

sections.label: சரணம் 2
lines: ரட்சகர் மகிமை சொல்லி ரட்சை செய்தி கூறுவோம்;
சிந்தையில் மேல் நோக்கி மேலாய்ச் சிலுவைக் காட்சி சொல்வோம்;

sections.label: சரணம் 3
lines: தேவ ஆவி, ஊதும் எம்மில் தேவனிடம் சேர்த்திடும்.

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Thukka Ninaivai Yakatrith Thoniyaaip Potrip Paatu.
Nanpar Ondraaik Koota Nanmai Seydha Thevanaith Thudhi;
Emmai Avar Anpin Saththam Evitre Esu Paadham.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Ratchakar Makimai Solli Ratchai Seydhi Kooruvom;
Sindhaiyil Mel Nokki Melaaich Chiluvaik Kaatchi Solvom;

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Theva Aavi, Oodhum Emmil Thevanitam Serththitum.

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: With songs and honors sounding loud, Address the Lord on high;
Over the heavens He spreads His cloud, And waters veil the sky.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: He sends His showers of blessing down To cheer the plains below;
He makes the grass the mountains crown, And corning valleys grow.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: His steady counsels change the face Of the declining year;
He bids the sun cut short his race, And wintry days appear.

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: He sends His word, and melts the snow;
He calls the warmer gales to blow, And bids the spring return.

sections.label: Verse 5
lines: The changing wind, the flying cloud,
Obey His mighty word: With songs and honors sounding loud Praise ye the sovereign Lord!

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: O Thou in whose presence my soul takes delight,
On whom in affliction I call,
My comfort by day and my song in the night,
My hope, my salvation, my all!

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: His voice, as the sound of the dulcimer sweet, Is heard through the shadows of death;
The cedars of Lebanon bow at His feet,
The air is perfumed with His breath.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: His lips, as a fountain of righteousness flow,
To water the gardens of grace;
From which their salvation the Gentiles shall know,
And bask in the smiles of His face.

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: He looks, and ten thousands of angels rejoice,
And myriads wait for His word;
He speaks, and eternity, filled with His voice, Re-echoes the praise of the Lord.

translations.title: O Sing, My Soul, Your Maker's Praise

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: O sing my soul, your Maker's praise In grateful hymns ascending;
Whose steadfast love has crowned your days With heav'nly gifts un ending.
I sought the Lord, He heard my cry;
His holy angels hover nigh The tents of those who love Him.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: The Lord is good to those who seek His face in time of sorrow,
Providing comfort to the weak And grace for each tomorrow.
Though grief may tarry for a night,
The morn shall break in joy and light With blessings from His presence.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: The Lord will turn His face in peace When troubled souls draw near Him;
His loving kindness shall not cease To those who trust and fear Him.
Our God will not forsake His own;

translations.title: கர்த்தாவே, நாங்கள் நெஞ்சத்தில் மெய்ஞ் ஞானமற்ற மாந்தர்

sections.label: சரணம் 1
lines: கர்த்தாவே, நாங்கள் நெஞ்சத்தில் மெய்ஞ் ஞானமற்ற மாந்தர்;
உம்மால் உண்டான வேதத்தால், உம் ஆவியின் சகாயத்தால்,

sections.label: சரணம் 2
lines: உம் திரு வார்த்தையைத் தினம் எல்லாரும் பக்தியாக
வாசித்து, கேட்டு, சிந்தித்து, உட்கொள்ள நீர் கடாட்சித்து,

sections.label: சரணம் 3
lines: பிதாவே! எங்கும் ஜீவனாம் உம் வார்த்தை செல்வதாக;
ஆ! யேசுவே, நீர் சென்றதாம் செந்நெறி செல்வோமாக,
நல்லாவியை எம் உள்ளத்தில் இறக்கி வார்த்தையால் அதில்

translations.title: Karththaave, Naangal Nenjaththil Meynj Gnaanamatra Maandhar

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Karththaave, Naangal Nenjaththil Meynj Gnaanamatra Maandhar;
Ummaal Untaana Vedhaththaal, Um Aaviyin Sakaayaththaal,

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Um Thiru Vaarththaiyaith Thinam Ellaarum Pakdhiyaaka
Vaasiththu, Kettu, Sindhiththu, Utkolla Neer Kataatchiththu,

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Pidhaave! Engum Jeevanaam Um Vaarththai Selvadhaaka;
Aa! Yesuve, Neer Sendradhaam Senneri Selvomaaka,
Nallaaviyai Em Ullaththil Irakki Vaarththaiyaal Adhil

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Stretch forth to things eternal And hasten to the feet of your Redeemer God.
Though hid from mortal eyes, He dwells in light supernal;
Yet worship Him in humbleness and call Him Lord.
His banquet of love Awaits you above;
Yet here He grants a foretaste of the feast to come!
To heav'n lift up your voice: Alleluia, alleluia, alleluia!

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Now hear the harps of heav'n!
The never-ending anthem sounding through the sky!
To mortals is not giv'n To join in strains so glorious;
Yet here on earth we too can sing our praises high!
He bought with His blood The ransomed of God;
To Him be everlasting pow'r and victory.
And let the great amen Resound through heav'n again.

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Lord, in the morning Thou shalt hear My voice ascending high;
To Thee will I direct my prayer, To Thee lift up mine eye-

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Up to the hills where Christ is gone To plead for all His saints,
Presenting at His Father's throne Our songs and our complaints.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: O may Thy Spirit guide my feet In ways of righteousness;
Make every path of duty straight And plain before my face.

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: The men that love and fear Thy name Shall see their hopes fulfilled;
The mighty God will compass them With favor as a shield.

translations.title: The Dawn of God's Dear Sabbath

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: The dawn of God's dear Sabbath Breaks o'er the earth again,
As some sweet summer morning After a night of pain;
It comes as cooling showers To some exhausted land,
As shade of clustered palm trees 'Mid weary wastes of sand.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Lord, we would bring for offering,
Though marred with earthly soil, A week of earnest labor,
Of strong, deep love to Thee,

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: And we would bring our burden Of sinful thought and deed,
Our heart's most bitter sorrow For all Thy work undone- So many talents wasted!

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: And with that sorrow mingling, A steadfast faith, and sure,
And love so deep and fervent,
For Thee to make it pure,
In Thy dear presence finding The pardon that we need,
And then the peace so lasting- Celestial peace indeed.

translations.title: O Splendor of God's Glory Bright

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: O splendor of God's glory bright,
O Light of life, light's living spring,

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: O Thou true Sun, on us Thy glance Let fall in royal radiance;
The Spirit's sanctifying beam Upon our earthly senses stream.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: O joyful be the passing day With thoughts as clear as morning's ray,
With faith like noontide shining bright,
Our souls unshadowed by the night.

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: Dawn's glory gilds the earth and skies;
Let Him, our perfect morn, arise;
The Father's help His children claim,
And sing the Father's glorious name.

translations.title: Now That the Daylight Fills the Sky

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Now that the daylight fills the sky,
We lift our hearts to God on high,
That He, in all we do or say,
Would keep us free from harm today;

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Would guard our hearts and tongues from strife;
From anger's din would shield our life;
From evil sights would turn our eyes,
And close our ears to vanities;

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: So we, when this new day is gone And night in turn is drawing on,
With conscience by the world unstained Shall praise His name for vict'ry gained.

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: All praise to You, eternal Word!
O Spirit wise!' We sing as daylight fills the skies.

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: When morning gilds the skies my heart awaking cries,
Alike at work and prayer, to Jesus I repair: May Jesus Christ be praised!

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Whene'er the sweet church bell peals over hill and dell,
O hark to what it sings, as joyously it rings,

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: The night becomes as day when from the heart we say: May Jesus Christ be praised!
The powers of darkness fear when this sweet chant they hear: May Jesus Christ be praised!

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: Ye nations of mankind, in this your concord find,
Let all the earth around ring joyous with the sound,

sections.label: Verse 5
lines: In heaven's eternal bliss the loveliest strain is this,
Let earth, and sea and sky from depth to height reply,

sections.label: Verse 6
lines: Be this, while life is mine, my canticle divine: May Jesus Christ be praised!
Be this th'eternal song through all the ages long,

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Morning has broken like the first morning,
Blackbird has spoken like the first bird.
Praise for the singing!Praise for the morning!
Praise for the springing fresh from the Word!

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Sweet the rain's new fall sunlit from heaven,
Like the first dewfall on the first grass.
Praise for the sweetness of the wet garden,
Sprung in completeness where His feet pass.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Mine is the morning Born of the one light Eden saw play!
God's recreation of the new day!

translations.title: Open Now Thy Gates of Beauty

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Open now thy gates of beauty,
Where my soul in joyful duty Waits for God Who answers prayer.
Oh, how bless'd is this place,
Filled with solace, light, and grace!

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Gracious God, I come before Thee, Come Thou also unto me;
Where we find Thee and adore Thee,
There a heav'n on earth must be.
To my heart, oh, enter Thou, Let it be Thy temple now!

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Here Thy praise is gladly chanted, Here Thy seed is duly sown;
Let my soul, where it is planted,
Bring forth precious sheaves alone, So that all I hear may be Fruitful unto life in me.

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: Thou my faith increase and quicken,
Let me keep Thy gift divine,
May Thy Word still o'er me shine As my guiding star through life,
As my comfort in my strife.

sections.label: Verse 5
lines: Speak, O God, and I will hear Thee, Let Thy will be done indeed;
May I undisturbed draw near Thee While Thou dost Thy people feed.
Here of life the fountain flows;
Here is balm for all our woes.

translations.title: ஆத்துமாவே, உன்னை ஜோடி, துக்கம் யாவையும் விடு

sections.label: சரணம் 1
lines: ஆத்துமாவே, உன்னை ஜோடி, துக்கம் யாவையும் விடு;

translations.title: Aaththumaave, Unnai Joti, Thukkam Yaavaiyum Vitu

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Aaththumaave, Unnai Joti, Thukkam Yaavaiyum Vitu;

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: The day is past and gone;
The shadows of the evening fall;
Within my heart a welcome guest, Within my home abide;

sections.label: Refrain
lines: O Savior, stay this night with me;
O Savior, stay this night with me;

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Thy walk today with me Has made my heart within me burn,
Thy earnest words have filled my soul And kept me near Thy side;

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: And lone will be the night, If I cannot commune with Thee,
Nor find in Thee my light.
The darkness of the world, I fear, Would in my home abide;

translations.title: God, Who Made the Earth and Heaven

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: God, who made the earth and heaven,
Darkness and light: You the day for work have given,
May Your angel guards defend us,
Slumber sweet Your mercy send us,
Holy dreams and hopes attend us All through the night.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: And when morn again shall call us to run life's way,
May we still, what-e'er befall us,
From the pow'r of evil hide us,
In the narrow pathway guide us,
Never be Your smile denied us All through the day.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Guard us waking, guard us sleeping,
May we in Your mighty keeping All peaceful lie.
When the trumpet call shall wake us, Then, O Lord, do not forsake us, But to reign in glory take us with You on high.

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: Blest Three in One: Grant us grace, we now implore You,
Till we lay our crowns before You And in worthier strains adore You while ages run.

translations.title: Softly Now the Light of Day

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Softly now the light of day Fades upon out sight away: Free from care, from labor free,
Lord, we would commune with Thee.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Thou, whose allpervading eye Nought escapes, without, within,

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Soon from us the light of day Shall forever pass away;
Then, from sin and sorrow free, Take us, Lord, to dwell with Thee.

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Savior, breathe an evening blessing, Ere repose our spirits seal;
Sin and want we come confessing;
Thou canst save, and Thou canst heal.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Though the night be dark and dreary,
Thou art He who, never weary, Watchest where Thy people be.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Though the arrow past us fly,
Angel guards from Thee Surround us,
We are safe if Thou art nigh.

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: Should swift death this night o're-take us,
And our couch become our tomb,
May the morn of glory wake us,
Clad in light and deathless bloom.

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Abide with me; fast falls the eventide;
When other helpers fail and comforts flee,

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Swift to its close ebbs out life's little day;
Earth's joys grow dim; its glories pass away;
Change and decay in all around I see;
O Thou who changest not, abide with me.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: I need Thy presence every passing hour.
What but Thy grace can foil the tempter's power?
Who, like Thyself, my guide and stay can be?
Through cloud and sunshine, Lord, abide with me.

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: I fear no foe, with Thee at hand to bless;
Ills have no weight, and tears no bitterness.
I triumph still, if Thou abide with me!

sections.label: சரணம் 2
lines: நீர் மேலே குமிழ் போல் என் ஆயுசும்

sections.label: சரணம் 3
lines: நீர் என் துணை என் பாதை காட்டியும்

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Neer Mele Kumizh Pol En Aayusum

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Neer En Thunai En Paadhai Kaattiyum

translations.title: Day Is Dying in the West

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Day is dying in the west;
Heaven is touching earth with rest;
Wait and worship while the night Sets the evening lamps alight Through all the sky.

sections.label: Refrain
lines: Holy, holy, holy, Lord God of Hosts!
Heaven and earth are full of Thee!
Heaven and earth are praising Thee, O Lord most high!

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Lord of life, beneath the dome Of the universe, Thy home, Gather us who seek Thy face To the fold of Thy embrace, For Thou art nigh.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Through the glory and the grace Of the stars that veil Thy face,

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: When forever from our sight Pass the stars, the day, the night,
Lord of angels, on our eyes Let eternal morning rise And shadows end.

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Now the day is over, night is drawing nigh,
Shadows of the evening steal across the sky.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Father, give the weary, calm and sweet repose;
With Thy tenderest blessing May our eyelids close.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Through the long night watches, may thine angels spread Their white wings above me, watching round my bed.

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: All praise to thee, my God, this night, for all the blessings of the light!
Keep me, O keep me, King of kings, beneath thine own almighty wings.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Forgive me, Lord, for thy dear Son, the ill that I this day have done, that with the world, myself, and thee, I, ere I sleep, at peace may be.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: O may my soul on thee repose, and with sweet sleep mine eyelids close, sleep that may me more vigorous make to serve my God when I awake.

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: Praise God, from whom all blessings flow; praise him, all creatures here below; praise him above, ye heavenly host; praise Father,

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: To Thee of right belongs All praise of holy songs,
O Son of God, life giver;
The world doth glorify And shall exalt forever.

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Jesus, tender Shepherd, hear me, Bless Thy little lamb tonight;
Through the darkness be Thou near me;
Watch my sleep till morning light.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: All this day Thy hand has led me, And I thank Thee for Thy care;
Thou hast clothed me, warmed and fed me;

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Lord, is ended; the darkness falls at Thy behest; to Thee our morning hymns ascended;
Thy praise shall hallow now our rest.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: We thank Thee that Thy church, unsleeping while earth rolls onward into light, through all the world her watch is keeping, and rests not now by day or night.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: As o'er each continent and island the dawn leads on another day, the voice of prayer is never silent, nor die the strains of praise away.

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: Thy throne shall never, like earth's proud empires, pass away.
Thy kingdom stands, and grows forever, till all Thy creatures own Thy sway.

translations.title: Now All the Woods Are Sleeping

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Now all the woods are sleeping,
And night and stillness creeping O'er city, man, and beast;
But thou, my heart, awake thee,
To pray'r awhile be take thee,
And praise thy Maker ere thou rest.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: My Jesus, stay Thou by me,
And let no foe come nigh me,
But would the foe alarm me,
O let him never harm me,
But still Thine angels round me sing!

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: From every peril surely Our God will guard your heads;
And bid His hosts attend you,
And golden armed watch o'er your beds.

translations.title: Hark, the Vesper Hymn Is Stealing

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Hark! the vesper hymn is stealing O'er the waters soft and clear;

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Nearer yet, and nearer pealing, Soft it breaks upon the ear.

translations.title: Great Our Joy as Now We Gather

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Great our joy as now we gather Where the Master makes us one: Where we worship God the Father Thro' the Spirit of His Son.
All who search for His church Find it where His will is done.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Precious is the tie that binds us To our God when faith grows cold;
Precious all that now reminds us He is still our safe stronghold.
Faithful love serves to prove Here the Shepherd has His fold.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: May we learn from Christ's example How to use this house of prayer: He who loved and cleansed His temple Wants us all to worship there.
God the Son shuts out none: In His kingdom all may share.

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: Lord, inspire us with Your vision Of a world which must be won!
Glorious is the church's mission, Long endeavoured, scarce begun!
Faithful now ' this is how God's eternal will is done.

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Blessed Jesus, at Thy word, We have gathered all to hear Thee;
By Thy word our hearts were stirred,
Now to seek and love and fear Thee.
By Thy teachings sweet and holy,
Let us learn to love Thee solely.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: All our knowledge, sense, and sight,
Till Thy Spirit breaks our night,
With His beams of truth unclouded.
He alone to God canst win us, He who works all good within us.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Light of light, from God proceeding.
Open Thou our ears and heart Help us, by Thy Spirit's pleading.
Hear the cry Thy people raises!
Hear, and bless our prayer and praises!

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: God is here as we his people meet to offer praise and prayer, may we find in fuller measure what it is in Christ we share.
Here, as in the world around us, all our varied skills and arts wait the coming of his Spirit into open minds and hearts.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Here are symbols to remind us of our lifelong need of grace; here are table, font and pulpit; here the Word has central place.
Here in honesty of preaching, here in silence, as in speech, here in newness and renewal,
God the Spirit comes to each.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Here our children find a welcome in the Shepherd's flock and fold.
Here, as bread and wine are taken, Christ sustains us, as of old.
Here the servants of the Servant seek in worship to explore what it means in daily living to believe and to adore.

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: Church and Kingdom, in an age of change and doubt, keep us faithful to the Gospel, help us work your purpose out.
Here, in this day's dedication, all we have to give, receive: we, who cannot live without you, we adore you!

translations.title: How Lovely Is Thy Dwelling Place

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: How lovely is Thy dwelling place, O Lord of hosts to me!
The tabenacles of Thy grace How pleasant, Lord, they be!

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: My thirsty soul longs ardently, Yea, faints Thy courts to see;
My very heart and flesh cry out, O living God, for Thee.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Behold the sparrow findeth out A house where-in to rest;
The swallow also, for herself Provided hath a nest.

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: Ev'n Thine own altars, where she safe Her young ones forth may bring,
O Thou, almighty Lord of hosts,
Who art my God and King.

sections.label: Verse 5
lines: Blest are they in Thy house that dwell,
Blest is the man whose strength Thou art,
In whose heart are Thy ways.

translations.title: O Come, Let Us Sing to the Lord

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: O come, let us sing to the Lord,
Come let us every one A joyful noise make to the Rock Of our salvation.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Let us before His presence come With glad and thankful voice;
Let us sing psalms of praise to Him, And make a joyful noise.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: For God, a great God and great King, Above all gods, He is;
The depths of earth are in His hand,
The strength of hills is His.

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: To Him the ocean vast belongs, For He the sea did make;
The dry land also from His hands, Its form at first did take.

sections.label: Verse 5
lines: O come, bow down and worship Him,
Come to our Maker and our God,

translations.title: Lord, Dismiss Us With Thy Blessing

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Lord, dismiss us with thy blessing; fill our hearts with joy and peace; let us each, thy love possessing, triumph in redeeming grace.
O refresh us, O refresh us, traveling through this wilderness.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Thanks we give and adoration for thy gospel's joyful sound.
May the fruits of thy salvation in our hearts and lives abound; ever faithful, ever faithful to the truth may we be found.

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: God be with you till we meet again;
By His counsels guide, uphold you,
With His sheep securely fold you;
God be with you till we meet again.

sections.label: Refrain
lines: Till we meet, till we meet, Till we meet at Jesus' feet;
Till we meet, till we meet, God be with you till we meet again.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: God be with you till we meet again;
God be with you till we meet again.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: God be with you till we meet again;
When life's perils thick confound you;
Put His arms unfailing round you;
God be with you till we meet again.

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: God be with you till we meet again;
Keep love's banner floating over you,
Strike death's threatening wave before you;
God be with you till we meet again.

translations.title: சொற்பக் காலம் பிரிந்தாலும், பார்! பின்பு ஏக சபையாக

sections.label: சரணம் 1
lines: சொற்பக் காலம் பிரிந்தாலும், பார்! பின்பு ஏக சபையாக

sections.label: சரணம் 2
lines: அதுகாறும் தேவன் தாங்குவார்; மிக்க ஞானத்தால் நடத்தி,
மோச மின்றியும் காப்பாற்றி அதுகாறும் தேவன் தாங்குவார்.

sections.label: சரணம் 3
lines: அதுகாறும் தேவன் தாங்குவார்; சிறகாலே மூடி வைத்து,
மன்னா தந்து போஷிப்பித்து, அதுகாறும் தேவன் தாங்குவார்.

sections.label: சரணம் 4
lines: அதுகாறும் தேவன் தாங்குவார்; நாச மோசம் நேரிட்டாலும்,
கையில் ஏந்தி, அன்பினாலே அதுகாறும் தேவன் தாங்குவார்.

sections.label: சரணம் 5
lines: சாவும் தோற்றுப் பயந்தோடும்; அதுகாறும் தேவன் தாங்குவார்.

translations.title: Sorpak Kaalam Pirindhaalum, Paar! Pinpu Eka Sapaiyaaka

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Sorpak Kaalam Pirindhaalum, Paar! Pinpu Eka Sapaiyaaka

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Adhukaarum Thevan Thaanguvaar; Mikka Gnaanaththaal Nataththi,
Mosa Mindriyum Kaappaatri Adhukaarum Thevan Thaanguvaar.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Adhukaarum Thevan Thaanguvaar; Sirakaale Mooti Vaiththu,
Mannaa Thandhu Poshippiththu, Adhukaarum Thevan Thaanguvaar.

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: Adhukaarum Thevan Thaanguvaar; Naasa Mosam Nerittaalum,
Kaiyil Endhi, Anpinaale Adhukaarum Thevan Thaanguvaar.

sections.label: Verse 5
lines: Saavum Thotrup Payandhotum; Adhukaarum Thevan Thaanguvaar.

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: God be with you till we meet again;
By His counsels guide, uphold you,
With His sheep securely fold you: God be with you till we meet again.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: God be with you till we meet again;
Neath His wings securely hide you,
Daily manna still provide you: God be with you till we meet again.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: God be with you till we meet again;
When life's perils thick confound you,
Put His arms unfailing round you: God be with you till we meet again.

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: God be with you till we meet again;
Keep love's banner floating o'er you,
Smite death's threatening wave before you: God be with you till we meet again.

translations.title: O Lord, Now Let Your Servant

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: O Lord, now let Your servant Depart in heav'nly peace,
For I have seen the glory Of Your redeeming grace: A light to lead the Gentiles Unto Your holy hill,

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Then grant that I may follow Your gleam,
And faith is changed to sight;
Till raptured saints shall gather Upon that shining shore,
Where Christ, the blessed Day star,

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: On our way rejoicing Gladly let us go;
Conquer'd hath our Leader, Vanquish'd is the foe.
Who, if we be faithful, Can our hope destroy?

sections.label: Refrain
lines: On our way rejoicing As we forward move,

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Unto God the Father Joyful songs we sing,
Unto God the Savior Thankful hearts we bring,
Unto God the Spirit Bow we and adore,
On our way rejoicing Now and evermore.

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Lord, make us more holy Until we meet again.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Lord, make us more faithful Until we meet again.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Lord, make us more humble Until we meet again.

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: Lord, make us more loving Until we meet again.
Like Jesus, the Saviour, Until we meet again.

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Praise ye the Father for His loving kindness,
Tenderly cares He for His erring children;
Praise Him, ye angels, praise Him in the heavens;

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Praise ye the Savior, great is the compassion,
Graciously cares He for His chosen people;
Young men and maidens, ye old men and children,

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Praise ye the Spirit, comforter of Israel,
Sent of the Father and the Son to bless us;

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Come, Thou almighty King, Help us Thy name to sing, Help us to praise!
Father all glorious, O'er all victorious,

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Come, Thou incarnate Word, Gird on Thy mighty sword, Our prayer attend;
Come, and Thy people bless, And give Thy Word success;
Spirit of holiness, On us descend!

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: In this glad hour: Thou who almighty art,

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: To Thee, great One in Three,
Hence, evermore: Thy sovereign majesty May we in glory see,
And to eternity Love and adore!

translations.title: நீர் வாரும், ராஜாவே! உம் நாமம் துதிக்க

sections.label: சரணம் 1
lines: நீர் வாரும், ராஜாவே! உம் நாமம் துதிக்க

translations.title: Neer Vaarum, Raajaave! Um Naamam Thudhikka

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Neer Vaarum, Raajaave! Um Naamam Thudhikka

translations.title: Creator of the Stars of Night

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Creator of the stars of night, Thy people's everlasting light, O Christ, Thou Saviour of us all, We pray Thee, hear us when we call.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: At the great name of Jesus, now All knees must bend, all hearts must bow;
And things celestial Thee shall own, And things terrestrial, Lord alone.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Laud, honour, might, and glory be From age to age eternally.

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Early in the morning our song shall rise to Thee;
Holy, holy, holy, merciful and mighty!
God in three Persons, blessed Trinity!

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Casting down their golden crowns around the glassy sea;
Thousands and ten thousands worship low before Thee,
Which wert, and art, and evermore shalt be.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Holy, holy, holy! though the darkness hide Thee,
Though the eye of sinful man Thy glory may not see;
Only Thou art holy; there is none beside Thee,
Perfect in power, in love, and purity.

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: All Thy works shall praise Thy name, in earth, and sky, and sea;
Holy, holy, holy; merciful and mighty!
God in three Persons, blessed Trinity!

sections.label: சரணம் 1
lines: தூய, தூய, தூய, சர்வ வல்ல நாதா!

sections.label: சரணம் 2
lines: தூய, தூய, தூய, அன்பர் சூழ நின்று

sections.label: சரணம் 3
lines: பாவக்கண்ணால் உம் மாண்பைக் காண யார் வல்லோர்?

sections.label: சரணம் 4
lines: தூய, தூய, தூய, சர்வ வல்ல நாதா!

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Thooya, Thooya, Thooya, Sarva Valla Naadhaa!

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Thooya, Thooya, Thooya, Anpar Soozha Nindru

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Paavakkannaal Um Maanpaik Kaana Yaar Vallor?

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: Thooya, Thooya, Thooya, Sarva Valla Naadhaa!

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Like a river glorious, is God's perfect peace,
Over all victorious, in its bright increase;
Perfect, yet it floweth, fuller every day,
Perfect, yet it groweth, deeper all the way.

sections.label: Refrain
lines: Stayed upon Jehovah, hearts are fully blessed Finding, as He promised, perfect peace and rest.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Hidden in the hollow of His blessed hand,
Never foe can follow, never traitor stand;
Not a surge of worry, not a shade of care,
Not a blast of hurry touch the spirit there.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Every joy or trial falleth from above,
Traced upon our dial by the Sun of Love;
We may trust Him fully all for us to do.
They who trust Him wholly find Him wholly true.

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: There's the wonder of sunset at evening,
The wonder as sunrise I see;
But the wonder of wonders that thrills my soul Is the wonder that God loves me.

sections.label: Refrain
lines: O, the wonder of it all!
Just to think that God loves me.
O, the wonder of it all!
Just to think that God loves me.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: There's the wonder of springtime and harvest,
The sky, the stars, the sun;
But the wonder of wonders that thrills my soul Is the wonder that's only begun.

translations.title: O Love That Wilt Not Let Me Go

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: O Love that wilt not let me go, I rest my weary soul in thee;
I give thee back the life I owe, that in thine ocean depths its flow may richer, fuller be.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: O Light that followest all my way,
I yield my flickering torch to thee; my heart restores its borrowed ray, that in they sunshine's blaze its day may brighter, fairer be.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: O Joy that seekest me through pain,
I cannot close my heart to thee;
I trace the rainbow thru the rain, and feel the promise is not vain, that morn shall tearless be.

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: O Cross that liftest up my head, I dare not ask to fly from thee;
I lay in dust life's glory dead, and from the ground there blossoms red life that shall endless be.

translations.title: O Love of God Most Full

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: O love of God most full,
O love of God most free,
Come warm my heart, come fill my soul,

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Warm as the glowing sun So shines Thy love on me, It wraps me 'round with kindly care, It draws me unto Thee.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: The darkest night is full of light,

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: O love of God most full,
O love of God most free, It warms my heart, it fills my soul,

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: He sent the Savior: For God so loved us, and loves me too.

sections.label: Refrain
lines: I'll sing His praises, God loves His children, loves even me.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: He sent the Savior, the blest Redeemer;
He sent the Savior to set me free.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: He bade me welcome, O word of mercy;
He bade me welcome, O voice divine.

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: To Him be given while life shall last.

sections.label: சரணம் 2
lines: ஐயோ! நான் பாவி, நான் கெட்டுப் போனேன்;

sections.label: சரணம் 4
lines: அவர் என் மேய்ப்பர், என் வானத் தப்பம்;

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Aiyo! Naan Paavi, Naan Kettup Ponen;

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: Avar En Meyppar, En Vaanath Thappam;

translations.title: O Love of God, How Strong and True!

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: O love of God, how strong and true!
Beyond all knowledge and all thought.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: O love of God, how deep and great,
Far deeper than man's deepest hate;

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: We read thee best in Him who cam To bear for us the cross of shame;
Sent by the Father from on high,
Our life to live, our death to die.

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: We read thy power to bless and save, E'en in the darkness of the grave;
Still more in resurrection light We read the fullness of thy might.

sections.label: Verse 5
lines: O love of God, our shield and stay Through all the perils of our way!
Eternal love, in thee we rest, Forever safe, forever blest.

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: O world of God, so vast and strange,
Beyond the utmost reach of thought,
But not beyond a Father's care!
We are not strangers on this earth Whirling amid the suns of space;
We are God's children, this our home,
With those of every clime and race.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: O world of man where life is lived, So strangely mingling joy and pain, So full of evil and of good, So needful that the god shall reign!
It is this world that God has loved,
And goodness was its Maker's plan,
The promise of God's triumph is His coming in a Son of Man.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: O world of time's far-stretching years!
There was a day when time stood still, A central moment when there rose A cross upon a cruel hill;
In pain and death love's power was seen,
The wisdom of the ways of God,
The grace through which man's hurt is healed.

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Though I speak with tongues of men and angels,
Though I have the prophet's gift,
Though I hold the keys to hidden knowledge,
Though my faith can mountains shift;
Without love I am no better, Without love it's all for naught;
Lord, You spent Your life in loving others: What this means I would be taught.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Love is patient, knows no envy, Never gloats when others sin;
Love is never glad to see injustice,
Always wants the truth to win.
There's no end to love's endurance,
There's no test it cannot face;
Lord, You spent Your life in loving others: I shall fail without Your grace.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Though there'll be an end to hidden knowledge,
Visions, raptures, prophecy: Faith and hope and love shall last forever,
Love the greatest of the three.
Without love I am no better, Without love it's all for naught;
Lord, You gave Your life in saving others: What this means I would be taught.

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Before Jehovah's awful throne, Ye nations, bow with sacred joy;
Know that the Lord is God alone;
He can create, and He destroy.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: His sovereign power, without our aid,
Made us of clay, and formed us men; and when like wandering sheep we strayed,
He brought us to His fold again.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: We'll crowd His gates with thankful songs,
High as the heavens our voices raise;
And earth, with her ten thousand tongues,
Shall fill His courts with sounding praise.

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: Wide as the world is His command, Vast as Eternity His love;
Firm as a rock His truth shall stand,
When rolling years shall cease to move.

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: O worship the King, all glorious above,
O gratefully sing His wonderful love;
Our Shield and Defender, the Ancient of Days,
Pavilioned in splendor, and girded with praise.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Whose robe is the light, whose canopy space,
His chariots of wrath the deep thunderclouds form,
And dark is His path on the wings of the storm.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Thy bountiful care, what tongue can recite?
It breathes in the air, it shines in the light;
It streams from the hills, it descends to the plain,
And sweetly distills in the dew and the rain.

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: Frail children of dust, and feeble as frail,
In Thee do we trust, nor find Thee to fail;
Thy mercies how tender, how firm to the end!
Our Maker, Defender, Redeemer, and Friend.

sections.label: சரணம் 3
lines: உம் க்ருபை போதும் எங்கள் ஆயுள் மட்டும்.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Um Krupai Podhum Engal Aayul Mattum.

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: King, who ordainest Great winds Thy clarions, the lightnings Thy sword;
Show forth Thy pity on high where Thou reignest,

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: God the all merciful! earth hath forsaken Thy precepts holy, and slighted Thy word;
Bid not Thy wrath in its terrors awaken;
Give to us peace, O most merciful Lord.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: God the all righteousness One! man hath defied Thee;
Yet to eternity standeth Thy word;
Falsehood and wrong shall not tarry beside Thee;
Prosper the right, O most merciful Lord.

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: So shall we render Thee thankful devotion, For Thy deliverance from peril and sword, Singing in chorus from ocean to ocean, 'Thine is the power and the glory, O Lord.'

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Whose arm hath bound the restless wave,
Who bid'st the mighty ocean deep Its own appointed limits keep;
Oh hear us when we cry to Thee For those in peril on the sea.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: O Christ, whose voice the waters heard,
And hushed their raging at Thy word,
Who walkedst on the foaming deep,
And calm amidst its rage didst sleep;
Oh, hear us when we cry to Thee For those in peril on the sea.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: O Holy Spirit, who didst brood Upon the waters dark and rude,
And bid their angry tumult cease,
And give, for wild confusion, peace: Oh, hear us when we cry to Thee For those in peril on the sea.

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: O Trinity of love and power,
All trav'lers shield in danger's hour;
From rock and tempest, fire and foe,
Thus evermore shall rise to The Glad humns of praise from land and sea.

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: O Lord my God When I in awesome wonder Consider all the worlds Thy Hands have made I see the stars I hear the rolling thunder Thy power throughout the universe displayed

sections.label: Refrain
lines: Then sings my soul My Saviour God to Thee How great Thou art How great Thou art Then sings my soul My Saviour God to Thee How great Thou art How great Thou art

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: When through the woods And forest glades I wander And hear the birds sing sweetly in the trees When I look down From lofty mountain grandeur And see the brook and feel the gentle breeze

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: And when I think That God His Son not sparing Sent Him to die I scarce can take it in That on the Cross My burden gladly bearing He bled and died to take away my sin.

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: When Christ shall come With shouts of acclamation And take me home What joy shall fill my heart Then I shall bow In humble adoration And then proclaim 'My God, how great Thou art!'

translations.title: God Who Spoke in the Beginning

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: God who spoke in the beginning,
Set all life and growth in motion,
He who calls the earth to order Is the ground of what we are.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: God who spoke thro' men and nations,
Thro' events long past and gone,
He who calls the earth to order Gives His word and it is done.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: God whose speech becomes incarnate - Christ is servant,
Christ is Lord - Calls us to a life of service,
Heart and will to action stirred;
He who uses man's obedience Has the first and final word.

translations.title: I Sing the Migthy Power of God

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: I sing the almighty power of God, that made the mountains rise, that spread the flowing seas abroad, and built the lofty skies.
I sing the wisdom that ordained the sun to rule the day; the moon shines full at God's command, and all the stars obey.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: I sing the goodness of the Lord, who filled the earth with food, who formed the creatures thru the Word, and then pronounced them good.
Lord, how thy wonders are displayed, where'er I turn my eye, if I survey the ground I tread, or gaze upon the sky!

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: There's not a plant or flower below, but makes thy glories known, and clouds arise, and tempests blow, by order from thy thrown; while all that borrows life from thee is ever in thy care; and everywhere that we can be, thou,

translations.title: தேவப் பேராற்றல், வல்லமை நான் பாடுவேன் என்றும்

sections.label: சரணம் 1
lines: தேவப் பேராற்றல், வல்லமை நான் பாடுவேன் என்றும்
பணியும் தேவ மெய் ஞானம், நான் போற்றிப் பாடுவேன்.

sections.label: சரணம் 2
lines: நான் தங்கும் பூமி ஆகாயம் எங்கும் அவையெல்லாம்
படைப்பின் அற்புதக் காட்சி; நான் பாடுவேன் என்றும்.

sections.label: சரணம் 3
lines: கார்மேகம் சீறும் புயல்கள் அவர் கட்டளை கீழ்
உம் சமுகம் அல்லால் வேறு புகலிடம் காணோம்.

translations.title: Thevap Peraatral, Vallamai Naan Paatuven Endrum

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Thevap Peraatral, Vallamai Naan Paatuven Endrum
Paniyum Theva Mey Gnaanam, Naan Potrip Paatuven.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Naan Thangum Poomi Aakaayam Engum Avaiyellaam
Pataippin Arpudhak Kaatchi; Naan Paatuven Endrum.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Kaarmekam Seerum Puyalkal Avar Kattalai Keezh
Um Samukam Allaal Veru Pukalitam Kaanom.

translations.title: Let All on Earth Their Voices Raise

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Let all on earth their voices raise,
To sing the great Jehovah's praise,
And bless His holy name: His glory let the people know,
His wonders to the nations show,

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: He made the shining worlds on high,
And reigns in glory there: His beams are majesty and light;

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Come, the great day, the glorious hour,
When earth shall feel His saving power,
Then shall the race of men confess The beauty of His holiness,

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Eternal God, whose power upholds Both flower and flaming star,
To whom there is no here nor there, No time, no near nor far, No alien race, no foreign shore, No child unsought, unknown: O send us forth,
To make all lands Your own!

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: O God of truth, whom science seeks And reverent souls adore,
Illumine every earnest mind Of every clime and shore: Dispel the gloom of error's night,
Until true wisdom from above Shall make life's pathway clear!

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: O God of beauty, oft revealed In dreams of human art,
In speech that flows to melody,
In holiness of heart: Teach us to ban al ugliness,
Till all shall know the loveliness Of lives made fair and free!

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: O God of righteousness and grace, Seen in the Christ, Your Son, Whose life and death reveal Your face, By whom Your will was done;
Help us to spread Your gracious reign Till greed and hate shall cease,
And kindness dwell in human hearts,
And all the earth find peace!

translations.title: Ye Watchers and Ye Holy Ones

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Ye watchers and ye holy ones, Bright seraphs, cherubim and thrones, Raise the glad strain, Alleluia!

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: O higher than the cherubim, More glorious than the seraphim, Lead their praises, Alleluia!
Thou bearer of th'eternal Word, Most gracious, magnify the Lord.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: O friends, in gladness let us sing, Supernal anthems echoing, Alleluia!
To God the Father, God the Son, And God the Spirit, Three in One.

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: This is my Father's world, and to my listening ears all nature sings, and round me rings the music of the spheres.
This is my Father's world: I rest me in the thought of rocks and trees, of skies and seas; his hand the wonders wrought.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: This is my Father's world, the birds their carols raise, the morning light, the lily white, declare their maker's praise.
This is my Father's world: he shines in all that's fair; in the rustling grass I hear him pass; he speaks to me everywhere.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: O let me ne'er forget that though the wrong seems oft so strong,
This is my Father's world: why should my heart be sad?
The Lord is King; let the heavens ring!
God reigns; let the earth be glad!

translations.title: என் பிதாவின் லோகம் என் காதுகள் கேட்க

sections.label: சரணம் 1
lines: என் பிதாவின் லோகம் என் காதுகள் கேட்க

sections.label: சரணம் 3
lines: என் பிதாவின் லோகம் நான் என்றும் மறவேன்
மோசம் நேரிட்ட போதிலும் அவரே என் கர்த்தர்.

translations.title: En Pidhaavin Lokam En Kaadhukal Ketka

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: En Pidhaavin Lokam En Kaadhukal Ketka

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: En Pidhaavin Lokam Naan Endrum Maraven
Mosam Neritta Podhilum Avare En Karththar.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Each little flower that opens, Each little bird that sings;
He made their glowing colors, He made their tiny wings.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: The river running by The sunset, and the morning That brightens up the sky,

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: The cold wind in the winter,
The ripe fruits in the garden,

sections.label: Verse 5
lines: He gave us eyes to see them,
And lips that we might tell How great is God Almighty,
Who has made all things well.

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: To spread its Maker's praise abroad;
And every labor of His hands Shows something worthy of our God.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: But in the grace that rescued us His brightest form of glory shines;
'Tis fairest drawn upon the cross In precious blood and crimson lines.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Here His whole name appears complete.
Nor wit can guess, nor reason prove,
Which of the letters best is writ,
The pow'r, the wisdom, or the love.

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: We would forever speak His name In sounds to mortal ears unknown,
With angels join to praise the Lamb,
And worship at His Father's throne.

translations.title: Spring Has Now Unwrapped the Flowers

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Spring has now unwrapped the flowers,
Life in all her growing powers Towards the light is striving: Gone the iron touch of cold,
Now make up for lost time.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Herb and plant that winter long,
Now be stirring, green and strong,
Find in growth their pleasure: All the world with beauty fills,
Flowers make glee among the hills, Set the meadows dancing.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Through each wonder of fair days God Himself expresses;
As the world He blesses: So, as He renews the earth,
In His grace of glad new birth We must seek revival.

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: With all the blue, ethereal sky,
And spangled heavens, a shining frame,
Th' unwearied sun from day to day Does his Creator's power display,
And publishes to every land The work of an almighty hand

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Soon as the evening shades prevail,
The moon takes up the wondrous tale;
And nightly to the listening earth Repeats the story of her birth;
While all the stars that round her burn,
And all the planets in their turn,
Confirm the tidings as they roll,
And spread the truth from pole to pole

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: What though in solemn silence all Move round the dark terrestrial ball?
What though no real voice nor sound Amid their radiant orbs be found?
In reason's ear they all rejoice And utter forth a glorious voice,
Forever singing as they shine, "The hand that made us is divine."

translations.title: Lord of the Boundless Curves of Space

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Lord of the boundless curves of space And time's deep mystery,
To Your creative might we trace All nature's energy.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: And every age of history Your purpose,

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Yours is the image stamped on man,
Though marred by man's own sin;
And Yours the liberating plan Again his soul to win.

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: Give us to know Your truth; but more,
The strength to do Your will;
Until the love our souls adore Shall all our being fill.

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Can you count the stars that brightly Twinkle in the midnight sky?
Can you count the clouds, so lightly O'er the meadows floating by?
God, the Lord, doth mark their number With His eyes that never slumber;
He hath made every one, He hath made them every one.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Can you count the wings now flashing In the sunshine's golden light?
Can you count the fishes splashing In the cooling waters bright?
God, the Lord, a name hath given, To all creatures under heaven;
He hath named them every one, He hath named them every one.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Do you know how many children Rise each morning blithe and gay?
Can you count their jolly voices, Singing sweetly day by day?
God hears all the happy voices, In their merry songs rejoices;
And He loves them, every one, And He loves them, every one.

translations.title: God Will Take Care of You

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: God will take care of you; beneath his wings of love abide,
God will take care of you.

sections.label: Refrain
lines: God will take care of you, through every day, o'er all the way; he will take care of you,
God will take care of you.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Through days of toil when heart doth fail,
God will take care of you; when dangers fierce your path assail,
God will take care of you.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: All you may need he will provide,
God will take care of you; nothing you ask will be denied,
God will take care of you.

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: No matter what may be the test,
God will take care of you; lean, weary one, upon his breast,
God will take care of you.

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: There is no shadow of turning with Thee;
Thou changest not, Thy compassions, they fail not;
As Thou has been Thou forever will be.

sections.label: Refrain
lines: Morning by morning new mercies I see All I have needed Thy hand hath provided,

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Summer and winter, and springtime and harvest,
Sun, moon, and stars in their courses above,
Join with all nature in manifold witness To Thy great faithfulness, mercy, and love.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Pardon for sin and a peace that endureth,
Thy own dear presence to cheer and to guide;
Strength for today and bright hope for tomorrow,
Blessings all mine, with ten thousand beside.

sections.label: பல்லவி
lines: உமது உண்மை பெரிதே! உமது உண்மை பெரிதே!
என் தேவை எல்லாம் உம் கரம் ஈந்ததே,

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Children of the heavenly Father Safely in His bossom gather;
Nestling bird nor star in heaven Such a refuge e'er was given.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: God His own doth tend and nourish,
In His holy love they flourish;
From all evil things He spares them,
In His mighty arms He bears them.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Neither life nor death shall ever From the Lord His children sever;
Unto them His grace He showeth, And their sorrows all He knoweth.

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: Praise the Lord in joyful numbers, Your Protector never slumbers;
At the will of your Defender Every foe-man must surrender.

sections.label: Verse 5
lines: Though He giveth or He taketh, God His children ne'er forsaketh;
His the loving purpose solely To preserve them pure and holy.

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Unto the hills around shall I lift up my longing eyes?
O whence for me shall my salvation come, from whence arise?
From God the Lord doth come my certain aid,
From God the Lord, who heav'n and earth hath made.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: He will not suffer that thy foot be moved; safe shalt Thou be.
No careless slumber shall His eyelids close, who keepeth thee.
Who keepeth Israel in His holy care.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Jehovah is Himself thy keeper true, thy changeless shade.
Jehovah they defense on thy right hand Himself hath made.
And thee no sun by day shall ever smite, No moon shall harm thee in the silent night.

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: From every evil shall He keep thy soul, from every sin;
Jehovah shall preserve thy going our,n thy coming in.
Above thee watching, He, whom we adore.,
Shall keep thee henceforth, yea, forevermore.

translations.title: O God, Our Help in Ages Past

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: O God, our help in ages past, our hope for years to come, our shelter from the stormy blast, and our eternal home!

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Under the shadow of thy throne, still may we dwell secure; sufficient is thine arm alone, and our defense is sure.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Before the hills in order stood, or earth received her frame, from everlasting, thou art God, to endless years the same.

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: A thousand ages, in thy sight, are like an evening gone; short as the watch that ends the night, before the rising sun.

sections.label: Verse 5
lines: O God, our help in ages past, our hope for years to come; be thou our guide while life shall last, and our eternal home!

sections.label: சரணம் 4
lines: ஆயிரம் ஆண்டு உமக்கு ஓர் நாளைப் போலாமே;

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: Aayiram Aantu Umakku Or Naalaip Polaame;

translations.title: My Shepherd Will Supply My Need

sections.label: Verse 1
