lines: My Shepherd will supply my need, Jehovah is His name.
In pastures fresh He makes me feed Beside the living stream.
He brings my wand'ring spirit back When I forsake His ways,
And leads, me for His mercy's sake,
In paths of truth and grace.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: When I walk through the shades of death, Thy presence is my stay;
A word of Thy supporting breath Drives all my fears away.
Thy hand in sight of all my foes Doth still my table spread;
My cup with blessings overflows, Thine oil anoints my head.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: The sure provisions of my God Attend me all my days;
O may Thy house be mine abode And all my work be praise.
There would I find a settled rest While others go and come;
No more a stranger or a guest, But like a child at home.

translations.title: Sing to the Great Jehovah's Praise

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Sing to the great Jehovah's praise!
Who kindly lengthens out our days,

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: His providence hath brought us through Another various year;
We all, with vows and anthems new,

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: O God, Thy mercies past we own, And Thy continued care;
To Thee presenting through Thy Son What e'er we have and are,
What e'er we have and are.

translations.title: Give to Our god Immortal Praise

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Give to our God immortal praise;
Mercy and truth are all His ways: Wonders of grace to God belong,
Repeat His mercies in your song.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Give to the Lord of lords renown,
The King of kings with glory crown: His mercies ever shall endure When lords and kings are known no more.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: He sent His Son with power to save From guilt and darkness and the grave: Wonders of grace to God belong,
Repeat His mercies in your song.

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: Thro' this vain world He guides our feet,
And leads us to His heav'nly seat;
When this vain world shall be no more.

translations.title: God Moves in a Mysterious Way

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: God moves in a mysterious way His wonders to perform;
He plants His footsteps in the sea, And rides upon the storm.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Ye fearful saints, fresh courage take;
The clouds ye so much dread Are big with mercy, and shall break In blessings on your head.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Judge not the Lord by feeble sense, But trust Him for His grace;
Behind a frowning providence He hides a smiling face.

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: His purposes will ripen fast, Unfolding every hour;
The bud may have a bitter taste, But sweet will be the flower.

sections.label: Verse 5
lines: Blind unbelief is sure to err, And scan His work in vain;
God is His own interpreter, And He will make it plain.

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: How sweet the sound that saved a wretch like me!
I once was lost, but now am found; was blind, but now I see.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: 'Twas grace that taught my heart to fear, and grace my fears relieved; how precious did that grace appear the hour I first believed.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: The Lord has promised good to me, his word my hope secures; he will my shield and portion be, as long as life endures.

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: Through many dangers, toils, and snares, I have already come;
'tis grace hath brought me safe thus far, and grace will lead me home.

sections.label: Verse 5
lines: When we've been there ten thousand years, bright shining as the sun, we've no less days to sing God's praise than when we first begun.

translations.title: பாவச் சேற்றில் மூழ்கும் என்னை என் மீட்பர் ரட்சித்தார்

sections.label: சரணம் 1
lines: பாவச் சேற்றில் மூழ்கும் என்னை என் மீட்பர் ரட்சித்தார்

sections.label: சரணம் 4
lines: அங்கே நித்திய காலமாய் என் மீட்பரைப் பாடி
போற்றித் துதிப்பேன் என்றுமாய் என் மீட்பின் ராஜனை

translations.title: Paavach Chetril Moozhkum Ennai En Meetpar Ratchiththaar

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Paavach Chetril Moozhkum Ennai En Meetpar Ratchiththaar

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: Ange Niththiya Kaalamaai En Meetparaip Paati
Potrith Thudhippen Endrumaai En Meetpin Raajanai

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Marvelous grace of our loving Lord.
Grace that exceeds our sin and our guilt!
Yonder on Calvary's mount outpoured There where the blood of the Lamb was spilt.

sections.label: Refrain
lines: Grace that will pardon and cleanse within Grace, grace,
Grace that is greater than all our sin!

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Sin and despair, like the seawaves cold,
Threaten the soul with infinite loss;
Grace that is greater yes grace untold Points to the Refuge, the mighty Cross.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Freely bestowed on all who believe!
You that are longing to see His face,
Will you this moment His grace receive?

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: God's free mercy streameth over all the world,
Shines in might victorious His eternal love.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Summer suns are glowing over land and sea;
Happy light is flowing, Bountiful and free;
Everything rejoices in the mellow rays;
Earth's ten thousand voices swell the psalm of praise.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Lord, upon our blindness thy pure radiance pour;
For Thy loving kindness we would love Thee more;
And when clouds are drifting dark across the sky,
Then, the veil uplifting, father, be Thou nigh.

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: We will never doubt Thee, tho' veil Thy light;
Life is dark without Thee, death with Thee is bright.
Light of light, shine o'er us on our pilgrim way, Go Thou still before us to the endless day.

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: My Father is omnipotent And that you can't deny;
A God of might and miracles;

sections.label: Refrain
lines: It took a miracle to put the stars in place;
It took a miracle to hang the world in space.
But when He saved my soul,
Cleansed and made me whole, It took a miracle of love and grace!

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Though here His glory has been shown, We still can't fully see The wonders of His might, His throne;

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: The Bible tells us of His power And wisdom all way through;
And every little bird and flower Are testimonies, too.

translations.title: Let Us With a Gladsome Mind

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Let us with a gladsome mind Praise the Lord, for He is kind: For His mercies shall endure,

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Filled the new made world with light: For His mercies shall endure,

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: All things living He does feed;
His full hand supplies their need: For His mercies shall endure,

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: Let us then with gladsome mind Praise the Lord, for He is kind: For His mercies shall endure,

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: As pants the hart for cooling streams When heated in the chase, So longs my soul,

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: For Thee, my God, the living God,
My thirsty soul doth pine: O when shall I behold Thy face,

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Why restless, why cast down, my soul?
Hope still, and thou shalt sing The praise of Him who is thy God,

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: To Father, Son, and Holy Ghost, The God whom we adore, Be glory, as it was, is now, And shall be evermore.

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: There's a wideness, in God's mercy, like the wideness of the sea;
There is mercy, with the Savior, Which is more than liberty.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: There is welcome, for the sinner, and more graces for the good;
There is mercy, with the Savior, There is healing in His blood.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: For the love of God is broader Than the measure of man's mind.
And the heart of the Eternal, is most wonderfully kind.

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: If our love were but more simple, We should take Him at His word;
And our lives would be all sunshine,
In the sweetness of our Lord.

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: O come, O come, Immanuel, And ransom captive Israel That mourns in lonely exile here Until the Son of God appear.

sections.label: Refrain
lines: Immanuel Shall come to thee, O Israel!

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: O come, Thou Wisdom from on high, And order all things, far and nigh;
To us the path of knowledge show, And cause us in her ways to go.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: O come, Desire of nations, bind All peoples in one heart and mind;
Bid envy, strife, and quarrels cease;
Fill the whole world with heaven's peace.

sections.label: சரணம் 2
lines: வெம் சாவின் மேல் பேர் வெற்றி அளியும்.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Vem Saavin Mel Per Vetri Aliyum.

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Ere the worlds began to be,
He the source, the ending He,
Of the things that are, that have been,
And that future years shall see,

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: O ye heights of heaven adore Him;
Powers, dominions, bow before Him, And extol our God and King;
Let no tongue on earth be silent,

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Christ, to Thee with God the Father And,
Hymn and chant and high thanksgiving And unwearied praises be.

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: The advent of our God With eager prayers we greet,
And singing haste upon His road His coming reign to meet.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: The everlasting Son Was born to make us free;
And He a servant's form put on To gain our liberty.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: As Judge, on clouds of light,
His scattered people to unite With them in heaven to reign.

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: Praise to the incarnate Son Who comes to set us free,

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: The first noel the angel did say Was to certain poor shepherds in fields where they lay;
In fields where they lay keeping their sheep,
On a cold winter's night that was so deep.

sections.label: Refrain
lines: Noel, Noel, Noel, Noel, Born is the King of Israel

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: They looked up and say a star Shining in the east, beyond them far,
And to the earth it gave great light,
And so it continued both day and night.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: And by the light of that same star,
Three wise men came from country far,
And to the earth it gave great light,
And to follow the star wherever it went.

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: This star drew nigh to the northwest, O'er Bethlehem it took its rest,
And there it did both stop and stay,
Right over the place where Jesus lay.

sections.label: Verse 5
lines: Then entered in those wise men three,
And offered there, in His presence,
Their gold, and myrrh, and frankincense.

translations.title: Angels From the Realms of Glory

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Angels from the realms of glory,
Wing your flight o'er all the earth;
Ye, who sang creation's story, Now proclaim Messiah's birth;

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Watching o'er your flocks by night,
God with man is now residing;

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Sages, leave your contemplations, Brighter visions beam afar;
Seek the great Desire of nations;
Ye have seen His natal star;

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: Watching long in hope and fear,

sections.label: சரணம் 2
lines: நம்மில் தங்கும் தேவ சுதன் ஒளி வீசி மின்னுதே.

sections.label: சரணம் 3
lines: நீதிமான்கள் நீங்கள் எல்லாம் வீண் சிந்தனை மறப்பீர்.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Nammil Thangum Theva Sudhan Oli Veesi Minnudhe.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Needhimaankal Neengal Ellaam Veen Sindhanai Marappeer.

translations.title: There's a Song in the Air

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: There's a song in the air!
There's a star in the sky!
There's a mother's deep prayer And a baby's low cry!
And the star rains its fire while the beautiful sing,
For the manger of Bethlehem cradles a King!

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: There's a tumult of joy O'er the wonderful birth,
For the virgin's sweet boy Is the Lord of the earth.
Aye! the star rains its fire while the beautiful sing,
For the manger of Bethlehem cradles a King!

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: In the light of that star Lie the ages impearled;
And that song from afar Has swept over the world.
Every hearth is aflame and the beautiful sing In the homes of the nations that Jesus is King!

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: And we echo the song That comes down through the night From the heavenly throng.
Aye! we shout to the lovely evangel they bring,
And we greet in His cradle our Savior and King!

translations.title: Go, Tell It On the Mountain

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: While shepherds kept their watching O'er silent flocks by night,
Behold throughout the heavens There shone a holy light.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: The shepherds feared and trembled When lo!
Above the earth Rang out the angel chorus That hailed our Savior's birth.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Down in a lowly manger The humble Christ was born,
And brought us God's salvation That blessed Christmas morn.

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: Go, tell it on the mountain,
Over the hills and everywhere: Go, tell it on the mountain That Jesus Christ is born!

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Hark! the herald angels sing, "Glory to the new born King, peace on earth, and mercy mild,

God and sinners reconciled!" Joyful, all ye nations rise, join the triumph of the skies; with th' angelic host proclaim, "Christ is born in Bethlehem!" Hark! the herald angels sing, "Glory to the new born King!"

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Christ, the everlasting Lord; late in time behold him come, offspring of a virgin's womb.
Veiled in flesh the Godhead see; hail th' incarnate Deity, pleased with us in flesh to dwell,
Hark! the herald angels sing, "Glory to the new born King!"

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Hail the heaven-born Prince of Peace!
Light and life to all he brings, risen with healing in his wings.
Mild he lays his glory by, born that we no more may die, born to raise us from the earth, born to give us second birth.
Hark! the herald angels sing, "Glory to the new born King!"

translations.title: கேள்! ஜென்மித்த ராயர்க்கே விண்ணில் துத்யம் ஏறுதே

sections.label: சரணம் 1
lines: கேள்! ஜென்மித்த ராயர்க்கே விண்ணில் துத்யம் ஏறுதே;
மண்ணோர் யாரும் எழுந்து, விண்ணோர் போல் கெம்பீரித்து

sections.label: சரணம் 2
lines: வானோர் போற்றும் க்றிஸ்துவே, லோகம் ஆளும் நாதரே!
நீர், இம்மானுவேல், அன்பாய்ப் பாரில் வந்தீர் மாந்தனாய்.

sections.label: சரணம் 3
lines: வாழ்க சாந்த ப்ரபுவே! வாழ்க நீதி சூர்யனே!
சாவை வெல்லப் பிறந்தீர்; மறு ஜென்மம் அளித்தீர்.

translations.title: Kel! Jenmiththa Raayarkke Vinnil Thudhyam Erudhe

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Kel! Jenmiththa Raayarkke Vinnil Thudhyam Erudhe;
Mannor Yaarum Ezhundhu, Vinnor Pol Kempeeriththu

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Vaanor Potrum Krisdhuve, Lokam Aalum Naadhare!
Neer, Immaanuvel, Anpaaip Paaril Vandheer Maandhanaai.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Vaazhka Saandha Prapuve! Vaazhka Needhi Sooryane!
Saavai Vellap Pirandheer; Maru Jenmam Aliththeer.

translations.title: As With Gladness Men of Old

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: As with gladness, men of old Did the guiding star behold As with joy they hailed its light Leading onward, beaming bright So, most glorious Lord, may we Evermore be led to Thee.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: As with joyful steps they sped To that lowly manger bed There to bend the knee before Him Whom heaven and earth adore;
So may we with willing feet Ever seek Thy mercy seat.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: As they offered gifts most rare At that manger rude and bare;
So may we with holy joy,
Pure and free from sin's alloy,
Christ, to Thee, our heavenly King.

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: Holy Jesus, every day Keep us in the narrow way;
And, when earthly things are past,
Bring our ransomed souls at last Where they need no star to guide,
Where no clouds Thy glory hide.

sections.label: Verse 5
lines: In the heavenly country bright, Need they no created light;
Thou its light, its joy, its crown,
Thou its sun which goes not down;
There forever may we sing Alleluias to our King!

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Away in a manger, no crib for a bed,
The little Lord Jesus laid down his sweet head.
The stars in the sky looked down where he lay,
The little Lord Jesus asleep in the hay.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: The cattle are lowing, the baby awakes,
But little Lord Jesus no crying he makes.
Lord Jesus, look down from the sky And stay by my cradle til morning is nigh.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Be near me, Lord Jesus, I ask Thee to stay Close by me forever, and love me, I pray.
Bless all the dear children in thy tender care,
And take us to heaven, to live with Thee there.

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Joy to the world, the Lord is come!
Let every heart prepare Him room,
And heaven, and heaven and nature sing.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Joy to the earth, the Savior reigns!
While fields and floods, rocks, hills, and plains,

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: No more let sin and sorrow grow, Nor thorns infest the ground;
He comes to make His blessings flow Far as the curse is found,
Far as the curse is found,
Far as, far as the curse is found.

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: He rules the world with truth and grace,
And makes the nations prove The glories of His righteousness,
And wonders, and wonders of His love.

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: In the bleak midwinter Frosty wind made moan;
Earth stood hard as iron, Water like a stone;
Snow had fallen, snow on snow, Snow on snow, In the bleak midwinter, Long ago.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Angels and archangels May have gathered there,
Cherubim and seraphim Thronged the air: But His mother only In her maiden bliss,
Worshipped the beloved With a kiss.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: What can I give Him, Poor as I am?
If I were a shepherd I would bring a lamb;
If I were a wise man I would do my part;
Yet what can I give Him?

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Infant holy, infant lowly, For His bed a cattle stall;
Oxen lowing, little knowing Christ the babe is Lord of all;
Christ the babe is Lord of all,
Christ the babe is Lord of all.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Flocks were sleeping, shepherds keeping Vigil till the morning new;
Saw the glory, heard the story, Tidings of the gospel true;
Christ the babe was born for you,
Christ the babe was born for you.

translations.title: Break Forth, O Beauteous Heavenly Light

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Ye shepherds, shrink not with affright,
This child, now weak in infancy,
Our confidence and joy shall be,

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Break forth, O beauteous heavenly light To herald our salvation;
He stoops to earth-the God of might, Our hope and expectation.
He comes in human flesh to dwell, Our God with us, Immanuel, The night of darkness ending, Our fallen race befriending.

translations.title: As It Fell Upon a Night

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: As it fell upon a night In the winter weather,
Angels bright in starry height Began to sing together.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Shepherds sleeping on the plain Woke to see the glory,
All amazed they stood and gazed And heard the angels' story.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Unto you a child is born In a manger lowly,
Humble, He, yet born to be The King of Love most holy.

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: Happy angels from afar, Cease your singing never!

translations.title: It Came Upon the Midnight Clear

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: It came upon the midnight clear, that glorious song of old, from angels bending near the earth to touch their harps of gold;
"Peace on earth, goodwill to men, from heav'n's all gracious King!" The world in solemn stillness lay to hear the angels sing.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Still through the cloven skies they come, with peaceful wings unfurled;
And still their heav'nly music floats o'er all the weary world;
Above its sad and lowly plains they bend on hovering wing;
And ever o'er its Babel sounds the blessed angels sing!

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Yet with the woes of sin and strife the world has suffered long; beneath the angel strain have rolled two thousand years of wrong;
And man, at war with man, hears not the love song which they bring O hush the noise, ye men of strife, and hear the angels sing!

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: The days are hast'ning on, by prophet bards foretold,
When, with the ever circling years, comes round the age of gold;
When peace shall over all the earth its ancient splendors fling;
And the whole world send back the song which now the angels sing!

translations.title: Lo, How a Rose E'er Blooming

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Lo, how a rose e're blooming From tenderstem hath sprung,
Of Jesse's lineage coming As men of old have sung.
Amid the cold of winter When half spent was the night.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: The Rose I have in mind,
To show God's love aright She bore to them a Savior,
When half spent was the night.

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: O come, all ye faithful, joyful and triumphant, O come ye, O come ye to Bethlehem!
Come and behold Him, born the King of angels!
O come, let us adore Him,
O come, let us adore Him,
O come, let us adore Him,

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Sing, choirs of angels sing in exultation,
O sing all ye citizens of heaven above!
Glory to God, all glory in the highest!
O come, let us adore Him,
O come, let us adore Him,
O come, let us adore Him,

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Yea, Lord, we greet Thee, born this happy morning, Jesus, to Thee be all glory given;
Word of the Father, now in flesh appearing!
O come, let us adore Him,
O come, let us adore Him,
O come, let us adore Him,

sections.label: சரணம் 3
lines: விண் மண்ணிலும் கர்த்தர் கனம் பெற்றோர் என்று

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Vin Mannilum Karththar Kanam Petror Endru

translations.title: Now Is Born the Divine Christ Child

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: He was born in a stable bare,
On bed of straw how He sleeps so soundly,
He was born in a stable bare,
Let us worship and to Him bow.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Ages long since are past and gone,
When the wise men foretold His coming,
Ages long since are past and gone,
When the wise men foretold His birth.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Now is born the divine Christ child,
Play the musette, play the tuneful oboe,
Now is born the divine Christ child,
Sing we all and rejoice this day.

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Thy Father's will hast Thou fulfilled;
For Thou hast left Thy heavenly throne Our lowly state to make Thine own.
O Jesus sweet, O Jesus mild.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: With joy hast Thou the whole world filled;
Thou comest down from heaven's hall To comfort us whom tears enthrall.
O Jesus sweet, O Jesus mild.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: O Jesus sweet, O Jesus mild, Thou art love's image undefiled.
Inflame our hearts with love's pure fire,
That we may share Thy heart's desire.
O Jesus sweet, O Jesus mild.

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: O Jesus sweet, O Jesus mild, Help us to do as Thou hast willed.
What'er we have belongs to Thee: O may we ever faithful be.
O Jesus sweet, O Jesus mild.

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: O little town of Bethlehem How still we see thee lie!
Above thy deep and dreamless sleep The silent stars go by;
Yet in thy dark streets shineth The everlasting light;
The hopes and fears of all the years Are met in thee tonight.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: For Christ is born of Mary;
While mortals sleep, the angels keep Their watch of wondering love.
O morning stars, together Proclaim the holy birth!
And praises sing to God the King, And peace to men on earth.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: How silently, how silently The wondrous gift is given!
So God imparts to human hearts The blessings of His heaven.
No ear may hear His coming;
But in this world of sin,
Where meek souls will recieve Him still,

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: O holy Child of Bethlehem, Descend to us, we pray;
Cast out our sin and enter in-- Be born in us today.
We hear the Christmas angels The great glad tidings tell-- Oh, come to us, abide with us,

translations.title: ஓ பெத்லகேமே சிற்றூரே, என்னே உன் அமைதி!

sections.label: சரணம் 1
lines: ஓ பெத்லகேமே சிற்றூரே, என்னே உன் அமைதி!
விண் வாழ்வின் ஜோதி தோன்றிற்றே உன் வீதியில் இன்றே;
நல்லோர் நாட்டம் பொல்லார் கோட்டம் உன் பாலன் யேசுவே.

sections.label: சரணம் 2
lines: கூறும், ஓ விடி வெள்ளிகாள்! இம்மைந்தன் ஜன்மமே;
மா திவ்விய பாலன் தோன்றினார் மண்மாந்தர் தூக்கத்தில்,

sections.label: சரணம் 3
lines: மெய் பக்தர் ஏற்பார் ஸ்வாமியை தம் சாந்த ஆன்மாவில்.

sections.label: சரணம் 4
lines: வேண்ட நற் சிறு பாலரும் இத் தூய பாலனை,

sections.label: சரணம் 5
lines: ஜெனிப்பீர் எங்களில் இன்றும் எம் பாவம் நீக்குவீர்;
ஆ வாரும், வந்து தங்கிடும் இம்மானு வேலரே.

translations.title: O Pedhlakeme Sitroore, Enne Un Amaidhi!

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: O Pedhlakeme Sitroore, Enne Un Amaidhi!
Vin Vaazhvin Jodhi Thondritre Un Veedhiyil Indre;
Nallor Naattam Pollaar Kottam Un Paalan Yesuve.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Koorum, O Viti Vellikaal! Immaindhan Janmame;
Maa Thivviya Paalan Thondrinaar Manmaandhar Thookkaththil,

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Mey Pakdhar Erpaar Svaamiyai Tham Saandha Aanmaavil.

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: Venta Nar Siru Paalarum Ith Thooya Paalanai,

sections.label: Verse 5
lines: Jenippeer Engalil Indrum Em Paavam Neekkuveer;
Aa Vaarum, Vandhu Thangitum Immaanu Velare.

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Good Christians, now rejoice, With heart, and soul, and voice;
Give ye heed to what we say: Jesus Christ is born today;
Ox and ass before Him bow, And He is in the manger now.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Good Christians, now rejoice, With heart, and soul, and voice;
Now ye hear of endless bliss: Jesus Christ was born for this!
He hath ope'd the heav'nly door, And we are blessed evermore.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Good Christians, now rejoice, With heart, and soul, and voice;
Now ye need not fear the grave: Jesus Christ was born to save!
Calls you one and calls you all To gain His everlasting hall.

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: We three kings of Orient are;
Bearing gifts we traverse afar Field and fountain, moor and mountain,

sections.label: Refrain
lines: O star of wonder, star of night,
Guide us to Thy perfect light.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Born a King on Bethlehem's plain,
Gold I bring to crown Him again,
King forever, ceasing never Over us all to reign.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Prayer and praising all men raising, Worship Him, God on high.

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: Myrrh is mine; its bitter perfume Breathes a life of gathering gloom: Sorrowing, sighing, bleeding, dying,

sections.label: Verse 5
lines: Glorious now behold Him arise, King and God and sacrifice;
Sounds through the earth and skies.

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: There's a star in the east on Christmas morn.
It will lead to the place where the Savior's born,

sections.label: Refrain
lines: Leave your sheep and leave your lambs,
Leave your ewes and leave your rams,
Follow, follow, Rise up, shepherd and follow.
Follow the star of Behlehem, Rise up, shepherd, and follow.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: If you take good heed to the angel's words,
You'll forget your flocks, you'll forget your herds,

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: While shepherds watched their flocks by night,
The angel of the Lord came down,

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: 'Fear nor!' said he- for mighty dread Had seized their troubled mind- 'Glad tidings of great joy I bring,

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: 'To you, in David's town this day, Is born of David's line,
The Savior who is Christ the Lord;
And this shall be the sign:

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: 'The heavenly Babe you there shall find To human view displayed,
All meanly wrapped in swathing bands,

sections.label: Verse 5
lines: Thus spake the seraph; and forth with Appeared a shining throng Of angels praising God on high,

sections.label: Verse 6
lines: 'All glory be to God on high, And to the earth be peace;
Good will henceforth from heaven to men, Begin and never cease!'

translations.title: ராக்காலம் பெத்லேம் மேய்ப்பர்கள் தம் மந்தை காத்தனர்

sections.label: சரணம் 1
lines: ராக்காலம் பெத்லேம் மேய்ப்பர்கள் தம் மந்தை காத்தனர்;
கர்த்தாவின் தூதன் இறங்க விண் ஜோதி கண்டனர்.

sections.label: சரணம் 2
lines: அவர்கள் அச்சங்கொள்ளவும், விண் தூதன் திகில் ஏன்?

sections.label: சரணம் 3
lines: தாவீதின் வம்சம் ஊரிலும், மெய் கிறிஸ்து நாதனார்

sections.label: சரணம் 6
lines: மா உன்னதத்தில், ஆண்டவா, நீர் மேன்மை அடைவீர்;

translations.title: Raakkaalam Pedhlem Meypparkal Tham Mandhai Kaaththanar

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Raakkaalam Pedhlem Meypparkal Tham Mandhai Kaaththanar;
Karththaavin Thoodhan Iranga Vin Jodhi Kantanar.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Avarkal Achchangollavum, Vin Thoodhan Thikil En?

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Thaaveedhin Vamsam Oorilum, Mey Kirisdhu Naadhanaar

sections.label: Verse 6
lines: Maa Unnadhaththil, Aantavaa, Neer Menmai Ataiveer;

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Thou didst leave Thy throne And Thy kingly crown When Thou camest to earth for me;
But in Bethlehem's home Was there found no room For Thy holy nativity.

sections.label: Chorus 2
lines: My heart shall rejoice, Lord Jesus, When Thou comest and callest for me.

sections.label: Chorus 1
lines: O come to my heart, Lord Jesus, There is room in my heart for Thee.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Heaven's arches rang When the angels sang Proclaiming Thy royal degree;
But of lowly birth Didst Thou come to earth,

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: And the birds their nest In the shade of the forest tree;
But Thy couch was the sod,

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: Thou camest, O Lord, With the living word That should set Thy people free;

sections.label: Verse 5
lines: Let Thy voice call me home,
There is room at My side for thee.'

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: What child is this, who, laid to rest, On Mary's lap is sleeping?
Whom angels greet with anthems sweet,

sections.label: Refrain
lines: This, this is Christ the King,
Whom shepherds guard and angels sing: Haste, haste to bring Him laud,
The babe, the son of Mary.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Why lies He in such mean estate Where ox and ass are feeding?
Good Christian, fear: for sinners here The silent Word is pleading.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: So bring Him incense, gold, and myrrh,
Come, peasant, king, to own Him,
The King of kings salvation brings,

translations.title: Angels We Have Heard on High

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Angels we have heard on high,

sections.label: Refrain
lines: Gloria, in excelsis Deo, Gloria in excelsis Deo.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Why this songs of happy cheer?
What great brightness did you see?
What glad tidings did you hear?

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Come to Bethlehem and see Him whose birth the angels sing;
Come adore, on bended knee, Christ the Lord, the newborn King.

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: See Him in a manger laid, Whom the angels praise above;
Mary, Joseph, lend your aid, While we raise our hearts in love.

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: All is calm, all is bright Round yon virgin mother and Child,
Holy Infant so tender and mild,
Sleep in heavenly peace, sleep in heavenly peace.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Shepherds quake at the sight, glories stream from heaven afar, heavenly hosts sing Alleluia;
Christ, the Savior is born, Christ, the Savior is born.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Son of God, love's pure light, Radiant beams from Thy holy face, with the dawn of redeeming grace, Jesus, Lord, at Thy birth, Jesus, Lord, at Thy birth.

sections.label: சரணம் 1
lines: கன்னி மாதா பாலன் சூழ, தூய பாலன் இளங்குழந்தை

sections.label: சரணம் 2
lines: தூதர் பாடல் ஆயர் காதில்: அல்லேலூயா ராயர் வாழ்கவே!
மீட்பர் க்றிஸ்து பிறந்தார்; யேசு மீட்பர் பிறந்தார்.

sections.label: சரணம் 3
lines: ஒளி வீசும் தூயமுகம் மீட்பின் கிருபை ஜெனித்தார்.

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Kanni Maadhaa Paalan Soozha, Thooya Paalan Ilanguzhandhai

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Thoodhar Paadal Aayar Kaadhil: Allelooyaa Raayar Vaazhkave!
Meetpar Krisdhu Pirandhaar; Yesu Meetpar Pirandhaar.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Oli Veesum Thooyamukam Meetpin Kirupai Jeniththaar.

translations.title: O Sing a Song of Bethlehem

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: O sing a song of Bethlehem,
And of the news that came to them From angels in the air: The light that shone on Bethlehem Fills all the world today;
Of Jesus'birth and peace on earth The angels sing alway.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: O sing a song of Nazareth,
O sing of fragrant flowers breath,
And of the sinless Boy: For now the flowers of Nazareth In every heart may grow;
Now spreads the fame of His dear name On all the winds that blow.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: O sing a song of Calvary, Its glory and dismay;
Of Him who hung upon the tree,
And took our sins away: For He who died on Calvary Is risen from the grave;
And Christ, our Lord, by heaven adored, Is mighty now to save.

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Songs of thankfulness and praise, Jesus, Lord, to You we raise, Manifested by the star To the sages from afar;
Branch of royal David's stem In Your birth at Bethlehem;
Anthems be to You addressed, God in man made manifest.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Manifest at Jordan's stream, Prophet, Priest, and King supreme;
And at Cana, wedding guest, In Your Godhead manifest;
Manifest in power divine, Changing water into wine;
Anthems be to You addressed, God in man made manifest.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Manifest in making whole Palsied limbs and fainting soul;
Manifest in valiant fight, Quelling all the devil's might;
Manifest in gracious will, Ever bringing good from ill;
Anthems be to You addressed, God in man made manifest.

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: Grant us grace to see You, Lord, Mirrored in Your holy Word;
And be pure, as pure as we may,
That we like You may be At Your great epiphany;
Let us praise You, ever blest, God in man made manifest.

translations.title: I Think When I Read That Sweet Story

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: I think when I read that sweet story of old,
When Jesus was here among men,
How He called little children as lambs to His fold,
I should like to have been with Him then.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: I wish that His hands had been placed on my head,
That His arm had been thrown around me,
And that I might have seen His kind look when He said, "Let the little ones come unto Me."

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: I long for the joy of that glorious time,
The sweetest and brightest and best,
When the dear little children of every clime Shall crowd to His arms and be blest.

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Christ upon the mountain peak Stands alone in glory blazing;
Let us, if we dare to speak,
With the saints and angels praise Him:

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Trembling at His feet we saw Moses and Elijah speaking;
All the prophets and the law Shout thro' them their joyful greeting:

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Swift the cloud of glory came,
God proclaiming in the thunder Jesus as His Son by name;

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: This is God's beloved Son: Law and prophets fade before Him;
First and last, the only One, Let creation now adore Him.

translations.title: O Love, How Deep, How Broad

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: O love, how deep, how broad, how high,
That God, the Son of God, should take Our mortal form for mortal's sake!

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: For us baptized, for us He bore His holy fast and hungered sore;
For us temptation sharp He knew;

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: For us, in crown of thorns arrayed,
He bore the shameful cross and death;
For us He gave His dying breath.

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: For us He rose from death again, For us He went on high to reign;
For us He sent His Spirit here To guide, to strengthen, and to cheer.

sections.label: Verse 5
lines: All glory to our Lord and God For love so deep, so high, so broad;
The Trinity whom we adore Forevermore and forevermore.

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Once in royal David's city Stood a lowly cattle shed,
Where a mother laid her Baby In a manger for His bed;
Mary was that mother mild, Jesus Christ her little Child.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: He came down to earth from heaven,
Who is God and Lord of all,
And His shelter was a stable,
And His cradle was a stall;
With the poor, and mean, and lowly,
Lived on earth our Savior holy.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: And through all His wondrous childhood He would honor and obey,
Love and watch the lowly mother In whose gentle arms He lay.
Christian children all must be Mild, obedient, good as He.

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: And our eyes at last shall see Him,
For that Child so dear and gentle Is our Lord in heaven above;
And He leads His children on To the place where He is gone.

sections.label: சரணம் 1
lines: கன்னி மாதா பாலன் தன்னை முன்னணையில் வைத்தாரே;

sections.label: சரணம் 2
lines: அவர் வீடோ மாட்டுக் கொட்டில், தொட்டிலோ முன்னணையாம்

sections.label: சரணம் 4
lines: பாலர்க் கேற்ற பாதை காட்டப் பாலனாக வளர்ந்தார்;
பலவீன மாந்தன் போலத் துன்பம், துக்கம் சகித்தார்;
இன்ப துன்ப நாளிலும் துணை செய்வார் நமக்கும்.

sections.label: சரணம் 5
lines: நம்மை மீட்ட நேசர் தம்மைக் கண்ணால் கண்டுகளிப்போம்;
அவர் தாமே நித்ய ராஜ்ய நாதர் என்று அறிவோம்;

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Kanni Maadhaa Paalan Thannai Munnanaiyil Vaiththaare;

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Avar Veeto Maattuk Kottil, Thottilo Munnanaiyaam

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: Paalark Ketra Paadhai Kaattap Paalanaaka Valarndhaar;
Palaveena Maandhan Polath Thunpam, Thukkam Sakiththaar;
Inpa Thunpa Naalilum Thunai Seyvaar Namakkum.

sections.label: Verse 5
lines: Nammai Meetta Nesar Thammaik Kannaal Kantukalippom;
Avar Thaame Nidhya Raajya Naadhar Endru Arivom;

translations.title: Who Is He in Yonder Stall?

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Who is He in yonder stall, At whose feet the shepherds fall?

sections.label: Refrain
lines: O wondrous story, 'Tis the Lord, the King of glory!
At His feet we humbly fall, Crown Him, crown Him Lord of all.
At His feet we humbly fall- the Lord of all.
Crown Him, crown Him, Jesus, Jesus, Crown Him Lord of all.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Who is He in deep distress, Fasting in the wilderness?

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Who is He, the gathering throng Greet with loud triumphant song?

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: Lo, at midnight, who is He Prays in dark Gethsemane?

sections.label: Verse 5
lines: Who is He on yonder tree Dies in shame and agony?

sections.label: Verse 6
lines: Who is He that from the grave Comes to heal and help and save?

sections.label: Verse 7
lines: Who is He that from His throne Rules through all the world alone?

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: He had to walk it by Himself.
O nobody else could walk it for Him.
He had to walk it by Himself.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: I must go and stand my trial.
I have to stand it by myself.
O nobody else could stand it for me.
I have to stand it by myself.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: He had to walk it by Himself.
O nobody else could walk it for Him.
He had to walk it by Himself.

translations.title: Tell Me the Story of Jesus

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Tell me the story of Jesus,
Write on my heart every word,
Tell me the story most precious Sweetest that ever was heard;
Tell how the angels, in chorus,
Sang as they welcomed His birth,
Glory to God in the highest,
Peace and good tidings to earth.

sections.label: Refrain
lines: Tell me the story of Jesus,
Write on my heart every word,
Tell me the story most precious,

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Tell of the days that He passed,
How for our sins He was tempted,
Tell of the years of His labor,
Tell of the sorrow He bore,

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Tell of the cross where they nailed Him,
Tell of the grave where they laid Him, Tell how He liveth again;
Love in that story so tender, Clearer than ever I see;
Stay, let me weep while you whisper, Love paid the ransom for me.

translations.title: Prince of Peace, Control My Will

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Prince of Peace, control my will,
Bid this struggling heart be still;
Bid my fears and doubtings cease, Hush my spirit into peace.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Thou hast bought me with Thy blood, Opened wide the gate to God;
Peace, I ask, but peace must be, Lord, in being one with Thee.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: May Thy will, not mine, be done, May Thy will and mine be one;
Chase these doubtings from my heart,

translations.title: When I Survey the Wondrous Cross

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: When I survey the wondrous cross on which the Prince of Glory died; my richest gain I count but loss, and pour contempt on all my pride.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Forbid it, Lord, that I should boast, save in the death of Christ, my God; all the vain things that charm me most, I sacrifice them to his blood.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: See, from his head, his hands, his feet, sorrow and love flow mingled down.
Did e'er such love and sorrow meet, or thorns compose so rich a crown.

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: Were the whole realm of nature mine, that were an offering far too small; love so amazing, so divine, demands my soul, my life, my all.

translations.title: என் அருள் நாதா! யேசுவே, சிலுவை காட்சி பார்க்கையில்

sections.label: சரணம் 1
lines: என் அருள் நாதா! யேசுவே, சிலுவை காட்சி பார்க்கையில்,
பூலோக மேன்மை நஷ்டமே என்றறிவேன் உள் மனசில்.

sections.label: சரணம் 2
lines: என் மீட்பர் சிலுவை அல்லால் வேறொன்றிலும் நான் மகிழேன்;

sections.label: சரணம் 3
lines: கை, தலை, காலிலிருந்தே பேரன்பும் துன்பும் கலந்தே
பாய்ந் தோடப் பார்! இக்காட்சியே முள் முடியும் ஒப்பற்றதே!

sections.label: சரணம் 4
lines: என் ஜீவன், செல்வம், சுகமும் மா நேசருக்குப் பாத்தியம்.

sections.label: சரணம் 5
lines: மாந்தர்க்கு மீட்பைக் கஸ்தியால் சம்பாதித் தீந்த யேசுவே
எந்நாளும் என்றும் உமக்கே மா தோத்திரம் உண்டாகவே.

translations.title: En Arul Naadhaa! Yesuve, Siluvai Kaatchi Paarkkaiyil

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: En Arul Naadhaa! Yesuve, Siluvai Kaatchi Paarkkaiyil,
Pooloka Menmai Nashtame Endrariven Ul Manasil.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: En Meetpar Siluvai Allaal Verondrilum Naan Makizhen;

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Kai, Thalai, Kaalilirundhe Peranpum Thunpum Kalandhe
Paain Thotap Paar! Ikkaatchiye Mul Mutiyum Oppatradhe!

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: En Jeevan, Selvam, Sukamum Maa Nesarukkup Paaththiyam.

sections.label: Verse 5
lines: Maandharkku Meetpaik Kasdhiyaal Sampaadhith Theendha Yesuve
Ennaalum Endrum Umakke Maa Thoththiram Untaakave.

translations.title: When I Survey the Wondrous Cross

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: When I survey the wondrous cross On which the Prince of glory died,
My richest gain I count but loss,
And pour contempt on all my pride.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: See, from His head, His feet, Sorrow and love flow mingled down;
Did e'er such love and sorrow meet?
Or thorns compose so rich a crown?

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Since I, who was undone and lost,
Have pardon through His name and word;
Forbid it, then, that I should boast,
Save in the cross of Christ my Lord.

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: Were the whole realm of nature mine,
That were a tribute far too small;
Love so amazing, so divine, Demands my life, my soul, my all.

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: O sacred Head, now wounded, with grief and shame weighed down, now scornfully surounded with thorns, thine only crown: how pale thou art with anguish, with sore abuse and scorn!
How does that visage languish which once was bright as morn!

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: What thou, my Lord, has suffered was all for sinners' gain; mine, mine was the transgression, but thine the deadly pain.
Lo, here I fall, my Savior!
'Tis I deserve thy place; look on me with thy favor, vouchsafe to me thy grace.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: What language shall I borrow to thank thee, dearest friend, for this thy dying sorrow, thy pity without end?
O make me thine forever; and should I fainting be,
Lord, let me never, never outlive my love for thee.

sections.label: சரணம் 1
lines: முன் கன மேன்மை கொண்ட நீ லச்சை காண்பானேன்?

sections.label: சரணம் 2
lines: நீர் பட்ட வாதை யாவும் என் பாவப் பாரமே;
இத்தீங்கும் நோவும் சாவும் என் குற்றம் கர்த்தரே
ஆனாலும் நீர் அன்பாக என்னைக் கண்ணோக்கு மேன்.

sections.label: சரணம் 3
lines: முன் ஜீவன் ஊறும் ஆறாய் என் தாகம் தீர்த்தீரே;

sections.label: சரணம் 4
lines: உம்மண்டை இங்கே நிற்பேன், என் மேல் இரங்குமேன்;
இதோ, நான் உம்மைப் பற்றி கண்ணீர் விட்டண்டினேன்;

sections.label: சரணம் 7
lines: அப்போ நான் உம்மைப் பார்த்து கண்ணோக்கி நெஞ்சிலே

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Mun Kana Menmai Konta Nee Lachchai Kaanpaanen?

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Neer Patta Vaadhai Yaavum En Paavap Paarame;
Iththeengum Novum Saavum En Kutram Karththare
Aanaalum Neer Anpaaka Ennaik Kannokku Men.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Mun Jeevan Oorum Aaraai En Thaakam Theerththeere;

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: Ummantai Inge Nirpen, En Mel Irangumen;
Idho, Naan Ummaip Patri Kanneer Vittantinen;

sections.label: Verse 7
lines: Appo Naan Ummaip Paarththu Kannokki Nenjile

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Go to dark Gethsemane, ye that feel the tempter's power; your Redeemer's conflict see, watch with him one bitter hour.
Turn not from his griefs away; learn of Jesus Christ to pray.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: See him at the judgment hall, beaten, bound, reviled, arraigned;
O the wormwood and the gall!
O the pangs his soul sustained!
Shun not suffering, shame, or loss; learn of Christ to bear the cross.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Calvary's mournful mountain climb; there, adoring at his feet, mark that miracle of time,
"It is finished!" hear him cry; learn of Jesus Christ to die.

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Were you there when they crucified my Lord?
Were you there when they crucified my Lord?
Sometimes it causes me to tremble, tremble, tremble.
Were you there when they crucified my Lord?

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Were you there when they nailed Him to the tree?
Were you there when they nailed Him to the tree?
Sometimes it causes me to tremble, tremble, tremble.
Were you there when they nailed Him to the tree?

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Were you there when they pierced Him in the side?
Were you there when they pierced Him in the side?
Sometimes it causes me to tremble, tremble, tremble.
Were you there when they pierced Him in the side?

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: Were you there when the sun refused to shine?
Were you there when the sun refused to shine?
Sometimes it causes me to tremble, tremble, tremble.
Were you there when the sun refused to shine?

sections.label: Verse 5
lines: Were you there when they laid Him in the tomb?
Were you there when they laid Him in the tomb?
Sometimes it causes me to tremble, tremble, tremble.
Were you there when they laid Him in the tomb?

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: On a hill far away stood an old rugged cross, the emblem of suffering and shame; and I love that old cross where the dearest and best for a world of lost sinners was slain.

sections.label: Refrain
lines: So I'll cherish the old rugged cross, till my trophies at last I lay down;
I will cling to the old rugged cross, and exchange it some day for a crown.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: O that old rugged cross, so despised by the world, has a wondrous attraction for me; for the dear Lamb of God left his glory above to bear it to dark Calvary.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: To that old rugged cross I will ever be true, its shame and reproach gladly bear; then he'll call me some day to my home far away, where his glory forever I'll share.

sections.label: சரணம் 1
lines: மா நேசர் மரித்தார் பாவங்கள் யாவையும் போக்க.

sections.label: சரணம் 3
lines: எனக்கு மா அழகு அக்குருசில் என் யேசு,
பாடு சாவு ஆனார் பரிசுத்தம் ஆக்க என்னை.

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Maa Nesar Mariththaar Paavangal Yaavaiyum Pokka.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Enakku Maa Azhaku Akkurusil En Yesu,
Paatu Saavu Aanaar Parisuththam Aakka Ennai.

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Ride on! ride on in majesty!
Hark, all the tribes hosanna cry;
O Savior meek, pursue Thy road With palms and scattered garments strowed.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Ride on! ride on in majesty!
In lowly pomp ride on to die;
O Christ, Thy triumphs now begin O'er captive death and conquered sin.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Ride on! ride on in majesty!
The winged squadrons of the sky Look down with sad and wondering eyes To see the approaching sacrifice.

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: Ride on! ride on in majesty!
In lowly pomp ride on to die;
Bow Thy meek head to mortal pain, Then take, O God, Thy power and reign.

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Throned upon the awful tree, Lamb of God, Your grief we see.
None its lines of woe can trace.
None can tell what pangs unknown Hold You silent and alone.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Silent through those three dread hours,
Till the Lamb of God may die.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Hark, that cry that peals aloud Upward through the whelming cloud!
You, the Father's only Son, You, His own anointed one, You are asking- can it be?

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: Lord, should fear and anguish roll Darkly o'er our sinful soul,
You, who once were thus bereft That Your own might ne'er be left,
Teach us by that bitter cry In the gloom to know You nigh.

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: What wondrous love is this, O my soul, O my soul?
What wondrous love is this, O my soul?
What wondrous love is this That caused the Lord of bliss To bear the dreadful curse for my soul, for my soul;
To bear the dreadful curse for my soul, for my soul;

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: To God and to the Lamb I will sing, I will sing;
To God and to the Lamb, I will sing;
To God and to the Lamb Who is the great I am,
While millions join the theme, I will sing, I will sing;

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: And when from death I'm free, I'll sing on, I'll sing on;
And when from death I'm free, I'll sing on;
And when from death I'm free, I'll sing and joyful be,
And through eternity I'll sing on, I'll sing on!
And through eternity, I'll sing on.

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Alas! and did my Savior bleed, and did my Sovereign die?
Would he devote that sacred head for sinners such as I?

sections.label: Refrain
lines: At the cross, at the cross, where I first saw the light, and the burden of my heart rolled away; it was there by faith I received my sight, and now I am happy all the day!

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Was it for crimes that I have done, he groaned upon the tree?

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: But drops of grief can ne'er repay the debt of love I owe: Here, Lord, I give myself away;

translations.title: There Is a Green Hill Far Away

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: There is a green hill far away,
Where the dear Lord was crucified,
Who died to save us all.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: We may not know, we cannot tell,
What pains He had to bear,
But we believe it was for us He hung and suffered there.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: He died that we might be forgiven,
He died to make us good,
That we might go at last to heaven,

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: There was no other good enough To pay the price of sin;
He only could unlock the gate Of heaven, and let us in.

sections.label: Verse 5
lines: O dearly, dearly has He loved!
And we must love Him too,
And trust in His redeeming blood,
And try His works to do.

translations.title: Look, You Saints! the Sight Is Glorious

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Look, you saints, the sight is glorious,
See the Man of sorrows now;
From the fight returned victorious, Every knee to Him shall bow.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Crown the Savior! angels crown Him!
On the seat of power enthrone Him While the vault of heaven rings.
Crown the Savior, King of Kings.
Crown the Savior, King of Kings.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Sinners in derision crowned Him, Mocking thus the Savior's claim;
Saints and angels crowd around Him,
Own His title, praise His name.

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: Oh, what joy the sight affords!
King of kings and Lord of lords!
King of kings and Lord of lords!

translations.title: Christ the Lord Is Risen Today

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Christ the Lord is risen today, Alleluia!
Sons of man and angels say, Alleluia!
Raise your joys and triumphs high, Alleluia!
Sing, ye heavens, and earth reply, Alleluia!

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Lives again our glorious King, Alleluia!
Where, O death, is now thy sting?
Once he died our souls to save, Alleluia!

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Love's redeeming work is done, Alleluia!
Fought the fight, the battle won, Alleluia!
Death in vain forbids him rise, Alleluia!

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: Soar we now where Christ has led, Alleluia!
Made like him, like him we rise, Alleluia!
Ours the cross, the grave, the skies, Alleluia!

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: His the scepter, His the throne.
His the triumph, His the victory alone.
Hark! the songs of peaceful Zion thunder like a mighty flood.
Jesus out of every nation has redeemed us by His blood.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Alleluia! not as orphans are we left in sorrow now;
He is near us, faith believes, nor questions how;
Though the cloud from sight received Him when the forty days were o'er Shall our hearts forget His promise, 'I am with you evermore'?

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Alleluia! bread of angels, Thou on earth our food, our stay;
Alleluia! here the sinful flee to Thee from day to day: Intercessor,
Where the songs of all the sinless sweep across the crystal sea.

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: And have the bright immensities Received our risen Lord,
Where light years frame the Pleiades And point Orion's sword?
Do flaming suns His footsteps trace Thro'corridors sublime,
The Lord of inter stellar space And conqueror of time?

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: The heav'n that hides Him from our sight Knows neither near nor far;
A little candle sheds its light As surely as a star.
And where His loving people meet To share the gift divine,
There stands He with unhurrying feet;

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Come, you faithful, raise the strain Of triumphant gladness;
God has brought His people Now rejoice, Jerusalem, And with true affection Welcome in unwearied strains Jesus'resurrection.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Christ has burst His prison From the frost and gloom of death light and life have risen All the winter of our sins,
Long and dark, is flying From His ligth, to whom we give Thanks and praise undying.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: 'Alleluia!' now we cry to our King immortal,
Who, triumphant, burst the bars of the tomb's dark portal 'Alleluia!' with the Son,
'Alleluia!' yet again to the Spirit raising.

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Come, you faithful, raise the strain Of triumphant gladness;
God has brought His Israel Into joy from sadness;
Loosed from Pharoah's bitter yoke Jacob's sons and daughters;
Led them with unmoistened foot Through the Red Sea waters.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: And from three days'sleep in death As a sun has risen;
All the winter of our sins,
Long and dark, is flying From His light, to whom is giv'n Laud and praise undying.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Now the queen of seasons, bright With the day of splendor,
With the royal feast of feasts,
Comes to gladden faithful hearts Which with true affection Welcome in unwearied strain Jesus'resurrection.

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: For today among the twelve Christ appeared, be stowing His deep peace, which evermore Passes human knowing.
Neither could the gates of death,
Nor the watchers, nor the seal,

sections.label: Verse 5
lines: 'Alleluia!' now we cry To our King immortal,
Who, triumphant, burst the bars Of the tomb's dark portal;
'Alleluia' with the Son, God the Father praising;
'Alleluia!' yet again To the Spirit raising.

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Thine is the glory, Risen, conquering Son;
Endless is the victory Thou o'er death hast won.
Angels in bright raiment Rolled the stone away,
Kept the folded grave-clothes Where Thy body lay.

sections.label: Refrain
lines: Thine is the glory, Risen, conquering Son;
Endless is the victory Thou o'er death hast won.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Let His Church with gladness Hymns of triumph sing,

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: No more we doubt Thee, Glorious Prince of life!
Make us more than conquerors, Through Thy deathless love;
Bring us safe through Jordan To Thy home above.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: The strife is o'er, the battle done;
Now is the victor's triumph won!
Now be the song of praise begun.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: The pow'rs of death have done their worst,
But Christ their legions has dispersed.
Let shouts of holy joy outburst.

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: The three sad days have quickly sped,
He rises glorious from the dead.
All glory to our risen head!

sections.label: Verse 5
lines: Lord, by the stripes which wounded You,
From death's sting free Your servants too,
That we may live and sing to You.

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Good Christian friends, rejoice and sing!
Now is the triumph of our King!
To all the world glad news we bring: Alleluia!

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: The Lord of life is risen for aye;
Bring flowers of song to strew His way;
Let all mankind rejoice and say: Alleluia!

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Praise we in songs of victory That love, that life which cannot die,
And sing with hearts uplifted high: Alleluia!

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: And sing today with one accord The life laid down, the life restored: Alleluia!

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: He'll soon appear, The last loud trumpet speaks Him near;
Hail Him, all saints, from pole to pole- How welcome to the faithful soul!

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: From heaven angelic voices sound: Behold the Lord of glory crowned,
And in His highest glories shine.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: The grave yields up its precious trust,
Which long has slumbered in the dust,
Now meet the Savior in the air.

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: He claims the kingdom for His own;
The saints rejoice, they shout, they sing,
And hail Him their triumphant King.

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Now the green blade rises from the buried grain,
What that in dark earth many days has lain;
Love lives again, that with the dead has been;
Love is come again like wheat arising green.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: In the grave they laid Him, love by hatred slain,
Thinking that He would never wake again,
Laid in the earth like grain that sleeps unseen;
Love is come again like wheat arising green.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Forth He came in triumph, like the risen grain,
He that for three days in the grave had lain;
Raised from the dead, my living Lord is seen;
Love is come again like wheat arising green.

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: When our hearts are wintry, grieving, or in pain,
Your touch can call us back to life again,
Field of our hearts that dead and bare have been;
Love is come again like wheat arising green.

translations.title: Hail the Day That Sees Him Rise

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Hail the day that sees Him rise, Alleluia!
Christ, awhile to mortals giv'n, Alleluia!

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Take the King of glory in!

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: He shows the prints of love: Alleluia!

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: Lord beyond our mortal sight, Alleluia!
Raise our hearts to reach Thy height, Alleluia!
There Thy face unclouded see, Alleluia!
Find our heav'n of heav'ns in Thee.

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Jesus, your blood and righteousness My beauty are, my glorious dress;
Mid flaming worlds, in these arrayed,
With joy shall I lift up my head.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Bold shall I stand in that great day,
Cleansed and redeemed, no debt to pay;
For by your cross absolved I am From sin and guilt, from fear and shame.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Lord, I believe your precious blood, Which at the mercy seat of God Pleads for the captives' liberty, Was also shed in love for me.

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: When from the dust of death I rise To claim my mansion in the skies,
This then shall be my only plea: Christ Jesus lived and died for me.

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Once our blessed Christ of beauty Was veiled off from human views;
But through suffering, death, and sorrow He has rent the veil in two.

sections.label: Refrain
lines: O behold the Man of Sorrows!
O behold Him in plain view!
He is the mighty Conqueror Since her rent the veil in two;
He is the mighty Conqueror Since her rent the veil in two.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Yes, He is with God, the Father, Interceding there for you;
For He is the Well beloved Since He rent the veil in two.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Holy angels bow before Him, Men of earth give praises due;
For He is the mighty Conqueror Since He rent the veil in two.

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: The wonders of redeeming love Our highest thoughts exceed;
The Son of God comes from above For sinful man to bleed.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: He gives Himself, His life, His all, A sinless sacrifice.
For man He drains the cup of gall, For man the victim dies.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: And now before His Father's face His precious blood He pleads;
For those who seek the throne of grace His love still intercedes.

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: He knows the frailties of our frame, For He has borne our grief;
Our great High Priest once felt the same, And He can send relief.

sections.label: Verse 5
lines: His love will not be satisfied,
Till He in glory sees The faithful ones for whom He died From sin forever free.

translations.title: O Listen to Our Wondrous Story

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: O listen to our wondrous story, Counted once among the lost;
Yet One came down from heaven's glory, Saving us at awful cost!

sections.label: Refrain
lines: Who saved us from eternal loss?
Who but God's Son upon the cross?
Believe it thou, In heaven interceding!

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: No angel could His place have taken, Highest of the high tho' he;
The loved One on the cross forsaken Was One of the Godhead three!

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Will you surrender to this Savior?
You, too, shall come to know His favor,
He will save you, save you now.

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Does Jesus care when my heart is pained Too deeply for mirth and song;
As the burdens press, and the cares distress,
And the way grows weary and long?

sections.label: Refrain
lines: O yes, He cares- I know He cares!
His heart is touched with my grief;
I know my Savior cares. (He cares.)

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Does Jesus care when my way is dark With a nameless dread and fear?
As the daylight fades into deep night shades,
Does He care enough to be near?

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Does Jesus care when I've said goodbye To the dearest on earth to me,
And my sad heart aches till it nearly breaks - Is it aught to Him?

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: His cross stands empty to the sky.
Let streets and homes with praises ring.
His love in death shall never die.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: No longer bound To distant years in Palestine,
He comes to claim the here and now And conquer every place and time.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: In every insult, rift, and war Where color, scorn or wealth divide,
He suffers still, yet loves the more,

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: Ascended Lord He rules the world His Father made,
His love adored Shall be to all on earth displayed.

translations.title: I Will Sing of Jesus' Love

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: I Will sing of Jesus love,
Sing of Him,who first loved me; for He left bright worlds above,

sections.label: Refrain
lines: I will sing of Jesus love Endless praise my heart shall give;
He has died that I might live I will sing His love to me.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: O the depths of love divine!
Earth or heaven can never know How that sin as dark as mine can be made as white as snow.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Nothing good for Him I've done;
How could He such love bestow?
Lord, I own my heart is won, help me now my love to show.

translations.title: போற்றுவேன் யேசு அன்பை! என்னை முன் நேசித்தாரே!

sections.label: சரணம் 1
lines: போற்றுவேன் யேசு அன்பை! என்னை முன் நேசித்தாரே!

sections.label: பல்லவி
lines: போற்றுவேன்! யேசு அன்பை என்றுமே என் மனதில்

sections.label: சரணம் 2
lines: நான் கண்ணீர் விடுமுன்னே எனக்காய்க் கண்ணீர் விட்டார்,

sections.label: சரணம் 3
lines: என் பாவக் கறை போக்கித் தூய்மை யாக்கினீரே, உம்
தெய்வீக அன்பின் ஆழம் யார் அளவிடக் கூடும்?

sections.label: சரணம் 4
lines: நான் தீமை செய்தபோது நீர் அன்பு காண்பித்தீரே.
என் உள்ளம் உமக்குத் தான் அன்பை உருவாக்குமே.

translations.title: Potruven Yesu Anpai! Ennai Mun Nesiththaare!

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Potruven Yesu Anpai! Ennai Mun Nesiththaare!

sections.label: Refrain
lines: Potruven! Yesu Anpai Endrume En Manadhil

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Naan Kanneer Vitumunne Enakkaaik Kanneer Vittaar,

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: En Paavak Karai Pokkith Thooimai Yaakkineere, Um
Theyveeka Anpin Aazham Yaar Alavitak Kootum?

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: Naan Theemai Seydhapodhu Neer Anpu Kaanpiththeere.
En Ullam Umakkuth Thaan Anpai Uruvaakkume.

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: I hear the Savior say, "Thy strength indeed is small;
Child of weakness, watch and pray, Find in Me thine all in all."

sections.label: Refrain
lines: Jesus paid it all, All to Him I owe;
Sin had left a crimson stain;
He washed it white as snow.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Lord, now indeed I find Thy power, and Thine alone,
And melt the heart of stone.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Since nothing good have I Whereby Thy grace to claim, I'll wash my garment white In the blood of Calvary's Lamb.

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: And when before the throne I stand in Him complete, I'll lay my trophies down,

translations.title: திக்கற்ற பாவி நான், சீர் கெட்ட நீசனே

sections.label: சரணம் 1
lines: திக்கற்ற பாவி நான், சீர் கெட்ட நீசனே,
சொந்த கிரியை கந்தை தான், என்றன் கதி யேசுவே.

sections.label: சரணம் 2
lines: என் நேச ரட்சகா! உம் திரு ரத்தமே
தீமை, கறை, மாசெல்லாம் நீங்கி விடச் செய்யுமே.

translations.title: Thikkatra Paavi Naan, Seer Ketta Neesane

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Thikkatra Paavi Naan, Seer Ketta Neesane,
Sondha Kiriyai Kandhai Thaan, Endran Kadhi Yesuve.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: En Nesa Ratchakaa! Um Thiru Raththame
Theemai, Karai, Maasellaam Neengi Vitach Cheyyume.

translations.title: Jesus Is All the World to Me

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Jesus is all the world to me, my life, my joy, my all; he is my strength from day to day, without him I would fall.
When I am sad, to him I go, no other one can cheer me so; when I am sad, he makes me glad, he's my friend.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Jesus is all the world to me, my friend in trials sore;
I go to him for blessings, and he gives them o'er and o'er.
He sends the sunshine and the rain, he sends the harvest's golden grain; sunshine and rain, harvest of grain, he's my friend.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Jesus is all the world to me, and true to him I'll be;
O how could I this friend deny, when he's so true to me?
Following him I know I'm right, he watches o'er me day and night; following him by day and night, he's my friend.

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: Jesus is all the world to me, I want no better friend;
I trust him now, I'll trust him when life's fleeting days shall end.
Beautiful life with such a friend, beautiful life that has no end; eternal life, eternal joy, he's my friend.

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: I've found a Friend; oh, such a Friend!
He loved me ere I knew Him;
He drew me with the cords of love, And thus He bound me to Him.
And 'round my heart still closely twine Those ties which nought can sever,
For I am His, and He is mine,

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: I've found a Friend; oh, such a Friend!
He bled, He died to save me;
And not alone the gift of life, But His own self He gave me.
Nought that I have my own I call, I hold it for the Giver;
My heart, my strength, my life my all, Are His, and His forever.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: I've found a Friend; oh, such a Friend!
All power to Him is given;
To guard me on my upward course, And bring me safe to heaven.
The eternal glories gleam afar, To nerve my faint endeavor;
So now to watch, to work, to war, And then to rest forever.

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: I've found a Friend; oh, such a Friend!
So kind, and true, and tender, So wise a counselor and guide, So mighty a defender.
From Him, who loveth me so well, What power my soul can sever?
Shall life or death, or earth, or hell?

translations.title: Jesus, What a Friend for Sinners

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Jesus! what a Friend for sinners!
Friends may fail me, foes assail me, He, my Savior, makes me whole.

sections.label: Refrain
lines: Saving, helping, keeping, loving, He is with me to the end.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Jesus! what a Strength in weakness!
Let me hide myself in Him.
Tempted, tried, and sometimes failing, He, my Strength, my victory wins.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Jesus! what a Help in sorrow!
While the billows over me roll,
Even when my heart is breaking, He, my Comfort, helps my soul.

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: I do now receive Him, [or Jesus!
I do now adore Him,] More than all in Him I find.
He hath granted me forgiveness, I am His, and He is mine.

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: O who am I that for my sake My Lord should take frail flesh and die?

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: He came from His blest throne,
But men made strange, and none The longed for Christ would know.
But O my Friend, my Friend indeed Who at my need His life did spend.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: And for His death they thirst and cry.

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: Why, what hath my Lord done?
What makes this rage and spite?
He made the lame to run, He gave the blind their sight.
Sweet injuries! yet they at these Themselves displease, and 'gainst Him rise.

sections.label: Verse 5
lines: They rise, and needs will have My dear Lord made away;
A murderer they save, The Prince of life they slay.
Yet cheerful He to suff'ring goes,
That He His foes from thence might free.

sections.label: Verse 6
lines: Here might I stay and sing, No story so divine: Never was love, dear King,
This is my Friend, in whose sweet praise I all my days could gladly spend.

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Who can cheer the heart like Jesus, By His presence all divine?
True and tender, pure and precious, Oh, how blest to call Him mine!

sections.label: Refrain
lines: All that thrills my soul is Jesus;
He is more than life to me; (to me;) And the fairest of ten thousand,
In my blessed Lord I see.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Love of Christ so freely given,

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Every need His hand supplying, Every good in Him I see;
On His strength divine relying, He is All in All to me.

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: By the crystal flowing river With the ransomed I will sing,
And forever and forever Praise and glorify the King.

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Jesus loves me! this I know, For the Bible tells me so;
Little ones to Him belong They are weak but He is strong

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: He wo died Heaven's gate to open wide: He will wash away my sin,
Let His little child come in.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Jesus, take this heart of mine, Make it pure and wholly thine;
On the coross You died for me, I will love and live for Thee.

translations.title: யேசு என்றன் நேசரே, கண்டேன் வேத நூலிலே

sections.label: சரணம் 1
lines: யேசு என்றன் நேசரே, கண்டேன் வேத நூலிலே,
பாலர் அவர் சொந்தம் தான் தாங்க அவர் வல்லோர் தான்.

sections.label: பல்லவி
lines: யேசு என் நேசர், யேசு என் நேசர்
யேசு என் நேசர், மெய் வேத வாக்கிதே.

sections.label: சரணம் 2
lines: என்னை மீட்க மரித்தார், மோட்ச வாசல் திறந்தார்,
என்றன் பாவம் நீக்குவார், பாலன் என்னை ரட்சிப்பார்.

sections.label: சரணம் 3
lines: யேசு தாங்கித் தேற்றுவார், பாது காக்க வருவார்.

sections.label: சரணம் 4
lines: நேசனாய் நான் மரித்தால், மோட்சம் சேர்ப்பார் அன்பினால்.

translations.title: Yesu Endran Nesare, Kanten Vedha Noolile

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Yesu Endran Nesare, Kanten Vedha Noolile,
Paalar Avar Sondham Thaan Thaanga Avar Vallor Thaan.

sections.label: Refrain
lines: Yesu En Nesar, Yesu En Nesar
Yesu En Nesar, Mey Vedha Vaakkidhe.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Ennai Meetka Mariththaar, Motcha Vaasal Thirandhaar,
Endran Paavam Neekkuvaar, Paalan Ennai Ratchippaar.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Yesu Thaangith Thetruvaar, Paadhu Kaakka Varuvaar.

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: Nesanaai Naan Mariththaal, Motcham Serppaar Anpinaal.

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Love divine, all loves excelling, joy of heaven, to earth come down; fix in us thy humble dwelling; all thy faithful mercies crown!
Jesus thou art all compassion, pure, unbounded love thou art; visit us with thy salvation; enter every trembling heart.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Breathe, O breathe thy loving Spirit into every troubled breast!
Let us all in thee inherit; let us find that second rest.
Take away our bent to sinning;
Alpha and Omega be; end of faith, as its beginning, set our hearts at liberty.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Come, Almighty to deliver, let us all thy life receive; suddenly return and never, nevermore thy temples leave.
Thee we would be always blessing, serve thee as thy hosts above, pray and praise thee without ceasing, glory in thy perfect love.

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: Finish, then, thy new creation; pure and spotless let us be.
Let us see thy great salvation perfectly restored in thee; changed from glory into glory, till in heaven we take our place, till we cast our crowns before thee, lost in wonder, love, and praise.

translations.title: அன்பின் ரூபி திவ்யானந்தம் பாரில் ஈய வந்தீரே!

sections.label: சரணம் 1
lines: அன்பின் ரூபி திவ்யானந்தம் பாரில் ஈய வந்தீரே!
எங்கள் ஏழை நெஞ்சில் வாசம் பண்ணி மருள் தீர்ப்பீரே
பாரத் துக்கங் கொண்ட உள்ளம் வந்து தேற்றல் செய்குவீர்.

sections.label: சரணம் 2
lines: உமது நல் ஆவி தாரும் எங்கள் நெஞ்சு பூரிப்பாய்
உம்மில் சார நீரே வாரும், சுத்த நேச வடிவாய்;
பாவ ஆசை எல்லாம் நீக்கி அடியாரை ரட்சியும்

sections.label: சரணம் 3
lines: என்றும் உம்மை ஸ்தோத்தரித்து வானோர் போலச் சேவிப்போம்;

sections.label: சரணம் 4
lines: நாங்கள் நித்ய வீட்டில் சேர்ந்து கறை திரை இன்றியே,
உன்றன் சாயல் பெற்று வாழ்ந்து; தேவ அன்பில் மூழ்கியே
எங்கள் க்ரீடம் உன்தன் பாதம் வைத்துப் போற்றும் வரைக்கும்,
நாதா, அடியாரை நித்தம் மறு ரூப மாக்கிடும்.

translations.title: Anpin Roopi Thivyaanandham Paaril Eeya Vandheere!

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Anpin Roopi Thivyaanandham Paaril Eeya Vandheere!
Engal Ezhai Nenjil Vaasam Panni Marul Theerppeere
Paarath Thukkang Konta Ullam Vandhu Thetral Seykuveer.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Umadhu Nal Aavi Thaarum Engal Nenju Poorippaai
Ummil Saara Neere Vaarum, Suththa Nesa Vativaai;
Paava Aasai Ellaam Neekki Atiyaarai Ratchiyum

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Endrum Ummai Sdhoththariththu Vaanor Polach Chevippom;

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: Naangal Nidhya Veettil Serndhu Karai Thirai Indriye,
Undran Saayal Petru Vaazhndhu; Theva Anpil Moozhkiye
Engal Kreetam Undhan Paadham Vaiththup Potrum Varaikkum,
Naadhaa, Atiyaarai Niththam Maru Roopa Maakkitum.

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Who can cheer the heart like Jesus, By His presence all divine?
True and tender, pure and precious, Oh, how blest to call Him mine!

sections.label: Refrain
lines: All that thrills my soul is Jesus;
He is more than life to me; (to me;) And the fairest of ten thousand,
In my blessed Lord I see.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Love of Christ so freely given,

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Every need His hand supplying, Every good in Him I see;
On His strength divine relying, He is All in All to me.

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: By the crystal flowing river With the ransomed I will sing,
And forever and forever Praise and glorify the King.

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Saviour, teach me day by day,
Loving Him who first loved me.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: With a child's glad heart of love,
At Thy bidding may I move,
Prompt to serve and follow Thee,
Loving Him who first loved me.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Teach me I am not my own, I am Thine, and Thine alone;
Thine to keep, to rule, to save From all sin that would enslave.

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: Love in loving finds employ, In obedience all her joy;
Ever new that joy will be, Loving Him who first loved me.

sections.label: Verse 5
lines: Teach me thus Thy steps to trace, Strong to follow in Thy grace.
Learning how to love from Thee, Loving Him who first loved me.

translations.title: Sing We of the Modern City

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Sing we of the modern city, Scene alike of joy and stress;
Sing we of its nameless people In their urban wilderness.
Into endless rows of houses Life is set a millionfold,
Life expressed in human beings Daily born and growing old.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: In the city full of people,
World of speed and hectic days,
In the ever-changing setting Of the latest trend and craze,
Christ is present, and among us;
In the crowd we see Him stand.
In the bustle of the city Jesus Christ is every man.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: God is not remote in heaven,
But on earth to share our shame,
Changing graph and mass and number Into persons with a name.
By His timeless presence proving People matter, people count!

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: "There shall be showers of blessing;" This is the promise of love;
There shall be seasons refreshing, Sent from the Savior above.

sections.label: Refrain
lines: Showers of blessing, Showers of blessing we need;
Mercy drops round us are falling, But for the showers we plead.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: "There shall be showers of blessing;" Precious reviving again;
Over the hills and the valleys, Sound of abundance of rain.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: "There shall be showers of blessing;" Send them upon us, O Lord;
Grant to us now a refreshing;
Come, and now honor Thy word.

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: "There shall be showers of blessing;" O that today they might fall,
Now as to God were confessing,
Now as on Jesus we call!

translations.title: Tell Me the Old, Old Story

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Tell me the old, old story,
For I am weak and weary,

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Tell me the story softly, With earnest tones and grave;
Remember I'm the sinner Whom Jesus came to save;
Tell me the story always, If you would really be,
In any time of trouble, A comforter to me.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Tell me the same old story,
When you have cause to fear That this world's empty glory Is costing me too dear;
Yes, and when that world's glory Is dawning on my soul,
Tell me the old, old story: "Christ Jesus makes thee whole."

translations.title: The King of Love My Shepherd Is

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: The King of love my Shepherd is, Whose goodness faileth never;
I nothing lack if I am His, And He is mine forever.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Where streams of living water flow My ransomed soul He leadeth,
And, where the verdant pastures grow,

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Perverse and foolish, oft I strayed,
But yet in love He sought me,
And on His shoulder gently laid,

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: And so through all the length of days Thy goodness faileth never;
I would sing Thy praise Within Thy house forever.

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: And can it be that I should gain an interest in the Savior's blood!
Died he for me? who caused his pain!
For me? who him to death pursued?
How can it be that thou, my God, shouldst die for me?

sections.label: Refrain
lines: How can it be that thou, my God, shouldst die for me?

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: He left his Father's throne above so free, so infinite his grace!; emptied himself of all but love, and bled for Adam's helpless race.
'Tis mercy all, immense and free, for O my God, it found out me!
