sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Long my imprisoned sprit lay, fast bound in sin and nature's night; thine eye diffused a quickening ray;
I woke, the dungeon flamed with light; my chains fell off, my heart was free,
I rose, went forth, and followed thee.

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: Jesus, and all in him, is mine; alive in him, my living Head, and clothed in righteousnes divine, bold I approach th' eternal throne, and claim the crown, through Christ my own.

translations.title: The Head That Once Was Crowned

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: The head that once was crowned with thorns Is crowned with glory now;
A royal diadem adorns The mighty victor's brow.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: The highest place that heaven affords Is His, is His by right;
The King of kings, and Lord of lords, And heaven's eternal light.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: The joy of all who dwell above,
To whom He manifests His love,
And grants His name to know.

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: To them the cross, with all its shame,
With all its grace is given;
Their name an everlasting name, Their joy the joy of heaven.

sections.label: Verse 5
lines: To them the cross, with all its shame,
With all its grace is given;
Their name an everlasting name, Their joy the joy of heaven.

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: The Lord is coming, let this be The herald note of jubilee;
And when we meet and when we part The salutation from the heart.

sections.label: Chorus 4
lines: The Lord is coming, let this be The herald note of jubilee,

sections.label: Chorus 3
lines: The Lord is coming, let this be The herald note of jubilee,

sections.label: Chorus 2
lines: The Lord is coming, let this be The herald note of jubilee,

sections.label: Chorus 1
lines: The Lord is coming, let this be The herald note of jubilee,

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: The Lord is coming, sound it forth From east to west, from south to north;
Speed on the tidings glad, That none who love Him may be sad.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: The Lord is coming, swift and sure And all His judgements shall endure,
And none can hope to escape His wrath,
Who walk not in the narrow path.

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: This earth, with her ten thousand wrongs Will soon be tuned to nobler songs;
Our praise shall then, in realms of light,

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Christ is coming! let creation Bid her groans and travail cease;
Let the glorious proclamation Hope restore and faith increase;
Come, Thou blessed Prince of Peace! (Prince of Peace!) Come, Thou blessed Prince of Peace!

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Earth can now but tell the story Of Thy bitter cross and pain;
She shall yet behold Thy glory When Thou comest back to reign;
Let each heart repeat the strain. (repeat the strain) Let each heart repeat the strain.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: With that 'blessed hope' before us, Let no harp remain unstrung;
Let the mighty advent chorus Onward roll from tongue to tongue: Christ is coming!
Come, Lord Jesus, quickly come! (quickly come!) Come, Lord Jesus, quickly come!

translations.title: Hail Him the King of Glory

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Tell it to every kindred and nation, Tell it far and near;
Earth's darkest night will fade with the dawning,

sections.label: Refrain
lines: Hail Him the King of glory, Once the Lamb for sinners slain;
Tell, tell the wondrous story, 'Jesus comes to reign.'

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Nations again in strife and commotion, Warnings by the way;
Signs in the heavens, unerring omens, Herald the glorious day.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Children of God look up with rejoicing;
Bless'd are they who, waiting and watching,

sections.label: சரணம் 1
lines: நம் யேசு ராஜன் வரும் பொழுது பொழுது விடியும்.

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Nam Yesu Raajan Varum Pozhudhu Pozhudhu Vitiyum.

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: This is the threefold truth On which our faith depends;
And with this joyful cry Worship begins and ends;

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: By this we are upheld When doubt and grief assails Our Christian fortitude,

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: This is the threefold truth Which, if we hold it fast,
Changes the world and us And brings us home at last.

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Come, thou long expected Jesus! born to set thy people free; from our fears and sins release us, let us find our rest in thee.
Israel's strength and consolation, hope of all the earth thou art; dear desire of every nation, joy of every longing heart.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Born thy people to deliver, born a child and yet a King, born to reign in us forever, now thy gracious kingdom bring.
By thine own eternal spirit rule in all our hearts alone; by thine all sufficient merit, raise us to thy glorious throne.

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: The golden morning is fast approaching;
Jesus soon will come To take his faithful and happy children to their promised home

sections.label: Refrain
lines: O, we see the gleams of the golden morning piercing thro' this night of gloom!
O, see the gleams of the golden morning that will burst the tomb.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: The gospel summons will soon be carried to the nations round;
The Bridegroom then will cease to tarry and the trumpet sound.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Attended by all the shining angels,
Down the flaming sky the Judge will come, and will take his people where they will not die.

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: The lov'd of earth who have long been parted,
The tears of those who are broken hearted shall be wiped away.

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Face to face with Christ my Savior,
Face to face, what will it be,
When with rapture I behold Him,
Jesus Christ, who died for me?

sections.label: Refrain
lines: Face to face shall I behold Him, Far beyond the starry sky;
Face to face in all His glory I shall see Him by and by!

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Only faintly now I see Him,
But a blessed day is coming,
When His glory shall be seen.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: What rejoicing in His presence, When are banished grief and pain;
When the crooked ways are straightened,
And the dark things shall be plain!

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: Face to face! oh, blissful moment!
Face to face to see and know;
Face to face with my Redeemer, Jesus Christ, who loves me so.

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: It may be at morn, when the day is awaking,
When sunlight through darkness and shadow is breaking,
That Jesus will come in the fullness of glory To receive from the world His own.

sections.label: Refrain
lines: O Lord Jesus, how long, how long Ere we shout the glad song?

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: It may be at midday, it may be at twilight, It may be, perchance, that the blackness of midnight Will burst into light in the blaze of His glory,

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: O delight! should we go without dying, No sickness, no sadness, no dread, and no crying,
Caught up through the clouds with our Lord into glory,

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: There'll be no dark valleys when Jesus comes,
There'll be no dark valleys when Jesus comes,
There'll be no dark valleys when Jesus comes,
To gather His loved ones home.

sections.label: Refrain
lines: To gather His loved ones home, To gather His loved ones home.
There'll be no dark valleys when Jesus comes,
To gather His loved ones home.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: There'll be no more sorrow when Jesus comes,
There'll be no more sorrow when Jesus comes,
There'll be a happy tomorrow when Jesus comes,
To gather His loved ones home.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: There'll be songs of greeting when Jesus comes,
There'll be songs of greeting when Jesus comes,
There'll be songs of greeting when Jesus comes,
To gather His loved ones home.

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: That glorious day is coming, The hour is hastening on;
Its radiant light is nearing, Far brighter than the sun;
To meet Him in the air.
The saints, then all victorious Will go to meet their Lord;
An earth both bright and glorious, Will then be their reward;
And God Himself there reigning, Will wipe all tears away;
Nor clouds nor night remaining, But one eternal day.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: O Christian, keep from sleeping, And let your love abound;
Be watchful, prayerful, faithful, The trumpet soon will sound!
Then you, in that blest morning, May meet Him in the sky!

translations.title: Wake, Awake for the Night Is Flying

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Wake, awake, for night is flying, The watchmen on the heights are crying, Awake, Jerusalem, arise!
His chariot wheels are nearer rolling,
He comes; prepare, ye virgins wise.
Rise up with willing feet Go forth, the Bridegroom meet;
Bear through the night your well-trimmed light,
Speed forth to join the marriage rite.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Her heart with deep delight is springing,
She wakes, she rises from her gloom;
In grace arrayed, by truth victorious;
Her Star is risen, her Light is come!
All hail, incarnate Lord, Our crown, and our reward!
We haste along, in pomp and song,
And gladsome join the marriage throng.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Lamb of God, the heavens adore Thee,
And men and angels sing before Thee,
With harp and cymbal's clearest tone.
By the pearly gates in wonder We stand, and swell the voice of thunder,
That echoes round Thy dazzling throne.
No vision ever brought, No ear hath ever caught,
We raise the song, we swell the throng,
To praise Thee ages all along.

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: He comes, with clouds descending, Once for favored sinners slain;
Swell the triumph of His train: Hallelujah!
Jesus comes, and comes to reign.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Every eye shall now behold Him Robed in dreadful majesty!
Those who set at nought and sold Him,
Pierced, and nailed Him to the tree,

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: When the solemn trump has sounded,
Heaven and earth shall flee away;
All who hate Him, must, confounded,
Hear the summons of that day- 'Come to judgment!

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: Yea, amen! let all adore Thee, High on Thy eternal throne!
Savior, take the power and glory,
O come quickly, O come quickly, Claim the kingdom for Thine own!

translations.title: 'Tis Almost Time for the Lord to Come

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: 'Tis almost time for the Lord to come, I hear the people say;
The stars of heaven are growing dim, It must be the breaking of the day.

sections.label: Refrain
lines: O it must be the breaking of the day!
O it must be the breaking of the day!
The night is almost gone, The day is coming on;
O it must be the breaking of the day!

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: The signs foretold in the sun and moon,
In earth and sea and sky,
The coming of the Master draweth nigh.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: It must be time for the waiting church To cast her pride away,
With girded loins and burning lamps,
To look for the breaking of the day.

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: Go quickly out in the streets and lanes And in the broad highway,
And call the maimed, the halt, and blind,
To be ready for the breaking of the day.

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Lift up the trumpet, and loud let it ring: Jesus is coming again!
Cheer up, ye pilgrims, be joyful and sing: Jesus is coming again!

sections.label: Refrain
lines: Coming again, coming again, Jesus is coming again!

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Echo it, hilltops; proclaim it, ye plains: Jesus is coming again!
Coming in glory, the Lamb that was slain;

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Heavings of earth, tell the vast, wondering throng: Jesus is coming again!
Tempests and whirlwinds, the anthem prolong;

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: Nations are angry'by this we do know Jesus is coming again!
Knowledge increases; men run to and fro;

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: We have this hope that burns within our heart,
Hope in the coming of the Lord.
We have this faith that Christ alone imparts,
Faith in the promise of His Word.
We believe the time is here,
When the nations far and near Shall awake, and shout and sing Hallelujah!
We have this hope that burns within our heart,
Hope in the coming of the Lord.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: We are united in Jesus Christ our Lord.
We are united in His love.
Love for the waiting people of the world,
People who need our Savior's love.
Soon the heav'ns will open wide,
Christ will come to claim His bride,
All the universe will sing Hallelujah!
We have this hope this faith, and God's great love,

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: The King shall come when morning dawns And light triumphant breaks,
When beauty gilds the eastern hills And life to joy awakes.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Not as of old a little child,
To bear and fight and die,
But crowned with glory like the sun That lights the morning sky.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: O, brighter than that rising morn When Christ, victorious, rose And left the lonesome place death,

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: O, brighter than that glorious morn Shall dawn upon our race They day when Christ in splendour comes,
And we shall see His face.

sections.label: Verse 5
lines: The King shall come when morning dawns And light and beauty brings.
Your people pray: Come quickly, King of kings.

translations.title: When the Roll Is Called Up Yonder

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: When the trumpet of the Lord shall sound, and time shall be no more,
And the morning breaks, eternal, bright and fair;
When the saved of earth shall gather over on the other shore,
And the roll is called up yonder, I'll be there.

sections.label: Refrain
lines: When the roll is called up yonder,
When the roll is called up yonder,
When the roll is called up yonder,
When the roll is called up yonder, I'll be there.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: On that bright and cloudless morning, when the dead in Christ shall rise,
And the glory of His resurection share;
When His chosen ones shall gather to their home beyond the skies,
And the roll is called up yonder, I'll be there.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Let us labor for the Master from the dawn till setting sun,
Let us talk of all His wondrous love and care,
Then, when all of life is over, and our work on earth is done,
And the roll is called up yonder I'll be there.

translations.title: திவ்யக் காள சத்தம் கேட்க யேசு தோன்றும் காலத்தில்

lines: Thivyak Kaala Saththam Ketka Yesu Thondrum Kaalaththil

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: The church has waited long Her absent Lord to see;
And still in loneliness she waits, A friendless stranger she.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: How long, O Lord our God, Holy and true and good, Wilt Thou not judge Thy suffering church, Her sighs and tears and blood?

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: We long to hear Thy voice,
To see Thee face to face,
To share Thy crown and glory then,
As now we share Thy grace.

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: Come, Lord, and wipe away The curse, the sin, the stain, And make this blighted world of ours Thine own fair world again.

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: When He cometh, when He cometh To make up His jewels,

sections.label: Refrain
lines: Like the stars of the morning,
They shall shine in their beauty,

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: He will gather, He will gather The gems for His kingdom;
All the pure ones, all the bright ones, His loved and His own.

translations.title: அருள் நாதர் வரும் போது தம் சம்பத்தைச் சேர்ப்பார்.

sections.label: சரணம் 1
lines: அருள் நாதர் வரும் போது தம் சம்பத்தைச் சேர்ப்பார்.

sections.label: சரணம் 2

தூய நெஞ்சர், நல்ல நேசர், தம் ரத்னம் என்பார்.

சிறு பாலர், சிறு தாசர், தம் ரத்னம் என்பார்.

translations.title: Arul Naadhar Varum Podhu Tham Sampaththaich Cherppaar.

lines: Arul Naadhar Varum Podhu Tham Sampaththaich Cherppaar.
Sarva Pakdhar, Arul Petraar, Tham Radhnam Enpaar.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Raajyam Thannil Nesamaaka Tham Thaasaraich Cherppaar
Thooya Nenjar, Nalla Nesar, Tham Radhnam Enpaar.

lines: Arul Naadhar Thayai Meedhu Mey Nampikkai Vaiththaar.
Siru Paalar, Siru Thaasar, Tham Radhnam Enpaar.

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: As Lord and King of kings,
O what a wondrous story The blessed Bible brings: His face will shine like the sunlight,
His head be white as snow,

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: His voice like rushing waters Will reach with mighty sound Into the deepest quarters Of all creation round;
And at this wondrous greeting The dead in Christ shall rise,
Their Lord and Saviour meeting In glory in the skies.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: And we who believing And His appearing love,
Shall know we are receiving His glory from above;
His resurrection power Will raise us to the place Where we that wondrous hour Shall see Him face to face.

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: O hasten Thine appearing Thou bright and Morning Star!
Lord, may we soon be hearing The trumpet sound afar;
They people all are yearning To be Thy raptured bride,
To be Thy own returning Be caught up to Thy side.

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: We shall see the Lord in glory when He comes!
As I read the gospel story,
We shall see the Lord in glory,
We shall see the Lord in glory when He comes!

sections.label: Refrain
lines: With the alleluias ringing to the sky,
With the alleluias ringing to the sky!
As I read the gospel in glory,
We shall see the Lord in glory,
With the alleluias ringing in the sky!

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: We shall hear the trumpet sounded when He comes!
We shall hear the trumpet sounded,
See the Lord by saints surrounded,
We shall hear the trumpet sounded when He comes!

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: We shall all rise up to meet Him when He comes!
We shall all rise up to meet Him,
When He calls His own to greet Him We shall all rise up to meet Him when He comes!

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Rejoice, give thanks, and sing and triumph evermore Lift up your heart, lift up your voice!

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Jesus, the Savior, reigns, The God of truth and love;
When He had purged our stains,
He took His seat above Lift up your heart, lift up your voice!

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: He rules o'er earth and heaven The keys of death and grave Are to our Jesus given Lift up your heart, lift up your voice!

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: Our Lord the judge shall come,
And take His servants up To their eternal home Lift up your heart, lift up your voice!

translations.title: Hark! Ten Thousand Harps and Voices

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Hark! ten thousand harps and voices Sound the note of praise above;
Jesus reigns, the God of love: See,

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: King of glory, reign forever, Thine an everlasting crown;
Nothing from Thy love shall sever Those whom Thou hast made Thine own;
Happy objects of Thy grace, Destined to behold Thy face.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Bring, O bring the glorious day, When, the awful summons hearing, Heaven and earth shall pass away:;
Then, with golden harps we'll sing, 'Glory, glory to our King!' Alleluia!

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Crown him with many crowns, the Lamb upon his throne,
Hark! how the heavenly anthem drowns all music but its own.
Awake, my soul, and sing of him who died for thee, and hail him as thy matchless King through all eternity.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Crown him the Lord of love! behold his hands and side, those wounds, yet visible above, in beauty glorified;
No angel in the sky Can fully bear that sight,
But downward bend his wondering eye At mysteries so great.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Crown him the Lord of peace! whose power a scepter sways from pole to pole, that wars may cease, and all be prayer and praise.
His reign shall know no end, and round his pierced feet fair flowers of paradise extend their fragrance ever sweet.

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: Crown him the Lord of years;
For thou hast died for me; thy praise shall never, never fail throughout eternity.

sections.label: சரணம் 3
lines: போர் ஓய்ந்து ஜெப ஸ்தோத்திரமே பூமியை நிரப்பும்;

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Por Oindhu Jepa Sdhoththirame Poomiyai Nirappum;

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Seek ye first the kingdom, 'Tis your Father's will.
So the voice of Jesus bids us follow still.
Saviour, we would hear Thee, Follow, find, and see;
And in life's adventure Thy disciples be.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: When at last discovered, some will sell their all;
So, when breaks the vision of that kingdom fair,
Ours shall be its riches And its beauty rare.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: As the silent leaven works its secret way,
Or as grows the seed grain through the night and day;
Lord, so be the increase, peaceable but sure,

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: As the tender seedling grows up tall and strong,
And the birds of heaven to its branches throng;
So shall all God's children, from the east and west,

sections.label: Verse 5
lines: Humblest shall be greatest, poor in spirit reign;
Home shall come the childlike, born through Thee again;
Eager hearts arrive there on the pilgrim's road, Hail!
The kingdom glorious of the living God!

translations.title: God Is Working His Purpose Out

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: God is working His purpose out As year suceeds to year;
God is working His purpose out, And the time is drawing near;
Nearer and nearer draws the time,
The time that shall surely be When the earth shall be filled with the glory of God As the waters cover the sea.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: From utmost east to utmost west,
By the mouth of many messengers Goes forth the voice of God;
Give ear to me, ye confinents,
Ye isles, give ear to me,
That the earth shall be filled with the glory of God As the waters cover the sea.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: March we forth in the strength of God With the banner of Christ unfurled,
That the light of the glorious gospel of truth May shine throughout the world: Fight we the fight with sorrow and sin To set their captives free,
That the earth shall be filled with the glory of God As the waters cover the sea.

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: All we can do is nothing worth Unless God blesses the deed;
Vainly we hope for the harvest tide Till God gives life to teh seed;
Yet nearer and nearer draws the time,
The time that shall surely be,
When the earth shall be filled with the glory of God As the waters cover the sea.

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Lift up your heads, ye mighty gates!
Behold the King of glory waits;
The King of kings is drawing near,
The Savior of the world is here.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: The Lord is just, a helper tried;
Mercy is ever at His side;
His kingly crowns is holiness, His scepter, pity in distress.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: O blest the land, the city blest,
Where Christ the Ruler is confessed!
O happy hearts and happy homes To whom this King in triumph comes!

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: Fling wide the portals of your heart;
Make it a temple, set apart From earthly use for heaven's employ,
Adorned with prayer, and love, and joy.

sections.label: Verse 5
lines: I open wide My heart to Thee; here, Lord, abide.
Let me Thy inner presence feel, Thy grace and love in me reveal.

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Jesus shall reign where'er the sun Does his successive journeys run;
His kingdom stretch from shore to shore,
Till moons shall wax and wane no more.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: People and realms of ev'ry tongue Dwell on His love with sweetest song,
And infant voices shall proclaim Their early blessings on His name.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: The prisoner leaps to lose his chains;
The weary find eternal rest, And all who suffer want are blessed.

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: Let every creature rise and bring Honors peculiar to our King;
Angels descend with songs again, And earth repeat the loud amen!

translations.title: A Hymn of Glory Let Us Sing

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: A hymn of glory let us sing;
New hymns thro'-out the world shall ring Alleluia!
Christ, by a road before untrod, Ascends unto the throne of God.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: O Lord, our homeward pathway bend,
Where, seated on Your Father's throne,
You reign as King of kings alone.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Give us Your joy on earth, O Lord, In heav'n to be our great reward.
When throned with You forever, we Shall praise Your name eternally.

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: All praise to you let earth accord: Alleluia!
You are, while endless ages run, With Father and with Spirit one.

translations.title: All Hail the Power of Jesus' Name

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: All hail the power of Jesus' name!
Bring forth the royal diadem, and crown Him Lord of all.
Bring forth the royal diadem, and crown Him Lord of all.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Ye chosen seed of Israel's race, ye ransomed from the fall,
Hail Him who saves you by His grace, and crown Him Lord of all.
Hail Him who saves you by His grace, and crown Him Lord of all.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Let every kindred, every tribe on this terrestrial ball To Him all majesty ascribe, and crown Him Lord of all.
To Him all majesty ascribe, and crown Him Lord of all.

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: O that with yonder angel throng we at His feet may fall!
We'll join the everlasting song, and crown Him Lord of all.
We'll join the everlasting song, and crown Him Lord of all.

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: All glory, laud, and honor, to thee, Redeemer, King, to whom the lips of children made sweet hosannas ring.
Thou art the King of Israel, thou David's royal Son, who in the Lord's name comest, the King and Blessed One.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: The company of angels are praising thee on high, and we with all creation in chorus make reply.
The people of the Hebrews with psalms before thee went; our prayer and praise and anthems before thee we present.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: To thee, before thy passion, they sang their hymns of praise; to thee, now high exalted, our melody we raise.
Thou didst accept their praises; accept the prayers we bring, who in all good delightest, thou good and gracious King.

sections.label: சரணம் 5
lines: அப்பாட்டைக் கேட்ட வண்ணம் எம் வேண்டல் கேளுமே;

sections.label: Verse 5
lines: Appaattaik Ketta Vannam Em Vental Kelume;

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Blest be the King whose coming Is in the name of God!
For Him let doors be opened, No hearts against Him barred!
Not robed in royal splendor, In power and pomp comes He;
But clad as are the poorest, Such His humility.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Blest be the King whose coming Is in the name of God!
By those who truly listen His voice is truly heard;
Who have not learned to heed The Christ who is the promise,

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Blest be the King whose coming Is in the name of God!
He only to the humble Reveals the face of God.
All power is His, all glory!
All things are in His hand,
All ages and all peoples, 'Till time itself shall end.

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: Blest be the King whose coming Is in the name of God!
He offers to the burdened The rest and grace they need.
And light his Yoke shall be,
For He would have us bear it, So He can made us free!

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: At the name of Jesus every knee shall bow,
Every tongue confess Him King of glory now;
'Tis the Father's pleasure we should call Him Lord,
Who from the beginning was the mighty Word.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: At His voice creation sprang at once to sight,
Thrones and dominations stars upon their way,
All the heavenly orders in their great array.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: To receive a name From the lips of sinners,

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: In your hearts enthrone Him: There let Him subdue All that is not holy,
Crown Him as your captain in temptation's hour,
Let His will enfold you in its light and power.

sections.label: Verse 5
lines: Surely, this Lord Jesus shall return again,
For all wreaths of empire meet upon His brow,
And our hearts confess Him King of glory now.

translations.title: Christ, Whose Glory Fills the Skies

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Christ, whose glory fills the skies,
Christ, the true, the only light,
Sun of Righteousness, arise, triumph o'er the shades of night;
Dayspring from on high, be near;

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Dark and cheerless is the morn unaccompanied by thee; joyless is the day's return, till thy mercy's beams I see; till they inward light impart, cheer my eyes and warm my heart.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Visit then this soul of mine; pierce the gloom of sin and grief; fill me,
Radiancy divine, scatter all my unbelief; more and more thyself display, shining to the perfect day.

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Christ and none other; born in our darkness,
He became our brother- if we have seen Him, we have seen the Father: Glory to God on high!

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Christ and none other; no one can serve Him, and despise another.
Who else unites us, one in God the Father?

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Christ and none other; sold once for silver, murdered here, our brother- He, who redeems us, reigns with God the Father: Glory to God on high!

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: Give God the glory, God and none other; give God the glory, Spirit, Son and Father; give God the glory, God-with-us our brother: Glory to God on high!

translations.title: Christ Is Made the Sure Foundation

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Christ is made the sure foundation,
Christ the head and cornerstone, chosen of the Lord, and precious, binding all the Church in one; holy Zion's help for ever, and her confidence alone.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: All that dedicated city, dearly loved of God on high, in exultant jubilation pours perpetual melody;
God the One in Three adoring in glad hymns eternally.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: To this temple, where we call thee, come,
O Lord of Hosts, today; with thy wonted loving-kindness hear thy servants as they pray, and thy fullest benediction shed within its walls alway.

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: Here vouchsafe to all thy servants what they ask of thee of gain; what they gain from thee, for ever with the bless'd to retain, and hereafter in thy glory evermore with thee to reign.

sections.label: Verse 5
lines: Laud and honor to the Father, laud and honor to the Son, laud and honor to the Spirit, ever Three, and ever One, con-substantial, co-eternal, while unending ages run.

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: I love Thee, I love Thee, I love Thee,my Lord;
I love Thee, my Savior, I love Thee, my God.
I love Thee, I love Thee, and that Thou dost know;
But how much I love Thee my actions will show.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: I'm happy, I'm happy, O, wondrous account!
My joys are immortal, I stand on the mount!
I gaze on my treasure and long to be there,
With Jesus and angels, and kindred so dear.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: O Jesus, my Savior, with Thee I am blest,
My life and salvation, my joy and my rest: Thy name be my theme, and Thy love be my song;
Thy grace shall inspire both my heart and my tongue.

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: He smiles, and He loves me, and helps me to sing.
I'll praise Him, I'll praise Him, with notes loud and clear While rivers of pleasure my spirit do cheer.

translations.title: In the Cross of Christ I Glory

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: In the cross of Christ I glory, towering o'er the wrecks of time; all the light of sacred story gathers round its head sublime.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: When the woes of life o'ertake me, hopes deceive, and fears annoy, never shall the cross forsake me.
Lo! it glows with peace and joy.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: When the sun of bliss is beaming light and love upon my way, from the cross the radiance streaming adds more luster to the day.

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: Bane and blessing, pain and pleasure, by the cross are sanctified; peace is there that knows no measure, joys that through all time abide.

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: How sweet the name of Jesus sounds In a believer's ear!
It soothes his sorrows, heals his wounds,

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: It makes the wounded spirit whole, And calms the troubled breast;
'Tis manna to the hungry soul, And to the weary, rest.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Dear name, the rock on which I build,
My neverfailing treasury, filled With boundless stores of grace.

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: Jesus! my Shepherd, Guardian, Friend, My Prophet, Priest, and King!
My Lord, my life, my way, my end!

sections.label: Verse 5
lines: Weak is the effort of my heart, And cold my warmest thought;
But when I see Thee as Thou art, I'll praise Thee as I ought.

translations.title: நல் மீட்பர் இயேசு நாமமே என் காதுக்கின்பமாம்

sections.label: சரணம் 1
lines: நல் மீட்பர் இயேசு நாமமே என் காதுக்கின்பமாம்;

sections.label: சரணம் 4
lines: என் ரட்சகா, என் கேடகம் என் கோட்டையும் நீரே;

sections.label: சரணம் 5
lines: மாநேசர், மேய்ப்பர், பர்த்தாவும்; என் ஜீவனும் நீரே;

sections.label: சரணம் 6
lines: என் நெஞ்சின் ஊக்கம் அற்பந்தான், என் அன்பில் குளிர்ந்தேன்;
உம் முகம் பார்க்கும் போதோ, நான் சீராகப் போற்றுவேன்.

sections.label: சரணம் 7
lines: இம்மையில் ஆயுள் முழுதும் உம் அன்பைக் கூறுவேன்;
உம் நாமத்தால் என் சாவிலும் நான் ஆறித் தேறுவேன்.

translations.title: Nal Meetpar Iyesu Naamame En Kaadhukkinpamaam

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Nal Meetpar Iyesu Naamame En Kaadhukkinpamaam;

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: En Ratchakaa, En Ketakam En Kottaiyum Neere;

sections.label: Verse 5
lines: Maanesar, Meyppar, Parththaavum; En Jeevanum Neere;

sections.label: Verse 6
lines: En Nenjin Ookkam Arpandhaan, En Anpil Kulirndhen;
Um Mukam Paarkkum Podho, Naan Seeraakap Potruven.

sections.label: Verse 7
lines: Immaiyil Aayul Muzhudhum Um Anpaik Kooruven;
Um Naamaththaal En Saavilum Naan Aarith Theruven.

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Truest Friend to me: Ah! how long I've panted,
And my heart has fainted, thirsting,
Thine I am, O spotless Lamb, I will suffer naught to hide Thee, Nought I ask beside Thee.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: In Thine arms I rest me; foes who would molest me Cannot reach me here.
Sin and hell in conflict fell,
With their bitter storms assail me,

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: For the Lord of gladness, Jesus, enters in.
Though the storms may gather, still have peace within;
Yea, whatever we here must bear,
Still in Thee lies purest pleasure,

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Fairest Lord Jesus, ruler of all nature,
O thou of God and man the Son!
Thee will I honor, thou, my soul's glory, joy, and crown.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Fair are the meadows, fairer still the woodlands, robed in the blooming garb of spring: Jesus is fairer,
Jesus is purer who makes the woeful heart to sing.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Fair is the sunshine, fairer still the moonlight, and all the twinkling starry host: Jesus shines brighter,
Jesus shines purer than all the angels heaven can boast.

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: Lord of all the nations, Son of God and Son of Man!
Glory and honor, praise, adoration, now and forevermore be thine!

translations.title: Jesus, the Very Thought of Thee

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Jesus, the very thought of thee with sweetness fills the breast; but sweeter far thy face to see, and in thy presence rest.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: No voice can sing, no heart can frame,
Nor can the memory find A sweeter sound than Jesus' name,

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: O hope of every contrite heart!
O joy of all the meek, to those who fall, how kind thou art!
How good to those who seek!

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: But what to those who find?
Ah, this nor tongue nor pen can show; the love of Jesus, what it is, none but his loved ones know.

sections.label: Verse 5
lines: Jesus, our only joy be thou, as thou our prize wilt be;
Jesus, be thou our glory now, and through eternity.

translations.title: Jesus, Thou Joy of Loving Hearts

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Jesus, Thou joy of loving hearts!
From the best bliss that earth imparts,
We turn unfilled to Thee again.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Thy truth unchanged has ever stood;
Thou savest those that on Thee call;
To them that seek Thee Thou art good,
To them that find Thee, all in all.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: And long to feast upon Thee still;
We drink of Thee, the Fountainhead,
And thirst our souls from Thee to fill!

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: Our restless spirits yearn for Thee,
Where-e'r our changeful lot is cast;
Glad, when Thy gracious smile we see,
Blest, when our faith can hold Thee fast.

sections.label: Verse 5
lines: O Jesus, ever with us stay;
Make all our moments calm and bright;
Chase the dark night of sin away,
Shed o'r the world Thy holy light!

translations.title: King of Glory, King of Peace

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: King of glory, King of peace, I will love Thee;
And that love may never cease, I will move Thee.
Thou hast granted my request, Thou hast heard me;
Thou didst note my working breast, Thou hast spared me.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Wherefore with my utmost art I will sing Thee,
And the cream of all my heart I will bring Thee.
Though my sins against me cried, Thou didst clear me;
And alone, when they replied, Thou didst hear me.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Seven whole days, not one in seven, I will praise Thee;
In my heart, though not in heav'n I can raise Thee.
Small it is, in this poor sort to enroll Thee: Ev'n eternity's too short to extol Thee.

translations.title: My Song Shall Be of Jesus

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: My song shall be of Jesus;
He fills my cup with blessings,
And tunes my heart to praise.
My song shall be of Jesus,
And bought me with His blood.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: My song shall be of Jesus When, sitting at His feet,
I call to mind His goodness In meditation sweet: My song shall be of Jesus,
I'll sing the grace that saves me, And keeps me at His side.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: My song shall be of Jesus While pressing on my way To reach the blissful kingdom Of pure and perfect day: And when my soul shall enter That realm of splendor fair, A song of praise to Jesus I'll sing forever there.

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: More about Jesus, I would know, More of His grace to others show;
More of His saving fullness see,
More of His love who died for me.

sections.label: Refrain
lines: More, more about Jesus, More, more about Jesus;
More of His saving fullness see,
More of His love who died for me.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: More about Jesus, let me learn, More of His holy will discern;
Spirit of God, my teacher be, Showing the things of Christ to me.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: More about Jesus, in His word, Holding communion with my Lord;
Hearing His voice in every line,

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: More about Jesus, on His throne, Riches in glory all His own;
More of His kingdom's sure increase,

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Now the power of sin consume;
Bring Thy blest millennium, Holy Lamb.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Thus may we each moment feel,
Love Him, serve Him, praise Him still,
Till we all on Zion's hill See the Lamb.

sections.label: சரணம் 2
lines: மீட்பர் ராஜ்யம் வரட்டும், பாவம் இப்போ நீங்கட்டும்

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Meetpar Raajyam Varattum, Paavam Ippo Neengattum

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: There is a name I love to hear, I love to sing its worth;
It sounds like music in my ear, The sweetest name on earth.

sections.label: Refrain
lines: O, how I love Jesus, O, how I love Jesus, O, how I love Jesus- Because He first loved me!

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: It tells me of a Savior's love, Who died to set me free;
It tells me of His precious blood, The sinner's perfect plea.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: It tells of One whose loving heart Can feel my deepest woe,
Who in each sorrow bears a part That none can bear below.

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: There is a Name I love to hear, I love to sing its worth;
It sounds like music in my ears, The sweetest Name on earth.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: It tells me of a Savior's love, Who died to set me free;
It tells me of a Savior's blood, The sinners' perfect plea.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: It tells of one whose loving heart Can feel my deepest woe;
Who in each sorrow bears A part that none can bear below.

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Sing, O Earth, His wonderful love proclaim!
Hail Him! hail Him! highest archangels in glory;
Strength and honor give to His holy Name!
In His arms He carries them all day long:

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: For our sins He suffered, and bled, and died.
He our Rock, our hope of eternal salvation, Hail Him! hail Him!
Love unbounded, wonderful, deep and strong.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Heavenly portals loud with hosannas ring!
Jesus, Savior, reigneth forever and ever.
Christ is coming! over the world victorious,
Power and glory unto the Lord belong.

translations.title: O for a Thousand Tongues to Sing

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: O for a thousand tongues to sing my great Redeemer's praise, the glories of my God and King, the triumphs of his grace!

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: My gracious Master and my God, assist me to proclaim, to spread through all the earth abroad the honors of thy name.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Jesus! the name that charms our fears, that bids our sorrows cease;
'tis music in the sinner's ears, 'tis life, and health, and peace.

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: He breaks the power of canceled sin, he sets the prisoner free; his blood can make the foulest clean; his blood availed for me.

sections.label: Verse 5
lines: He speaks, and listening to his voice, new life the dead receive; the mournful, broken hearts rejoice, the humble poor believe.

sections.label: Verse 6
lines: Hear him, ye deaf; his praise, ye dumb, your loosened tongues employ; ye blind, behold your savior come, and leap, ye lame, for joy.

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: I serve a risen Savior, He's in the world today;
I know that He is living, whatever men may say;
I see His hand of mercy,
I hear His voice of cheer And just the time I need Him He's always near.

sections.label: Refrain
lines: He lives, He lives, Christ Jesus lives today!
He walks with me and talks with me along life's narrow way.
He lives, He lives, salvation to impart!
You ask me how I know He lives?

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: In all the world around me I see His loving care,
And tho' my heart grows weary I never will despair;
I know that He is leading thru all the stormy blast,
The day of His appearing will come at last.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: O Christian, lift up your voice and sing,
Eternal hallelujahs to Jesus Christ the King!
The hope of all who seek Him, the help of all who find,
None other is so loving, so good and kind.

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Come, let us sing the song of songs- The angels first began the strain- The homage which to Christ belongs: 'Worthy the Lamb, for He was slain!'

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Slain to redeem us by His blood,
To cleanse from every sinful stain,
And make us kings and priests to God: 'Worthy the Lamb, for He was slain!'

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: To Him who suffered on the tree,
Our souls, at His soul's price, to gain,
Blessing, and praise, and glory be: 'Worthy the Lamb, for He was slain!'

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: To Him, enthroned by filial right All power in heaven and earth proclaim,
Honor, and majesty, and might: 'Worthy the Lamb, for He was slain!'

sections.label: Verse 5
lines: Long as we live, and when we die,
And while in heaven with Him we reign,
This song our song of songs shall be: 'Worthy the Lamb, for He was slain!'

translations.title: There's No Other Name Like Jesus

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: There's no other name like Jesus, 'Tis the dearest name we know, 'Tis the angel's joy in heaven, 'Tis the Christian's joy below.

sections.label: Refrain
lines: Sweet name, (sweet name) dear name, (dear name) There's no other name like Jesus;
Sweet name, (sweet name) dear name, (dear name) There's no other name like Jesus.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: There's no other name like Jesus When the heart with grief is sad,
There's no other name like Jesus When the heart is free and glad.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: 'Tis the hope that I shall see Him When in glory He appears, 'Tis the hope to hear His welcome That my fainting spirit cheers.

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: If He wills that I should labor In His vineyard day by day,
Then 'tis well if only Jesus Blesses all I do or say.

sections.label: Verse 5
lines: If He wills that death's cold finger Touch my feeble, mortal clay,
Then 'tis well if only Jesus Is my dying trust and stay.

translations.title: The Great Physician Now is Near

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: The great Physician now is near, The sympathizing Jesus;
He speaks the drooping heart to cheer, Oh! hear the voice of Jesus.

sections.label: Refrain
lines: Sweetest note in seraph song, Sweetest name on mortal tongue;
Sweetest carol ever sung, Jesus, blessed Jesus.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Your many sins are all forgiven, Oh! hear the voice of Jesus;
Go on your way in peace to heaven, And wear a crown with Jesus.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: All glory to the dying Lamb!
I love the blessed Savior's name, I love the name of Jesus.

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: His name dispels my guilt and fear, No other name but Jesus;
Oh! how my soul delights to hear The charming name of Jesus.

translations.title: பேரன்பர் யேசு நிற்கிறார், நாம் அண்டிக் கொள்ளுவோமே

sections.label: சரணம் 1
lines: பேரன்பர் யேசு நிற்கிறார், நாம் அண்டிக் கொள்ளுவோமே

sections.label: சரணம் 2
lines: உன் பாவம் யாவும் மன்னித்தேன்; அஞ்சாதே என்கிறாரே
சந்தேகங் கொண்டு சோர்வதேன்? மெய்ப் பாக்யம் ஈகிறாரே.

sections.label: சரணம் 3
lines: மா மேன்மை யேசு ஸ்வாமிக்கே நம்மால் உண்டாவதாக

sections.label: சரணம் 4
lines: ரட்சண்ய வல்ல நாமத்தால் விசாரம் நீங்கிப் போகும்;

translations.title: Peranpar Yesu Nirkiraar, Naam Antik Kolluvome

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Peranpar Yesu Nirkiraar, Naam Antik Kolluvome

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Un Paavam Yaavum Manniththen; Anjaadhe Enkiraare
Sandhekang Kontu Sorvadhen? Meyp Paakyam Eekiraare.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Maa Menmai Yesu Svaamikke Nammaal Untaavadhaaka

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: Ratchanya Valla Naamaththaal Visaaram Neengip Pokum;

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: I cannot tell why He whom angels worship Should set His love upon the souls of men,
Or why as Shepherd He should seek the wanderers,
To bring them back, they know not how nor when.
But this I know, that He was born of Mary When Bethlehem's manger was His only home,
And that He lived at Nazareth and laboured;
And so the Saviour, Saviour of the world, has come.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: I cannot tell how silently He suffered As with His peace He graced this place of tears,
Nor how His heart upon the cross was broken,
The crown of pain to three and thirty years.
But this I know He heals the broken hearted And stays our sin and calms our lurking fear,
And lifts the burden from the heavy laden;
For still the Saviour, Saviour of the world, is here.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: I cannot tell how He will win the nations,
How He will claim His earthly heritage,
How satisfy the needs and aspirations Of east and west, of sinner and of sage.
But this I know, all flesh shall see His glory,
And He shall reap the harvest He has sown,
And some glad day His sun will shine in splendour When He the Saviour,
Saviour, of the world, is known.

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: I cannot tell how all lands shall worship,
When at His biding every storm is stilled,
Or who can say how great the jubilation When all our hearts with love for Him are filled.
But this I know the skies shall sound His praises,
Ten thousand thousand human voices sing,
And earth to heaven, and heaven to earth will answer,
Saviour of the world, is King!

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Ye servants of God, your Master proclaim, and publish abroad his wonderful name; the name all-victorious of Jesus extol, his kingdom is glorious and rules over all.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: God ruleth on high, almighty to save, and still he is nigh, his presence we have; the great congregation his triumph shall sing, ascribing salvation to Jesus, our King.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: 'Salvation to God, who sits on the throne!' Let all cry aloud and honor the Son; the praises of Jesus the angels proclaim, fall down on their faces and worship the Lamb.

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: Then let us adore and give him his right, all glory and power, all wisdom and might; all honor and blessing with angels above, and thanks never ceasing and infinite love.

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Come down, O Love divine, seek thou this soul of mine and visit it with thine own ardor glowing;
O Comforter, draw near, within my heart appear, and kindle it, thy holy flame bestowing.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: O let it freely burn, till earthly passions turn to dust and ashes in its heat consuming; and let thy glorious light shine ever on my sight, and clothe me round, the while my path illuming.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Let holy charity Mine outward vesture be,
And lowliness become my inner clothing;
True lowliness of heart which takes the humbler part,
And o'er its own shortcomings weeps with loathing.

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: And so the yearning strong with which the soul will long shall far outpass the power of human telling; for none can guess its grace, till Love create a place wherein the Holy Spirit makes a dwelling.

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Baptize us anew With power from on high, With love, O refresh us!

sections.label: Refrain
lines: With love and the Spirit baptize us today.
We praise Thee, we bless Thee, dear Lamb that was slain We laud and adore Thee,

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: O wash us and cleanse us From sin's guilty stain.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: O heavenly Dove, Descend from on high!

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: From heaven it came: Thou art My beloved, Well pleased I am.

translations.title: Draw Us in the Spirit's Tether

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Draw us in the Spirit's tether,
For when humbly in Thy name,
Two or three are met together Thou are in the midst of them;
Touch we now Thy garment's hem.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: As the brethren used to gather In the name of Christ to sup, Then with thanks to God the Father Break the bread and bless the cup, Alleluia!
So knit Thou our friendship up.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: All our meals and all our living Make as sacraments of Thee,
That by caring, helping, giving We may true disciples be.

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Hover o'er me, Holy Spirit, Bathe my trembling heart and brow;
Fill me with Thy hallowed presence, Come, O come and fill me now.

sections.label: Refrain
lines: Fill me now, fill me now, Jesus, come and fill me now.
Fill me with Thy hallowed presence, Come, O come and fill me now.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Thou canst fill me, gracious Spirit,
Though I cannot tell Thee how;
But I need Thee, greatly need Thee;
Come, O come and fill me now.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: I am weakness, full of weakness;
At Thy sacred feet I bow;
Blest, divine, eternal Spirit, Fill with love, and fill me now.

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: Cleanse and comfort, bless and save me;
Bathe, O, bathe my heart and brow;
Thou art comforting and saving, Thou art sweetly filling now.

translations.title: தூய ஆவி அசைவாடி என் உள்ளத்தை நிரப்பும்

sections.label: சரணம் 1
lines: தூய ஆவி அசைவாடி என் உள்ளத்தை நிரப்பும்;
உன்றன் திவ்ய சமுகத்தால் இப்போ வந்து நிரப்பும்.

sections.label: பல்லவி
lines: உன்றன் திவ்ய சமூகத்தால், இப்போ வந்து நிரப்பும்.

sections.label: சரணம் 2
lines: உம்மை வேண்டி நாடுகிறேன்; இப்போ வந்து நிரப்பும்.

sections.label: சரணம் 4
lines: கழுவி, இரட்சை செய்து, என் உள்ளத்தை நிரப்பும்;
ஆற்றி ரட்சித் தெனை இப்போ அன்பாய் நிரப்புகிறீர்.

translations.title: Thooya Aavi Asaivaati En Ullaththai Nirappum

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Thooya Aavi Asaivaati En Ullaththai Nirappum;
Undran Thivya Samukaththaal Ippo Vandhu Nirappum.

sections.label: Refrain
lines: Undran Thivya Samookaththaal, Ippo Vandhu Nirappum.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Ummai Venti Naatukiren; Ippo Vandhu Nirappum.

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: Kazhuvi, Iratchai Seydhu, En Ullaththai Nirappum;
Aatri Ratchith Thenai Ippo Anpaai Nirappukireer.

translations.title: The Spirit of the Lord Revealed

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: The Spirit of the Lord revealed His will to saints of old;
Their heart and mind lips unsealed His glory to unfold.
Amid the gloom of ancient night They hailed the dawning Word,
And in the coming of the light Proclaimed the coming Lord.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: The prophets passed; at length there came To sojourn and abide,
The Word incarnate, to whose name The prophets testified;
As man with man, revealed at last The Father to our sight.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Eternal Spirit, who dost speak To mind and conscience still,
That we in this our day, may seek To do our Father's will,
To us the word of life impart,
Give us the quiet, humble heart To hear and to obey.

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: There's a sweet, sweet spirit in this place,
And I know that it's the spirit of the Lord;
Sweet Holy Spirit, Sweet Heavenly Dove,

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: And for these blessings We lift our hearts in praise,
Without a doubt we'll know That we have been revived When we shall leave this place.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: There are sweet expressions on each face,
And I know they feel the presence of the Lord.
Sweet Holy Spirit, Sweet Heavenly Dove,

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: And for these blessings We lift our hearts in praise,
Without a doubt we'll know That we have been revived When we shall leave this place.

translations.title: Fire of God, Thou Sacred Flame

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Let Thy heat my soul refine Till it glows with love divine.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Breath of God, that swept in power In the pentecostal hour,
Holy Breath, be Thou in me Source of vital energy.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Thy might within Conquers sorrow, pain, and sin: Fortify from evil's art All the gateways of my heart.

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: Truth of God, Thy piercing rays Penetrate my secret ways.
May the light that shames my sin Guide me holier paths to win.

sections.label: Verse 5
lines: Thy grace profound Knoweth neither age nor bound: Come, my heart's own guest to be,

translations.title: O for That Flame of Living Fire

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: O for that flame of living fire Which shone so bright in saints of old;
Which bade their souls to heaven aspire,
Calm in distress, in danger bold!

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Lord, which dwelt In Abram's breast, and sealed Him Thine?
Which made Paul's heart with sorrow melt,

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: That spirit which from age to age Proclaimed Thy love, and taught Thy ways?
And breathed in David's hallowed lays?

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: Is not Thy grace as mighty now As when Elijah felt its power?
When glory beamed from Moses' brow,
Or Job endured the trying hour?

sections.label: Verse 5
lines: Renew Thy work, Thy grace restore;
And while to Thee our hearts we raise,
On us Thy Holy Spirit pour.

translations.title: Breathe on Me, Breath of God

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Breathe on me, breath of God,
That I may love what Thou dost love,
And do what Thou wouldst do.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Breathe on me, breath of God,
Until with Thee I will one will,

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Breathe on me, breath of God,
Until this earthly part of me Glows with Thy fire divine.

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: Breathe on me, breath of God, So shall I constant be,
And live with Thee the perfect life Of Thine eternity.

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Spirit of God, descend upon my heart; wean it from earth; through all its pulses move; stoop to my weakness, mighty as thou art, and make me love thee as I ought to love.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: I ask no dream, no prophet ecstasies, no sudden rending of the veil of clay, no angel visitant, no opening skies; but take the dimness of my soul away.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Has thou not bid me love thee, God and King?
All, all thine own, soul, heart and strength and mind.
I see thy cross; there teach my heart to cling.
O let me seek thee, and O let me find.

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: Teach me to feel that thou art always nigh; teach me the struggles of the soul to bear.
To check the rising doubt, the rebel sigh, teach me the patience of unanswered prayer.

sections.label: Verse 5
lines: Teach me to love thee as thine angels love, one holy passion filling all my frame; the kindling of the heaven-descended Dove, my heart an altar, and thy love the flame.

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Spirit divine, attend our prayers, And make this house Thy home;
Descend with all Thy gracious powers, O come, great Spirit, come!

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Come as the light; to us reveal Our emptiness and woe,
And lead us in those paths of life Where-on the righteous go.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Come as the fire, and purge our hearts Like sacrificial flame;
Let our whole soul an of ' f'ring be To our Redeemer's name.

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: Come as the dove, and spread Thy wings,
And let Thy church on earth become Blest as the church above.

sections.label: Verse 5
lines: Spirit divine, attend our prayers, Make a lost world Thy home;
Descend with all Thy gracious powers, O come, great Spirit, come!

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Shine upon this heart of mine,
Chase the shades of night away,

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Holy Spirit, power divine, Cleanse this guilty heart of mine;
Long has sin, without control, Held dominion o'er my soul.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Cheer this saddened heart of mine,

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: Dwell within this heart of mine,

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Come, Holy Spirit, heavenly Dove, With all Thy quickening powers;
Kindle a flame of sacred love In these cold hearts of ours.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: O raise our thoughts from things below, From vanities and toys!
Then shall we with fresh courage go To reach eternal joys.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Awake our souls to joyful songs;
Till praise employs our thankful tongues, And doubt forever dies.

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: Father, we would no longer live At this poor, dying rate;
To Thee our thankful love we give, For Thine to us is great.

sections.label: Verse 5
lines: Come, Holy Spirit, heavenly Dove, With all Thy quickening powers;
Come, shed abroad a Savior's love, And that shall kindle ours.

translations.title: O Holy Dove of God Descending

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: O holy Dove of God descending,
You are the love that knows no ending.
All of our shattered dreams You're mending: Spirit, now live in me.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: O holy Wind of God now blowing,
You are the seed that God us sowing.
You are the life that starts us growing: Spirit, now live in me.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: O holy Rain of God now falling,
You make the Word of God enthralling,
You are that inner voice now calling: Spirit, now live in me.

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: O holy Flame of God now burning,
You are the power of Christ returning.
You are the answer to our yearning: Spirit, now live in me.

translations.title: Break Thou the Bread of Life

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Break thou the bread of life, dear Lord, to me, as thou didst break the loaves beside the sea; beyond the sacred page I seek thee,
Lord; my spirit pants for thee,

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Bless thou the truth, dear Lord, to me, to me, as thou didst bless the bread by Galilee; then shall all bondage cease, all fetters fall; and I shall find my peace, my all in all.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Thou art the bread of life, O Lord, to me;
Thy holy Word the truth That saveth me;
Give me to eat and live With Thee above;
Teach me to love Thy truth, For Thou art love.

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: Spirit and life are they, Words Thou dost speak;
I hasten to obey, But I am weak;
Thou art my only help, Thou art my life;
Heeding Thy holy Word I win the strife.

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Give me the Bible, star of gladness gleaming,
To cheer the wanderer lone and tempest tossed, No storm can hide that peaceful radiance beaming Since Jesus came to seek and save the lost.

sections.label: Refrain
lines: Give me the Bible' holy message shining,
Thy light shall guide me in the narrow way.
Precept and promise, law and love combining, 'Til night shall vanish in eternal day.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Give me the Bible when my heart is broken,
When sin and grief have filled my soul with fear,
Give me the precious words by Jesus spoken,
Hold up faith's lamp to show my Savior near.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Give me the Bible, all my steps enlighten,
Teach me the danger of these realms below,
That lamp of safety, o'er the gloom shall brighten,
That light alone the path of peace can show.

sections.label: சரணம் 1
lines: வேத நூல் தாரும், தூது மொழி வீச,

sections.label: சரணம் 2
lines: வேத நூல் தாரும், தூது மொழி வீச,

sections.label: சரணம் 3
lines: வேத நூல் தாரும், நடத்தும் என் நடை,
வேத நூல் தாரும், தூது மொழி வீச,

sections.label: சரணம் 4
lines: வேத நூல் தாரும், தூது மொழி வீச,

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Vedha Nool Thaarum, Thoodhu Mozhi Veesa,

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Vedha Nool Thaarum, Thoodhu Mozhi Veesa,

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Vedha Nool Thaarum, Nataththum En Natai,
Vedha Nool Thaarum, Thoodhu Mozhi Veesa,

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: Vedha Nool Thaarum, Thoodhu Mozhi Veesa,

translations.title: Lord, I Have Made Thy Word My Choice

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Lord, I have made Thy word my choice, My lasting heritage;
There shall my noblest powers rejoice,

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: I'll read the histories of Thy love, And keep Thy laws in sight;
While through Thy promises I rove, With ever fresh delight.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: In this broad land of wealth unknown,
Seeds of immortal bliss are sown,

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: The best relief that mourners have, It makes our sorrows blest;
Our fairest hope beyond the grave, And our eternal rest.

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: O Light of our dark sky: we praise you for the radiance that from the hallowed page, a lantern to our footsteps, shines on from age to age.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: The church from her dear Master received the gift divine, and still that light is lifted o'er all the earth to shine.
It is the sacred vessel where gems of truth are stored; it is the heaven-drawn picture of Christ, the living Word.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: It floateth like a banner before God's host unfurled; it is a shining beacon above the darkling world.
It is the chart and compass that o'er life's surging tide, mid mists and rocks and quicksands,

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: O make Thy church, dear Savior, a lamp of purest gold, to bear before the nations your true light as of old.
O teach your wandering pilgrims by this their path to trace, till, clouds and darkness ended, they see Thee face to face.

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Shall pierce the darkness of our earthbound way And show Your grace,
And guide our footsteps to the perfect day.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: From days of old, through blind and willful ages,
Who wrote with eager or reluctant pen.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Undimmed by time, those words are still revealing To sinful hearts Your justice and Your grace;
And questing mortals longing for Your healing,
See Your compassion in the Savior's face.

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: To all the world Your summons You are sending,
Through all the earth, to ever land and race,
That myriad tongues, in one great anthem blending,
May praise and celebrate Your gift of grace.

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Thanks to God whose Word was spoken In the deed that made the earth.
His the voice that called a nation;
His the fires that tried her worth.
Praise Him For His open Word

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Thanks to God whose Word incarnate Glorified the flesh of man.
Deeds and words and death and rising Tell the grace in heaven's plan.
Praise Him For His open Word

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Thanks to God whose Word is answered By the Spirit's voice within.
Here we drink of joy unmeasured,
Life redeemed from death and sin.
Praise Him For His open Word

translations.title: For Your Holy Book We Thank You

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: For Your holy book we thank You,
And for all who served You well,
That its pages might forth tell Your strong love and tender care For Your people everywhere.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: For Your holy book we thank You,
And for those who work today,
That the people of all nations,
Reading it and following may Know Your love and tender care For Your people everywhere.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: For Your holy book we thank You,
May its message be our guide,
May we understand the wisdom Of the laws it will provide: And Your love and tender care For Your people everywhere.

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: For Your holy book we thank You,
May its message in our hearts Lead us now to see in Jesus All the grace Your word imparts: All Your love and tender care For Your people everywhere.

translations.title: Lord Jesus, Once You Spoke to Men

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Lord Jesus, once You spoke to men Upon the mountain and the plain,
O help us listen now as then And wonder at Your words again.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: We all have secret fears to face, Our minds and motives to amend.
Our living Lord and present friend.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: The gospel speaks; and we receive Your light, Your love, Your own command.
O help us live what we believe, In daily word of heart and hand.

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Come, every soul by sin oppressed,
And He will surely give you rest,

sections.label: Refrain
lines: Only trust Him, only trust Him, Only trust Him now;
He will save you, He will save you, He will save you now.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: For Jesus shed his precious blood Rich blessings to bestow;
Plunge now into the crimson flood That washes white as snow.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Yes, Jesus is the truth, the way, That leads you into rest;
Believe in Him without delay, And you are fully blest.

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: Come, then, and join this holy band,
To dwell in that celestial land,

sections.label: சரணம் 1
lines: மெய் வேத வாக்கை நம்பினால், மா பாரம் நீங்குமாம்.

sections.label: சரணம் 2
lines: மாசற்ற ரத்தம் சிந்தியே பேர் வாழ் வுண்டாக்கினார்

sections.label: சரணம் 4
lines: மெய் பாக்யர் கூட்டம் சேருவாய், ப்ரயாணம் செய்யவும்

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Mey Vedha Vaakkai Nampinaal, Maa Paaram Neengumaam.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Maasatra Raththam Sindhiye Per Vaazh Vuntaakkinaar

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: Mey Paakyar Koottam Seruvaai, Prayaanam Seyyavum

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Come, ye sinners poor and needy, Weak and wounded, sick and sore;
Jesus ready stands to save you, Full of pity, love, and power.

sections.label: Refrain
lines: I will arise and go to Jesus, He will embrace me in His arms;
In the arms of my dear Savior, O there are ten thousand charms.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Come. ye thirsty, come, and welcome, God's free bounty glorify;
Every grace that brings you nigh.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Let not conscience make you linger, Nor of fitness fondly dream;
All the fitness He requireth Is to feel your need of Him.

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: Lo! th'incarnate God, ascended, Pleads the merit of His blood;
Venture on Him, venture wholly, Let no other trust intrude.

translations.title: I Gave My Life for Thee

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: I gave my life for thee,
I gave, I gave My life for thee, What hast thou given for Me?
I gave, I gave My life for thee, What hast thou given for Me?

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: I left, I left it all for thee, Hast thou left aught for Me?
I left, I left it all for thee, Hast thou left aught for Me?

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: I suffered much for thee, more than thy tongue can tell,
I've borne, I've borne it all for thee,
What hast thou borne for Me?
I've borne, I've borne it all for thee,
What hast thou borne for Me?

translations.title: நீ உயிரைப் பெற, நான் இரத்தம் சிந்தினேன்

sections.label: சரணம் 1
lines: நீ உயிரைப் பெற, நான் இரத்தம் சிந்தினேன்

translations.title: Nee Uyiraip Pera, Naan Iraththam Sindhinen

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Nee Uyiraip Pera, Naan Iraththam Sindhinen

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: I hear Thy welcome voice, That calls me, Lord, to Thee;
For cleansing in Thy precious blood, That flowed on Calvary.

sections.label: Refrain
lines: Wash me, cleanse me, in the blood That flowed on Calvary.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Though coming weak and vile, Thou dost my strength assure;
Thou dost my vileness fully cleanse, Till spotless all, and pure.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: 'Tis Jesus calls me on To perfect faith and love,
To perfect hope, and peace, and trust,

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: All hail! the gift of Christ, our Lord,

translations.title: வா! நீசப் பாவி வா! என்றென்னைக் கூப்பிட்டீர்

sections.label: சரணம் 1
lines: வா! நீசப் பாவி வா! என்றென்னைக் கூப்பிட்டீர்;
என் தோஷம் தீர ரட்சகா! சுத்தாங்கம் பண்ணுவீர்.

sections.label: சரணம் 2
lines: சீர் கெட்ட பாவி நான்; என் நீதி கந்தையே,

translations.title: Vaa! Neesap Paavi Vaa! Endrennaik Kooppitteer

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Vaa! Neesap Paavi Vaa! Endrennaik Kooppitteer;
En Thosham Theera Ratchakaa! Suththaangam Pannuveer.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Seer Ketta Paavi Naan; En Needhi Kandhaiye,

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: O Jesus, thou art standing, outside the fast closed door, in lowly patience waiting to pass the threshold o'er: O shame, professing Christians, his Name and sign who bear,
O shame, thrice shame upon us, to keep him standing there!

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: O Jesus, thou art knocking; and lo, that hand is scarred, and thorns thy brow encircle, and tears thy face have marred: O love that passeth knowledge, so patiently to wait!
O sin that hath no equal, so fast to bar the gate!

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: O Jesus, thou art pleading in accents meek and low, 'I died for you, my children, and will you treat me so?' O Lord, with shame and sorrow we open now the door; dear Savior, enter, enter, and leave us never more.

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: I have a Savior, He's pleading in glory, A dear, loving Savior, though earth friends be few;
And now He is watching in tenderness o'er me,
But oh that my Savior were your Savior, too.

sections.label: Refrain
lines: For you am I praying, I'm praying for you.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: I have a Father; to me He has given A hope for eternity, blessed and true;
And soon He will call to meet Him in heaven,
But oh that He'd let me bring you with me, too!

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Awaiting in glory my wondering view;
Oh, when I receive it, all shining in brightness,
Dear friend, could I see you receiving one, too!

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: When Jesus has found you, tell others the story,
That my loving Savior is your Savior, too;
Then pray that your Savior will bring them to glory,
And prayer will be answered-'twas answered for you!

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Jesus calls us o'er the tumult of our life's wild, restless sea; day by day his sweet voice soundeth, saying, 'Christian, follow me!'

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Jesus calls us from the worship of the vain world's golden store, from each idol that would keep us, saying, 'Christian, love me more!'

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: In our joys and in our sorrows, days of toil and hours of ease, still he calls, in cares and pleasures, 'Christian, love me more than these!'

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: Savior, may we hear thy call, give our hearts to thine obedience, serve and love thee best of all.

translations.title: யேசு நம்மை அழைக்கிறார், துன்பம் லோகில் சூழ்கையில்

sections.label: சரணம் 1
lines: யேசு நம்மை அழைக்கிறார், துன்பம் லோகில் சூழ்கையில்
அன்பு பொங்கி அழைக்கிறார்; என்னைப் பின் செல் என்கிறார்.

sections.label: சரணம் 2
lines: மண் பொன் ஆசை மாய லோகில் மனதை மயக்கையில்,
மன்னன் யேசு நம்மை நோக்கி, என்னை நேசி என்கிறார்.

sections.label: சரணம் 3
lines: இன்பம் துன்பம் லாபம் நஷ்டம் களிப்பு வேளையிலும்,
கிறிஸ்தவனே! என்னில் வெகு அன்பு கூரு என்கிறார்.

sections.label: சரணம் 4
lines: யேசு நம்மை அழைக்கிறார்; நேசர் சத்தம் கேளுமே;

translations.title: Yesu Nammai Azhaikkiraar, Thunpam Lokil Soozhkaiyil

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Yesu Nammai Azhaikkiraar, Thunpam Lokil Soozhkaiyil
Anpu Pongi Azhaikkiraar; Ennaip Pin Sel Enkiraar.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Man Pon Aasai Maaya Lokil Manadhai Mayakkaiyil,
Mannan Yesu Nammai Nokki, Ennai Nesi Enkiraar.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Inpam Thunpam Laapam Nashtam Kalippu Velaiyilum,
Kirisdhavane! Ennil Veku Anpu Kooru Enkiraar.

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: Yesu Nammai Azhaikkiraar; Nesar Saththam Kelume;

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Sing them over again to me, wonderful words of life,
Let me more of their beauty see, wonderful words of life;
Words of life and beauty teach me faith and duty.

sections.label: Refrain
lines: Beautiful words, wonderful words, wonderful words of life,
Beautiful words, wonderful words, wonderful words of life.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Christ, the bless'd One, gives to all wonderful words of life;
Sinner, list to the loving call, wonderful words of life;
All so freely given, wooing us to heaven.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Sweetly echo the Gospel call, wonderful words of life;
Offer pardon and peace to all, wonderful words of life;

sections.label: சரணம் 1
lines: வெல்க! சத்திய வேதம் வாழ்க! நித்திய வேதம்!

sections.label: சரணம் 2
lines: வான வருஷ மாரி, ஞான பொக்கிஷ வாரி,

sections.label: சரணம் 3
lines: யேசு! என்றனைப் பாரும்; நித்தம் எந்தனைக் காரும்.

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Velka! Saththiya Vedham Vaazhka! Niththiya Vedham!

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Vaana Varusha Maari, Gnaana Pokkisha Vaari,

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Yesu! Endranaip Paarum; Niththam Endhanaik Kaarum.

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Softly and tenderly Jesus is calling, calling for you and for me; see, on the portals he's waiting and watching, watching for you and for me.

sections.label: Refrain
lines: Come home, come home; ye who are weary come home; earnestly, tenderly,

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Why should we tary when Jesus is pleading, pleading for you and for me?
Why should we linger and heed not his mercies, mercies for you and for me?

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Think of the wonderful love he has promised, promised for you and for me!
Though we have sinned, he has mercy and pardon, pardon for you and for me.

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Would you like to come with Me All the way and back again?
You must follow the Leader then.
All the way and back again,

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: If I want a thorny crown, If the soldiers knock me down Can I really be a king?
Love will answer everything If you follow the Leader, If you follow the Leader,
Love will answer everything, If you follow the Leader.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: When I go along the road, I shall lift a heavy load.
I will carry a cross for you.
You will learn to carry it too When you follow the Leader,
You will learn to carry it too When you follow the Leader.

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: I am going to stretch My hands, Reaching out to all the lands.
Can I really be a king?
When you follow the Leader Love's the lord of everything,

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: The Savior is waiting to enter your heart Why don't you let Him come in?
There's nothing in this world to keep you apart What is your answer to Him?

sections.label: Refrain
lines: Time after time He has waited before And now He is waiting again To see if you are willing To open the door Oh, how He wants to come in.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: If you'll take one step Toward the Savior, my friend,
You'll find His arms open wide.
Receive Him, and all of your darkness will end Within your heart He'll abide.

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: O soul, are you weary and troubled?
No light in the darkness you see?
There's light for a look at the Savior,
And life more abundant and free!

sections.label: Refrain
lines: Look full in His wonderful face,
And the things of earth will grow strangely dim,
In the light of His glory and grace.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Through death into life everlasting He passed, and we follow Him there;
Over us sin no more hath dominion' For more than conquerors we are!

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: His Word shall not fail you'He promised;
Believe Him, and all will be well: Then go to a world that is dying,

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: We have not known Thee as we ought,
Nor learned Thy wisdom, grace, and power;
The things of earth have filed our thoughts,
And trifles of the passing hour.
Lord, give us light Thy truth to see,
And make us wise in knowing Thee.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: We have not feared Thee as we ought,
Nor bowed beneath Thine awful eye,
Nor guarded deed, and word, and thought,
Lord, give us faith to know Thee near,
And grant the grace of holy fear.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: We have not loved Thee as we ought,
Nor cared that we are loved by Thee;
Thy presence we have coldly sought,
And feebly longed Thy face to see.
Lord, give a pure and loving heart To feel and own the love Thou art.

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: We have not served Thee as we ought;
The work with little fervor wrought,
The battles lost, or scarcely won!
Lord, give the zeal, and give the might,
For Thee to toil, for Thee to fight.

sections.label: Verse 5
lines: When shall we know Thee as we ought,
And fear, and love, and serve aright!
When shall we, out of trial brought, Be perfect in the land of light!
Lord, may we day by day prepare To see Thy face, and serve Thee there.

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Out of my bondage, sorrow and night, Jesus, I come, Jesus, I come;
Into Thy freedom, gladness and light, Jesus, I come to Thee;
Out of my sickness into Thy health, Out of my want and into Thy wealth, Out of my sin and into Thyself, Jesus, I come to Thee.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Out of my shameful failure and loss, Jesus, I come, Jesus, I come;
Into the glorious gain of Thy cross, Jesus, I come to Thee;
Out of earth's sorrows into Thy balm, Out of life's storms and into Thy calm, Out of distress to jubilant psalm, Jesus, I come to Thee.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Out of unrest and arrogant pride, Jesus, I come, Jesus, I come;
Into Thy blessed will to abide, Jesus, I come to Thee;
Out of myself to dwell in Thy love, Out of despair into raptures above, Upward for aye on wings like a dove, Jesus, I come to Thee.

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: Out of the fear and dread of the tomb, Jesus, I come, Jesus, I come;
Into the joy and light of Thy home, Jesus, I come to Thee;
Out of the depths of ruin untold, Into the peace of Thy sheltering fold, Ever Thy glorious face to behold, Jesus, I come to Thee.

translations.title: சிறையின் கஷ்டம் கசப்பிலும் நின்று வந்தேன்! நீங்கி வந்தேன்!

sections.label: சரணம் 1
lines: சிறையின் கஷ்டம் கசப்பிலும் நின்று வந்தேன்! நீங்கி வந்தேன்!

sections.label: சரணம் 2
lines: இழிவு நஷ்டம் தவறிலும் நின்று வந்தேன்! நீங்கி வந்தேன்!

sections.label: சரணம் 3
lines: மருளுகின்ற ஸ்திதியிலும் நின்று வந்தேன்! நீங்கி வந்தேன்!

sections.label: சரணம் 4
lines: மரணக் கெடி பயத்திலும் நின்று வந்தேன்! நீங்கி வந்தேன்!
