translations.title: Siraiyin Kashtam Kasappilum Nindru Vandhen! Neengi Vandhen!

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Siraiyin Kashtam Kasappilum Nindru Vandhen! Neengi Vandhen!

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Izhivu Nashtam Thavarilum Nindru Vandhen! Neengi Vandhen!

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Marulukindra Sdhidhiyilum Nindru Vandhen! Neengi Vandhen!

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: Maranak Keti Payaththilum Nindru Vandhen! Neengi Vandhen!

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: At the cross of Christ we bow;
Take our guilt and grief away;
Hear and heal us now, we pray.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Now, O Lord, this very hour, Send Thy grace and show Thy power;
While we rest upon Thy word, Come, and bless us now, O Lord!

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Mercy now, O Lord, we plead In this hour of utter need;

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: Rising o'r us like the sun,
Light and life art Thou within: Savior,

sections.label: சரணம் 2
lines: நல்ல வார்த்தை சொல்லுமே; வல்ல கையை நீட்டுமே;

sections.label: சரணம் 3
lines: கெஞ்சிக் கேட்டு நிற்கையில், தஞ்சம் தேடும் என்றனில்,

sections.label: சரணம் 4
lines: உந்தன் மைந்தன் நீதியை, நம்பி வந்த பாவியை,

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Nalla Vaarththai Sollume; Valla Kaiyai Neettume;

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Kenjik Kettu Nirkaiyil, Thanjam Thetum Endranil,

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: Undhan Maindhan Needhiyai, Nampi Vandha Paaviyai,

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Would you be free from the burden of sin?
There's pow'r in the blood, pow'r in the blood;
Would you o'er evil a victory win?
There's wonderful power in the blood.

sections.label: Refrain
lines: There is pow'r, pow'r, wonder working pow'r In the blood of the Lamb;
There is pow'r, pow'r, wonder working pow'r In the precious blood of the Lamb.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Would be free from your passion and pride?
There's pow'r in the blood, pow'r in the blood;
Come for a cleansing to Calvary's tide?
There's wonderful power in the blood.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Would you do service for Jesus your King?
There's pow'r in the blood, pow'r in the blood;
Would you live daily His praises to sing?
There's wonderful power in the blood.

translations.title: பாவப் பாரம் நீங்க மன துண்டா? யேசு ரத்தத்தில் பெலன் உண்டு

sections.label: சரணம் 1
lines: பாவப் பாரம் நீங்க மன துண்டா? யேசு ரத்தத்தில் பெலன் உண்டு;
தீமையை வென்று நீ ஜெயிப்பாயா? இரத்தத்தில் சக்தி உண்டு.

sections.label: பல்லவி
lines: வல்லமை அற்புத வல்லமை ஆட்டுக் குட்டியின் ரத்தத்தில்.

sections.label: சரணம் 2
lines: துர் இச்சை அகந்தை வெல்லுவாயா? யேசு ரத்தத்தில் பெலன் உண்டு;
கல்வாரி ஊற்றில் நீ மூழ்குவாயா? இரத்தத்தில் சக்தி உண்டு.

sections.label: சரணம் 3
lines: துய்ய வெண்மையாக விருப்பமா? யேசு ரத்தத்தில் பெலன் உண்டு;
கறை யாவும் தீரும் ஜீவ ஊற்றில் இரத்தத்தில் சக்தி உண்டு.

sections.label: சரணம் 4
lines: யேசு உன் ராஜனைச் சேவிப்பாயா? யேசு ரத்தத்தில் பெலன் உண்டு;
தினம் துதி பாடி, ஜீவிப்பாயா? இரத்தத்தில் சக்தி உண்டு.

translations.title: Paavap Paaram Neenga Mana Thuntaa? Yesu Raththaththil Pelan Untu

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Paavap Paaram Neenga Mana Thuntaa? Yesu Raththaththil Pelan Untu;
Theemaiyai Vendru Nee Jeyippaayaa? Iraththaththil Sakdhi Untu.

sections.label: Refrain
lines: Vallamai Arpudha Vallamai Aattuk Kuttiyin Raththaththil.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Thur Ichchai Akandhai Velluvaayaa? Yesu Raththaththil Pelan Untu;
Kalvaari Ootril Nee Moozhkuvaayaa? Iraththaththil Sakdhi Untu.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Thuyya Venmaiyaaka Viruppamaa? Yesu Raththaththil Pelan Untu;
Karai Yaavum Theerum Jeeva Ootril Iraththaththil Sakdhi Untu.

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: Yesu Un Raajanaich Chevippaayaa? Yesu Raththaththil Pelan Untu;
Thinam Thudhi Paati, Jeevippaayaa? Iraththaththil Sakdhi Untu.

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Chief of sinners though I be, Jesus shed His blood for me;
Died that I might live on high, Died that I might never die;
As the brance is to the vine, I am His, and He is mine.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: O the height of Jesus' love!
Found me when I sought Him not!

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Chief of sinners though I be, Christ is all in all to me;
All my wants to Him are known, All my sorrows are His own;
Safe with Him from earthly strife, He sustains the hidden life.

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: I've wandered far away from God, Now I'm coming home;
The paths of sin too long I've trod;

sections.label: Refrain
lines: Coming home, coming home Never more to roam;
Open wide Thine arms of love;

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: I've wasted many precious years, Now I'm coming home;
I now repent with bitter tears;

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: I'm tired of sin and straying Lord, Now I'm coming home;
I'll trust thy love belive thy word;

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: My only hope, my only plea, Now I'm coming home;
That Jesus died, and died for me;

sections.label: Verse 5
lines: I need His cleansing blood I know, Now I'm coming home;
O wash me whiter than the snow;

sections.label: பல்லவி
lines: நான் வாறேன், நான் வாறேன் அலையேன் என்றும்,
உம் அன்பின் கரம் திறவும், கர்த்தா, நான் வாறேன்.

sections.label: Refrain
lines: Naan Vaaren, Naan Vaaren Alaiyen Endrum,
Um Anpin Karam Thiravum, Karththaa, Naan Vaaren.

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: God, be merciful to me, On Thy grace I rest my plea;
Plenteous in compassion Thou, Blot out my transgressions now;
Wash me, make me pure within, Cleanse, O cleanse me from my sin, Wash me, make me pure within, Cleanse, O cleanse me from my sin.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: I am evil, born in sin;
Thou alone my Savior art, Teach Thy wisdom to my heart;
Wash me whiter than the snow,
Wash me whiter than the snow.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Gracious God, my heart renew, Make my spirit right and true;
Cast me not away from Thee, Let Thy Spirit dwell in me;

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: Sinners then shall learn from me And return, O God, to Thee;
Savior, all my guilt remove, And my tongue shall sing Thy love;
Touch my silent lips, O Lord, And my mouth shall praise accord, Touch my silent lips, O Lord, And my mouth shall praise accord.

translations.title: I Lay My Sins on Jesus

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: I lay my sins on Jesus, The spotless Lamb of God;
He bears them all, and frees us From the accursed load,

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: I bring my guilt to Jesus,
To wash my crimson stains White in His blood most precious Till not a stain remains,

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: I lay my wants on Jesus, All fullness dwells in Him;
He healeth my diseases He doth my soul redeem,

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: I long to be with Jesus, Meek, loving, lowly, mild;
I long to be like Jesus The Father's holy child,

sections.label: Verse 5
lines: I long to be with Jesus Amid the heav'nly throng,
To sing with them His praises,

translations.title: Forgive Our Sins as We Forgive

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: 'Forgive our sins as we forgive,' You taught us, Lord, to pray;
But You alone can grant us grace To live the words we say.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: How can Your pardon reach and bless The unforgiving heart That broods on wrongs and will not let Old bitterness depart?

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: In blazing light Your cross reveals The truth we dimly knew: How trifling others' debts to us;
How great our debt to You!

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: Lord, cleanse the depths within our souls And bid resentment cease;
Then, by Your mercy reconciled, Our lives will spread Your peace.

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Rock of Ages, cleft for me, Let me hide myself in Thee;
Let the water and the blood,
From Thy riven side which flowed, Be of sin the double cure,
Cleanse me from its guilt and power.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Not the labor of my hands Can fulfill Thy law's demands;
Could my zeal no respite know,
All for sin could not atone;
Thou must save, and Thou alone.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Victor o'er the last of foes,
When I soar to worlds unknown,
And behold Thee on Thy throne,
Rock of Ages, cleft for me,
Let me hide myself in Thee.

sections.label: சரணம் 1
lines: பக்கம் பட்ட காயமும், பாய்ந்த செந்நீர் வெள்ளமும்,

sections.label: சரணம் 2
lines: கண்ணீர் நித்தம் சொரிந்தும், தொய்யாத் தவம் புரிந்தும்,
பாவம் நீங்க மாட்டாதே; நீரே மீட்பர், யேசுவே!

sections.label: சரணம் 3
lines: நிழல் போன்ற வாழ்விலே கண்ணை மூடும் சாவிலே,
உம் ரண்டாம் வருகையில் வாதை வரும் வேளையில்

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Pakkam Patta Kaayamum, Paaindha Senneer Vellamum,

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Kanneer Niththam Sorindhum, Thoiyaath Thavam Purindhum,
Paavam Neenga Maattaadhe; Neere Meetpar, Yesuve!

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Nizhal Pondra Vaazhvile Kannai Mootum Saavile,
Um Rantaam Varukaiyil Vaadhai Varum Velaiyil

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Nearer, still nearer, close to Thy heart,
Draw me, my Savior, so precious Thou art;
Fold me, O fold me close to Thy breast, Shelter me safe in that haven of rest, Shelter me safe in that haven of rest.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Nearer, still nearer, nothing I bring,
Nought as an offering to Jesus my King- Only my sinful now contrite heart,
Grant me the cleansing Thy blood doth impart,
Grant me the cleansing Thy blood doth impart.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Nearer, still nearer, Lord, to be Thine;
All of its pleasures, pomp and its pride;
Give me but Jesus, my Lord crucified,
Give me but Jesus, my Lord crucified.

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: Nearer, still nearer, while life shall last;
Till safe in glory my anchor is cast;
Through endless ages, ever to be,
Nearer, my Savior, still nearer to Thee,
Nearer, my Savior, still nearer to Thee.

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: In the blood from the cross, I have been washed from sin;
But to be free from dross, Still I would enter in.

sections.label: Refrain
lines: Deeper yet, deeper yet, Into the crimson flood;
Deeper yet, deeper yet, Under the precious blood.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Day by day, hour by hour, Blessings are sent to me;
But for more of His power, Ever my prayer shall be.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Near to Christ I would live, Following Him each day;
What I ask He will give;
So then with faith I pray.

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: Now I have peace, sweet peace, While in this world of sin;
But to pray I'll not cease Till I am pure within.

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Beneath the cross of Jesus I fain would take my stand, the shadow of a mighty rock within a weary land; a home within the wilderness, a rest upon the way, from the burning of the noontide heat, and the burden of the day.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Upon that cross of Jesus mine eye at times can see the very dying form of One who suffered there for me; and from my stricken heart with tears two wonders I confess: the wonders of redeeming love and my unworthiness.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: I take, O cross, thy shadow for my abiding place;
I ask no other sunshine than the sunshine of his face; content to let the world go by, to know no gain nor loss, my sinful self my only shame, my glory all the cross.

sections.label: சரணம் 1
lines: அலைந்து சோரும் பூமியில், தங்கும் பாறை நிழல்
கொடும் சூர்யவெப்பம் என் ஆறுதல், கவலைகளின் என் ஆறுதல்.

sections.label: சரணம் 2
lines: மீட்பின் அன்பும் என் அபாத்ரமும், தேவ ரகசியம்.

sections.label: சரணம் 3
lines: உம்முகம் சூர்யன் ஒளி போல், வேறே ஒளி காணேன்,
சிலுவை யன்றி வேறொன்றிலும், மேன்மை நான் பாராட்டேன்.

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Alaindhu Sorum Poomiyil, Thangum Paarai Nizhal
Kotum Sooryaveppam En Aarudhal, Kavalaikalin En Aarudhal.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Meetpin Anpum En Apaadhramum, Theva Rakasiyam.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Ummukam Sooryan Oli Pol, Vere Oli Kaanen,
Siluvai Yandri Verondrilum, Menmai Naan Paaraatten.

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Faith of our fathers, living still,
In spite of dungeon, fire and sword;
O how our hearts beat high with joy Whenever we hear that glorious Word!
Faith of our fathers, holy faith!
We will be true to thee till death.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Our fathers, chained in prisons dark,
Were still in heart and conscience free: How sweet would be their children's fate.
If they, like them, could die for thee!
Faith of our fathers, holy faith!
We will be true to thee till death.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Faith of our fathers, we will love Both friend and foe in all our strife;
And preach Thee, too, as love knows how By kindly words and virtuous life.
Faith of our fathers, holy faith!
We will be true to thee till death.

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: In the morning, when I rise In the morning, when I rise In the morning, when I rise

sections.label: Refrain
lines: Give me Jesus, Give me Jesus.
You can have all this world, Just give me Jesus.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Just about the break of day,
Just about the break of day,
Just about the break of day,

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: Oh, when I come to die, Oh, when I come to die, Oh, when I come to die,

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: I am thine, O Lord, I have heard thy voice, and it told thy love to me; but I long to rise in the arms of faith and be closer drawn to thee.

sections.label: Refrain
lines: Draw me nearer, nearer, blessed Lord, to the cross where thou hast died.
Draw me nearer, nearer, nearer, blessed Lord, to thy precious, bleeding side.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Consecrate me now to thy service,
Lord, by the power of grace divine; let my soul look up with a steadfast hope, and my will be lost in thine.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: O the pure delight of a single hour that before thy throne I spend, when I kneel in prayer, and with thee, my God,
I commune as friend with friend!

translations.title: I Am Coming to the Cross

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: I am coming to the cross;
I am poor and weak and blind;
I am counting all but dross;

sections.label: Refrain
lines: I am trusting, Lord, in Thee.
Humbly at Thy cross I bow.
Save me, Jesus, save me now.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Long my heart has sighed for Thee;
Jesus sweetly speaks to me: 'I will cleanse you from all sin.'

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Here I give my all to Thee: Friends and time and earthly store;
Soul and body Thine to be, Wholly Thine forevermore.

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: I am every whit made whole: Glory, glory to the Lamb!

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: I would be, dear Savior, wholly Thine;
Teach me how, teach me how;
I would do Thy will, O Lord, not mine;

sections.label: Refrain
lines: Wholly Thine, wholly Thine, Wholly Thine, this is my vow;
Wholly Thine, wholly Thine, Wholly Thine, O Lord, just now.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: What is worldly pleasure, wealth or fame,
I will leave them all for Thy dear Name, This my wealth shall be.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: As I cast earth's transient joys behind,
Come Thou near, come Thou near;
In Thy presence all in all I find, 'Tis my comfort here.

sections.label: சரணம் 1
lines: எனதல்ல, உம் சித்தம் செய்ய, இப்போ உதவும்.

sections.label: சரணம் 2
lines: பூலோகப் பொருள் புகழ் என்ன? நீர் அல்லால், நீர் அல்லால்;

sections.label: சரணம் 3
lines: சிற்றின்பத்தை நான் நீக்குகிறேன் நீர் வாரும், நீர் வாரும்;
உம் ப்ரசனத்தில் எல்லாம் காண்பேன், இதென் ஆறுதல்.

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Enadhalla, Um Siththam Seyya, Ippo Udhavum.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Poolokap Porul Pukazh Enna? Neer Allaal, Neer Allaal;

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Sitrinpaththai Naan Neekkukiren Neer Vaarum, Neer Vaarum;
Um Prasanaththil Ellaam Kaanpen, Idhen Aarudhal.

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: All to Jesus I surrender; all to him I freely give;
I will ever love and trust him, in his presence daily live.

sections.label: Refrain
lines: I surrender all, all to thee, my blessed Savior,

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: All to Jesus I surrender; humbly at his feet I bow, worldly pleasures all forsaken; take me,

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: All to Jesus I surrender; make me,
Savior, wholly thine; fill me with thy love and power; truly know that thou art mine.

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: All to Jesus I surrender; now I feel the sacred flame.
O the joy of full salvation!

sections.label: சரணம் 1
lines: என்றும் அவரோடு தங்கி நம்பி நேசிப்பேன் மெய்யாய்.

sections.label: சரணம் 2
lines: லோக இன்பம் யாவும் விட்டேன், இப்போ தேற்றுக் கொள்ளுமே.

sections.label: சரணம் 3
lines: நான் உம் சொந்தம்; நீரென் சொந்தம்; சாட்சியாம் தேவாவியும்.

sections.label: சரணம் 5
lines: பூர்ண ரட்சை பேரானந்தம் சதா ஸ்தோத்திரம் அவர்க்கே.

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Endrum Avarotu Thangi Nampi Nesippen Meyyaai.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Loka Inpam Yaavum Vitten, Ippo Thetruk Kollume.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Naan Um Sondham; Neeren Sondham; Saatchiyaam Thevaaviyum.

sections.label: Verse 5
lines: Poorna Ratchai Peraanandham Sadhaa Sdhoththiram Avarkke.

translations.title: I Would Draw Nearer to Jesus

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: I would draw nearer to Jesus,
Safe and secure at His side.
I would draw nearer to Jesus, I would draw nearer to Him;
Fully surrendered each moment, I would draw nearer to Him.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: I would draw nearer to Jesus,
Knowing He loves to be gracious,
I would draw nearer to Him.
I would draw nearer to Jesus, I would draw nearer to Him;
Fully surrendered each moment, I would draw nearer to Him.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: I would draw nearer to Jesus,
Seeking Hi strength to be true,
Willing to tell of His goodness,
Gladly His blest will to do.
I would draw nearer to Jesus, I would draw nearer to Him;
Fully surrendered each moment, I would draw nearer to Him.

sections.label: Refrain
lines: Be like Jesus, this my song, In the home and in the throng;
Be like Jesus, all day long!

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: He has broken every fetter, I would be like Jesus;
That my soul may serve Him better, I would be like Jesus.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: All the way from earth to glory, I would be like Jesus;
Telling o'er and o'er the story, I would be like Jesus.

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: That in Heaven He may meet me, I would be like Jesus;
That His words 'Well done' may greet me, I would be like Jesus.

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Jesus, keep me near the cross; there a precious fountain, free to all, a healing stream, flows from Calvary's mountain.

sections.label: Refrain
lines: In the cross, in the cross, be my glory ever, till my raptured soul shall find rest beyond the river.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Near the cross, a trembling soul, love and mercy found me; there the bright and morning star sheds its beams around me.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: O Lamb of God, bring its scenes before me; help me walk from day to day with its shadow o'er me.

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: Near the cross I'll watch and wait, hoping, trusting ever, till I reach the golden strand

sections.label: சரணம் 1
lines: பாவம் போக்கும் ரத்தமாம் திவ்ய ஊற்றைக் காட்டும்.

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Paavam Pokkum Raththamaam Thivya Ootraik Kaattum.

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Just as I am, without one plea, But that Thy blood was shed for me, And that Thou bidst me come to Thee, O Lamb of God, I come, I come.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Just as I am, and waiting not To rid my soul of one dark blot, To Thee whose blood can cleanse each spot, O Lamb of God, I come, I come.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Just as I am, though tossed about With many a conflict, many a doubt, 'Fightings within, and fears without,' O Lamb of God, I come, I come.

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: Just as I am, poor, wretched, blind;
Sight, riches, healing of the mind, Yea, all I need in Thee to find, O Lamb of God, I come, I come.

sections.label: Verse 5
lines: Because Thy promise I believe, O Lamb of God, I come, I come.

sections.label: Verse 6
lines: Just as I am, Thy love I own Has broken every barrier down;
Now, to be Thine, and Thine alone, O Lamb of God, I come, I come.

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Just as I am, without one plea, but that thy blood was shed for me, and that thou bidst me come to thee, O Lamb of God, I come, I come.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Just as I am, and waiting not to rid my soul of one dark blot, to thee whose blood can cleanse each spot, O Lamb of God, I come, I come.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Just as I am, though tossed about with many a conflict, many a doubt, fightings and fears within, without, O Lamb of God, I come, I come.

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: Just as I am, poor, wretched, blind; sight, riches, healing of the mind, yea, all I need in thee to find, O Lamb of God, I come, I come.

sections.label: Verse 5
lines: Just as I am, thou wilt receive, wilt welcome, pardon, cleanse, relieve; because thy promise I believe, O Lamb of God, I come, I come.

sections.label: Verse 6
lines: Just as I am, thy love I own hath broken every barrier down; now, to be thine, and thine alone, O Lamb of God, I come, I come.

translations.title: நான் பாவிதான், ஆனாலும் நீர் மாசற்ற ரத்தஞ் சிந்தினீர்

sections.label: சரணம் 1
lines: நான் பாவிதான், ஆனாலும் நீர் மாசற்ற ரத்தஞ் சிந்தினீர்;
வாவென்று என்னைக் கூப்பிட்டீர்; என் மீட்பரே, வாறேன்.

sections.label: சரணம் 2
lines: நான் பாவிதான், என் நெஞ்சிலே கறை பிடித்திருக்குதே;
என் கறை நீங்க இப்போதே என் மீட்பரே வாறேன்.

sections.label: சரணம் 3
lines: நான் பாவிதான், பயத்தினால் அலைந்து, பாவப் பாரத்தால்,
அமிழ்ந்து மாண்டு போவதால் என் மீட்பரே, வாறேன்.

sections.label: சரணம் 4
lines: நான் பாவிதான், இரங்குவீர் அணைத்துக் காத்து, ரட்சிப்பீர்
அருளாம் செல்வம் அளிப்பீர்; என் மீட்பரே, வாறேன்.

sections.label: சரணம் 5
lines: நான் பாவிதான், அன்பாக நீர் நீங்காத் தடைகள் நீக்கினீர்;
உமக்குச் சொந்தம் ஆக்கினீர் என் மீட்பரே, வாறேன்.

translations.title: Naan Paavidhaan, Aanaalum Neer Maasatra Raththanj Chindhineer

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Naan Paavidhaan, Aanaalum Neer Maasatra Raththanj Chindhineer;
Vaavendru Ennaik Kooppitteer; En Meetpare, Vaaren.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Naan Paavidhaan, En Nenjile Karai Pitiththirukkudhe;
En Karai Neenga Ippodhe En Meetpare Vaaren.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Naan Paavidhaan, Payaththinaal Alaindhu, Paavap Paaraththaal,
Amizhndhu Maantu Povadhaal En Meetpare, Vaaren.

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: Naan Paavidhaan, Iranguveer Anaiththuk Kaaththu, Ratchippeer
Arulaam Selvam Alippeer; En Meetpare, Vaaren.

sections.label: Verse 5
lines: Naan Paavidhaan, Anpaaka Neer Neengaath Thataikal Neekkineer;
Umakkuch Chondham Aakkineer En Meetpare, Vaaren.

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: O for a closer walk with God, A calm and heavenly frame, A light to shine upon the road That leads me to the Lamb!

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Return, O holy Dove, return, Sweet messenger of rest!
I hate the sins that made Thee mourn And drove Thee from my breast.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: What peaceful hours I once enjoyed!
But they have left an aching void The world can never fill.

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: The dearest idol I have known,
Help me to tear it from Thy throne,

translations.title: Live Out Thy Life Within Me

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Live out Thy life within me, O Jesus, King of kings!
Be Thou Thyself the answer To all my questionings;
Live out Thy life within me, In all things have Thy way!
I, the transparent medium Thy glory to display.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: The temple has been yielded, And purified of sin;
Let Thy Shekinah glory Now shine forth from within,
And all the earth keep silence,
The body henceforth be Thy silent, gentle servant,

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Its members every moment Held subject to Thy call,
Ready to have Thee use them,
Or not be used at all;
Or strain, or stress, or fret Or chafings at Thy dealings,

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: When Thou hast need of me.
Live out Thy life within me, O Jesus, King of kings!
Be Thou the glorious answer To all my questionings.

translations.title: நீர் என்னில் வாசஞ்செய்யும், என் யேசு ராஜாவே!

sections.label: சரணம் 1
lines: நீர் என்னில் வாசஞ்செய்யும், என் யேசு ராஜாவே!
நீர் என்னில் வாசஞ்செய்து, உம் வழி காண்பியும்.

sections.label: சரணம் 3
lines: நீர் சொல்லும் சித்தம் செய்ய, அவை ஆயத்தமே
உமது பணி செய்ய, ஓர் நாளும் குன்றாதே

sections.label: சரணம் 4
lines: நீர் என்னில் வாசஞ்செய்யும், ஓ யேசு ராஜாவே!

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: King of my life, I crown Thee now, Thine shall the glory be;
Lest I forget Thy thorn crowned brow, Lead me to Calvary.

sections.label: Refrain
lines: Lest I forget Gethsemane, Lest I forget Thine agony;
Lest I forget Thy love for me, Lead me to Calvary.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Show me the tomb where Thou wast laid, Tenderly mourned and wept;
Angels in robes of light arrayed Guarded Thee whilst Thou slept.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Let me like Mary, through the gloom, Come with a gift to Thee;
Show to me now the empty tomb, Lead me to Calvary.

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: May I be willing, Lord, to bear Daily my cross for Thee;
Even Thy cup of grief to share, Thou hast borne all for me.

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Lord Jesus, I long to be perfectly whole;
I want Thee forever to live in my soul;
Break down every idol, cast out every foe;
Now wash me, and I shall be whiter than snow.

sections.label: Refrain
lines: Whiter than snow, yes, whiter than snow;
Now wash me, and I shall be whiter than snow.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Lord Jesus, look down from Thy throne in the skies,
And help me to make a complete sacrifice;
I give up myself, and whatever I know;
Now wash me, and I shall be whiter than snow.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Lord Jesus, for this I most humbly entreat;
I wait, blessed Lord, at Thy crucified feet,
Now wash me, and I shall be whiter than snow.

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: Lord Jesus, Thou seest I patiently wait;
Come now, and within me a new heart create;
To those who have sought Thee, Thou never said'st No;
Now wash me, and I shall be whiter than snow.

translations.title: Lord, I Want to Be a Christian

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Lord, I want to be a Christian in my heart, in my heart, Lord, I want to be a Christian in my heart, in my heart.
In my heart, in my heart, Lord, I want to be a Christian in my heart, in my heart.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Lord, I want to be more loving in my heart, in my heart, Lord, I want to be more loving in my heart, in my heart.
In my heart, in my heart, Lord, I want to be more loving in my heart, in my heart.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Lord, I want to be more holy in my heart, in my heart, Lord, I want to be more holy in my heart, in my heart.
In my heart, in my heart, Lord, I want to be more holy in my heart, in my heart.

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: Lord, I want to be more like Jesus in my heart, in my heart, Lord, I want to be more like Jesus in my heart, in my heart.
In my heart, in my heart, Lord, I want to be more like Jesus in my heart, in my heart.

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Lord of creation, to you be all praise!
Most mighty your working, most wondrous your ways!
Your glory and might are beyond us to tell,
And yet in the heart of the humble you dwell.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: In joyful obedience your tasks to fulfill.
Your bondage is freedom; your service is song;
And held in your keeping, my weakness is strong.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Rich truth that surpasses man's knowledge to find;
What eye has not seen and what ear has not heard Is taught by your spirit and shines from your word.

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: I give you my all, If I ever disown you,
But led in your service your word to obey, I'll walk in your freedom to the end of the way.

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: My Jesus, I love thee, I know thou art mine; for thee all the follies of sin I resign.
My gracious Redeemer, my Savior art thou; if ever I loved thee, my Jesus, 'tis now.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: I love thee because thou hast first loved me, and purchased my pardon on Calvary's tree;
I love thee for wearing the thorns on thy brow; if ever I loved thee, my Jesus, 'tis now.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: And praise Thee as long as Thou lendest me breath;
And say when the death dew lies cold on my brow, if ever I loved thee, my Jesus, 'tis now.

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: In mansions of glory and endless delight;
I'll ever adore thee in heaven so bright;
I'll sing with the glittering crown on my brow; if ever I loved thee, my Jesus, 'tis now.

sections.label: சரணம் 2
lines: நீர் ப்ராண த்யாகம் செய்து மீட்டுக் கொண்டீர்

sections.label: சரணம் 3
lines: என் ஜீவன் போனால் கூட நீங்க மாட்டேன்

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Neer Praana Dhyaakam Seydhu Meettuk Konteer

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: En Jeevan Ponaal Koota Neenga Maatten

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Nothing between my soul and my Savior, naught of this world's delusive dream;
I have renounced all sinful pleasure;
Jesus is mine, there's nothing between.

sections.label: Refrain
lines: Nothing between my soul and my Savior, so that his blessed face may be seen; nothing preventing the least of his favor; keep the way clear! let nothing between.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Nothing between, like worldly pleasure; habits of life, though harmless they seem, must not my heart from him ever sever; he is my all, there's nothing between.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Nothing between, e'en many hard trials, though the whole world against me convene; watching with prayer and much self denial, I'll triumph at last, there's nothing between.

translations.title: O for a Heart to Praise My God!

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: O for a heart to praise my God, A heart from sin set free, A heart that always feels Thy blood So freely shed for me.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Where only Christ is heard to speak,

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: A heart in every thought renewed And full of love divine,
Perfect and right and pure and good, A copy,

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: Write Thy new name upon my heart, Thy new, best name of Love.

translations.title: Just as I Am, Thine Own to Be

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Just as I am, Thine own to be, Friend of the young, who lovest me, To consecrate myself to Thee, O Jesus Christ, I come.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: In the glad morning of my day,
My life to give, my vows to pay,
With no reserve and no delay,
With all my heart I come.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: I would live ever in the light, I would work ever for the right;
I would serve Thee with all my might;

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: Just as I am, young, strong, and free, To be the best that I can be For truth, and righteousness, and Thee, Lord of my life, I come.

translations.title: Jesus, I My Cross Have Taken

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Jesus, I my cross have taken, all to leave and follow Thee.
All things else I have forsaken, Thou from hence my all shall be.
Perish every fond ambition, all I've sought or hoped or known.
Yet how rich is my condition!
God and Heaven are still mine own.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Let the world despise and leave me, they have left my Savior, too.
Human hearts and looks deceive me;
Thou art faithful, Thou art true.
O, 'tis not in grief to harm me, while thy love is left to me;
O, 'twere not in joy to charm me, If that love be hid from me.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Soul, then know thy full salvation; rise o'er sin, and fear, and care;
Joy to find in every station something still to do or bear: Think what Spirit dwells within thee;
Think what Father's smiles are thine;
Think that Jesus died to win thee, child of heaven, canst thou repine?

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: Haste then on from grace to glory, armed by faith, and winged by prayer,
God's own hand shall guide thee there.
Soon shall close thy earthly mission, soon shall pass thy pilgrim days;
Hope soon change to glad fruition, faith to sight, and prayer to praise.

translations.title: Open My Eyes That I May See

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Open my eyes, that I may see Glimpses of truth Thou hast for me;
Place in my hands the wonderful key That shall unclasp and set me free.
Silently now I wait for Thee, Ready, my God, Thy will to see;
Open my eyes, illumine me, Spirit Divine!

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Open my ears that I may hear Voices of truth Thou sendest clear; and while the wavenotes fall on my ear,
Silently now I wait for Thee, Ready, my God, Thy will to see;
Open my ears, illumine me, Spirit Divine!

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Open my mouth, and let me bear Gladly the warm truth everywhere;
Open my heart, and let me prepare Love with Thy children thus to share.
Silently now I wait for Thee, Ready, my God, Thy will to see;
Open my heart, illumine me, Spirit Divine!

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: I'd rather have Jesus than silver or gold;
I'd rather be His than have riches untold;
I'd rather have Jesus than houses or land;
I'd rather be led by His nail-pierced hand:

sections.label: Refrain
lines: Than to be the king of a vast domain or be held in sin's dread sway!
I'd rather have Jesus than anything this world affords today.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: I'd rather have Jesus than men's applause;
I'd rather be faithful to His dear cause;
I'd rather have Jesus than world-wide fame;
I'd rather be true to His holy name:

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: He's fairer than lilies of rarest bloom;
He's sweeter than honey from out the comb;
He's all that my hungering spirit needs - I'd rather have Jesus and let Him lead:

translations.title: Must Jesus Bear the Cross Alone

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Must Jesus bear the cross alone, and all the world go free?
No, there's a cross for everyone, and there's a cross for me.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: The consecrated cross I'll bear till He shall set me free; and then go home my crown to wear, for there's a crown for me.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Upon the crystal pavement, down at Jesus' pierced feet, with joy I'll cast my golden crown, and His dear name repeat.

translations.title: Take the World, but Give Me Jesus

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Take the world, but give me Jesus;
All its Joys are but a name,

sections.label: Refrain
lines: Oh, the height and depth of mercy!
Oh, the length and breadth of love!
Oh, the fullness of redemption, Pledge of endless life above.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Take the world, but give me Jesus, Sweetest comfort of my soul;
With my Savior watching o'er me, I can sing, though billows roll.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Take the world, but give me Jesus;
Let me view his constant smile;
Then throughout my pilgrim journey Light will cheer me all the while.

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: Take the world, but give me Jesus;
In His cross my trust shall be,
Till, with clearer, brighter vision Face to face my Lord I see.

translations.title: Take My Life and Let It Be

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Take my life, and let it be Consecrated, Lord, to Thee;
Take my hands, and let them move At the impulse of Thy love;
At the impulse of Thy love.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Take my feet, and let them be Swift and beautiful for Thee.
Take my voice, and let me sing Always, only, for my King;

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Take my lips, and let them be Filled with messages from Thee.
Take my silver and my gold: Not a mite would I withhold;
Not a mite would I withhold.

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: Take my will, and make it Thine, It shall be no longer mine;
Take my heart, it is Thine own, It shall be Thy royal throne.
It shall be Thy royal throne.

sections.label: Verse 5
lines: Take my love, my Lord, I pour At Thy feet its treasure store;
Take myself, and I will be, Ever, only, all for Thee.

sections.label: சரணம் 1
lines: என்றன் காலம் நேரமும் நீர் கையாடி யருளும்.

sections.label: சரணம் 2
lines: என்றன் கை பேரன்பினால் ஏவப்பட்டு, என்றன் கால்

sections.label: சரணம் 3
lines: என்றன் நாவு இன்பமாய் உம்மைப்பாட, என்றன் வாய்

sections.label: சரணம் 5
lines: என்றன் நெஞ்சை ஆளுவீர், அதில் தோன்றி வசிப்பீர்.

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Endran Kaalam Neramum Neer Kaiyaati Yarulum.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Endran Kai Peranpinaal Evappattu, Endran Kaal

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Endran Naavu Inpamaai Ummaippaata, Endran Vaai

sections.label: Verse 5
lines: Endran Nenjai Aaluveer, Adhil Thondri Vasippeer.

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: O Jesus, I have promised to serve thee to the end; be thou forever near me, my Master and my friend.
I shall not fear the battle if thou art by my side, nor wander from the pathway if thou wilt be my guide.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: O let me feel thee near me!
I see the sights that dazzle, the tempting sounds I hear; my foes are ever near me, around me and within; but Jesus, draw thou nearer, and shield my soul from sin.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: O Jesus, thou hast promised to all who follow thee that where thou art in glory there shall thy servant be.
And Jesus, I have promised to serve thee to the end;
O give me grace to follow, my Master and my Friend.

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Oh now I see the crimson wave, The fountain deep and wide;
Jesus, my Lord, mighty to save, Points to His wounded side.

sections.label: Refrain
lines: The cleansing stream I see, I see, I plunge, and O, it cleanseth me!
O praise the Lord! it cleanseth me, It cleanseth me, yes, cleanseth me.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: I see the new creation rise, I hear the speaking blood;
It speaks polluted nature dies, Sinks 'neath the cleansing flood.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: I rise to walk in heaven's own light, Above the world and sin;
With heart made pure and garments white,

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: 'tis heaven below To feel the blood applied,

translations.title: On Jordan's Banks the Baptist's Cry

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: On Jordan's banks the Baptist's cry Announces that the Lord is nigh;
Awake and hearken, for he brings Glad tidings of the King of kings!

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Then cleansed be every life from sin;
Make straight the way for God within,
And let us all our hearts prepare For Christ to come and enter there.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: We hail You as our Savior, Lord, Our refuge and our great reward;
Without Your grace we waste away Like flow'rs that wither and decay.

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: Stretch forth Your hand, our health restore,
And make us rise to fall no more;
Oh, let Your face upon us shine And fill the world with love divine.

translations.title: Come, Thou Fount of Every Blessing

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Come, thou Fount of every blessing,
Tune my heart to sing thy grace;
Call for songs of loudest praise.
Teach me ever to adore Thee,
May I still Thy goodness prove,
While the hope of endless glory Fills my heart with joy and love.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Hither by thy help I've come;
And I hope, by thy good pleasure, Safely to arrive at home.
Jesus sought me when a stranger, Wandering from the fold of God;
He, to rescue me from danger, Interposed his precious blood.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: O, to grace how great a debtor Daily I'm constrained to be!
Let thy goodness, like a fetter, Bind me closer still to thee.
Prone to wander, Lord, I feel it, Prone to leave the God I love;
Here's my heart'O, take and seal it,
Seal it for thy courts above.

translations.title: தாரும் சுத்த ஆவி தாரும், எங்கள் ஆத்துமத்திலே

sections.label: சரணம் 1
lines: தாரும் சுத்த ஆவி தாரும், எங்கள் ஆத்துமத்திலே,

sections.label: சரணம் 2
lines: எங்கள் நெஞ்சில் நல்ல புத்தி தேவ பக்தி தோன்றவே,
மாற்றத் தாரும், மாற்றத் தாரும் நல்ல தேவ ஆவியை. (2)

sections.label: சரணம் 3
lines: கால் தள்ளாடி, கால் தள்ளாடிப் போகில் நீரே ரட்சியும். (2)

sections.label: சரணம் 4
lines: என்று கெஞ்சும் போதிரங்கி, என்னைத் தேற்றிக் கொண்டிரும்!
துன்பம் நீங்க, துன்பம் நீங்க நீர் சகாயராய் இரும். (2)

translations.title: Thaarum Suththa Aavi Thaarum, Engal Aaththumaththile

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Thaarum Suththa Aavi Thaarum, Engal Aaththumaththile,

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Engal Nenjil Nalla Puththi Theva Pakdhi Thondrave,
Maatrath Thaarum, Maatrath Thaarum Nalla Theva Aaviyai. (2)

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Kaal Thallaati, Kaal Thallaatip Pokil Neere Ratchiyum. (2)

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: Endru Kenjum Podhirangi, Ennaith Thetrik Kontirum!
Thunpam Neenga, Thunpam Neenga Neer Sakaayaraai Irum. (2)

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Christ has for sin atonement made, What a wonderful Saviour!
We are redeemed! the price is paid!

sections.label: Refrain
lines: What a wonderful Savior is Jesus, my Jesus!
What a wonderful Savior is Jesus, my Lord!

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: I praise Him for the cleansing blood, What a wonderful Saviour!
That reconciled my soul to God;

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: He walks beside me all the way, What a wonderful Saviour!
And keeps me faithful day by day;

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: He gives me overcoming power, What a wonderful Saviour!
And triumph in each trying hour;

translations.title: என் பாவம் நீக்கி விட்டனர் ஒப்பில்லா வல்ல மீட்பர்

sections.label: சரணம் 1
lines: என் பாவம் நீக்கி விட்டனர் ஒப்பில்லா வல்ல மீட்பர்
மா க்ரயம் தந்து மீட்டனர் ஒப்பில்லா வல்ல மீட்பர்.

sections.label: பல்லவி
lines: ஒப்பில்லா வல்ல மீட்பர்! மா நேசர்! என் நேசர்!
ஒப்பில்லா வல்ல மீட்பர்! என் யேசுவைப் பார்.

sections.label: சரணம் 2
lines: மாசற்ற ரத்தம் சிந்தினார் ஒப்பில்லா வல்ல மீட்பர்.
தம்மண்டை சேர்த்து அணைத்தார் ஒப்பில்லா வல்ல மீட்பர்.

sections.label: சரணம் 3
lines: என் நெஞ்சைச் சுத்தமாக்கினார் ஒப்பில்லா வல்ல மீட்பர்,
அங்கர சாட்சி செய்கிறார் ஒப்பில்லா வல்ல மீட்பர்.

sections.label: சரணம் 4
lines: என் துணையாக நிற்கிறார் ஒப்பில்லா வல்ல மீட்பர்.
எத்தீங்கு மின்றிக் காக்கிறார் ஒப்பில்லா வல்ல மீட்பர்.

translations.title: En Paavam Neekki Vittanar Oppillaa Valla Meetpar

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: En Paavam Neekki Vittanar Oppillaa Valla Meetpar
Maa Krayam Thandhu Meettanar Oppillaa Valla Meetpar.

sections.label: Refrain
lines: Oppillaa Valla Meetpar! Maa Nesar! En Nesar!
Oppillaa Valla Meetpar! En Yesuvaip Paar.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Maasatra Raththam Sindhinaar Oppillaa Valla Meetpar.
Thammantai Serththu Anaiththaar Oppillaa Valla Meetpar.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: En Nenjaich Chuththamaakkinaar Oppillaa Valla Meetpar,
Angara Saatchi Seykiraar Oppillaa Valla Meetpar.

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: En Thunaiyaaka Nirkiraar Oppillaa Valla Meetpar.
Eththeengu Mindrik Kaakkiraar Oppillaa Valla Meetpar.

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: There is a fountain filled with blood drawn from Emmanuel's veins;
And sinners plunged beneath that flood lose all their guilty stains.
Lose all their guilty stains, lose all their guilty stains;
And sinners plunged beneath that flood lose all their guilty stains.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: The dying thief rejoiced to see that fountain in his day;
And there may I, though vile as he, wash all my sins away.
Wash all my sins away, wash all my sins away;
And there may I, though vile as he, wash all my sins away.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Thy precious blood shall never lose its power Till all the ransomed church of God are saved, to sin no more.
Are saved, to sin no more, are saved, to sin no more;
Till all the ransomed church of God are saved, to sin no more.

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: I saw the stream Thy flowing wounds supply,
Redeeming love has been my theme, and shall be till I die.
And shall be till I die, and shall be till I die;
Redeeming love has been my theme, and shall be till I die.

sections.label: Verse 5
lines: Lord, I believe Thou hast prepared, unworthy though I be, For me a blood-bought free reward, a golden harp for me!
For me a blood-bought free reward, a golden harp for me!

sections.label: Verse 6
lines: There in a nobler, sweeter song, I'll sing Thy power to save,
When this poor lisping, stammering tongue is ransomed from the the grave.
Is ransomed from the grave, is ransomed from the grace;
When this poor lisping, stammering tongue is ransomed from the the grave.

sections.label: சரணம் 1
lines: எப்பாவ தோஷ குற்றமும், நிர் மூல மாகுமே.

sections.label: சரணம் 2
lines: பேர் வாழ்வின் வாக்குத் தத்தமும் அப்பாவி யடைந்தான்.

sections.label: சரணம் 3
lines: என் பாவத் திகில் நீங்கிற்றால் ஓயாமல் பாடுவேன்.

sections.label: சரணம் 5
lines: உம் திரு ரத்தம், ரட்சகா! பாய்ந்தோடச் செய்யுமே;

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Eppaava Thosha Kutramum, Nir Moola Maakume.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Per Vaazhvin Vaakkuth Thaththamum Appaavi Yataindhaan.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: En Paavath Thikil Neengitraal Oyaamal Paatuven.

sections.label: Verse 5
lines: Um Thiru Raththam, Ratchakaa! Paaindhotach Cheyyume;

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Redeemed, how I love to proclaim it!
Redeemed by the blood of the Lamb;
Redeemed through His infinite mercy, His child and forever I am.

sections.label: Refrain
lines: Redeemed, redeemed, Redeemed by the blood of the Lamb;
Redeemed, redeemed, His child and forever I am.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Redeemed, and so happy in Jesus, No language my rapture can tell;
I know that the light of His presence With me doth continually dwell.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: I know there's a crown that is waiting In yonder bright mansion for me;
And soon, with the spirit made perfect,
At home with the Lord I shall be.

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Redeemed, how I love to proclaim it!
Redeemed by the blood of the Lamb;
Redeemed thro' His infinite mercy, His child, and forever, I am.

sections.label: Refrain
lines: Redeemed, redeemed, Redeemed by the blood of the Lamb;
Redeemed, how I love to proclaim it!
His child and forever I am.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: I think of my blessed Redeemer, I think of Him all the day long;
I sing, for I cannot be silent;
His love is the theme of my song.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: I know I shall see in His beauty The King in whose law I delight,
And giveth me songs in the night.

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: God is my strong salvation, What foe have I to fear?
My Light, my Help, is near: Though hosts encamp around me,
Firm in the fight I stand;
What terror can confound me, With God at my right hand?

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: His truth be thine affiance, When faint and desolate.
His might thy heart shall strengthen, His love thy joy increase;
The Lord will give thee peace.

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: We have heard a joyful sound, Jesus saves, Jesus saves;
Spread the gladness all around, Jesus saves, Jesus saves;
Bear the news to every land,
Climb the steeps and cross the waves,

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: ft it on the rolling tide, Jesus saves, Jesus saves;
Tell to sinners, far and wide, Jesus saves, Jesus saves;
Sing, ye islands of the sea.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: ng above the battle's strife, Jesus saves, Jesus saves;
By His death and endless life, Jesus saves, Jesus saves;
Sing it softly through the gloom,
When the heart for mercy craves,
Sing in triumph o'er the tomb,

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: ve the winds a mighty voice, Jesus saves, Jesus saves;
Let the nations now rejoice, Jesus saves, Jesus saves;

hymns.tuneName: TO GOD BE THE GLORY • Tamil #12

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: To God be the glory, great things he hath done!
So loved he the world that he gave us his Son, who yielded his life an atonement for sin, and opened the lifegate that all may go in.

sections.label: Refrain
lines: Praise the Lord, praise the Lord, let the earth hear his voice!
Praise the Lord, praise the Lord, let the people rejoice!
O come to the Father thru Jesus the Son, and give him the glory, great things he hath done!

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: O perfect redemption, the purchase of blood, to every believer the promise of God; the vilest offender who truly believes, that moment from Jesus a pardon receives.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Great things he hath taught us, great things he hath done, and great our rejoicing thru Jesus the Son; but purer, and higher, and greater will be our wonder, our transport, when Jesus we see.

translations.title: மெய்த் தேவனைத் துதி பேர் நன்மை செய்தார்

sections.label: சரணம் 1
lines: மெய்த் தேவனைத் துதி பேர் நன்மை செய்தார்,

translations.title: Meyth Thevanaith Thudhi Per Nanmai Seydhaar

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Meyth Thevanaith Thudhi Per Nanmai Seydhaar,

translations.title: Is This a Day of New Beginnings?

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Is this a day of new beginnings,
Time to remember and move on,
Time too believe what love is bringing,
Laying to rest the pain that's gone?

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: How can the seasons of a planet Mindlessly spinning round its sun With just a human name and number Say that some new thing has begun?

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Yet through the life and death of Jesus Love's mighty Spirit, now as then,
Can make for us a world of difference As faith and hope are born again.

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: Then let us, with the Spirit's daring,
Step from the past and leave behind Its disappointment, guilt, and grieving,
Seeking new paths, and sure to find.

sections.label: Verse 5
lines: Christ is alive, and goes before us To show and share what love can do.
This is a day of new beginnings;
Our God is making all things new.

translations.title: I Will Sing of My Redeemer

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: I will sing of my Redeemer, And His wondrous love to me;
On the cruel cross He suffered, From the curse to set me free.

sections.label: Refrain
lines: Sing, oh sing, of my Redeemer, With His blood, He purchased me.
Paid the debt, and made me free.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: I will tell the wondrous story,
How my lost estate to save,
In His boundless love and mercy,

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: I will sing of my Redeemer, And His heavenly love to me;
He from death to life hath brought me, Son of God with Him to be.

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Lord, the house of thine abode, the church our blest Redeemer saved with his own precious blood.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: I love thy church, O God!
Her walls before thee stand dear as the apple of thine eye, and graven on thy hand.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Beyond my highest joy I prize her heavenly ways, her sweet communion, solemn vows, her hymns of love and praise.

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: Sure as thy truth shall last, to Zion shall be given the brightest glories earth can yield, and brighter bliss of heaven.

translations.title: Christ Is the World's True Light

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Christ is the world's true light,
The daystar clear and bright Of every man and nation;
New life, new hope awakes Where'er men own His sway: Freedom her bondage breaks,
And night is turned to day.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: From sunrise to its setting: When Christ is throned as Lord,

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: One Lord, in one great name Unite us all who own Thee,
Cast out our pride and shame That hinder to enthrone Thee;
The world has waited long, Has travailed long in pain, To heal its ancient wrong, Come, Prince of Peace, and reign.

translations.title: Lord, Who Dost Give to Thy Church

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Lord, who dost give to Thy church for its healing Gifts, and the grace to sustain and renew,
Hear as we pray that today and each morrow We to Thy purpose may show ourselves true.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Clear be the voices of preachers and prophets Fearlessly speaking the word of the Lord,
Word of redemption thro' God's Son incarnate,
Blessing for cursing, and peace for the sword.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Tender and wise be the hearts of the pastors,
Guiding and guarding the souls in their care,
Firm with the wayward, a strength to the doubting,
Helping the needy their burdens to bear.

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: May those who teach grow in knowledge and patience,
Guiding to wisdom the young and the old,
Training for worship and witness and service,
Foes to all falsehood, in truthfulness bold.

sections.label: Verse 5
lines: Lord, ever give to us gifts in due measure,
Each needing other, and all having worth;
So to the Father, the Son, and the Spirit,
Glory be shown by the church here on earth.

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Built on the Rock the Church shall stand,
Crumbled have spires in every land,
Bells still are chiming and calling Calling the young and old to rest,
Calling the souls of those distressed,

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Not in our temples made with hands God, the Almighty, is dwelling;
High in the heav'ns His temple stands,
Yet He who dwells in heav'n above Deigns to abide with us in love,

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: We are God's house of living stones,
Were two or three to seek His face,
He in their midst would show His grace,

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: Yet in this house, an earthly frame,
Hither we come to praise His name,
Jesus to us His Spirit sent,

sections.label: Verse 5
lines: Thro' all the passing years, O Lord, Grant that, when church bells are ringing, Many may come to hear God's Word Where He this promise is bringing: I know My own, My own know Me: You, not the world, My face shall see;
My peace I leave with you.

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: The church's one foundation is Jesus Christ her Lord; she is his new creation by water and the Word.
From heaven he came and sought her to be his holy bride; with his own blood he bought her, and for her life he died.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Elect from every nation, yet one o'er all the earth; her charter of salvation, one Lord, one faith, one birth; one holy name she blesses, partakes one holy food, and to one hope she presses, with every grace endued.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Though with a scornful wonder we see her sore oppressed, by schisms rent asunder, by heresies distressed, yet saints their watch are keeping; their cry goes up, 'How long?' And soon the night of weeping shall be the morn of song.

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: 'Mid toil and tribulation, and tumult of her war, she waits the consummation of peace forevermore; till, with the vision glorious, her longing eyes are blest, and the great church victorious shall be the church at rest.

sections.label: சரணம் 3
lines: பக்தர் ஓயாத சத்தம் எம் மட்டும்? என்பதாம்;

sections.label: சரணம் 4
lines: பெற்று, போர் ஓய்ந்து வெற்றி சிறந்து, மாட்சிமை

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Pakdhar Oyaadha Saththam Em Mattum? Enpadhaam;

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: Petru, Por Oindhu Vetri Sirandhu, Maatchimai

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Here in Christ we gather, love of Christ our calling.
Christ, our love, is with us, gladness be His greeting.
Let us fear Him, yes, and love Him, God eternal.
Loving Him, let each love Christ in all his brethren.

sections.label: Refrain
lines: God is love, and where true love is God Himself is there.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: When we Christians gather, members of one body,
Let there be in us no discord but one spirit.
Banished now be anger, strife, and every quarrel.
Christ, our God, be always present here among us.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Grant us love's fulfillment, joy with all the blessed,
O purest Light of all creation, Be our bliss while endless ages sing Your praises.

translations.title: Blest Be the Tie That Binds

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Blest be the tie that binds our hearts in Christian love; the fellowship of kindred minds is like to that above.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Before our Father's throne we pour our ardent prayers; our fears, our hopes, our aims are one, our comforts and our cares.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: We share each other's woes, our mutual burdens bear; and often for each other flows the sympathizing tear.

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: When we asunder part, it gives us inward pain; but we shall still be joined in heart, and hope to meet again.

sections.label: சரணம் 1
lines: இந்த மனங்க ளொற்றுமை சீர் பொருந் தட்டுமே.

sections.label: சரணம் 2
lines: நம் பிதா சன்னிதி நாம் ஜெபம் செய்கிறோம்;
பயம், ஆசை, நோக்கம் ஒன்றாம் சுகம் அலுவலும்.

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Indha Mananga Lotrumai Seer Porun Thattume.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Nam Pidhaa Sannidhi Naam Jepam Seykirom;
Payam, Aasai, Nokkam Ondraam Sukam Aluvalum.

translations.title: Thy Hand, O God Has Guided

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Thy hand, O God, has guided Thy flock from age to age;
The wondrous tale is written Full clear on every page;
Our fathers owned Thy goodness, And we their deeds record;
And both of this bear witness, One church, one faith, one Lord.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Thy heralds brought glad tidings To greatest as to least;
They bade men rise and hasten To share the great King's feast: And this was all their teaching,
To all alike proclaiming One church, one faith, one Lord.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: When shadows thick were falling, And all seemed sunk in night, Thou, Lord, did send Thy servants, Thy chosen sons of light.
On them and on Thy people Thy plenteous grace was poured,
And this was still their message: One church, one faith, one Lord.

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: Thy mercy will not fail us, Nor leave Thy work undone;
With Thy right hand to help us, The vict'ry shall be won;
And then by men and angels Thy name shall be adored,
And this shall be their anthem: One church, one faith, one Lord.

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: That love should dwell among you all.
This is My will that you should love As I have shown that I love you.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: No greater love a man can have Than that he die to save his friends.
You are My friends if you obey What I command that you should do.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: You chose not Me, but I chose you That you should go and bear much fruit.
I chose you out that you in Me Should bear much fruit that will abide.

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: All that I ask My Father, dear,
For My name's sake you shall receive.
That love should dwell in each, in all.

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Father, help Your people in this world to build Something of Your kingdom and to do Your will,
Lead us to discover partnership in love;
Bless our ways of sharing and our pride remove.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Lord of desk and altar, bind our lives in one,
That in work and worship love may set the tone.
Give us grace to listen, clarity of speech;
Make us truly thankful for the gifts of each.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Holy is the setting of each room and yard,
Lecture hall and kitchen, office, shop, and ward.
Holy is the rhythm of our working hours;
Hallow then our purpose, energy, and pow'rs.

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: Strengthen, Lord, for service hand and heart and brain;
Help us good relations daily to maintain.
Let the living presence of the servant Christ Heighten our devotion, make our life a feast.

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Thy love, O God, has all mankind created, And led Thy people to this present hour;
In Christ we see life's glory consummated;
Thy Spirit manifests His living power.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: From out the darkness of our hope's frustration,
From all the broken idols of our pride,
We turn to seek Thy truth's illumination,
And find Thy mercy waiting at our side.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: In pity look upon Thy children's striving For life and freedom, peace and brotherhood,
Till at the fullness of Thy truth arriving,
We find in Christ the crown of every good.

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: Inspire Thy church, mid earth's discordant voices,
To preach the gospel of her Lord above,
Until the day this warring world rejoices To hear the mighty harmonies of love.

translations.title: Where Cross the Crowded Ways of Life

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Where cross the crowded ways of life, where sound the cries of race and clan, above the noise of selfish strife, we hear your voice,

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: From tender childhood's helplessness, from woman's grief, man's burdened toil, from famished souls, from sorrow's stress, your heart has never known recoil.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: The cup of water given for you still holds the freshness of your grace; yet long these multitudes to view the sweet compassion of your face.

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: O Master, from the mountainside make haste to heal these hearts of pain; among these restless throngs abide;
O tread the city's streets again.

sections.label: Verse 5
lines: Till all the world shall learn your love and follow where your feet have trod, till, glorious from your heaven above, shall come the city of our God.

translations.title: All Who Love and Serve Your City

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: All who love and serve your city,
All who bear its daily stress,
All who cry for peace and justice,
All who curse and all who bless.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: In your day of loss and sorrow,
In your day of helpless strife,
Seek the Lord, who is your life.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: For all days are days of judgment,
And the Lord is waiting still,
Drawing near His friends who spurn Him,

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: Risen Lord, shall yet the city Be the city of despair?
Come today, our judge, our glory;
Be its name 'The Lord is there!'

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Who dares stand idle on the harvest plain While all around him waves the golden grain?
And to each servant does the Master say, 'Go work today.'

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Claim the high calling angels cannot share;
To young and old the gospel gladness bear;
Redeem the time; its hours too swiftly fly.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: No time for rest; till glows the western sky,
Till the long shadows o'r our pathway lie,
And a glad sound comes with the setting sun, 'Well done, well done!'

translations.title: Far and Near the Fields Are Teeming

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Far and near the fields are teeming with the sheaves of ripened grain;
Far and near their gold is gleaming O'er the summy slope and plain.

sections.label: Refrain
lines: Lord of harvest, send forth reapers!
Hear us Lord,to Thee we cry;
Send them now the sheaves to gather,

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Send them forth with morn's first beaming,
Send them in the noon-tides's glare;
When the sun's last rays are streaming, bid them gather everywhere.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: O thou, whom thy Lord is sending, gather now the sheaves of gold;
Heavenward then at evening wending Thou shalt come with joy untold.

translations.title: Hark! the Voice of Jesus Calling

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Hark! the voice of Jesus calling, 'Who will go and work today?
Fields are white, the harvest waiting,
Who will bear the sheaves away?' Loud and long the Master calleth,
Who will answer, gladly saying, 'Here am I, O Lord, send me'?

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: If you cannot cross the ocean And the heathen lands explore,
You can find the heathen nearer,
You can help them at your door;
If you cannot speak like angels, If you cannot preach like Paul,
You can tell the love of Jesus,
You can say He died for all.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: If you cannot be the watchman,
Pointing out the path to heaven,
Offering life and peace to all;
With your prayers and with your bounties You can do what Heaven demands,
You can be like faithful Aaron,

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: While the souls of men are dying,
And the Master calls for you,
Let none hear you idly saying, 'There is nothing I can do!' Gladly take the task He gives you,
Let His work your pleasure be;
Answer quickly when He calleth, 'Here am I, O Lord, send me.'

translations.title: கேள் யேசு அழைக்கும் சத்தம் யார் போய் என் வேலை செய்வார்?

sections.label: சரணம் 1
lines: கேள் யேசு அழைக்கும் சத்தம் யார் போய் என் வேலை செய்வார்?
முதிர்ந்த பயிர் அறுத்து அரிகள் யார் சுமப்பார்?
கூவி அழைக்கும் ஆண்டவர் உன்னத பலம் ஈவார்.
இதோ நான் தேவா அனுப்பும் பதில் யார் சொல்வார் நன்று.

sections.label: சரணம் 2
lines: தூது கேளோர் நாடு தேடி கடல் தாண்டா விட்டாலும்
வீட்டருகில் உன் பக்கத்தில் தூது சொல்லி உதவு.
தூதர், பவுல் போல் போதிக்க ஆற்றல் இல்லாவிட்டாலும்
யேசு மாண்டார் உனக்கென்று நேசர் அன்பு கூறலாம்.

sections.label: சரணம் 3
lines: என்னால் ஆகாதொன்றும் செய்ய மக்கள் கேட்கச் சொல்லாதே.
தரும் வேலை செய் களிப்பாய் ஊழியமே உன் வாழ்வு.
அழைத்தால் பதில் சொல் உடன் தேவா இதோ அனுப்பும்.

translations.title: Kel Yesu Azhaikkum Saththam Yaar Poi En Velai Seyvaar?

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Kel Yesu Azhaikkum Saththam Yaar Poi En Velai Seyvaar?
Mudhirndha Payir Aruththu Arikal Yaar Sumappaar?
Koovi Azhaikkum Aantavar Unnadha Palam Eevaar.
Idho Naan Thevaa Anuppum Padhil Yaar Solvaar Nandru.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Thoodhu Kelor Naatu Theti Katal Thaantaa Vittaalum
Veettarukil Un Pakkaththil Thoodhu Solli Udhavu.
Thoodhar, Pavul Pol Podhikka Aatral Illaavittaalum
Yesu Maantaar Unakkendru Nesar Anpu Kooralaam.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Ennaal Aakaadhondrum Seyya Makkal Ketkach Chollaadhe.
Tharum Velai Sey Kalippaai Oozhiyame Un Vaazhvu.
Azhaiththaal Padhil Sol Utan Thevaa Idho Anuppum.

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: From the eastern mountains Pressing on they come,

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: There their Lord and Savior Meek and lowly,
Wondrous light that led them Onward on their way,
Ever now to lighten Nations from afar,
As they journey homeward By that guiding star.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Gather in the outcasts All who've gone astray,
Guide them by the brightness Of Thy guiding star.

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: Whether bond or free, 'Neath Thy starlit banner,
O'er the distant mountains To that heavenly home,
Where no sin nor sorrow Evermore shall come.

translations.title: Hark! 'Tis the Shepherd's Voice I Hear

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Out in the desert dark and drear,
Calling the sheep who've gone astray,
Far from the Shepherd's fold away.

sections.label: Refrain
lines: Bring them in from the fields of sin;
Bring them in, Bring them in, Bring the wanderers to Jesus.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Who'll go and help the Shepherd kind,
Help Him the wandering ones to find?
Who'll bring them back into the fold,
Where they'll be sheltered from the cold?

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Out in the desert hear their cry, Out on the mountain wild and high, Hark!
'tis the Master speaks to thee, 'Go, find My sheep where 'er they be.'

translations.title: நல் மேய்ப்பர் க்றிஸ்து வானவர் தப்பிப்போன ஆடுகளை

sections.label: சரணம் 1
lines: நல் மேய்ப்பர் க்றிஸ்து வானவர் தப்பிப்போன ஆடுகளை

sections.label: பல்லவி
lines: மந்தையில் மந்தையில் நாம் கொண்டு சேர்த்து விடுவோம்,

sections.label: சரணம் 2
lines: உதவி செய்ய யார் செல்வார்? மேய்ப்பருக்கு ஒத்தாசையாய்
குளிர் இல்லாத மந்தைக்குள் கொண்டு சேர்த்திட யார் செல்வார்?

sections.label: சரணம் 3
lines: ஆடுகளைப் போய்த் தேடிட ஏவும் சத்தத்தைக் கேட்கிறேன்.

translations.title: Nal Meyppar Krisdhu Vaanavar Thappippona Aatukalai

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Nal Meyppar Krisdhu Vaanavar Thappippona Aatukalai

sections.label: Refrain
lines: Mandhaiyil Mandhaiyil Naam Kontu Serththu Vituvom,

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Udhavi Seyya Yaar Selvaar? Meypparukku Oththaasaiyaai
Kulir Illaadha Mandhaikkul Kontu Serththita Yaar Selvaar?

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Aatukalaip Poith Thetita Evum Saththaththaik Ketkiren.

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Come, Christians, follow where our Captain trod, Our King victorious, Christ, the Son of God.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Led on their way by this triumphant sign,
The hosts of God in conquering ranks combine.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: All newborn soldiers of the Crucified Bear on their brows the seal of Him Who died.

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: O Lord, once lifted on the glorious tree,
As Thou hast promised, draw us all to Thee.

sections.label: Verse 5
lines: So shall our song of triumph ever be: Praise to the Crucified for victory!

sections.label: Verse 6
lines: Lift high the cross, the love of Christ proclaim,
Till all the world adore His sacred Name.

translations.title: Lord, Whose Love in Humble Service

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Lord, whose love in humble service Bore the weight of human need,
Worked Your mercy's perfect deed: We,
Your servants, bring the worship Not of voice alone, but heart;
Consecrating to Your purpose Every gift which You impart.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Still the hungry cry for bread;
Still the captives long for freedom;
Still in grief we mourn our dead.
As you, Lord, in deep compassion Healed the sick and freed the soul, By Your Spirit send Your power To our world to make it whole.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: As we worship, grant us vision,
Till your love's revealing light In its height and depth and greatness Dawns upon our quickened sight,
Making known the needs and burdens Your compassion bids us bear,

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: O Jesus Christ, to You may hymns be rising In every city for Your love and care;
Inspire our worship, grant the glad surprising That Your blest Spirit brings men everywhere.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Grant us new courage sacrificial humble Strong in Your strength to venture and to dare,
To lift the fallen, guide the feet that stumble,
Seek out the lonely &God's mercy share

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Show us Your Spirit, brooding o'r each city,
As You did weep above Jerusalem,
Seeking to gather all in love and pity,
And healing those who touch Your garment's hem.

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: O Zion, haste, thy mission high fulfilling, to tell to all the world that God is light, that he who made all nations is not willing one soul should perish, lost in shades of night.

sections.label: Refrain
lines: Publish glad tidings, tidings of peace; tidings of Jesus, redemption and release.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Proclaim to every people, tongue, and nation that God, in whom they live and move, is love; tell how he stooped to save his lost creation, and died on earth that we might live above.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Give of thine own to bear the message glorious; give of thy wealth to speed them on their way; pour out thy soul for them in prayer victorious;
O Zion, haste to bring the brighter day.

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: O Zion, ere thou meet Him,
Make known to every heart His saving grace;
Let none whom He hath ransomed fail to greet Him,
Through thy neglect, unfit to see His face.

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: O where are the reapers that garner in The sheaves of the good from the fields of sin?
With sickles of truth must the work be done,
And no one may rest till the 'harvest home.'

sections.label: Refrain
lines: O who will come And share in the glory of the 'harvest home'?
O who will help us to garner in The sheaves of good from the fields of sin?

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: The fields all are ripening, and far and wide The world now is waiting the harvest tide: But reapers are few, and the work is great,
And much will be lost should the harvest wait.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: So come with your sickles, ye sons of men,
And gather together the golden grain;
Toil on till the Lord of the harvest come,
Then share ye His joy in the 'harvest home.'

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Rescue the perishing, care for the dying, snatch them in pity from sin and the grave; weep o'er the erring one, lift up the fallen, tell them of Jesus, the mighty to save.

sections.label: Refrain
lines: Rescue the perishing, care for the dying;
Jesus is merciful, Jesus will save.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Though they are slighting him, still he is waiting, waiting the penitent child to receive; plead with them earnestly, plead with them gently; he will forgive if they only believe.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Rescue the perishing, duty demands it; strength for thy labor the Lord will provide; back to the narrow way patiently win them; tell the poor wanderer a Savior has died.

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Watchman, blow the gospel trumpet, Every soul a warning give;
Whosoever hears the message May repent, and, turn and live.

sections.label: Chorus 1
lines: Blow it loud o'er land and sea;

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Sound it loud o'r every hilltop, Gloomy shade and sunny plain;
Ocean depths repeat the message, Full salvation's glad

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Sound it in the hedge and highway,
Earth's dark spots where exiles roam;
Let it tell all things are ready, Father waits to welcome home.

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: Sound it for the heavy laden, Weary, longing to be free;
Sound a Savior's invitation, Sweetly saying, 'Come to me.'

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Sowing in the morning, sowing seeds of kindness,
Sowing in the noontide and the dewy eve,
Waiting for the harvest and the time of reaping - We shall come rejoicing, bringing in the sheaves.

sections.label: Refrain
lines: Bringing in the sheaves, bringing in the sheaves,
We shall come rejoicing, bringing in the sheaves.
Bringing in the sheaves, bringing in the sheaves,
We shall come rejoicing, bringing in the sheaves.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Sowing in the sunshine, sowing in the shadows,
Fearing neither clouds nor winter's chilling breeze;
By and by the harvest and the labor ended - We shall come rejoicing, bringin in the sheaves.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Going forth with weeping, sowing for the Master,
Tho the loss sustained our spirit often grieves;
When our weeping's over He will bid us welcome - We shall come rejoicing, bringing in the sheaves

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Christ for the world we sing, the world to Christ we bring, with loving zeal; the poor, and them that mourn, the faint and overborne, sinsick and sorrow-worn, whom Christ doth heal.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Christ for the world we sing, the world to Christ we bring, with fervent prayer; the wayward and the lost, by restless passions tossed, redeemed at countless cost, from dark despair.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Christ for the world we sing, the world to Christ we bring, with joyful song; the newborn souls, whose days, reclaimed from error's ways, inspired with hope and praise, to Christ belong.

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Lift Him up, 'tis He that bids you, Let the dying look and live;
To all weary, thirsting sinners, Living waters will He give;
And though once so meek and lowly,
Yet the Prince of heaven was He;
And the blind, who grope in darkness,
Through the blood of Christ shall see.

sections.label: Refrain
lines: Lift Him up, the risen Savior, High amid the waiting throng;
Lift Him up, 'tis He that speaketh,
Now He bids you flee from wrong.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Lift Him up, this precious Savior, Let the multitude behold;
They with willing hearts shall seek Him,
He will draw them to His fold;
They shall gather from the wayside,
They shall bear the cross of Jesus,

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Lift Him up in all His glory, 'Tis the Son of God on high;
His love shall draw them, E'n the careless shall draw nigh;
Let them hear again the story Of the cross, the death of shame;
And from tongue to tongue repeat it;
Mighty throngs shall bless His name.

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: O then lift Him up in singing, Lift the Savior up in prayer;
He, the glorious Redeemer, All the sins of men did bear;
Yes, the young shall bow before Him,
And the old their voices raise;
All the deaf shall hear hosannah;
And the dumb shall shout His praise.

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: How beauteous are their feet Who stand on Zion's hill;
Who bring salvation on their tongues, And words of peace reveal!

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: How charming is their voice, So sweet the tidings are: 'Zion, behold thy Savior King;

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: That hear the joyful sound Which kings and prophets waited for,

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: How blessed are our eyes, That see this heavenly light;
Prophets and kings desired it long, But died without the sight!

sections.label: Verse 5
lines: The watchmen join their voice, And tuneful notes employ;
Jerusalem breaks forth in songs, And deserts learn the joy.

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Seeking the lost, yes, kindly entreating Wanderers on the mountain astray;
Words of the Master speaking today.

sections.label: Refrain
lines: Going afar (going afar) Upon the mountain (upon the mountain) Bringing the wanderer back again, back again,
Into the fold (into the fold) Of my Redeemer (of my Redeemer) Jesus the Lamb for sinners slain, for sinners slain.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Seeking the lost and pointing to Jesus Souls that are weak and hearts that are sore,
Leading them forth in ways of salvation,
Showing the path to life evermore.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Thus would I go on missions of mercy,
Following Christ from day unto day,
Cheering the faint and raising the fallen,
Pointing the lost to Jesus, the Way.

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: While on earth her faith is tried: We beseech Thee, hear us.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: May her voice be ever clear,
Telling of a Savior dear: We beseech Thee, hear us.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: May she guide the poor and blind,
Seek the lost until she find,
And the broken hearted bind: We beseech Thee, hear us.

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: Gather all the nations in: We beseech Thee, hear us.

translations.title: Work, for the Night Is Coming

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Work for the night is coming, Work through the morning hours;
Work while the dew is sparkling;
Work when the day grows brighter, Work in the glowing sun;
Work for the night is coming, When man's work is done.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Work for the night is coming, Work thro' the sunny noon;
Fill brightest hours with labor, Rest comes sure and soon.
Give every flying minute Something to keep in store;
Work for the night is coming, When man works no more.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Work for the night is coming, Under the sunset skies;
While their bright tints are glowing, Work for daylight flies.
Work till the last beam fadeth, Fadeth to shine no more;
Work while the night is dark'ning, When man's work is o'er.

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: All things are Thine; no gift have we,
Lord of all gifts, to offer Thee;
And hence with grateful hearts today,
Thine own before Thy feet we lay.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Thy will was in the builder's thought;
Thy hand unseen amidst us wrought;
Thro' mortal motive, scheme and plan,

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: No lack Thy perfect fullness knew;
For human needs and longings grew This house of prayer- this home of rest.
Here may Thy saints be often blessed.

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: In weakness and in want we call On Thee, for whom the heav'ns are small;
Thy glory is Thy children's good, Thy joy Thy tender Fatherhood.

sections.label: Verse 5
lines: O Father! deign these walls to bless;
Make this the abode of righteousness,
And let these doors a gateway be To lead us from ourselves to Thee!

translations.title: Go Forth, Go Forth With Christ

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Go forth, go forth with Christ,
Who called you to this day,
He who has led, will lead And keep you in His way: His word is fast,
His promise sure To all who serve Him and endure.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Go forth, go forth with Christ,
Each vict'ry you shall gain Through Him your Lord alone: To guard you in fidelity His Spirit shall your strength'ner be.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Go forth, go forth with Christ,
Who bought us by His blood To be His servants here: Walk in the way your Savior trod, Go forth with Him, go forth with God.

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: 'Go, preach My gospel,' saith the Lord;
'Bid the whole world My grace receive;
He shall be saved who trusts My word,

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: And ye shall prove My gospel true By all the works that I have done,
By all the wonders ye shall do.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: I'm with you till the world shall end;
All power is vested in My hands;
I can destroy, and I defend.'

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: He spake, and light shone round His head;
On a bright cloud to heaven He rode;
They to the farthest nations spread The grace of their ascended Lord.
