translations.title: We Give This Child to You

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: We give this child to You, Our precious gift of love.
Help us to lead each step aright With guidance from above.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: O bless each child of Yours,
And grant when they are grown,
They will have learned to love Your way,
And choose it for their own.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: And may Your Spirit fill Our hearts and home, that all we do Be subject to Your will.

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: We would trust the One who knows All our weak and failing powers.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Like the dawning of fair morn Come thy hours to us again.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Welcome, day blessed by our Lord!
Toil shall cease and anxious care.
Day commanded by His word, Day for song and praise and prayer.

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: Day God bids us ne'er forget,
Day of days His name to bless.

sections.label: Refrain
lines: By our God divinely blest, It to us a sign shall be Throughout all eternity.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Seek not pleasures of this earth,
With its folly, noise, and mirth,
There are better things in store,

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: As the Sabbath draweth on Friday eve at set of sun,

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: And to help us by His pow'r,

translations.title: O Day of Rest and Gladness

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: O day of rest and gladness,
O day of joy and light,
O balm of care and sadness, most beautiful, most bright; on thee, the high and lowly, who bend before throne, sing, 'Holy, holy, holy,' to the Eternal One.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Thou art a port protected from storms that round us rise; a garden intersected with streams of paradise; thou art a cooling fountain in life's dry, dreary sand; from thee, like Pisgah's mountain, we view our promised land.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: A day of sweet reflection, thou art a day of love, A day to raise affection from earth to things above.
New graces ever gaining from this our day of rest,
We reach the rest remaining in mansions of the blessed.

translations.title: O Day of Rest and Gladness

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: O day of rest and gladness,
O day of joy and light,
O balm of care and sadness,
On thee the high and lowly Before th' eternal throne Sing, 'Holy, holy, holy,' To the great Three in One.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Thou art a port protected From storms that round us rise;
A garden intersected With streams of paradise;
Thou art a cooling fountain In life's dry dreary sand;
From Thee, like Pisgah's mountain, We view our promised land.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: A day of sweet reflection Thou art, a day of love, A day to raise affection From earth to things above.
New graces ever gaining From this our day of rest,
We seek the rest remaining To mansions of the blest.

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Safely through another week God has brought us on our way;
Let us now a blessing seek, Waiting in His courts today;
Day of all the week the best,
Emblem of eternal rest: Day of all the week the best,

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: While we seek supplies of grace,
Take away the sin and shame: From our worldly cares set free,
May we rest this day in Thee: From our worldly cares set free,
May we rest this day in Thee.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: When the more shall bid us rise, May we feel Thy presence near;
May Thy glory meet our eyes,
While we in Thy house appear: Here afford us,
Lord, a taste Of our everlasting feast: Here afford us,
Lord, a taste Of our everlasting feast.

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: May the gospel's joyful sound Conquer sinners, comfort saints;
Make the fruits of grace abound,
Bring relief to all complaints: Thus may all our Sabbaths be,
Till we we rise to reign with Thee.
Thus may all our Sabbaths be, Till we we rise to reign with Thee.

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Crowning jewel of creation, Blest and hallowed, sanctified;
Time and changes all transcending, Shared forever, glorified.

sections.label: Refrain
lines: Blessed Sabbath made for man, Gift from the Creator's hand.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Sin and sickness, prayer and weeping Cease at close of earthly days;
But Thy Sabbath is eternal, Joyful thanks to Thee we raise!

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Teach us Lord, in storm or sunshine How to truly rest in Thee,
May Thy Sabbath peace enfold us And our shelter ever be.

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: The sacred anthem slowly rang Across the fields of praise,
When earth's first Sabbath made complete All creatures and all days.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Woman and man together share The blessed Sabbath mood;
And in that green and golden world Know all God's works are good.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: But now in our diminished lives We sing a blemished song;
The earth is worn and disarrayed And all our work goes wrong.

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: We put our doubt and fear away And rest within God's rest.

sections.label: Verse 5
lines: And arching over time and space The Lord of Sabbaths wills Renewal for the weary earth And healing for our ills.

sections.label: Verse 6
lines: There will be no more weeping, when We know and shall be known.
With hosts of the redeemed we'll sing Around God's shining throne.

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Peace and healing on thy wing;
And to every troubled breast Speak of the divine behest: Thou shalt rest,

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Earthly longings bid retire, Quench the passions' hurtful fire;
Bring thou thy divine behest: Thou shalt rest,

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Wipe from every cheek the tear, Banish care and silence fear;
All things working for the best,
Teach us the divine behest: Thou shalt rest,

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: The Lord our God hath blest,
Of all the week the brightest,
Of all the week the best;
It brings repose from labor, It tells of joy divine,

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Who said to His disciples, 'I am the living way;' And if we meekly follow Our Savior here below, He'll give us of the fountain Whose streams eternal flow.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Its golden hours we'll spend In thankful hymns to Jesus,
O gentle loving, Savior, How good and kind Thou art, How precious is Thy promise To dwell in every heart!

sections.label: பல்லவி

Vaazhka Vaazhka! Endrum Vaazhka! Oivu Thiname!

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Light of light, enlighten me, Now anew the day is dawning;
Sun of grace, the shadows flee;
With Thy joyous sunshine blest, Happy is my day of rest.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Let me with my heart today,
All my soul to Thee up springing,
Have a foretaste inward given How they worship Thee in heaven.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: For the day to God is holy;
Come, Thou glorious Majesty, Deign to fill this temple lowly;
Nought today my soul shall move, Simply resting in Thy love.

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: We love Thy Sabbath, Lord, And worship at Thy will;
Oh may these hours sweet peace afford And deeper faith instill.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Thine angels sang for joy Cration's work to see;
We too, this day, would raise our hearts In grateful praise to Thee.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: That sealed this sacred day, A sign that all may understand We own Thy sovereign sway.

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: Renew and sanctify our hearts That we may see Thy face.

sections.label: Verse 5
lines: And joyful sing our Sabbath song Through all eternity.

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: To the world in kindness given;
Welcome to this humble breast, As the beaming light from heaven.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Day of calm and sweet repose, Gently now thy moments run;
Balm to soothe our cares and woes, Till our labor here is done.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Holy day that most we prize,
Day of solemn praise and prayer,
Day to make the simple wise, O, how great thy blessings are!

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: Welcome, welcome, day of rest, With thy influence all divine;
May thy hallowed hours be blessed to this waiting heart of mine.

translations.title: Dear Lord, We Come at Set of Sun

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Dear Lord, we come at set of sun, And at Your feet we kneel To worship You, Creator, King, This day, Your sign and seal.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Our earthly tasks we lay aside,
To enter now Your holy rest,

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Sweet Sabbath rest, your sacred hours Are as a golden chain That reaches back to Eden's gate And points us home again.

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: And when this earth shall be renewed,
Shall all redeemed each Sabbath day Still meet to praise their God.

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Lord of the Sabbath and its light,
I hail Thy hallowed day of rest;
It is my weary soul's delight,
The solace of my careworn breast,
The solace of my careworn breast.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: O sacred day of peace and joy, Thy hours are ever dear to me;
Ne'er may a sinful thought destroy The holy calm I find in thee,
The holy calm I find in thee.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: How sweetly now they glide along!
How hallowed is the calm they yield!

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: O Jesus, let me ever hail Thy presence with the day of rest;
Then will Thy servant never fail To deem Thy Sabbath doubly blest,
To deem Thy Sabbath doubly blest.

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Far from all care we hail the Sabbath morning;
O'er waving fields and from the distant sea Swell notes of praise in harmony resounding As all creation turns her heart to Thee.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Lord, of Thy great creation Fails now to laud Thee for Thy love and power,
Yet still a remnant love Thee and remember Thy holy law and each sweet Sabbath hour.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Calm now the throbbings of each troubled breast.
Speak to our hearts the peace of Thy commandments,
Breathe on each soul fair Eden's hallowed ret.

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: Strong in Thy might and quiet in Thy meekness,
May we Thine image bear from day to day.
Then may we enter pearly gates eternal And sing redemption's song each Sabbath day.

translations.title: As Birds Unto the Genial Homeland

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: As birds unto the genial homeland fly,
The winter's cold and low'ring skies to flee, So seeks my soul Thy gracious presence here And finds,
O God, its rest and peace in Thee.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Here at Thy shrine we leave all vexing care,
For get the disappointment, grief and tear,
And on the wings of hopeful song and prayer We rise, and rising feel Thy Spirit here.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Bless all who spend this night in pain and woe,
The burdened heart, the fainting, and distressed,
Thy comfort send to darkened homes bereaved,
Thy saving help to those by want oppressed.

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: Come, Sabbath joy, each trusting heart now fill, And blissful peace within our homes abide, May thankful praise each grateful heart now thrill, And to God's loving care their lives confide.

translations.title: Lord God, Your Love Has Called Us Here

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Lord God, Your love has called us here, As we, by love, for love were made.
Your living likeness still we bear Tho' marred, dishonored, disobeyed.
We come, with all our heart and mind Your call to hear,

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: We come with self inflicted pains Of broken trust and chosen wrong,
Half free, half bound by inner chains,
By powers and systems close confined,
Yet seeking hope for human kind.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Lord God, in Christ You call our name,
And then receive us as Your own,
Not thro' some merit, right, or claim,
But by Your gracious love alone.
We strain to glimpse Your mercy seat,
And find You kneeling at our feet.

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: Then take the towel, and break the bread,
And humble us, and call us friends.
Suffer and serve till all are fed And show how grandly love intends To work till all creation sings,
To fill all worlds, to crown all things.

sections.label: Verse 5
lines: Lord God, in Christ You set us free Your life to live,
Give us Your Spirit's liberty To turn from guilt and dull despair And offer all that faith can do,
While love is making all things new.

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: An upper room did our Lord prepare For those loved until the end: And His disciples still gather there,

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: And after supper He washed their feet,
In Him our joy shall be made complete Sent out to serve, as He was sent.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: A lasting gift Jesus gave His own: To share His bread,
Whatever burdens may bow us down,
He by His cross shall lift us up.

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: No end there is! we depart in peace.
He loves beyond our uttermost: In every room in our Father's house,
He will be there, as Lord and host.

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Bread of the world in mercy broken,
Wine of the soul in mercy shed,
By whom the words of life are spoken,
And in whose death our sins are dead;

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Look on the heart by sorrow broken,
Look on the tears by sinners shed;
And be Thy feast to us the token That by Thy grace our souls are fed.

translations.title: Beneath the Forms of Outward Rite

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Beneath the forms of outward rite Thy supper,
Lord, is spread In every quiet upper room Where fainting souls are fed.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: The bread is always consecrate Which men divide with men;
And every act of brotherhood Repeats Thy feast again.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: The blessed cup is only passed True memory of Thee,
When life anew pours out its wine With rich sufficiency.

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: O Master, through these symbols shared,
That in our daily life may flame The passion of Thy heart.

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: I come with joy to meet my Lord,
In awe and wonder to recall His life laid down for me,
His life laid down for me.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: I come with Christians far and near To find, as all are fed,
Our true community of love In Christ's communion bread,

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: As Christ breaks bread for us to share Each proud division ends.
That love that made us makes us one,

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: And thus with joy we meet our Lord.
His presence always near, Is in such friendship better known: We see and praise Him here,
We see and praise Him here.

sections.label: Verse 5
lines: Together met, together bound, We'll go our diff'rent ways,
And as His people in the world, We'll live and speak His praise, We'll live and speak His praise.

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: In imitation, Lord, of Thee, This solemn service we repeat;
For Thine example full of grace, Has made this humble duty sweet.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Renew each sacred spark of love, And vitalize the holy flame;
May union strong our hearts unite While this we do in Jesus' name.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Our great example Thou shalt be, In washing Thy disciples feet;
And as we follow Thy command, Make Thou our fellowship complete.

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: And show the death of our dear Lord,

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: His broken body in our stead is here, In his memorial bread;
And so our feeble love is fed, Until He come.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: His fearful drops of agony, His lifeblood shed for us we see;
The wine shall tell the mystery, Until He come.

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: And thus that dark betrayal night,
With the last advent we unite The shame, the glory, by this rite,

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Let us break bread together on our knees, let us break bread together on our knees.
When I fall on my knees with my face to the rising sun,
O Lord, have mercy on me.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Let us drink wine together on our knees, let us drink wine together on our knees.
When I fall on my knees with my face to the rising sun,
O Lord, have mercy on me.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Let us praise God together on our knees, let us praise God together on our knees.
When I fall on my knees with my face to the rising sun,
O Lord, have mercy on me.

translations.title: Now Let Us From This Table Rise

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Now let us from this table rise Renewed in body, mind, and soul;
With Christ we die and live again,
His selfless love has made us whole.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: With minds alert, upheld by grace,
To spread the word in speech and deed,
We follow in the steps of Christ,
At one with all in hope and need.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: To fill each human house with love, It is the sacrament of care;
The work that Christ began to do We humbly pledge ourselves to share.

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: Then grant us courage, Father God, To choose again the pilgrim way And help us to accept with joy The challenge of tomorrow's day.

translations.title: O God, Unseen, Yet Ever Near

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: O God, unseen, yet ever near,
Reveal Thy presence now While we in love that hath no fear,

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Here may Thy faithful people know The blessings of Thy love,
The streams that thro' the dessert flow,

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: We come, obedient to Thy Word To feast on heav'nly food, Our meat, the body of our Lord, Our drink, His precious blood.

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: Thus may we all Thy words obey, For we, O God, are Thine,

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Love consecrates the humblest act And haloes mercy's deeds;
It sheds a benediction sweet And hallows human needs.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: When in the shadow of the cross Christ knelt and washed the feet Of His disciples,
He gave us A sign of love complete.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Love serves and willing, stoops to serve;
What Christ in love so true Has freely done for one and all,

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: The people of God from His dwelling take leave.
Oh, now be extended The fruits of this service in all who believe.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Shall blossom in action for God and for all.
His love shall unite us To work for God's kingdom and answer His call.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: With praise and thanksgiving To God ever living,
The tasks of our everyday life we will face.
Embracing His children of each tribe and race.

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: With Your feast You feed us, With Your light now lead us;
Unite us as one in this life that we share.
Then may all the living With praise and thanks giving Give honor to Christ and His name that we bear.

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Alleluia, Jesus, true and living Bread!

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Tho' the lowliest form now veil You As of old in Bethlehem,
Here as there Your angels hail You Branch and flow'r of Jesse's stem.
Alleluia, We in worship join with them.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Your off'ring finished Once for all when You were slain,
In its fullness undiminished Shall forever more remain.
Alleluia, Cleansing souls from every stain.

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: Heav'n and earth with loud hosanna Worship You the Lamb who died.

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Jesus invites His saints To meet around His board,
And sup in memory of the death And sufferings of their Lord.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: We take the bread and wine As emblems of Thy death;
Lord, raise our souls above the sign, To feast on Thee by faith.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Faith eats the bread of life, And drinks the living wine;
It looks beyond this scene of strife Unites us to the Vine.

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: Soon shall the night be gone, Our Lord will come again;
The marriage supper of the Lamb Will usher in His reign.

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Thy broken body, gracious Lord, Is shadowed by this broken bread;
The wine which in this cup is poured,
Points to the blood which Thou hast shed.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: And while we meet together thus, We show that we are one in Thee;
Thy precious blood was shed for us, Thy death, O Lord, hast set us free!

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: We have one hope that Thou wilt come,
Thee in the air we wait to see;
When Thou wilt give Thy saints a home,
And we shall ever reign with Thee.

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: The Son of God proclaim, The Lord of time and space;
The God who bade the light break forth Now shines in Jesus' face.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Though all was in His power He took the towel and basin then,
And serves us in this hour.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: He, God's creative word, The church's Lord and head, Here bids us gather as His friends, And share His wine and bread.

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: The Lord of life and death With wondering praise we sing;
We break the bread at His command, And name Him God and King.

sections.label: Verse 5
lines: We take this cup in hope: For He, who gladly bore The shameful cross, is ris'n again,

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Look upon Jesus, sinless is He;
Father, impute His life unto me.
My life of scarlet, my sin and woe,
Cover with His life, whiter than snow.

sections.label: Refrain
lines: Cover with His life, whiter than snow;
Fullness of His life then shall I know;
My life of scarlet, my sin and woe,
Cover with His life, whither than snow.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Deep are the wounds transgression has made;
Red are the stains; my soul is afraid.
Safe from the law that now judgeth me!

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Longing the joy of pardon to know;
Jesus holds out a robe white as snow;
Leaving my own, Gladly I wear Thy pure life alone.'

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: Reconciled by His death for my sin,
Justified by His life pure and clean,

translations.title: God Has Spoken by His Prophets

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: God has spoken by His prophets,
Each from age to age proclaiming God, the one, the righteous Lord.
Mid the world's despair and turmoil,
God is King, His throne eternal, God the first, and God the last.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: God has spoken by Christ Jesus,
God of God, ere time began,
Light of light, to earth descending,

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: God yet speaks by His own Spirit Speaking to the hearts of men,
In the age-long Word expounding God's own message, now as then;
Through the rise and fall of nations One sure faith yet standing fast,
God the first, and God the last.

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Rich in love and joy and peace.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Laden branches freely bearing Gifts the Giver loves to bless;
Here is fruit that grows by sharing,

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Rooted deep in Christ, our Master,
Christ, our pattern and our goal,
Teach us, as the years fly faster,

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: May we grow till harvests cease;
Till we taste, in life unending, Heaven's love and joy and peace.

translations.title: Christ the Lord, All Power Possessing

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Christ, the Lord, all power possessing,
Clouds received His from their sight.
Christ ascended on the clouds. (on the clouds) Christ ascended on the clouds.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Daniel views earth's judgment hour, Angels gathering open books.
God enthroned inflaming power For His Son's arrival looks.
Christ approaches on the clouds. (on the clouds) Christ approaches on the clouds.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Revelation's word fulfilling, Trumpet, voices pierce the air.
Saint and sinner fainting, thrilling, Every eye behold Him there.
Christ is coming on the clouds. (on the clouds) Christ is coming on the clouds.

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: The judgment has set, the books have been opened;
How shall we stand in that great day,
When every thought, and word, and action,
God, the righteous Judge, shall weigh?

sections.label: Refrain
lines: How shall we stand in that great day?
How shall we stand in that great day?
Shall we be found before Him wanting?
Or with our sins all washed away?

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: The work is begun with those who are sleeping,
Soon will the living here be tried,
Out of the books of God's remembrance,

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: O, how shall we stand that moment of searching,
When all our sins those books reveal?
When from that court, each case decided,

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: O solemn thought and can it be The hour o judgment now is come Which soon must fix our destiny,
And seal the sinner's fearful down?
Yes, it is so; the judgment hour Is swiftly hastening to its close;
Then will the Judge, in mighty power,
Descend in vengeance on His foes.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: He who came down to earth to die An offering for the sins of men,
And then ascended upon on high,
And will e'er long return again, Is standing now before the ark,
To plead His blood for saints, and make The last remembrance of their sin.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: The solemn moment is at hand When we who have His name confessed,
Each in his lot must singly stand And pass the final, searching test.
Jesus! we hope in Thee alone;
In mercy now upon us look,
Confess our names before the throne,
And blot our sins from out Thy book.

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: O blessed Savior! may we feel The full importance of this hour.
Inspire our hearts with holy zeal,
And aid us by Thy Spirit's power,
That we may in Thy strength be strong,
Then, on Mount Zion, join the song,
And swell the notes of victory.

translations.title: Day of Judgment, Day of Wonders!

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Day of judgement, day of wonders!
How the summons Will the sinner's heart confound!

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: See the Lord in the glory nearing,
You who long for His appearing,
Then shall say, 'This God is mine!' Gracious Savior,
Own me in that day as Thine.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: At His call the dead awaken, Rise to life form earth and sea!
All the powers of nature shaken By His looks prepare to flee.
Careless sinner, Careless sinner, What will then become of thee?

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: But to those who have confessed Loved and served the Lord below,
He will say, 'Come near, ye blessed,
You forever, You forever Shall my love and glory know.'

translations.title: Soon Shall the Trump of God

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Soon shall the trump of God Give out the welcome sound,
That shakes death's silent chamber walls,
And breaks the turf sealed ground.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: You dwellers in the dust, Awake, come forth, and sing;
Sharp has your frost of winter been,
But bright shall be your spring.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: That which was sown in earthly seed Shall rise a heav'nly flower.

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Jerusalem, my happy home, O how I long for thee!
When will my sorrows have an end, The joys when shall I see?

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: The walls are all of precious stone, Most glorious to behold;
Thy gates are richly set with pearl,
Thy streets are paved with gold.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Thy garden and thy pleasant walks My study long have been;
Such dazzling views by human sight Have never yet been seen.

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: Lord, help us by Thy mighty grace,
To keep in view the prize,
Till Thou dost come to take us home To that blessed paradise.

sections.label: சரணம் 1
lines: நான் அதைக் கண்டு பாக்கியம் அடைய வேண்டுமே.

sections.label: சரணம் 2
lines: பொன் தளம் போட்ட வீதியில் எப்போ துலாவுவேன்?

sections.label: சரணம் 4
lines: நானும் அங்குள்ள கூட்டத்தில், சேர்ந் தும்மைக் காணவே

sections.label: சரணம் 5
lines: எருசலேம் என் ஆலயம் நான் உன்னில் வாழுவேன்;
என் ஆவல், என் அடைக்கலம், எப்போ கண்டடைவேன்?

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Naan Adhaik Kantu Paakkiyam Ataiya Ventume.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Pon Thalam Potta Veedhiyil Eppo Thulaavuven?

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: Naanum Angulla Koottaththil, Sern Thummaik Kaanave

sections.label: Verse 5
lines: Erusalem En Aalayam Naan Unnil Vaazhuven;
En Aaval, En Ataikkalam, Eppo Kantataiven?

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: For all the saints who from their labors rest,
Who thee by faith before the world confessed.
Thy name, O Jesus, be forever blest.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Thou wast their Rock, their Fortress and their Might;
Thou, Lord, their captain in the well-fought fight;
Thou, in the darkness drear, their one true light.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: O may Thy soldiers, faithful, true, and bold,
Fight as the saints who nobly fought of old,
And win with them the victor's crown of gold.

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: And when the strife is fierce, the warfare long,
Steals on the ear the distant triumph song,
And hearts are brave again, and arms are strong.

sections.label: Verse 5
lines: From earth's wide bounds, from ocean's farthest coast, Thro' gates of pearl streams in the countless host, Singing to Father, Son, and Holy Ghost, Alleluia!

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Come, we that love the Lord, And let our joys be known;
Join in a song with sweet accord,
Join in a song with sweet accord,

sections.label: Refrain
lines: We're marching to Zion, Beautiful, beautiful Zion;
We're marching upward to Zion, The beautiful city of God.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Let those refuse to sing Who never knew our God;
But children of the heav'nly King,
But children of the heav'nly King May speak their joys abroad,

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: The hill of Zion yields A thousand sacred sweets Before we reach the heav'nly fields,
Before we reach the heav'nly fields Or walk the golden streets,

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: Then let our songs abound And ev'ry tear be dry;
We're marching thru Immanuel's ground, We're marching thru Immanuel's ground To fairer worlds on high,

sections.label: பல்லவி
lines: மா உன்னத சீயோன் சோபித சுந்தர சீயோன்

sections.label: Refrain
lines: Maa Unnadha Seeyon Sopidha Sundhara Seeyon

translations.title: Glorious Things of Thee Are Spoken

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Glorious things of thee are spoken, Zion, city of our God;
He whose word cannot be broken Formed thee for His own abode;
On the Rock of Ages founded, What can shake thy sure repose?
Thou mayest smile at all thy foes.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: See the streams of living waters Springing from eternal love,
Well supply thy sons and daughters,
And all fear and want remove;
Who can faint when such a river Ever flows their thirst to assuage?
Grace, which, like the Lord, the Giver,
Never fails from age to age.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: See the cloud and fire appear For a glory and a covering,
Showing that the Lord is near;
Blest inhabitants of Zion, Washed in the Redeemer's blood;
Jesus, whom their souls rely on,
Makes them kings and priests to God.

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: Savior, if of Zion's city I, through grace, a member am,
Let the world deride or pity,
I will glory in Thy name;
All his boasted pomp and show;
Solid joys and lasting treasure None but Zion's children know.

sections.label: சரணம் 1
lines: என்னைப் பாரும் என்னில் எங்கும் நோவும் ரோகமும் உண்டே;
பாவக் குஷ்டம் முற்றும் நீங்கக் கையை நீட்டித் தொடுமே;

sections.label: சரணம் 2
lines: அச்சம் நீக்கும் திவ்ய வாக்கை அன்பால் பொங்கிச் சொன்னீரே;
ஆ! கர்த்தாவே, நல்ல சீரை அனுக்ரகம் செய்யுமே.

sections.label: சரணம் 3
lines: ஏழைப் பாவி செய்த ஜெபம் கேட்டுப் பாவம் போக்கினீர்;
சுத்தமாக்கி உம் சமீபம் என்னைச் சேர்த்து அணைத்தீர்;

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Ennaip Paarum Ennil Engum Novum Rokamum Unte;
Paavak Kushtam Mutrum Neengak Kaiyai Neettith Thotume;

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Achcham Neekkum Thivya Vaakkai Anpaal Pongich Chonneere;
Aa! Karththaave, Nalla Seerai Anukrakam Seyyume.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Ezhaip Paavi Seydha Jepam Kettup Paavam Pokkineer;
Suththamaakki Um Sameepam Ennaich Cherththu Anaiththeer;

translations.title: For Thee, O Dear, Dear Country

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: For thee, O dear country, Mine eyes their vigils keep;
For very love beholding Thy holy name, they weep.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Where tears are ever banish'd And smiles have no alloy;

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: With jasper glow thy burwarks, Thy streets with emeralds blaze;
The sardius and the topaz Unite in thee their rays;

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: The cross is all thy splendor, The Crucified thy praise;
His laud and benediction Thy ransom'd saints shall raise;

sections.label: Verse 5
lines: O sweet and blessed country, The home of God's elect!
O sweet and blessed country That eager hearts expect!

translations.title: Holy, Holy, Is What the Angels Sing

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: There is singing up in heaven such as we have never known,
Where the angels sing the praises of the Lamb upon the throne;
Their sweet harps are ever tuneful and their voices are always clear,
O that we might be more like them while we serve the Master here!

sections.label: Refrain
lines: Holy, holy, is what the angels sing,
And I expect to help them make the courts of heaven ring;
But when I sing redemption's story, they will fold their wings,
For angels never felt the joys that our salvation brings.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: But I hear another anthem, blending voices clear and strong, 'Unto Him who hath redeemed us and hath bought us,' is the song;
We have come thro' tribulations to this land so fair and bright,
In the fountain freely flowing He hath made our garments white.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Then the angels stand and listen, for they cannot join that song,
Like the sound of many waters, by that happy, blood-washed throng;
For they sing about great trials, battles fought and vict'ries won,
And they praised the great Redeemer, who hath said to them, 'Well done.'

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: So, although I'm not an angel, yet I know that over there I will join a blessed chorus that the angels cannot share;
I will sing about my Savior, who upon dark Calvary Freely pardoned my transgressions, died to set the sinner free.

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: I shall see the King where the angels sing,
I shall see the King some day, in the better land,
And with Him shall ever stay.

sections.label: Refrain
lines: 'Twas on Calvary Jesus died for me;
I shall see the King someday.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: In the land of song, in the glory throng,
Where there never comes a night,
With my Lord once slain I shall ever reign In the glory land of light.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: I shall see the King, all my tributes bring,
And shall look upon His face;
Then my song shall be how He ransomed me And has kept me by His grace.

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: In the land of fadeless day Lies 'the city four-square;' It shall never pass away,

sections.label: Refrain
lines: God shall 'wipe away all tears;' There's no death, no pain, nor fears;
And they count not time by years, For there is 'no night there.'

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: All the gates of pearl are made,
In 'the city four-square;' All the streets with gold are laid,

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: And the gates shall never close To 'the city four-square;' There life's crystal river flows,

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: There they need no sunshine bright,
In 'that city four-square;' For the Lamb is all the light,

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: There's a land that is fairer than day,
And by faith we can see it afar;
For the Father waits over the way To prepare us a dwelling place there.

sections.label: Refrain
lines: In the sweet in the sweet By and by by and by,
We shall meet on that beautiful shore;
In the sweet in the sweet By and by by and by We shall meet on that beautiful shore.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: We shall sing on that beautiful shore The melodious songs of the blest,
And our spirits shall sorrow no more Not a sigh for the blessing of rest.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: To our bountiful father above We will offer our tribute of praise;
For the glorious gift of His love And the blessings that hallow our days.

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Beneath thy contemplation Sink heart and voice oppressed.
I know not, O I know not What holy joys are there;
What radiancy of glory, What bliss beyond compare.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: They stand, those hall of Zion,
And bright with many an angel,
The Prince is ever in them, The daylight is serene;
The pastures of the blessed Are deck in glorious sheen.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: There is the throne of David,
The shout of them that triumph,
The song of them that feast;
And they who, with their Leader,
Forever and forever Are clad in robes of white.

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: O sweet and blessed country, The home of God's elect!
O sweet and blessed country, That eager hearts expect!
Jesus, in mercy bring us To that dear land of rest;
Who art, with God the Father, And Spirit, ever blest.

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: O there'll be joy when the work is done,
Joy when the reapers gather home,
Bringing the sheaves at set of sun To the New Jerusalem.

sections.label: Refrain
lines: Joy, joy, joy, there'll be joy by and by,
Joy, joy, joy, where the joys never die;
Joy, joy, joy, for the day draweth nigh When the workers gather home.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Sweet are the songs that we hope to sing,
Grateful the thanks our hearts shall bring,
Praising forever Christ our King In the New Jerusalem.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Pure are the joys that await us there,
Jesus Himself doth them prepare, In the New Jerusalem.

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Come let us sing of homeland, Down by the crystal sea;
Wonderful land where Jesus Buildeth a mansion for me.

sections.label: Refrain
lines: Over yonder, down by the crystal sea, down by the crystal sea,
Over yonder, there's where I long to be,
There's where I long to be, No more sorrow, toil, grief, nor care,
In the homeland bright and fair,

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Water of life there floweth, Fruit in abundant store;
Citizens of that country Hunger and thirst never more.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Come go with me to homeland, Jesus invites you there;
Help spread the invitation, Tell it to men everywhere.

translations.title: Shall We Gather at the River

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Shall we gather at the river, where bright angel feet have trod, with its crystal tide forever flowing by the throne of God?

sections.label: Refrain
lines: Yes, we'll gather at the river, the beautiful, the beautiful river; gather with the saints at the river that flows by the throne of God.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: On the margin of the river, washing up its silver spray, we will walk and worship ever, all the happy golden day.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Ere we reach the shining river, lay we every burden down; grace our spirits will deliver, and provide a robe and crown.

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: Soon we'll reach the shining river, soon our pilgrimage will cease; soon our happy hearts will quiver with the melody of peace.

sections.label: சரணம் 1
lines: தேவ தூதர் நிற்பர், சேர்வோம் திரு நதி ஓரமே.

sections.label: சரணம் 2
lines: அந்த நதியின் அலைகள், மோதி வீசுங் கரையில்;

sections.label: சரணம் 3
lines: காந்தியான நதி போமுன் பாரம் யாவும் விட்டு ஓய்வோம்

sections.label: சரணம் 4
lines: கீதம் பாடுவதைக் கேட்போம், களிப்போம் நம் ரட்சிப்பில்.

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Theva Thoodhar Nirpar, Servom Thiru Nadhi Orame.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Andha Nadhiyin Alaikal, Modhi Veesung Karaiyil;

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Kaandhiyaana Nadhi Pomun Paaram Yaavum Vittu Oivom

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: Keedham Paatuvadhaik Ketpom, Kalippom Nam Ratchippil.

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: The armies of the ransomed saints Throng up the steeps of light.
'Tis finished, all is finished, Their fight with death and sin.
Fling open wide the golden gates, And let the victors in.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: What rush of hallelujahs Fills all the earth and sky!
The ringing of a thousand harps Proclaims the triumph high.
O day for which creation And all its tribes were made!
O joy, for all its former woes A thousandfold repaid!

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: O then what raptured greetings On Canaan's happy shore!
What knitting severed friendship where Death partings are no more!
Then eyes with joy shall sparkle,
That brimmed with tears of late;
Orphans no longer fatherless, Nor widows desolate.

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: Fill up the roll of Thine elect,
Then take Thy power and reign!
Appear, Desire of nations, Thine exiles long for home;
Show in the heavens Thy promised sign;

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: We speak of the realms of the blest,
That country so bright and so fair,
And oft are its glories confessed- But what must it be to be there!
We speak of its pathway of gold- Its walls decked with jewels so rare,
Its wonders and pleasures untold- But what must it be to be there!

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: We speak of its freedom of sin,
From trials without and within' But what must it be to be there!
We speak of its service of love,
Of the robes which glorified wear,
Of the church of the First Born above- But what must it be to be there!

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Our mourning is all at an end,
When, raised by the life-giving word,
We see the new city descend,
Adorned as a bride for her Lord;
The city so holy and clean, No sorrow can breathe in the air;
No gloom of affliction or sin, No shadow of evil, is there.

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: Do Thou, midst temptation and woe, For heaven my spirit prepare;
And shortly I also so shall know And feel what it is to be there.
Then o'er the bright fields we shall roam,
With saints and with angels at home,
And Jesus Himself will be there.

sections.label: சரணம் 1

lines: When all my labors and trails are o'er,

Will through the ages be glory for me.

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: The land of the free born!
There's no night in the homeland, But aye the fadeless morn;
I'm sighing for homeland, My heart is aching here;
There is no pain in the homeland To which I'm drawing near;
There is no pain in the homeland To which I'm drawing near.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: My Lord is in the homeland, With angels bright and fair;
There's no sin in the homeland, And no temptation there;
The music of the homeland Is ringing in my ears;
And when I think of the homeland My eyes are filled with tears;
And when I think of the homeland My ears are filled with tears.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: The dwellers in the homeland Are beckoning me to come,
Where neither death nor sorrow Invades their holy name;
Christ bring us all to the homeland Of Thy redeeming love;
Christ bring us all to the homeland Of Thy redeeming love

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: My heav'nly home is bright and fair,
Nor pain nor death can enter there;
It's glitt'ring tow'rs the sun outshine,
That heav'nly mansion shall me mine.

sections.label: Refrain
lines: I'm going home, I'm going home, I'm going home to die no more;
To die no more; to die no more- I'm going home to die no more.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: My Father's house is built on high,
Far, far above the starry sky;
When from this earthly prison free,
That heav'nly mansion mine shall be.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Let others seek a home below,
Which flames devour or waves oe'r flow;
Be mine a happier lot to own A heav'nly mansion near the throne.

translations.title: You Will See Your Lord A-Coming

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: You will see your Lord a-coming,
You will see your Lord a-coming,
You will see your Lord a-coming In a few more days.

sections.label: Refrain

lines: Gabriel sounds his mighty trumpet In a few more days.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: You will see the saints arising,
You will see the saints arising,
You will see the saints arising In a few more days.

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: Angels bear them to the Savior,
Angels bear them to the Savior,

sections.label: Verse 5
lines: Then we'll shout, our suff'ring over,
Then we'll shout, our suff'ring over,

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: I asked, as on I bent my steps-the watchman spake: 'the long, dark night is almost gone,
Then weep no more, but speed thy flight,
With Hope's bright star guiding ray,
Till thou shalt reach the realms of light,

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: I asked the warrior on the field;
This was his soul-inspiring song: 'With courage, bold, the sword I'll wield,
Then weep no more, but well endure The conflict, till thy work is done;
For this we know, the prize is sure, When victory is won.'

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: I asked again; earth, sea, and sun Seemed, with one voice, to make reply: 'Time's wasting sands are nearly run,
Then weep no more-with warning tones,

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: The traveler's lonely heart to cheer;
Which oft a healing balm has brought,
Then weep no more, since we shall meet Where weary footsteps never roam- Our trails past, our joys complete,

translations.title: How Cheering Is the Christian's Hope

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: How cheering is the Christian's hope, While toiling here below!
It bouys us up while this passing through This wilderness of woe,

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: It bouys us up while this passing through This wilderness of woe, It bouys us up while passing through This wilderness of woe.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: It points us to a land of rest,
Where saints with Christ will reign;
Where we shall meet the loved of earth, And never part again.

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: Fly, lingering moments, fly, O, fly, Dear Savior, quickly come!
We long to see Thee as Thou art, And reach that blissful home.

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: I saw one weary, sad, and torn,
With eager steps press on the way,
Who long the hallowed cross had born,
Still looking for the promised day;
While many a line of grief and care,
Upon his brow was furrowed there;
I asked what buoyed his spirits up, 'O this' said he-'the blessed hope.'

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: And one I saw, with sword and shield,
Who boldly braved the world's cold frown,
And fought, unyielding, on the field,
Though worn with toil, oppressed by foes, No murmur from his heart arose;
I asked what buoyed his spirits up, 'O this!' said he-'the blessed hope.'

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: And there was one who left behind The cherished friends of early years,
To tread the path bedewed with tears.
Through trials deep and conflict sore,
Yet still a smile of joy he wore;
O! what can bouy the spirit up?

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: While pilgrims here we journey on In this dark vale of sin and gloom,
Or through the portals of the tomb,
Till our returning King shall come To tkae His exile captives home, O! what can bouy the spirits up?

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: How sweet are the tidings that greet the pilgrim's ear,
As he wanders in exile from home!
Soon, soon will the Savior in glory appear,
And soon will the kingdom come.

sections.label: Refrain
lines: He's coming, coming, coming soon I know,
Coming back to this earth again;
And the weary pilgrims will to glory go,
When the Savior comes to reign.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: The mossy old graves where the pilgrims sleep Shall be open as wide as before,
And the millions that sleep in the mighty deep Shall live on this earth once more.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: There we'll meet ne'er to part in our happy Eden home,
Sweet songs of redemption we'll sing;
From the north, from the south, all the ransomed shall come,

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: Soon, if faithful, we all shall be there;
O, be watchful, be hopeful, be joyful till then,
And a crown of bright glory we'll wear.

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: There'll be no night in heaven, In that blest world above;
No anxious toil, no weary hours;

sections.label: Refrain
lines: There'll be no sorrow there, There'll be no sorrow there;
In heaven above, where all is love, There'll be no sorrow there.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: There'll be no grief in heaven;
For life is one glad day,
And tears are those of former things Which all have passed away.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: There'll be no sin in heaven;
All holy in there spotless robes,

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: I'm a pilgrim, and I'm a stranger;
I can tarry, I can tarry but a night;
Do not detain me, for I am going To where the fountains are ever flowing.

sections.label: Refrain
lines: I'm a pilgrim, and I'm a stranger;
I can tarry, I can tarry but a night.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: There the glory is ever shining!
O, my longing heart, my longing heart is there;
Here in this country so dark and dreary,
I long have wandered forlorn and weary.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: There's the city to which I journey;
My Redeemer, my Redeemer is its light!
There is no sorrow, nor any sighing,
Nor any tears there, or any dying.

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: I'm but a stranger here, Heav'n is my home;
Earth is a desert drear, Heav'n is my home.
Danger and sorrow stand Round me on every hand;
Heav'n is my fatherland, Heav'n is my home.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: What though the tempest rage, Heav'n is my home;
Short is my pilgrimage, Heav'n is my home;
And time's wild wintry blast Soon shall be over past;
I shall reach home at last, Heav'n is my home.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: There at my Savior's side Heav'n is my home;
I shall be glorified, Heav'n is my home;
There are the good and blest, Those I love most and best;
And there I, too, shall rest, Heav'n is my home.

translations.title: Lo, What a Glorious Sight Appears

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Lo, what a glorious sight appears To our believing eyes!
The earth and seas are passed away And the old rolling skies.
And the old rolling skies, And the old rolling skies;
The earth and seas are passed away, And the old rolling skies.

sections.label: Refrain
lines: O that will be joyful, joyful, joyful!
O that will be joyful When we meet to part no more!
When we meet to part no more On Canaan's happy shore;
'Tis there we'll meet at Jesus' feet,
When we meet to part no more!

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Attending angels shout for joy And the bright armies sing- Mortals!
Behold the sacred seat Of your descending King.
Of your descending King, Of your descending King;
Behold the sacred seat Of your descending King.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: His own soft hand shall wipe the tears From every weeping eye;
And pains, and groans, and griefs, and fears,
And death itself shall die, And death itself shall die;
And pains, and groans, and griefs, and fears,

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: Oh, how long Shall this bright hour delay?
Fly swifter round, ye wheels of time!
And bring the welcome day, And bring the welcome day;
Fly swifter round, ye wheels of time!

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Have the scattered flocks been torn;
Dark the dessert paths, and dreary;
Now the gathering call is sounding, Solemn in its warning voice;
Union, faith, and love, abounding, Bid the little flock rejoice.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Now the light of truth they're seeking,
All the ten commandments keeping, They are holy, just, and true.
On the words of lire they're feeding,
Precious to their taste so sweet;
All their Master's percepts heeding, Bowing humbly to His feet.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: In that light of light and beauty,
Soon its pearly gates they'll enter,
And of all its glories share.
Free from sin, and death, and pain;
Tear will never dim those mansions Where the souls immortal reign.

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: Shout their vict'ry thro' the skies.
O, we long for Thine appearing;
Our spirits cheering, Take thy ransomed children home.

translations.title: O, When Shall I See Jesus

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: O, when shall I see Jesus and reign with Him above,
And shall hear the trumpet sound in that morning?
And from the flowing fountain drink everlasting love,
And shall hear the trumpet sound in that morning.

sections.label: Refrain
lines: For I shall mount above the skies,
When I hear the trumpet sound in that morning.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Gird on the gospel armor of faith and hope and love,
And you'll hear the trumpet sound in that morning.
And when the combat's ended He'll carry you above,
And you'll hear the trumpet sound in that morning.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Our ears shall hear with transport the host of heaven sing,
And shall hear the trumpet sound in that morning.
Our tongues shall chant the glories of our immortal King.
And shall hear the trumpet sound in that morning,

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: There is a land of pure delight,
Infinite day excludes the night And pleasures banish pain.

sections.label: Refrain
lines: We soon shall hear the trumpet sound,
And soon we shall with Jesus reign,
And soon we shall with Jesus reign,

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: And but a little space divides This heav'nly land from ours.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Could we but stand where Moses stood,
Not all this world's pretended good Could ever charm us more.

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Together let us sweetly live, I am bound for the land of Canaan.
I am bound for the land of Canaan.

sections.label: Refrain
lines: O Canaan, bright Canaan, I am bound for the land of Canaan.
O Canaan, it is my happy home, I am bound for the land of Canaan.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Together let us watch and pray;
I am bound for the land of Canaan.
I am bound for the land of Canaan.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Our songs of praise shall fill the skies;
I am bound for the land of Canaan.
While higher still our joys shall rise;
I am bound for the land of Canaan.

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: Then come with me, beloved friend;
I am bound for the land of Canaan.
The joys to come shall never end;
I am bound for the land of Canaan.

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: What heavenly music steals over the sea!
Entrancing the senses like sweet melody!
'Tis the voice of the angels borne soft on the air;
For me they are singing; their welcome I hear.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: On the banks of old Jordan, here gazing I stand,
Send a convoy of angels, dear Jesus, I pray!
Let me join that sweet music; come, take me away.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Though dark are the waters and rough is the wave, If Jesus permit, the wild surges I'll brave;
For that heavenly music hath ravished me so,
I must join in that chorus!

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: We have heard from the bright, the holy, land;
We have heard, and our hearts are glad;
For we were a lonely pilgrim band, And weary, and worn, and sad.
They tell us the saints have a dwelling there- No longer are homeless ones;
And we know that the goodly land is fair,

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: They say green fields are waving there,
That never a blight shall know;
And the deserts wild are blooming fair,
And the roses of Sharon grow.
There are lovely birds in the bowers green,
Their songs are blithe and sweet;
And their warblings, gushing ever new,

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: We have heard of the palms, the robes, the crowns,
And the silvery band in white;
Of the city fair, with pearly gates, All radiant with light.
We have heard of the angels there, and saints,
With their harps of gold, how they sing;
Of the mount with the fruitful tree of life,
Of the leaves that healing bring.

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: He is fair, He's the joy and light of the place;
In His beauty we shall behold Him there,
And bask in His smiling face, We'll be there, we'll be there in a little while, We'll join the pure and the blest;
We'll have the palm, the robe, the crown, And forever be at rest.

translations.title: Don't You See My Jesus Coming

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Don't you see my Jesus coming, See Him come in yonder cloud?
With ten thousand angels round Him, How they do my Jesus crowd!

sections.label: Refrain
lines: I am bound for the kingdom, Will you go to glory with me?

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Don't you see the saints ascending,
Hear them shouting thro' the air.
Jesus smiling, trumpets sounding, Now His glory they shall share.

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Forever shared, forever whole, A never ebbing sea!

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: We nay not climb the heavenly steeps To bring the Lord Christ down;
In vain we search the lowest deeps, For him no depths can drown.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: But warm, so tender, even yet A present help is He;
And faith has still its Olivet, And love its Galilee.

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: The healing of His seamless dress Is by our beds of pain;
We touch Him in life's throng and press, And we are whole again.

sections.label: Verse 5
lines: Through Him the first fond prayers are said,
The last low whispers of our dead Are burdened with His name.

sections.label: Verse 6
lines: O Lord and Master of us all: Whate'er our names or sign,
We own Thy sway, we hear Thy call,
We test our lives by Thine!

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: I have a Friend so precious, So very dear to me,
He loves me with such tender love,
I could not live apart form Him,
I love to feel Him nigh,

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: He knows that I am weak,
And as He bids me lean on Him,
He leads me in the paths of light,

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: I tell Him all my sorrows,
I tell Him all my joys,
I tell Him all that pleases me,
He tells me what I ought to do,
He tells me how to try,

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: He knows that I am longing Some weary soul to win,
And so He bids me go and speak The loving word for Him;
He bids me tell His wondrous love,
And why He came to die,

lines: En Aapdha Nanpar Avar Mika Sirandhavar,

translations.title: I Love to Tell the Story

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: I love to tell the story of unseen things above, of Jesus and his glory, of Jesus and his love.
I love to tell the story, because I know 'tis true; it satisfies my longings as nothing else can do.

sections.label: Refrain
lines: I love to tell the story, 'twill be my theme in glory, to tell the old, old story of Jesus and his love.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: I love to tell the story; more wonderful it seems than all the golden fancies of all our golden dreams.
I love to tell the story, it did so much for me; and that is just the reason I tell it now to thee.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: I love to tell the story;
'tis pleasant to repeat what seems, each time I tell it, more wonderfully sweet.
I love to tell the story, for some have never heard the message of salvation from God's own holy Word.

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: I love to tell the story, for those who know it best seem hungering and thirsting to hear it like the rest.
And when, in scenes of glory,
I sing the new, new song, 'twill be the old, old story that I have loved so long.

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: More love to thee, O Christ, more love to thee!
Hear thou the prayer I make on bended knee.
This is my earnest plea: More love,
O Christ, to thee; more love to thee, more love to thee!

sections.label: Refrain
lines: , when they can sing with me: More love,
O Christ, to thee; more love to thee, more love to thee!

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Once earthly joy I craved, sought peace and rest; now thee alone I seek, give what is best.
This all my prayer shall be: More love,
O Christ, to thee; more love to thee, more love to thee!

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Let sorrow do its work, come grief and pain; sweet are thy messengers, sweet their

lines: Then shall my latest breath whisper thy praise; this be the parting cry my heart shall raise; this still its prayer shall be: More love,
O Christ, to thee; more love to thee, more love to thee!

translations.title: As the Bridegroom to His Chosen

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: As the bridegroom to His chosen,
As the king to His realm,
As the keep unto the castle,
As the pilot to the helm, So,

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: As the fountain in the garden,
As the candle in the dark,
As the treasure in the coffer,
As the manna in the ark, So,

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: As the ruby in the setting,
As the honey in the comb,
As the light within the lantern,
As the father in the home, So,

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: As the sunshine in the heavens,
As the image in the glass,
As the fruits up in the fig tree,
As the dew upon the grass, So,

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: As song-time and springtime and summertime to be, So is my Lord, my living Lord, So is my Lord to me.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Like calm in place of clamor Like peace that follows pain,
Like moonlight and starlight and sunlight on the sea, So is my Lord, my living Lord, So is my Lord to me.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: As home to the trav'ler and all he longs to see, So is my Lord, my living Lord, So is my Lord to me.

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Be still, my soul: the Lord is on thy side;
Bear patiently the cross of grief or pain;
Leave to thy God to order and provide;
In every change He faithful will remain.

sections.label: Refrain
lines: Be still, my soul: thy best, thy heavenly friend Through thorny ways leads to a joyful end.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Be still, my soul: thy God doth undertake To guide the future as He has the past.
Thy hope, thy confidence let nothing shake;
All now mysterious shall be bright at last.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Be still, my soul: the hour is hastening on When we shall be forever with the Lord,
When disappointment, grief, and fear are gone,
Sorrow forgot, love's purest joys restored.

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: O what a foretaste of glory divine!
Heir of salvation, purchase of God, born of his Spirit, washed in his blood.

sections.label: Refrain
lines: This is my story, this is my song, praising my Savior all the day long; this is my story, this is my song, praising my Savior all the day long.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Perfect submission, perfect delight, visions of rapture now burst on my sight; angels descending bring from above echoes of mercy, whispers of love.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Perfect submission, all is at rest;
I in my Savior am happy and blest, watching and waiting, looking above, filled with his goodness, lost in his love.

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Peace, perfect peace, in this dark world of sin?
The blood of Jesus whispers peace within.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Peace, perfect peace, by thronging duties pressed?
To do the will of Jesus: this is rest.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Peace, perfect peace, with loved ones far away?
In Jesus' keeping we are safe, and they.

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: Peace, perfect peace, our future all unknown?
Jesus we know, and He is on the throne.

translations.title: When I Can Read My Title Clear

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: When I can read my title clear To mansions in the skies I'll bid farewell to every fear,
And wipe my weeping eyes, I'll bid farewell to every fear,

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Should earth against my soul engage,
Then I can smile at Satan's rage,
Then I can smile at Satan's rage,

translations.title: I Heard the Voice of Jesus

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: I heard the voice of Jesus say, 'Come unto Me and rest;
Lay down, thou weary one, lay down Thy head upon My breast.' I came to Jesus as I was,
I found in Him a resting place, And He has made me glad.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: I heard the voice of Jesus say, 'Behold,
I freely give The living water; thirsty one,
Stoop down and drink and live.' I came to Jesus, and I drank Of that life giving stream;
My thirst was quench'd, my soul revived, And now I live in Him.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: I heard the voice of Jesus say, 'I am this dark world's light;
Look unto Me, thy morn shall rise,
And all thy day be bright.' I looked to Jesus, and I found In Him my star, my sun;
And in that light of life I'll walk,

translations.title: “வா பாவி இளைப்பாற வா, என் திவ்ய மார்பிலே

sections.label: சரணம் 1
lines: “வா பாவி இளைப்பாற வா, என் திவ்ய மார்பிலே

sections.label: சரணம் 2
lines: “வா, பாவி, தாகந் தீர்க்க வா, மெய்ப் பானம் இதுவே;
நான் ஜீவ தண்ணீர் தருவேன்” என்றார், நல் மீட்பரே,
அவ்வாறு ஜீவ ஊற்றிலே நான் பானம் பண்ணினேன்;

sections.label: சரணம் 3
lines: “வா, பாவி, இருள் நீங்க வா என் ஒளி வீசுதே.
என்றைக்கும் சுக ஜீவியாய் நான் வாழ்ந்து கொள்ளுவேன்.

translations.title: "Vaa Paavi Ilaippaara Vaa, En Thivya Maarpile

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: "Vaa Paavi Ilaippaara Vaa, En Thivya Maarpile

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: "Vaa, Paavi, Thaakan Theerkka Vaa, Meyp Paanam Idhuve;
Naan Jeeva Thanneer Tharuven" Endraar, Nal Meetpare,
Avvaaru Jeeva Ootrile Naan Paanam Panninen;

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: "Vaa, Paavi, Irul Neenga Vaa En Oli Veesudhe.
Endraikkum Suka Jeeviyaai Naan Vaazhndhu Kolluven.

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Far away in the depths of my spirit tonight,
Rolls a melody sweeter than psalm;
In celestial like strains it unceasingly falls O'er my soul like an infinite calm.

sections.label: Refrain
lines: Peace! wonderful peace, Coming down from the Father above;
Sweep over my spirit forever, I pray, In fathomless billows of love.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: What a treasure I have in this wonderful peace,
Buried deep in my inner most soul, So secure that no power can mine it away,
While the years of eternity roll!

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: I believe when I rise to that city of peace,
Where the Author of peace I shall see,
That one strain of the song which the ransomed will sing,
In that heavenly kingdom will be-

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: Weary soul, without gladness or comfort or rest,
Passing down the rough pathway of time!
Make the Savior your friend ere the shadows grow dark;
O accept of this peace so sublime.

translations.title: Life Is Great! So Sing About It

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: As we can and as we should- Shop and buses, towns and people,
Life is great and life is given;
Life is lovely, free and good.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Snow or sunshine, joy or pain,
Suffering that I can't explain Life is great if someone loves me,
Holds my hand and calls my name.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: The love of lovers, Whispered words and longing eyes;
Love that gazes at the cradle Where a child of loving lies;
Love that lasts when youth has faded,
Bends with age, but never dies.

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: Love is giving and receiving Boy and girl, or friend with friend;
Love is bearing and forgiving All the hurts that hate can send;
Love's the greatest way of living, Hoping, trusting to the end.

sections.label: Verse 5
lines: God is great! in Christ He loved us,
As we should, but never can- Love that suffered, hoped and trusted When disciples turned and ran,
Love that broke through death forever.

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: My Father is rich in houses and lands,
He holdeth the wealth of the world in His hands!
Of rubies and diamonds, of silver and gold,

sections.label: Refrain
lines: I'm a child of the King, A child of the King: With Jesus my Savior, I'm a child of the King.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: My Father's own Son, the Savior of men,
Once wandered on earth as the poorest of them;
But now He is pleading our pardon on high,
That we may be His when He comes by and by.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: I once was an outcast stranger on earth, A sinner by choice, an alien by birth,
But I've been adopted, my name's written down, An heir to a mansion, a robe and a crown.

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: A tent or a cottage, why should I care?
They're building a palace for me over there;
Though exiled from home, yet still may I sing: All glory to God, I'm a child of the King.

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: What a fellowship, what a joy divine, leaning on the everlasting arms; what a blessedness, what a peace is mine, leaning on the everlasting arms.

sections.label: Refrain
lines: Leaning, leaning, safe and secure from all alarms; leaning, leaning, leaning on the everlasting arms.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: O how sweet to walk in this pilgrim way, leaning on the everlasting arms;
O how bright the path grows from day to day, leaning on the everlasting arms.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: What have I to dread, what have I to fear, leaning on the everlasting arms?
I have blessed peace with my Lord so near, leaning on the everlasting arms.

translations.title: There's Sunshine in My Soul Today

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: There's sunshine in my soul today,
More glorious and bright Than glows in any earthly sky,

sections.label: Refrain
lines: When the peaceful, happy moments roll When Jesus shows His smiling face There is sunshine in the soul.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: There's music in my soul today, A carol to my King,
And Jesus, listening, can hear The songs I cannot sing.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: There's springtime in my soul today,
For when the Lord is near,
The dove of peace sings in my heart,

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: Theres gladness in my soul today,
And hope, and praise, and love,
For blessings which He gives me now,

translations.title: என் ஆன்மாவில் ப்ரகாசம் உண்டு மிக மாட்சியோடு

sections.label: சரணம் 1
lines: என் ஆன்மாவில் ப்ரகாசம் உண்டு மிக மாட்சியோடு
பூலோக மாட்சி காட்டிலும் யேசுவே என் ஒளி.

sections.label: பல்லவி
lines: ஆன்மாவில் ஒளிக்கதிர் வீசும் யேசுவின் புன் நகைப்பில்.

sections.label: சரணம் 2
lines: என் ஆன்மாவில் பாடல்கள் உண்டு என் ராஜாவுக்காக

sections.label: சரணம் 3
lines: என் ஆன்மாவில் வசந்தம் உண்டு கர்த்தர் அண்டும் போது
அவர் பாடல் என் இதயத்தை மலரச் செய்குதே.

translations.title: En Aanmaavil Prakaasam Untu Mika Maatchiyotu

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: En Aanmaavil Prakaasam Untu Mika Maatchiyotu
Pooloka Maatchi Kaattilum Yesuve En Oli.

sections.label: Refrain
lines: Aanmaavil Olikkadhir Veesum Yesuvin Pun Nakaippil.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: En Aanmaavil Paadalkal Untu En Raajaavukkaaka

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: En Aanmaavil Vasandham Untu Karththar Antum Podhu
Avar Paadal En Idhayaththai Malarach Cheykudhe.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Father grant us, grant us Your peace;
Oh, loving Father, grant us Your peace.
Grant us, grant us, grant Your peace;
Loving Father, grant us Your peace.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Accordenous ta paix, ta paix, Accordenous ta paix.
Accordenous ta paix, Accordenous ta paix.

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: Padre, danos, danos tupaz Padre, danos, tupaz.
Padre, danos, danos tupaz Padre, danos tupaz.

translations.title: A Song of Heaven and Homeland

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Come floating softly earthward As thro' heav'n's open door: It seems like angel voices,
That swell the mighty chorus Around the throne above.

sections.label: Refrain
lines: Heard from a land afar- The song of Heav'n and Homeland,

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Now soft, and low, and restful, It floods my soul with peace,
As if God's benediction Bade all earth's troubles cease.
Of wind, and wave, and sea- It fills the dome of heaven With glorious harmony.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Like something heard in dreams- It seems to catch the cadence Of heav'nly winds and streams,
My heart is filled with rapture,
To think, some day to come, I'll sing it with the angels- The song of heav'n and home.

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Nearer, my God, to thee, nearer to thee!
E'en though it be a cross that raiseth me, still all my song shall be, nearer, my God, to thee; nearer, my God, to thee, nearer to thee!

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Though like the wanderer, the sun gone down, darkness be over me, my rest a stone; yet in my dreams I'd be nearer, my God, to thee; nearer, my God, to thee, nearer to thee!

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: There let the way appear, steps unto heaven; all that thou sendest me, in mercy given; angels to beckon me nearer, my God, to thee; nearer, my God, to thee, nearer to thee!

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: Then, with my waking thoughts bright with thy praise, out of my stony griefs Bethel I'll raise; so by my woes to be nearer, my God, to thee; nearer, my God, to thee, nearer to thee!

sections.label: Verse 5
lines: Or if, on joyful wing cleaving the sky, sun, moon, and stars forgot, upward I fly, still all my song shall be, nearer, my God, to thee; nearer, my God, to thee, nearer to thee!

translations.title: Take the Name of Jesus With You

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Take the Name of Jesus with you,
Child of sorrow and of woe, It will joy and comfort give you;
Take it then, where'er you go.

sections.label: Refrain
lines: Hope of earth and joy of Heav'n.
Hope of earth and joy of Heav'n.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Take the Name of Jesus ever, As a shield from every snare;
Breathe that holy Name in prayer.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: O the precious Name of Jesus!
How it thrills our souls with joy,
When His loving arms receive us,
And His songs our tongues employ!

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: At the Name of Jesus bowing,
King of kings in heav'n we'll crown Him,

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: There is a balm in Gilead To make the wounded whole;
There is a balm in Gilead To heal the sin-sick soul.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: And think my work's in vain,
But then the Holy Spirit Revives my soul again.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: If you can not preach like Peter, If you can not pray like Paul,
You can tell the love of Jesus,
And say He died for all.

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Days are filled with sorrow and care,
Burdens are lifted at Calvary, Jesus is very near.

sections.label: Refrain
lines: Burdens are lifted at Calvary, Calvary, Calvary, Burdens are lifted at Calvary, Jesus is very near.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Cast your care on Jesus today, Leave your worry and fear;
Burdens are lifted at Calvary, Jesus is very near.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Troubled soul, the Saviour can see, Ev'ry heartache and tear;
Burdens are lifted at Calvary Jesus is very near.

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Come, ye disconsolate, where'er ye languish. come to the mercy seat, fervently kneel.
Here bring your wounded hearts, here tell your anguish; earth has no sorrow that heaven cannot heal.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Joy of the desolate, light of the straying, hope of the penitent, fadeless and pure!
Here speaks the Comforter, tenderly saying, 'Earth has no sorrow that heaven cannot cure.'

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Here see the bread of life; waters flowing forth from the throne of God, pure from above.
Come to the feast of love; come, ever knowing earth has no sorrow but heaven can remove.

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Sweet hour of prayer! sweet hour of prayer! that calls me from a world of care, and bids me at my Father's throne make all my wants and wishes known.
In seasons of distress and grief, my soul has often found relief, and oft escaped the tempter's snare by thy return, sweet hour of prayer!

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Sweet hour of prayer! sweet hour of prayer! thy wings shall my petition bear to him whose truth and faithfulness engage the waiting soul to bless.
And since he bids me seek his face, believe his word, and trust his grace, I'll cast on him my every care, and wait for thee, sweet hour of prayer!

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Sweet hour of prayer! sweet hour of prayer!
May I thy consolation share Till from Mount Pisgah's lofty height I view my home and take my flight.
In my immortal flesh I'll rise To size the everlasting prize.
And shout while passing through the air, 'Farewell, farewell, sweet hour of prayer!'

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Be silent, be silent, A whisper is heard;
Be silent, and listen, Oh treasure each word.

sections.label: Refrain
lines: Tread softly, tread softly, The Master is here;
Tread softly here, tread softly here,
Tread softly here, tread softly here,

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: This altar that echoes The message of grace.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Be silent, be silent, Breathe humbly our prayer;
A foretaste of Eden This moment we share.

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: Be silent, be silent, His mercy record;
Be silent, be silent, And wait on the Lord.

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Dear Lord and Father of mankind, forgive our foolish ways; reclothe us in our rightful mind, in purer lives thy service find, in deeper reverence, praise.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: In simple trust like theirs who heard, beside the Syrian sea, the gracious calling of the Lord, let us, like them, without a word, rise up and follow thee.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: O calm of hills above, where Jesus knelt to share with thee the silence of eternity, interpreted by love!

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: Drop thy still dews of quietness, till all our strivings cease; take from our souls the strain and stress, and let our ordered lives confess the beauty of thy peace.

sections.label: Verse 5
lines: Breathe through the heats of our desire thy coolness and thy balm; let sense be dumb, let flesh retire; speak through the earthquake, wind, and fire,
O still, small voice of calm.

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Dear Lord and Father of mankind, forgive our foolish ways; reclothe us in our rightful mind, in purer lives thy service find, in deeper reverence, praise.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: In simple trust like theirs who heard, beside the Syrian sea, the gracious calling of the Lord, let us, like them, without a word, rise up and follow thee.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: O calm of hills above, where Jesus knelt to share with thee the silence of eternity, interpreted by love!

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: Drop thy still dews of quietness, till all our strivings cease; take from our souls the strain and stress, and let our ordered lives confess the beauty of thy peace.

sections.label: Verse 5
lines: Breathe through the heats of our desire thy coolness and thy balm; let sense be dumb, let flesh retire; speak through the earthquake, wind, and fire,
O still, small voice of calm.

translations.title: Father, Lead Me Day by Day

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Father, lead me day by day, Ever in Thine own sweet way;
Teach me to be pure and true;
Show me what I ought to do.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: When in danger, make me brave;
Make me know that Thou canst save;
Keep me safe by Thy dear side;
Let me in Thy love abide.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: When tempted to do wrong, Make me steadfast, wise, and strong;
And when all alone I stand, Shield me with Thy mighty hand.

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: May I do the good I know, Be Thy loving child below,
Then at last go home to Thee,

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: I need thee every hour, most gracious Lord; no tender voice like thine can peace afford.

sections.label: Refrain
lines: I need thee, O I need thee; every hour I need thee;
O bless me now, my Savior, I come to thee.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: I need thee every hour; stay thou nearby; temptations lose their power when thou art nigh.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: I need thee every hour, in joy or pain; come quickly and abide, or life is vain.

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: I need thee every hour; teach me thy will; and thy rich promises in me fulfill.

sections.label: பல்லவி
lines: எந்நாளும் நீரே வேண்டும், இந்த நாளும் வேண்டும்;

sections.label: Refrain
lines: Ennaalum Neere Ventum, Indha Naalum Ventum;

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: I need Thee precious Jesus, for I am very poor;
A stranger and a pilgrim, I have no earthly store.
I need the love of Jesus to cheer me on my way,
To guide my doubting foot steps, to be my strength and stay.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: I need the heart of Jesus to feel each anxious care,
To tell my every trial, and all my sorrows share.
I need the Holy Spirit to teach me what I am,
To show me more of Jesus, to point me to the Lamb.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: I hope to see Thee soon,
Encircled with the rainbow, and seated on Thy throne.
There with Thy blood-bought children, my joy shall ever be To sing Thy ceaseless praises, to gaze, my Lord, on Thee.

sections.label: Verse 1
