lines: I must tell Jesus all of my trials,
I cannot bear these burdens alone;
In my distress He kindly will help me,
He ever loves and cares for His own.

sections.label: Refrain
lines: I cannot bear my burdens alone;
Jesus can help me, Jesus alone.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: I must tell Jesus all of my troubles,
He is a kind, compassionate Friend;
If I but ask Him He will deliver,
Make of my troubles quickly an end.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Oh, how the world to evil allures me!
Oh, how my heart is tempted to sin!
I must tell Jesus, and He will help me Over the world the vict'ry to win.

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Father, I stretch my hands to Thee;
If Thou withdraw Thyself from me, Ah, wither shall I go?

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: On Thy dear Son I now believe, O let me feel Thy power;
And all my varied wants relieve, In this accepted hour.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: To Thee I lift My weary, longing eyes;
O let me now receive that gift;

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: Surely Thou canst not let me die;
O speak, and I shall live;
And here I will unwearied lie, Till Thou Thy Spirit give.

sections.label: Verse 5
lines: How would my fainting soul rejoice Could I but see Thy face!
Now let me hear Thy quickening voice,

sections.label: Verse 6
lines: I now believe That Jesus died for me,
And that He shed His precious blood From sin to set me free.

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: I come to the garden alone, While the dew is still on the roses;
And the voice I hear, falling on my ear,

sections.label: Refrain
lines: And He tells me I am His own;
And the joy we share as we tarry there,

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: He speaks, and the sound of His voice Is so sweet the birds hush their singing,
And the melody that He gave to me Within my heart is ringing.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: I'd stay in the garden with Him Though the night around me be falling,
But He bids me go; through the voice of woe,
His voice to me is calling.

translations.title: At First I Prayed for Light

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: At first I prayed for light: Could I but see the way,
How gladly, swiftly would I walk To everlasting day!

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: And next I prayed for strength: That I might tread the road With firm, unfaltering feet, and win The heaven's serene abode.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: And then I asked for faith: Could I but trust my God, I'd live infolded in His peace,

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: But now I pray for love: Deep love to God and man;
A living love that will not fail, However dark His plan.

sections.label: Verse 5
lines: And light and strength and faith Are opening everywhere!
God waited patiently until I prayed the larger prayer.

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Let me to thy bosom fly,
While the billows near me roll,
While the tempest still is high;
Hide me, O my Savior, hide!
Till the storm of life is past;
Safe into the haven guide, O receive my soul at last!

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Other refuge has I none, Hangs my helpless soul on thee;
Leave O leave me not alone!
All my trust on Thee is stayed, All my help from Thee I bring;
Cover my defenseless head With the shadow of Thy wing.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Thou, O Christ, all I want, More than all in Thee I find;
Raise the fallen, cheer the faint,
Heal the sick, and lead the blind.
Just and holy is Thy name, I am all unrighteousness;
Vile and full of sin I am;
Thou art full of truth and grace.

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: Plenteous grace with Thee is found- Grace to pardon all my sin;
Let the healing streams abound, Make and keep me pure within;
Thou of life the Fountain art, Freely let me take of Thee;
Spring Thou up within my heart, Rise to all eternity.

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Jesus, lover of my soul, let me to Thy bosom fly,
While the nearer waters roll, while the tempest still is high.
Hide me, O my Savior, hide, till the storm of life is past;
O receive my soul at last.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Other refuge have I none, hangs my helpless soul on Thee;
Leave, ah! leave me not alone, still support and comfort me.
All my trust on Thee is stayed, all my help from Thee I bring;
Cover my defenseless head with the shadow of Thy wing.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Thou, O Christ, art all I want, more than all in Thee I find;
Raise the fallen, cheer the faint, heal the sick, and lead the blind.
Just and holy is Thy Name, I am all unrighteousness;
False and full of sin I am;
Thou art full of truth and grace.

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: Plenteous grace with Thee is found, grace to cover all my sin;
Let the healing streams abound; make and keep me pure within.
Thou of life the fountain art, freely let me take of Thee;
Spring Thou up within my heart; rise to all eternity.

translations.title: என்றன் ஆத்ம நேசரே, வெள்ளம் போன்ற துன்பத்தில்

sections.label: சரணம் 1
lines: என்றன் ஆத்ம நேசரே, வெள்ளம் போன்ற துன்பத்தில்,
தஞ்சம் தந்து, யேசுவே, திவ்ய மார்ப்பில் காருமே;
அப்பால் கரை யேற்றியே மோட்ச வீட்டில் சேருமே.

sections.label: சரணம் 2
lines: வல்ல தேவரீர் அல்லால் வேறே தஞ்சம் இல்லையே;
நீரே என்றன் நம்பிக்கை நீர் சகாயம் செய்குவீர்;

sections.label: சரணம் 3
lines: குறை யாவும் நீங்கிட, நாதா நீர் சம்பூரணர்;
நான் அசுத்த பாவிதான், நீரே சுத்தர், சுத்தரே;
நான் அநீதி கேடுள்ளோன், நீர் நிறைந்த நித்யரே.

sections.label: சரணம் 4
lines: பாவம் யாவும் மன்னிக்க ஆரருள் அமைந்த நீர்
ஜீவ ஊற்றாம் யேசுவே, என்றன் தாகம் தீருமே;
ஸ்வாமி, என்றும் என்னிலே நீர் சுரந்து ஊறுமே.

translations.title: Endran Aadhma Nesare, Vellam Pondra Thunpaththil

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Endran Aadhma Nesare, Vellam Pondra Thunpaththil,
Thanjam Thandhu, Yesuve, Thivya Maarppil Kaarume;
Appaal Karai Yetriye Motcha Veettil Serume.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Valla Thevareer Allaal Vere Thanjam Illaiye;
Neere Endran Nampikkai Neer Sakaayam Seykuveer;

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Kurai Yaavum Neengita, Naadhaa Neer Sampooranar;
Naan Asuththa Paavidhaan, Neere Suththar, Suththare;
Naan Aneedhi Ketullon, Neer Niraindha Nidhyare.

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: Paavam Yaavum Mannikka Aararul Amaindha Neer
Jeeva Ootraam Yesuve, Endran Thaakam Theerume;
Svaami, Endrum Ennile Neer Surandhu Oorume.

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Lest by base denial I depart from Thee;
When Thou see'st me waver, with a look recall,
Nor, for fear or favor, suffer me to fall.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: With forbidden pleasures would this vain world charm;
Or its sordid treasures spread to work me harm;
Bring to my remembrance sad Gethsemane, Or, in darker semblance, cross-crowned Calvary.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Should Thy mercy send me sorrow, toil, and woe,
Or should pain attend me on my path below,
Grant that I may never fail Thy hand to see;
Grant that I may ever cast my care on Thee.

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Teach, me, Father, what to say;
Teach me, Father, how to pray;
Teach me all along the way How to be like Jesus.

sections.label: Refrain
lines: I would be like Jesus, I would be like Jesus!
Help me, Lord, to daily grow More and more like Jesus!

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Teach me as the days go by,
Teach me not to reason why,
Teach me that to do and die, Is to be like Jesus.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Teach me that the time is short,
Teach me how to live and work,
Teach me that to never shirk Is to be like Jesus.

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: Teach me how we may be one, Like the Father and the Son;
And when all is overcome, I will be like Jesus.

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Like the woman at the well I was seeking For things that could not satisfy: And then I heard my Savior speaking: ' Draw from my well that never shall run dry'.

sections.label: Refrain
lines: Fill my cup Lord, I lift it up, Lord!
Come and quench this thirsting of my soul;
Feed me till I want no more' Fill my cup, fill it up and make me whole!

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: There are millions in this world who are craving The pleasures earthly things afford;
But none can match the wondrous treasure That I find in Jesus Christ my Lord.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: So, my brother, if the things this world gave you Leave hungers that won't pass away,
My blessed Lord will come and save you, If you kneel to Him and humbly pray:

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: 'We would see Jesus;' for the shadows lengthen Across the little landscape of our life;
We would see Jesus, our weak faith to strengthen For the last conflict, in this mortal strife.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: 'We would see Jesus,' Rock of our salvation,
Where on our feet were set with sovereign grace;
Not life, nor death, with all their agitation,
Can thence remove us, gazing on His face.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: 'We would see Jesus;' other lights are paling,
Which for long years we did rejoice to see;
The blessings of this sinful world are failing;
We would not mourn them, in exchange for Thee.

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: 'We would see Jesus;' this is all we're needing- Strength, joy and willingness come with the sight;
We would see Jesus, dying, risen, pleading,
Soon to return and end this mortal night!

translations.title: Near to the Heart of God

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: There is a place of quiet rest, near to the heart of God; a place where sin cannot molest, near to the heart of God.

sections.label: Refrain
lines: O Jesus, blest Redeemer, sent from the heart of God, hold us who wait before thee near to the heart of God.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: There is a place of comfort sweet, near to the heart of God; a place where we our Savior meet, near to the heart of God.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: There is place a place of full release, near to the heart of God; a place where all is joy and peace, near to the heart of God.

sections.label: பல்லவி
lines: ஓ! யேசு ரட்சகா! நீர் பரம் நின்று வந்தீர்.
உம் முன்னே காத்து நிற்கும் தாசர் எமைக் காரும்.

sections.label: சரணம் 3
lines: ஜெயம் என்றும் பெறும் இடம், தேவனின் மார்பருகே

sections.label: Refrain
lines: O! Yesu Ratchakaa! Neer Param Nindru Vandheer.
Um Munne Kaaththu Nirkum Thaasar Emaik Kaarum.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Jeyam Endrum Perum Itam, Thevanin Maarparuke

translations.title: Eternal Love, We Have No Good

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Eternal Love, we have no good to bring Thee, No single good of all our hands have wrought, No worthy music have we found to sing Thee, No jewelled word, no quick up soaring thought.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: And yet we come; and when our faith would falter Show us,
O Love, the quiet place of prayer,
The golden censer and the golden altar,
And the great angel waiting for us there.

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: O gracious Father of mankind, Our spirits' unseen friend;
High heaven's Lord, our hearts' dear guest,

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Thou dost not wait till human speech Thy gifts divine implore;
Our dreams, our aims, our work, our lives Are prayers Thou lovest more.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Thou hearest these, the good and ill, Deep buried in each breast;
The secret thought, the hidden plan, Wrought out our unexpressed.

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: O cleanse our prayers from human dross,
Until we labor for those gifts We ask on bended knee.

sections.label: Verse 5
lines: Our best is but Thyself in us, Our highest thought Thy will;
To hear Thy voice we need but love, And listen, and be still.

sections.label: Verse 6
lines: We would not bend Thy will to ours, But blend our wills to Thine;
Not dreams, our aims, our work, our lives Are prayers Thou lovest more.

sections.label: Verse 7
lines: Thou seekest us in love and truth More than our minds seek Thee;
Through open gates Thy power flows in Like flood tides from the sea.

sections.label: Verse 8
lines: No more we seek Thee from afar,
Nor ask Thee for a sign,
Content to pray in life and love And toil, till all are Thine.

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Still, still with Thee, when purple morning breaketh,
When the bird waketh, and the shadows flee;
Fairer than morning, lovelier than daylight,

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Alone with Thee, amid the mystic shadows,
The solemn hush of nature newly born;
Alone with Thee in breathless adoration,
In the calm dew and freshness of the morn.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: As to each newborn morning A fresh and solemn splendor still is given, So does this blessed consciousness, awaking,
Breathe each day nearness unto Thee and heaven.

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: So shall it be at last, in that bright morning,
When the soul waketh and life's shadows flee;
O in that hour, fairer than daylight dawning,

translations.title: What a Friend We Have in Jesus

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: What a friend we have in Jesus, All our sins and griefs to bear!
What a privilege to carry Everything to God in prayer!
Oh, what peace we often forfeit;
Oh, what needless pain we bear All because we do not carry Everything to God in prayer!

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: We should never be discouraged Take it to the Lord in prayer.
Can we find a friend so faithful Who will all our sorrows share?
Jesus knows our every weakness Take it to the Lord in prayer.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Are we weak and heavy laden, Cumbered with a load of care?
Precious Savior, still our refuge Take it to the Lord in prayer.
Do your friends despise, forsake you?
Take it to the Lord in prayer.
In his arms he'll take and shield you;
You will find a solace there.

translations.title: பாவ சஞ்சலத்தை நீக்க ப்ராண சிநேகித னுண்டே

sections.label: சரணம் 1
lines: பாவ சஞ்சலத்தை நீக்க ப்ராண சிநேகித னுண்டே,
பாவச் சுமை தீர்த்துப் போட யேசுவின் நற் பாதமே.
புத்தியீனம் மாறிப் போகும் ஜெப தபம் செய்வதால்.

sections.label: சரணம் 2
lines: மோச நாசம் நேரிட்டாலும், ஜெப தூபம் காட்டுவோம்.
நோக்குவார் உன் நெஞ்சின் நோவை; பெலவீனம் தாங்குவார்.
நீக்குவார் உன் மனச் சோர்வை; தீய குணம் மாற்றுவார்.

sections.label: சரணம் 3
lines: இன ஜனம் சாகும் போதும், புகலிடம் இதுவே,
ஒப்பில்லாத பிராண நேசா! உம்மை நம்பி நேசிப்போம்;
அளவற்ற அருள் நாதா! உம்மை நோக்கிக் கெஞ்சுவோம்.

translations.title: Paava Sanjalaththai Neekka Praana Sinekidha Nunte

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Paava Sanjalaththai Neekka Praana Sinekidha Nunte,
Paavach Chumai Theerththup Pota Yesuvin Nar Paadhame.
Puththiyeenam Maarip Pokum Jepa Thapam Seyvadhaal.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Mosa Naasam Nerittaalum, Jepa Thoopam Kaattuvom.
Nokkuvaar Un Nenjin Novai; Pelaveenam Thaanguvaar.
Neekkuvaar Un Manach Chorvai; Theeya Kunam Maatruvaar.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Ina Janam Saakum Podhum, Pukalitam Idhuve,
Oppillaadha Piraana Nesaa! Ummai Nampi Nesippom;
Alavatra Arul Naadhaa! Ummai Nokkik Kenjuvom.

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Take time to be holy, speak oft with thy Lord; abide in him always, and feed on his word.
Make friends of God's children, help those who are weak, forgetting in nothing his blessing to seek.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Take time to be holy, the world rushes on; spend much time in secret with Jesus alone.
By looking to Jesus, like him thou shalt be; thy friends in thy conduct his likeness shall see.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Take time to be holy, let him be thy guide, and run not before him, whatever betide.
In joy or in sorrow, still follow the Lord, and, looking to Jesus, still trust in his word.

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: Take time to be holy, be calm in thy soul, each thought and each motive beneath his control.
Thus led by his spirit to fountains of love, thou soon shalt be fitted for service above.

translations.title: Tis the Blessed Hour of Prayer

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: 'Tis the blessed hour of prayer, when our hearts lowly bend,
And we gather to Jesus, our Savior and Friend;
If we come to Him in faith, His protection to share,

sections.label: Refrain
lines: What a balm for the weary!
O how sweet to be there!
What a balm for the weary!
O how sweet to be there!

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: 'Tis the blessed hour of prayer, when the Savior draws near,
With a tender compassion His children to hear;
When He tells us we may cast at His feet every care,

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: 'Tis the blessed hour of prayer, when the tempted and tried To the Savior who loves them their sorrows confide;
With a sympathizing heart He removes every care;

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: 'Tis the blessed hour of prayer, trusting Him we believe,
That the blessings we're needing we'll surely receive;
In the fullness of this trust we shall lose every care;

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Sun of my soul, O Savior dear!
It is not night if Thou be near;
O may no earth-born cloud arise To hide Thee from Thy servant's eyes.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: When soft the dews of kindly sleep My weary eyelids gently steep, Be my last thought how sweet to rest Forever on my Savior's breast!

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Abide with me from morn till eve, For without Thee I cannot live;
Abide with me when night is nigh,
For without Thee I dare not die.

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: Be near and bless me when I wake,
Ere through the world my way I take;
Till in the ocean of Thy love I lose myself in heaven above.

translations.title: மெய் ஜோதியாம் என் நேசரே! நீர் தங்கினால் ராவில்லையே

sections.label: சரணம் 1
lines: மெய் ஜோதியாம் என் நேசரே! நீர் தங்கினால் ராவில்லையே;
என் நெஞ்சுக் கும்மை மறைக்கும் மேகம் வராமல் காத்திடும்.

sections.label: சரணம் 2
lines: உம் நேச மார்பில் என்றுமே நான் சாய்ந்து வாழ்தல் இன்பமே,

sections.label: சரணம் 3
lines: என்னோடு தங்கும் பகலில் சுகியேன் நீர் இல்லாவிடில்;
என்னோடு தங்கும் ராவிலும், நீர் தாங்கின் அஞ்சேன் சாவிலும்.

sections.label: சரணம் 4
lines: இன்றைக்குத் திவ்ய அழைப்பை அசட்டை செய்த பாவியை
நீர் கைவிடாமல், இப்போதே இழுத்துக் கொள்ளும், மீட்பரே!

sections.label: சரணம் 5
lines: துக்கிப்போர் சிசு போலவே அமர்ந்து தூங்கச் செய்யுமே.

sections.label: சரணம் 6
lines: விழிக்கும் போதென்னருகில், நீர் வந்து என்றன் வேலையில்
உம் அருள் தந்து காத்திடும் என் ஆயுள் காலம் முழுதும்.

translations.title: Mey Jodhiyaam En Nesare! Neer Thanginaal Raavillaiye

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Mey Jodhiyaam En Nesare! Neer Thanginaal Raavillaiye;
En Nenjuk Kummai Maraikkum Mekam Varaamal Kaaththitum.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Um Nesa Maarpil Endrume Naan Saaindhu Vaazhdhal Inpame,

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Ennotu Thangum Pakalil Sukiyen Neer Illaavitil;
Ennotu Thangum Raavilum, Neer Thaangin Anjen Saavilum.

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: Indraikkuth Thivya Azhaippai Asattai Seydha Paaviyai
Neer Kaivitaamal, Ippodhe Izhuththuk Kollum, Meetpare!

sections.label: Verse 5
lines: Thukkippor Sisu Polave Amarndhu Thoongach Cheyyume.

sections.label: Verse 6
lines: Vizhikkum Podhennarukil, Neer Vandhu Endran Velaiyil
Um Arul Thandhu Kaaththitum En Aayul Kaalam Muzhudhum.

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Far from the rapid pace where God can soothe my troubled mind.
There in my quiet hour with Him my cares are left behind.
New strength and courage there I find;
Then from this quiet place I go prepared to face a new day With love for all mankind.

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Lord Jesus, think on me, And purge away my sin;
From earth-born passions set me free, And make me pure within.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Lord Jesus, think on me, With care and woe oppressed;
Let me Thy loving servant be, And taste Thy promised rest.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Lord Jesus, think on me, Nor let me go astray;
Through darkness and perplexity Point Thou the heavenly way.

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: That I may sing above To Father,
The strains of praise and love.

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: I need the prayers of those I love,
While trav'ling o'er life's rugged way,
That I may true and faithful be,
And live for Jesus every day.

sections.label: Chorus 2
lines: I want my friends to pray for me,
To hold me up on wing of faith,
That I may walk the narrow way,
Kept by our Father's glorious grace.

sections.label: Chorus 1
lines: I want my friends to pray for me,
To bear my tempted soul above,
And intercede with God for me;
I need the prayers of those I love.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: I need the prayers of those I love,
To help me in each trying hour,
To bear my tempted sould to Him,
That He may keep me by His pow'r.

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: A mighty fortress is our God, a bulwark never failing; our helper he amid the flood of mortal ills prevaling.
For still our ancient foe doth seek to work us woe; his craft and power are great, and armed with cruel hate, on earth is not his equal.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Did we in our own strength confide, our striving would be losing, were not the right man on our side, the man of God's own choosing.
Dost ask who that may be?
Lord Sabbaoth, his name, from age to age the same, and he must win the battle.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: And though this world, with devils filled, should threaten to undo us, we will not fear, for God hath willed his truth to triumph through us.
The Prince of Darkness grim, we tremble not for him; his rage we can endure, for lo, his doom is sure; one little word shall fell him.

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: That word above all earthly powers, no thanks to them, abideth; the Spirit and the gifts are ours, thru him who with us sideth.
Let goods and kindred go, this mortal life also; the body they may kill;
God's truth abideth still; his kingdom is forever.

translations.title: கர்த்தர் தான் எங்கள் துர்க்கமும் அரண் பலமுமாமே

sections.label: சரணம் 1
lines: கர்த்தர் தான் எங்கள் துர்க்கமும் அரண் பலமுமாமே;
உண்டாம் இக்கட்டை அனைத்தும் கழிப்பர் அவர் தாமே.

sections.label: சரணம் 2
lines: ஆர்! யேசுக் கிறிஸ்து தான் இந்த மா பலவான்!

sections.label: சரணம் 4
lines: பகைஞர் தெய்வ வார்த்தையைப் பகைத்தும் அது நிற்கும்,
கர்த்தர் சகாயம், அவர் கை வரந் தந்தாதரிக்கும்

translations.title: Karththar Thaan Engal Thurkkamum Aran Palamumaame

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Karththar Thaan Engal Thurkkamum Aran Palamumaame;
Untaam Ikkattai Anaiththum Kazhippar Avar Thaame.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Aar! Yesuk Kirisdhu Thaan Indha Maa Palavaan!

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: Pakaignar Theyva Vaarththaiyaip Pakaiththum Adhu Nirkum,
Karththar Sakaayam, Avar Kai Varan Thandhaadharikkum

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Dying with Jesus, by death reckoned mine, Living with Jesus, a new life divine, Looking to Jesus till glory doth shine, Moment by moment, O Lord, I am Thine.

sections.label: Refrain
lines: Moment by moment I'm kept in His love;
Moment by moment I've life from above;
Looking to Jesus till glory doth shine;
Moment by moment, O Lord, I am Thine.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Never a trial that He is not there,
Never a burden that He doth not bear,
Never a sorrow that He doth not share,
Moment by moment I'm under His care.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Never a heart-ache, and never a groan,
Never a teardrop and never a moan;
Never a danger but there on teh throne,
Moment by moment He thinks of His own.

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: Never a weakness that He doth not feel,
Never a sickness that He cannot heal;
Moment by moment, in woe or in weal,
Jesus, my Savior, abides with me still.

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Anywhere with Jesus I can safely go,
Anywhere He leads me in this world below;
Anywhere without Him dearest joys would fade;
Anywhere with Jesus I am not afraid.

sections.label: Refrain
lines: Anywhere with Jesus I can safely go.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Anywhere with Jesus I am not alone;
Other friends may fail me, He is still my own;
Though His hand may lead me over drearest ways,
Anywhere with Jesus is a house of praise.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Anywhere with Jesus I can go to sleep,
When the darkening shadows round about me creep,
Knowing I shall waken nevermore to roam;
Anywhere with Jesus will be home, sweet home.

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: How firm a foundation, ye saints of the Lord, is laid for your faith in his excellent word!
What more can he say than to you he hath said, to you who for refuge to Jesus have fled?

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: 'Fear not, I am with thee, O be not dismayed, for I am thy God and will still give thee aid;
I'll strengthen and help thee, and cause thee to stand upheld by my righteous, omnipotent hand.'

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: 'When through deep waters I call thee to go, the rivers of woe shall not thee overflow; for I will be with thee, thy troubles to bless, and sanctify to thee thy deepest distress.'

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: 'When through fiery trials thy pathways shall lie, my grace, all-sufficient, shall be thy supply; the flame shall not hurt thee;
I only design thy dross to consume, and thy gold to refine.'

sections.label: Verse 5
lines: 'The soul that on Jesus hath leaned for respose, I will not, I will not depart to His foes;
That soul, though all hell should endeavor to shake, I'll never, no never, no never forsake!'

translations.title: If You But Trust in God to Guide You

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: If you but trust in God to guide you And place your confidence in Him,
You'll find Him always there beside you,
To give you hope and strength within.
For those who trust God's changeless love Build on the rock that will not move.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: What gain is there in futile weeping,
If you are in His care and keeping,
In sorrow will He love you less?
For He who took for you a cross Will bring you safe through every loss.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: In patient trust await His leisure In cheerful hope, with heart content To take whate'er your Father's pleasure And all discerning love have sent;
Doubt not your inmost wants are known To Him who chose you for His own.

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: Sing, pray, and keep His ways unswerving,
And trust His word; though undeserving,
You'll find His promise true to be.
God never will forsake in need The soul that trusts in Him indeed.

translations.title: I Know Whom I Have Believed

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: I know not why God's wondrous grace To me He hath made known,
Christ in love Redeemed me for His own.

sections.label: Refrain
lines: But 'I know whom I have believed, and am persuaded that His is able To keep that which I've committed Unto Him against that day.'

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: I know not how this saving faith To me He did impart,
Nor how believing in His word Wrought peace within my heart.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: I know not how the Spirit moves,

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: I know not when my Lord may come,
Nor if I walk the vale with Him,
Or meet Him in the air.

translations.title: Just When I Need Him Most

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Just when I falter, just when I fear;
Ready to help me, ready to cheer, Just when I need Him most.
Just when I need Him most,
Just when I need Him most,
Jesus is near to comfort and cheer,
Just when I need Him most.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Never forsaking, all the way through,
Just when I need Him most.
Just when I need Him most,
Just when I need Him most,
Jesus is near to comfort and cheer,
Just when I need Him most.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Bearing my burdens all the day long;
For all my sorrow giving a song, Just when I need Him most.
Just when I need Him most,
Just when I need Him most,
Jesus is near to comfort and cheer,
Just when I need Him most.

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: Answering when upon Him I call;
Tenderly watching lest I should fall, Just when I need Him most.
Just when I need Him most,
Just when I need Him most,
Jesus is near to comfort and cheer,
Just when I need Him most.

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: In heavenly love abiding, No change my heart shall fear;
And safe is such confiding, For nothing changes here.
The storm may roar without me, My heart may low be laid;
But God is round about me, And can I be dismayed?

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Wherever He may guide me, No want shall turn me back;
My Shepherd is besided me, And nothing can I lack.
His wisdom ever waketh, His sight is never dim;
He knows the way He taketh, And I will walk with Him.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Green pastures are before me, Which yet I have not seen;
Bright skies will soon be o'er me,
My hope I cannot measure, My path to life is free;
My Savior has my teasure, And He will walk with me.

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Lord of our life, and God of our salvation,
Star of our night, and hope of every nation,
Hear and receive Thy church's supplication,

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Lord, Thou canst help when earthly armor faileth;
Lord, Thou canst save when deadly sin assaileth;
Lord, o'er Thy rock nor death nor hell prevaileth;

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Peace in our hearts our evil thoughts assuaging;
Peace in Thy church, where brothers are engaging;
Peace, when the world its busy war is waging;

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: Grant us Thy help till foes are backward driven;
Grant them Thy truth that they may be forgiven;
Grant peace on earth, and, after we have striven,

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: The Lord is my light; then why should I fear?
By day and by night His presence is near;
He is my salvation from sorrow and sin;
This blessed persuasion the Spirit brings in.

sections.label: Refrain
lines: The Lord is my light, my joy, and my song;
By day and by night He leads me along;
The Lord is my light, my joy, and my song;
By day and by night He leads me along.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: The Lord is my light; though clods may arise,
Faith, stronger than sight, looks up to the skies Where Jesus forever in glory doth reign: Then how can I ever in darkness remain?

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: The Lord is my light, the Lord is my strength;
I know in His might I'll conquer at length;
My weakness in mercy He covers with power,

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: The lord is my light, my all and in all;
There is in His sight no darkness at all;
He is my Redeemer, my Savior and King;
With saints and with angels His praises I sing.

sections.label: பல்லவி
lines: கர்த்தர் என் ஒளி, அவர் என் கீதம்

sections.label: சரணம் 3
lines: கர்த்தர் என் ஒளி, கர்த்தர் என் பெலன்,

sections.label: சரணம் 4
lines: கர்த்தர் என் ஒளி, என் எல்லாம் அவர்,
அவர் என் மீட்பர் ரட்சகர் என் ராஜா,

sections.label: Refrain
lines: Karththar En Oli, Avar En Keedham

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Karththar En Oli, Karththar En Pelan,

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: Karththar En Oli, En Ellaam Avar,
Avar En Meetpar Ratchakar En Raajaa,

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: All the way my Savior leads me;
What have I to ask beside?
Can I doubt His tender mercy, Who through life has been my guide?
Heavenly peace, divinest comfort, Here by faith in Him to dwell;
For I know whate'er befall me, Jesus doeth all things well;
For I know whate'er befall me, Jesus doeth all things well.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: All the way my Savior leads me;
Cheers each winding path I tread;
Gives me grace for every trial, Feeds me with the living bread;
Though my weary steps may falter,
And my soul athirst may be,
Gushing from the Rock before me, Lo, a spring of joy I see;
Gushing from the Rock before me, Lo, a spring of joy I see.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: All the way my Savior leads me;
O the fullness of His love!
Perfect rest to me is promised In my Father's house above;
When I wake to life immortal,
Wing my flight to realms of day,
This my song through endless ages,
Jesus led me all the way;
This my song through endless ages, Jesus led me all the way.

translations.title: யேசு என் வழி நடத்த வேறு ஏதும் வேண்டுமோ?

sections.label: சரணம் 1
lines: யேசு என் வழி நடத்த வேறு ஏதும் வேண்டுமோ?
சென்ற நாள் க்ருபையால் ஆண்ட அவரில் சந்தேகமோ?
தேவ சமாதானம் ஆறுதல் இங் கவரில் தங்கவே;
என்ன நேரிட்டாலும் ஸ்தோத்திரம் யேசின் செயல் நன்மையே.

sections.label: சரணம் 2
lines: யேசு என் வழி நடத்திச் சுழலிலும் தேற்றுறார்;
என் அடி தள்ளாடினாலும், என் ஆத்மா தவிக்கினும்,
பொங்குதே சந்தோஷ ஊற்று; இதோ! கன்மலை நின்றும்.

sections.label: சரணம் 3
lines: யேசு என் வழி நடத்த என்ன பூர்ண பேரன்பு!
வாக்கு சம்பூரண ஆறுதல் என் பிதா வீட்டில் உண்டு.
என் ஆத்துமா சாவாமை போர்த்து இலங்கும் ராஜ்யம் சேர
இதோ என்றன் நித்ய கீதம் வழியெல்லாம் யேசுவே.

translations.title: Yesu En Vazhi Nataththa Veru Edhum Ventumo?

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Yesu En Vazhi Nataththa Veru Edhum Ventumo?
Sendra Naal Krupaiyaal Aanta Avaril Sandhekamo?
Theva Samaadhaanam Aarudhal Ing Kavaril Thangave;
Enna Nerittaalum Sdhoththiram Yesin Seyal Nanmaiye.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Yesu En Vazhi Nataththich Chuzhalilum Thetruraar;
En Ati Thallaatinaalum, En Aadhmaa Thavikkinum,
Pongudhe Sandhosha Ootru; Idho! Kanmalai Nindrum.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Yesu En Vazhi Nataththa Enna Poorna Peranpu!
Vaakku Sampoorana Aarudhal En Pidhaa Veettil Untu.
En Aaththumaa Saavaamai Porththu Ilangum Raajyam Sera
Idho Endran Nidhya Keedham Vazhiyellaam Yesuve.

translations.title: My Faith Looks Up to Thee

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: My faith looks up to thee, thou Lamb of Calvary, Savior divine;
Now hear me while I pray, take all my guilt away,
O let me from this day be wholly Thine.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: May thy rich grace impart strength to my fainting heart, my zeal inspire!
As thou hast died for me,
O may my love to thee pure, warm, and changeless be, a living fire!

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: While life's dark maze I tread, and griefs around me spread, be thou my guide; bid darkness turn to day, wipe sorrow's tears away, nor let me ever stray from Thee aside.

sections.label: சரணம் 1
lines: நீக்கும் என் பாதகம், ஆம் நான் இந்நாள் முதல், உம் அடிமை.

sections.label: சரணம் 2
lines: தொய்யுதே என் மனம், உம் க்ருபையால் தேற்றும்,

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Neekkum En Paadhakam, Aam Naan Innaal Mudhal, Um Atimai.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Thoiyudhe En Manam, Um Krupaiyaal Thetrum,

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Standing on the promises of Christ my King,
Thru eternal ages let His praises ring;
Glory in the highest I will shout and sing,
Standing on the promises of God.

sections.label: Refrain
lines: Standing, standing, Standing on the promises of God my Savior;
Standing, standing, I'm standing on the promises of God.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Standing on the promises that cannot fail,
When the howling storms of doubt and fear assail,
By the living word of God I shall prevail,
Standing on the promises of God.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Standing on the promises of Christ the Lord,
Bound to Him eternally by love's strong cord,
Overcoming daily with the Spirit's sword,
Standing on the promises of God.

translations.title: Give to the Winds Your Fears

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Give to the winds your fears;
In hope be undismayed: God hears your sighs and coundts your tears,
God shall lift up your head.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Your ways put in His hands To His sure truth adn tender care Who earth adn heave commands.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: O put your trust in God;
Walk in His strength with faith and hope, So shall your work be done.

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: Leave to His sovereign sway To choose and to command;
So you shall, faithful, seek His way how wise, how strong His hand!

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: A wonderful Savior is Jesus my Lord, A wonderful Savior to me,
He hideth my soul in the cleft of the rock,
Where rivers of pleasure I see.

sections.label: Refrain
lines: He hideth my soul in the cleft of the rock That shadows a dry, thirsty land; he hideth my life in the depths of His love,
And covers me there with His hand,
And covers me there with His hand.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: A wonderful Savior is Jesus my Lord,
He holdeth me up, and I shall not be moved,
He giveth me strength as my day.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: With numberless blessings each moment He crowns,
And filled with His fullness divine,
I sing in my rapture, Oh,
Glory to God For such a Redeemer as mine.

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: When clothed in His brightness, transported I rise To meet Him in clouds of the sky,
His wonderful love, I'll shout with the millions on high.

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Depth of mercy!'can there be Mercy still reserved for me?
Can my God His wrath forbear?
Me, the chief of sinners, spare?

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: I have long withstood His grace,
Long provoked Him to His face,
Would not hearken to His calls,
Grieved Him by a thousand falls.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Let me now my sins lament;
Now my foul revolt deplore, Weep, believe, and sin no more.

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: There for me the Savior stands,
Shows His wounds and spreads His hands;
Jesus weeps, and loves me still.

translations.title: My Hope Is Built on Nothing Less

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: My hope is built on nothing less than Jesus' blood and righteousness.
I dare not trust the sweetest frame, but wholly lean on Jesus' name.

sections.label: Refrain
lines: On Christ the solid rock I stand; all other ground is sinking sand, all other ground is sinking sand.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: When Darkness veils his lovely face,
I rest on his unchanging grace. in every high and stormy gale, my anchor holds within the veil.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: His oath, his covenant, his blood supports me in the whelming flood.
When all around my soul gives way, he then is all my hope and stay.

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: When He shall come with trumpet sound,
O may I then in him be found!
Dressed in his righteousness alone, faultless to stand before the throne.

translations.title: என் மிட்பர் ரத்தம் சிந்தினார் மா நீதியும் சம்பாதித்தார்

sections.label: சரணம் 1
lines: என் மிட்பர் ரத்தம் சிந்தினார் மா நீதியும் சம்பாதித்தார்;
என் சொந்த நீதி வெறுத்தேன்; யேசுவின் நாமம் நம்புவேன்.

sections.label: சரணம் 2
lines: கார் மேகம் அவர் முகத்தை மறைக்கும் காலம் அவரை

sections.label: சரணம் 3
lines: நியாயத் தீர்ப்புக் காலத்தில் எக்காள சத்தம் கேட்கையில்,
அஞ்சேன், என் மீட்பர் நீதியே அநீதம், எல்லாம் மூடுமே.

translations.title: En Mitpar Raththam Sindhinaar Maa Needhiyum Sampaadhiththaar

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: En Mitpar Raththam Sindhinaar Maa Needhiyum Sampaadhiththaar;
En Sondha Needhi Veruththen; Yesuvin Naamam Nampuven.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Kaar Mekam Avar Mukaththai Maraikkum Kaalam Avarai

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Niyaayath Theerppuk Kaalaththil Ekkaala Saththam Ketkaiyil,
Anjen, En Meetpar Needhiye Aneedham, Ellaam Mootume.

translations.title: My Faith Has Found a Resting Place

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: My faith has found a resting place, Not in a manmade creed;
I trust the ever living One, That He for me shall plead.

sections.label: Refrain
lines: I need no other evidence, I need no other plea;
It is enough that Jesus died, And rose again for me.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Enough for me that Jesus saves, This ends my fear and doubt;
A sinful soul, I come to Him, He will not cast me out.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: My soul is resting on the Word,

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: My great Physician heals the sick, The lost He came to save;
For me His precious blood He shed, For me His life He gave.

translations.title: Tis So Sweet to Trust in Jesus

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: 'Tis so sweet to trust in Jesus, and to take him at his word; just to rest upon his promise, and to know, 'Thus saith the Lord.'

sections.label: Refrain
lines: Jesus, Jesus, how I trust him!
How I've proved him o'er and o'er!
O for grace to trust him more!

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: O how sweet to trust in Jesus, just to trust his cleansing blood; and in simple faith to plunge me neath the healing, cleansing flood!

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Yes, 'tis sweet to trust in Jesus, just from sin and self to cease; just from Jesus simply taking life and rest, and joy and peace.

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: I'm so glad I learned to trust thee, precious Jesus,
Savior, friend; and I know that thou art with me, wilt be with me to the end.

sections.label: பல்லவி
lines: யேசு, யேசு நம்புவேன் நான் சோதித்தேன் பூரணமாய்
யேசு, யேசு நல்ல யேசு! அவர் க்ருபை நம்புவேன்.

sections.label: சரணம் 2
lines: ஆம்! எனக்கு பேர் இன்பந்தான், யேசுவை சார்ந்திருத்தல்;
சாந்தி, ஜீவன், சந்தோஷமும் என்றும் ஈகிறார் இவர்.

sections.label: சரணம் 4
lines: கற்றுக் கொண்டேன் உம்மை நம்ப, பொன்னேசு என் நல் நண்பர்!

sections.label: Refrain
lines: Yesu, Yesu Nampuven Naan Sodhiththen Pooranamaai
Yesu, Yesu Nalla Yesu! Avar Krupai Nampuven.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Aam! Enakku Per Inpandhaan, Yesuvai Saarndhiruththal;
Saandhi, Jeevan, Sandhoshamum Endrum Eekiraar Ivar.

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: Katruk Konten Ummai Nampa, Ponnesu En Nal Nanpar!

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: O safe to the Rock that is higher than I,
My soul in its conflicts and sorrows would fly;
So sinful, so weary, Thine, Thine, would I be;
Thou blest 'Rock of Ages,' I'm hiding in Thee.

sections.label: Refrain
lines: Hiding in Thee, hiding in Thee,
Thou blest 'Rock of Ages,' I'm hiding in Thee.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: In the calm of the noontide, in sorrow's lone hour,
In times when temptation casts over me its power;
In the tempests of life, on its wide, heaving sea,
Thou blest 'Rock of Ages,' I'm hiding in Thee.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: How oft in the conflict, when pressed by the foe,
I have fled to my refuge and breathed out my woe;
How often, when trials like sea billows roll,
O Thou Rock of my soul.

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: God sent His Son, they called His Jesus,
He came to love, heal, and forgive;
He lived and died to buy my pardon, An empty grave is there to prove my Savior lives.

sections.label: Refrain
lines: Because He lives I can face tomorrow,
Because He lives all fear is gone;
Because I know He holds the future.
And life is worth the living just because He lives.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: How sweet to hold a newborn baby,
And feel the pride, and joy He gives;
But greater still the calm assurance,
This child can face uncertain days because He lives.

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: From every stormy wind that blows,
From every swelling tide of woes,
There is a calm, a sure retreat: 'Tis found beneath the mercy seat.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: There is a place where Jesus sheds The oil of gladness on our heads, A place than all besides more sweet;
It is the blood-bought mercy seat.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: There is a scene where spirits blend,
Where friend holds fellowship with friend;
Though sundered far, by faith they meet Around one common mercy seat.

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: There, there, on angel's wings we soar,
And earthly cares molest no more,
And heaven comes down our souls to greet,
And glory crowns the mercy seat.

sections.label: Verse 5
lines: Ah! whither should we flee for aid,
Or how the hosts of sin defeat,
Had suffering saints no mercy seat?

translations.title: A Shelter in the Time of Storm

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: The Lord's our Rock, in Him we hide, A shelter in the time of storm;
Secure whatever ill betide, A shelter in the time of storm.

sections.label: Refrain
lines: Mighty Rock in a weary land,
Cooling shade on the burning sand,
Faithful guide for the pilgrim band' A shelter in the time of storm.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: A shade by day, defense by night, A shelter in the time of storm;
No fears alarm, no foes afright, A shelter in the time of storm.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: The raging storms may round us beat, A shelter in the time of storm We'll never leave our safe retreat, A shelter in the time of storm.

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: O Rock divine, O Refuge dear, A Shelter in the time of storm;
Be Thou our helper ever near, A Shelter in the time of storm.

sections.label: சரணம் 2
lines: பகலில் நிழல் இரவில் அரண் அரண் புயல் ஒதுக்கிடம்

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Pakalil Nizhal Iravil Aran Aran Puyal Odhukkitam

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Under His wings I am safely abiding;
Though the night deepens and tempests are wild,
I know He will keep me; he has redeemed me, and I am His child.

sections.label: Refrain
lines: Under His wings, under His wings, Who from His love can sever?
Under His wings, my soul shall abide, Safely abide forever.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Under His wings, what a refuge in sorrow!
How the heart yearningly turns to its rest!
Often when earth has no balm for my healing,
There I find comfort, and there I am blest.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Under His wings, O what precious enjoyment!
There will I hide till life's trials are over;
Sheltered, protected, no evil can harm me;
Resting in Jesus I'm safe evermore.

translations.title: It Is Well With My Soul

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: When peace, like a river, attendeth my way, when sorrows like sea billows roll; whatever my lot, thou hast taught me to say, It is well, it is well with my soul.

sections.label: Refrain
lines: It is well with my soul, it is well, it is well with my soul.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: My sin'oh, the joy of this glorious thought' My sin, not in part but the whole, is nailed to the cross, and I bear it no more, praise the Lord, praise the Lord, O my soul!

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: And, Lord, haste the day when my faith shall be sight, the clouds be rolled back as a scroll; the trump shall resound, and the Lord shall descend, even so, it is well with my soul.

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: We'll build on the Rock, the living Rock,
On Jesus, the Rock of Ages;
So shall we abide the fearful shock, When loud the tempest rages.

sections.label: Refrain
lines: We'll build on the Rock, We'll build on the Rock;
We'll build on the Rock, on the solid Rock,

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Some build on the sinking sands of life,
Some build on the waves of sin and strife,

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: O build on the Rock, for ever sure,
The firm and the true foundation;
Its hope is the hope which shall endure,

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Day by day, and with each passing moment,
Strength I find, to meet my trials here;
Trusting in my Father's wise bestowment, I've no cause for worry or for fear.
He Whose heart is kind beyond all measure Gives unto each day what He deems best' Lovingly, its part of pain and pleasure,
Mingling toil with peace and rest.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Every day, the Lord Himself is near me With a special mercy for each hour;
All my cares He fain would bear, and cheer me,
He Whose Name is Counselor and Power;
The protection of His child and treasure Is a charge that on Himself He laid;
'As thy days, thy strength shall be in measure,' This the pledge to me He made.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Help me then in every tribulation So to trust Thy promises, O Lord, That I lose not faith's sweet consolation Offered me within Thy holy Word.
Help me, Lord, when toil and trouble meeting, Ever to take, as from a father's hand, One by one, the days, the moments fleeting, Till I reach the promised land.

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: O, for a faith that will not shrink,
Though pressed by many a foe,
That will not tremble on the brink of poverty,

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: That will not murmur or complain Beneath the chastening rod,
But in the hour of grief or pain, of grief or pain Can lean upon its God;

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: A faith that shines more bright and clear When tempests rage without;
That when in danger knows no fear, knows of no fear,

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: That bears unmoved the world's dread frown,
That sin's wild ocean cannot drown, no, cannot drown,

sections.label: Verse 5
lines: Lord, give me such a faith as this,
And then, whate'er may come I'll taste, e'en here the hallowed bliss, the hallowed bliss Of an eternal home;

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Will your anchor hold in the storms of life,
When the clouds unfold their wings of strife?
When the strong tides lift, and the cables strain,
Will your anchor drift or firm remain?

sections.label: Refrain
lines: We have an anchor that keeps the soul Steadfast and sure while the billows roll,
Fastened to the Rock which cannot move,
Grounded firm and deep in the Savior's love.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: It is safely moored, 'twill the storm withstand,
For 'tis well secured by the Savior's hand;
And the cables passed from His heart to mine,
Can defy the blast, through strength divine.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: It will firmly hold in the straits of fear,
When the breakers have told the reef is near;
Though the tempest rave and the wild winds blow,
Not an angry wave shall our bark o'erflow.

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: It will surely hold in the floods of death,
When the waters cold chill our latest breath;
On the rising tide it can never fail,
While our hopes abide within the veil.

sections.label: Verse 5
lines: When our eyes behold, in the dawning light,
Shining gates of pearl, our harbor bright,
We shall anchor fast to the heavenly shore,
With the storms all past forevermore.

translations.title: I Am Trusting Thee, Lord Jesus

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: I am trusting Thee, Lord Jesus, Trusting only Thee;
Trusting Thee for full salvation, Great and free.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: I am trusting Thee for pardon;
For Thy grace and tender mercy, Trusting now.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: I am trusting Thee to guide me;
Every day and hour supplying All my need.

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: I am trusting Thee, Lord Jesus;
I am trusting Thee forever, And for all.

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: God, who stretched the spangled heavens Infinite in time and place,
Flung the suns in burning radiance Through the silent fields of space;
We, Your children in Your likeness, Share inventive powers with You;
Great Creator, still creating, Show us what we yet may do.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: We have ventured worlds undreamed of Since the childhood of our race;
Knowing the ecstasy of winging Through untraveled realms of space,
Probed the secrets of the atom,
Facing us with life's destruction Or our most triumphant hour.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: May it challenge us anew: Children of creative purpose,
May our dreams prove rich with promise;
Great Creator, give us guidance Till our goals and Yours are one.

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: He leadeth me: O blessed thought!
O words with heavenly comfort fraught!
Whate'er I do, where'er I be, still 'tis God's hand that leadeth me.

sections.label: Refrain
lines: He leadeth me, he leadeth me, by his own hand he leadeth me; his faithful follower I would be, for by his hand he leadeth me.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Sometimes mid scenes of deepest gloom, sometimes where Eden's bowers bloom, by waters still, o'er troubled sea, still 'tis his hand that leadeth me.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Lord, I would place my hand in thine, nor ever murmur nor repine; content, whatever lot I see, since 'tis my God that leadeth me.

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: And when my task on earth is done, when by thy grace the victory's won, e'en death's cold wave I will not flee, since God through Jordan leadeth me.

translations.title: நடத்துவார், ஆ! இன்பெண்ணம், மா ஆறுதல் சாரும் வண்ணம்

sections.label: சரணம் 1
lines: நடத்துவார், ஆ! இன்பெண்ணம், மா ஆறுதல் சாரும் வண்ணம்

sections.label: பல்லவி
lines: அவரை நேராய்ப் பின் செல்வேன், தம் கையாலே நடத்துவார்.

sections.label: சரணம் 2
lines: ஓர்வேளை இருள் பாதையில், ஓர்வேளை ஏதேன் பூங்காவில்,
அலை கடல் அமைவிலும் அவர் நேசக் கை நடத்தும்.

sections.label: சரணம் 3
lines: கர்த்தா நீர் என் கை பிடிப்பின்; திருப்தியால் குறை பேசேன்;
எந்த நிலையும் பூரணம்; நீரே எனக்குத் தாரகம்.

translations.title: Nataththuvaar, Aa! Inpennam, Maa Aarudhal Saarum Vannam

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Nataththuvaar, Aa! Inpennam, Maa Aarudhal Saarum Vannam

sections.label: Refrain
lines: Avarai Neraaip Pin Selven, Tham Kaiyaale Nataththuvaar.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Orvelai Irul Paadhaiyil, Orvelai Edhen Poongaavil,
Alai Katal Amaivilum Avar Nesak Kai Nataththum.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Karththaa Neer En Kai Pitippin; Thirupdhiyaal Kurai Pesen;
Endha Nilaiyum Pooranam; Neere Enakkuth Thaarakam.

translations.title: Guide Me, O Thou Great Jehovah

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Guide me, O thou great Jehovah, pilgrim through this barren land.
I am weak, but thou art mighty; hold me with thy powerful hand.
Bread of heaven, bread of heaven, feed me till I want no more; feed me till I want no more.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Open now the crystal fountain, whence the healing stream doth flow; let the fire and cloudy pillar lead me all my journey through.
Strong deliverer, strong deliverer, be thou still my strength and shield; be thou still my strength and shield.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: When I tread the verge of Jordan, bid my anxious fears subside; death of death and hell's destruction, land me safe on Canaan's side.
Songs of praises, songs of praises, I will ever give to thee;
I will ever give to thee.

translations.title: பாதை காட்டும் மா யேகோவா! பரதேசியான நான்

sections.label: சரணம் 1
lines: பாதை காட்டும் மா யேகோவா! பரதேசியான நான்

sections.label: சரணம் 2
lines: ஜீவ தண்ணீர் ஊறும் ஊற்றை நீர் திறந்து தாருமே;
தீப மேக ஸ்தம்பங் காட்டும் வழியில் நடத்துமே;

sections.label: சரணம் 3
lines: சாவின் சக்தி ஓங்கி வந்து நான் அழிந்து போகிலும்
சாவின் மேலும் வெற்றி தந்து; என்னைச் சேர்க்கும் காலத்தில்

translations.title: Paadhai Kaattum Maa Yekovaa! Paradhesiyaana Naan

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Paadhai Kaattum Maa Yekovaa! Paradhesiyaana Naan

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Jeeva Thanneer Oorum Ootrai Neer Thirandhu Thaarume;
Theepa Meka Sdhampang Kaattum Vazhiyil Nataththume;

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Saavin Sakdhi Ongi Vandhu Naan Azhindhu Pokilum
Saavin Melum Vetri Thandhu; Ennaich Cherkkum Kaalaththil

translations.title: I Will Early Seek the Savior

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: I will early seek the Savior, I will learn of Him each day;
I will follow in His footsteps, I will walk the narrow way.

sections.label: Refrain
lines: For He loves me, yes, He loves me, Jesus loves me, this I know.
Jesus loves me, died to save me, This is why I love Him so.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: I will hasten where He bids me,
I am not too young to go In the pathway where He leadeth,
Not too young His will to know.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: He is standing at the doorway Of escape from every sin;
I will knock, for He has promised, He will hear and let me in.

sections.label: சரணம் 2
lines: அவர் என்னை அனுப்பிடும் இடம் நோக்கி விரைவேன்.
அவர் என்னை நடத்திடும் பாதை நான் அறிகிறேன்.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Avar Ennai Anuppitum Itam Nokki Viraiven.
Avar Ennai Nataththitum Paadhai Naan Arikiren.

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Gentle Jesus, meek and mild, Look upon a little child;
Pity my simplicity, Suffer me to come to Thee.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Lamb of God, I look to Thee;
Thou art gentle, meek, and mild, Thou wast once a little child.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Fain I would be as Thou art;
Thou art pitiful and kind, Let me have Thy loving mind.

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: I shall then show forth Thy praise, Serve Thee all my happy days;
Then the world shall always see Christ, the Holy Child, in me.

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Lord, speak to me, that I may speak in living echoes of thy tone; as thou has sought, so let me seek thine erring children lost and lone.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: O lead me, Lord, that I may lead the wandering and the wavering feet;
O feed me, Lord, that I may feed thy hungering ones with manna sweet.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: O strengthen me, that while I stand firm on the rock, and strong in thee,
I may stretch out a loving land to wrestlers with the troubled sea.

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Jesus, Friend, so kind and gentle, Little ones we bring to Thee: Grant to them Thy dearest blessing, Let Thine arms around them be;
Now enfold them in Thy goodness, From all danger keep them free.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Thou who did receive the children To Thyself so tenderly,
Give to all who teach and guide them Wisdom and humility.
Vision true to keep them noble, Love to serve them faithfully.

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Jesus, Friend of little children, Be a friend to me;
Take my hand and ever keep me Close to Thee.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Teach me how to grow in goodness, Daily as I grow;
Thou hast been a child, and surely Thou dost know.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Step by step, O, lead me onward, Upward into youth;
Wiser, stronger, still becoming In Thy truth.

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: Never leave me, nor forsake me;
For I need Thee from life's dawning To its end.

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Jesus, Son of blessed Mary, Once on earth a little child, Pattern fair of holy living, Gracious, loving, undefiled;

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Though Thy eager heart was yearning Heavy laden souls to free,
Yet Thou calledst little children In their happiness to Thee.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Grant that we, like little children,
Free from pride and guile my be;
Cheerful, trusting, safe, protected By the blessed Trinity.

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Savior, like a shepherd lead us, much we need thy tenderest care; in thy pleasant pastures feed us, for our use thy folds prepare.
Thou hast bought us, thine we are.
Thou hast bought us, thine we are.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: We are thine, thou dost befriend us, be the guardian of our way; keep thy flock, from sin defend us, seek us when we go astray.
Hear, O hear us when we pray.
Hear, O hear us when we pray.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Thou hast promised to receive us, poor and sinful though we be; thou hast mercy to relieve us, grace to cleanse and power to free.
We will early turn to thee.
We will early turn to thee.

translations.title: ரட்சா பெருமானே பாரும் புண்ய பாதம் அண்டினோம்.

sections.label: சரணம் 1
lines: ரட்சா பெருமானே பாரும் புண்ய பாதம் அண்டினோம்.
சுத்தமாக்கிச் சீரைத் தாரும் தேடி வந்து நிற்கிறோம்.
யேசு நாதா! யேசு நாதா! உன்றன் சொந்த மாயினோம் (2)

sections.label: சரணம் 2
lines: மேய்ப்பன் போல முந்திச் சென்றும் பாது காத்தும் வருவீர்
யேசு நாதா! யேசு நாதா! நித்தம் போஷிப்பிக்கிறீர் (2)

sections.label: சரணம் 3
lines: யேசு நாதா! யேசு நாதா! ஓரு போதும் கைவிடீர் (2)

sections.label: சரணம் 4
lines: பின்பு திவ்ய பேரானந்தம் தந்து வாழச் செய்குவீர்.
யேசு நாதா! யேசு நாதா! ஊழி காலம் வாழ்விப்பீர் (2)

translations.title: Ratchaa Perumaane Paarum Punya Paadham Antinom.

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Ratchaa Perumaane Paarum Punya Paadham Antinom.
Suththamaakkich Cheeraith Thaarum Theti Vandhu Nirkirom.
Yesu Naadhaa! Yesu Naadhaa! Undran Sondha Maayinom (2)

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Meyppan Pola Mundhich Chendrum Paadhu Kaaththum Varuveer
Yesu Naadhaa! Yesu Naadhaa! Niththam Poshippikkireer (2)

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Yesu Naadhaa! Yesu Naadhaa! Oru Podhum Kaiviteer (2)

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: Pinpu Thivya Peraanandham Thandhu Vaazhach Cheykuveer.
Yesu Naadhaa! Yesu Naadhaa! Oozhi Kaalam Vaazhvippeer (2)

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: The Lord's my shepherd, I'll not want He makes me down to lie In pastures green; he leadeth me The quiet waters by.
He leadeth me, He leadeth me The quiet waters by.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: My soul he doth restore again And me to walk doth make Within the paths of righteousness Even for his own name's sake.
Within the paths of righteousness Even for his own name's sake.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Yea, though I walk through death's dark vale Yet will I fear no ill For thou art with me, and thy rod And staff me comfort still.
For thou art with me, and thy rod And staff me comfort still.

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: My table thou has furnished In presence of my foes;
My head thou dost with oil anoint And my cup overflows.
My head thou dost with oil anoint And my cup overflows.

sections.label: Verse 5
lines: Goodness and mercy all my life Shall surely follow me,
And in God's house for evermore My dwelling-place shall be.
And in God's house for evermore My dwelling-place shall be.

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Be Thou my Vision, O Lord of my heart;
Naught be all else to me, save that Thou art Thou my best Thought, by day or by night,

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Be Thou my Wisdom, and Thou my true Word;
I ever with Thee and Thou with me, Lord;
Thou my great Father, I Thy true son;
Thou in me dwelling, and I with Thee one.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Riches I heed not, nor man's empty praise,
Thou mine Inheritance, now and always: Thou and Thou only, first in my heart,
High King of Heaven, my Treasure Thou art.

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: High King of Heaven, my victory won,
Heart of my own heart, whatever befall,

sections.label: சரணம் 1
lines: என் இதயத்தின் நாதா, என் தரிசனம் நீரே,

sections.label: சரணம் 2
lines: என் மகா பிதாவே, நான் உம் பிள்ளை,

translations.title: Now Praise the Hidden God of Love

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Now praise the hidden God of love In whom we all must live and move,
Who shepherds us, at every stage Thro' youth, maturity, and age.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Who challenged us, when were young To storm the citadels of wrong;
In care for others taught us how God's true community must grow.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Who bids us never lose our zest,
Tho' age is urging us to rest,
But proves to us that we have still A work to do, a place to fill.

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: Then talk no more of wasted time,
But Godward look, and upward climb,
Content to sleep, when day is done,
And rise refreshed, and travel on.

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Loving Shepherd of Thy sheep, Keep Thy lamb, in safety keep;
None can pluck me from Thy hand.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Loving Shepherd, ever near, Teach Thy lamb Thy voice to hear;
Suffer not my steps to stray From the straight and narrow way.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Where Thou leadest I would go,
Till within the heavenly fold I my Shepherd shall behold.

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Tell of beauty God has giv'n for me: Throughout my life may beauty be Deep within a heart from sin set free.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Guide my thoughts, my life, in my walk with Thee,
That day by day the world may see Christ, the Lord and Savior, lives in me.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: I shall sing and praise God the Father,
Spirit, and Christ with the Son.
Grant faith when life on earth is done,
I shall sing with those whose rest is won.

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Jesus, Savior, pilot me over life's tempestuous sea; unknown waves before me roll, hiding rock and treacherous shoal.
Chart and compass come from thee;

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: As a mother stills her child, thou canst hush the ocean wild; boisterous waves obey thy will, when thou sayest to them, 'Be still!' Wondrous sovreign of the sea, Jesus, Savior, pilot me.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: When at last I near the shore, and the fearful breakers roar 'twixt me and the peaceful rest, then, while leaning on thy breast, may I hear thee say to me, 'Fear not,

sections.label: சரணம் 1
lines: என்னைத் தாங்கி நிற்கிறீர்; நேச நாதா! காக்கிறீர்.

sections.label: சரணம் 2
lines: வாரி போன்ற லோகத்தில் யாத்ரை செய்து போகையில்,
சூறைக் காற்று மோதினும், ஆழி கோஷ்ட மாயினும்,

sections.label: சரணம் 3
lines: சற்று தூரம் செல்லவே, தேவ ராஜ்யம் தோன்றுமே;
துன்பம் நீங்கி வாழுவேன்; இன்பம் பெற்று, போற்றுவேன்;

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Ennaith Thaangi Nirkireer; Nesa Naadhaa! Kaakkireer.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Vaari Pondra Lokaththil Yaadhrai Seydhu Pokaiyil,
Sooraik Kaatru Modhinum, Aazhi Koshta Maayinum,

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Satru Thooram Sellave, Theva Raajyam Thondrume;
Thunpam Neengi Vaazhuven; Inpam Petru, Potruven;

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: The Lord's my Shepherd, I'll not want.
He makes me down to lie In pastures green;
He leadeth me The quiet waters by.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: My soul He doth restore again.
And me to walk doth make Within the paths of righteousness, E'en for His own name's sake.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Yea, though I walk in death's dark vale,
Yet will I fear no ill,
For Thou art with me; and Thy rod And staff me comfort still.

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: My table Thou hast furnished In presence of my foes;
My head Thou dost with oil anoint, And my cup overflows.

sections.label: Verse 5
lines: Goodness and mercy all my life Shall surely follow me;
And in God's house forevermore My dwelling place shall be.

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Jesus, guide our way To eternal day: So shall we, no more delaying,
Thy voice obeying: Lead us by the hand To our Father's land.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: When we danger meet Steadfast make our feet;
Lord, preserve us uncomplaining Mid the darkness round us reigning: Through adversity lies our way to Thee.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Order all our way Through the mortal day: In our toil, with aid be near us: In our need, with succour cheer us: Till we safely stand In our Father's land.

sections.label: சரணம் 1
lines: கேட்டில் விழுந்தோர்க்கு ஞான ஒளி, ஜீவன், மீட்புமான

sections.label: சரணம் 2
lines: பாவம் யாவையுந் தொலைக்க, ஆக்கினை எல்லாம் விலக்க,

sections.label: சரணம் 4
lines: எனக்காய் ஆயத்தம் பண்ணும் வாசஸ்தலம், நித்ய வாழ்வும்

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Kettil Vizhundhorkku Gnaana Oli, Jeevan, Meetpumaana

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Paavam Yaavaiyun Tholaikka, Aakkinai Ellaam Vilakka,

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: Enakkaai Aayaththam Pannum Vaasasdhalam, Nidhya Vaazhvum

translations.title: O Let Me Walk With Thee

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: O let me walk with Thee, my God, As Enoch walked in days of old;
Place Thou my trembling hand in Thine,
And sweet communion with me hold;
E'en though the path I may not see, Yet, Jesus, let me walk with Thee.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: I cannot, dare not, walk alone;
The tempest rages in the sky, A thousand snares beset my feet, A thousand foes are lurking nigh.
Still Thou the raging of the sea,
O Master! let me walk with Thee.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: If I may rest my hand in Thine, I'll count the joys of earth but loss,
I'll bear the banner of the cross Till Zion's glorious gates I see;
Yet, Savior, let me walk with Thee.

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: We come Thy name to sin,
Hither our children bring To shout Thy praise.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Thou are our holy Lord, Thee all subduing Word, Healer of strife;
That from sin's deep disgrace Thou mightest save our race,

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Thou are the great High Priest;
Thou has prepared the feast Of heavenly love;
While in our mortal pain None call on Thee in vain;
Help Thou does not disdain, Help from above.

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: Jesus, Thou Christ of God, By Thy perennial word, Lead us where Thou hast trod, Make our faith strong.

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: As saints of old their first fruits brought Of orchard, flock, and field To God the giver all good,
So we today first fruits would bring: The wealth of this good land,
Of farm and market, shop and home,
Of mind, and heart, and hand.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: A world in need now summons us To labor, love, and give;
To make our life an offering To God, that all may live.
The Church of Christ is calling us To make the dream come true: A world redeemed by Christ-like love;
All life in Christ made new.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: In gratitude and humble trust We bring our best today,
To serve Your cause and share Your love With all along life's way.
O God, who gave yourself to us In Jesus Christ Your Son,
Teach us to give ourselves each day Until life's work is done.

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Come, ye thankful people, come, Raise the song of harvest home;
All is safely gathered in, Ere the winter storms begin.
God our Maker doth provide For our wants to be supplied;
Come to God's own temple, come;
Raise the song of harvest home!

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: We ourselves are God's own field, Fruit unto His praise to yield;
Wheat and tares together sown, Unto joy or sorrow grown;
First the blade and then the ear,
Then the full corn shall appear;
Grant, O harvest Lord, that we Wholesome grain and pure may be.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: For the Lord our God shall come, And shall take His harvest home;
From His field shall purge away All that doth offend, that day;
Give His angels charge at last In the fire the tares to cast;
But the fruitful ears to store In His garner evermore.

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: Raise the song of harvest home;
Free from sorrow, free from sin,
Come, ten thousand angels, come, Raise the glorious harvest home!

translations.title: For the Fruits of His Creation

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: For the fruits of His creation, thanks be to God;
For the gifts to every nation, thanks be to God;
Silent growth while men are sleeping,
Future needs in earth's safe keeping, thanks be to God!

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: In the just reward of labor, God's will is done;
In the hop we give our neighbor, God's will is done;
In our worldwide take of caring For the hungry and despairing,
In the harvests men are sharing,

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: For the harvests of His Spirit, thanks be to God;
For the good all men inherit, thanks be to God;
For the wonders that astound us,
For the truths that still confound us,
Most of all, that love has found us, thanks be to God!

translations.title: Now Thank We All Our God

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Now thank we all our God with heart and hands and voices, who wondrous things hath done, in whom His world rejoices;
Who, from our mothers' arms hath blessed us on our way with countless gifts of love, and still is ours today.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: O may this bounteous God through all our life be near us, with ever joyful hearts and blessed peace to cheer us; and keep us still in grace, and guide us when perplexed; and free us from all ills, in this world and the next.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: All praise and thanks to God the Father now be given; the Son, and Him who reigns with them in highest heaven; the one eternal God, whom earth and heaven adore; for thus it was, is now, and shall be evermore.

sections.label: சரணம் 1
lines: அநேக நன்மையால் ஆட் கொண்ட நம் பிரானை,

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Aneka Nanmaiyaal Aat Konta Nam Piraanai,

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Let all things now living a song of thanksgiving To God the Creator triumphantly raise,
Who fashioned and made us, protected and stayed us,
Who guideth us on to the end of our days.
His light goes before us, A pillar of fire shining forth in the night, 'Til shadows have vanished and darkness is banished, as forward we travel from light into light.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: His law He enforces: the stars in their courses,
The sun in His orbit, obediently shine;
The hills and the mountains, the rivers and fountains,
The deeps of the ocean proclaim Him divine,
We too should be voicing our love and rejoicing,
With glad adoration a song let us raise, 'Til all things now living unite in thanksgiving To God in the highest, hosanna and praise.

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: We plow the fields, and scatter the good seed on the land,
But it is fed and watered by God's almighty hand.
He sends the snow in winter, the warmth to swell the grain,
The breezes and the sunshine, and soft refreshing rain.

sections.label: Refrain
lines: All good gifts around us Are sent from heaven above;
Then thank the Lord, O thank the Lord For all His love.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: He only is the Maker of all things near and far;
He paints the wayside flower, He lights the evening star.
The winds and waves obey Him, by Him the birds are fed;
Much more, to us His children, He gives our daily bread.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: O Father, for all things bright and good,
The seed-time and the harvest, our life, our health, and food.
Accept the gifts we to offer for all Thy love imparts,
And, what Thou most desirest, our humble, thankful hearts.

translations.title: Come, Sing a Song of Harvest

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Come, sing a song of harvest, Of thanks for daily food!
To offer God the first-fruits is old as gratitude.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Long, long ago, the reapers, before they kept the feast,
Put first-fruits in a basket, and took it to the priest.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Shall we, sometimes forgetful oh where creation starts,
With science in our pockets lose wonder from our hearts?

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: May God, the great Creator, to whom all life belongs,
Accept these gifts we offer, our service and our songs.

sections.label: Verse 5
lines: And lest the world go hungry while we ourselves are fed,
Make each of us more ready to share our daily bread.

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Praise and thanksgiving let everyone bring Unto our Father for every good thing.

translations.title: For Sunrise Hope and Sunset Calm

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: For sunrise hope and sunset calm, and all that lies between,
For all the sweetness and the balm that is and that has been,
For comradeship for peace in strife, and light on darkened days;
For work to do and strength for life we sing our hymn of praise.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: But O, we press far, far above these gifts of pure delight,
And find in Thee, and in Thy love contentment infinite.
O Lord, beloved, in whom are found all joys of time and place,
What will it be when joy is crowned by vision of Thy face?

translations.title: For the Beauty of the Earth

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: For the beauty of the earth, for the glory of the skies, for the love which from our birth over and around us lies;
Lord of all, to Thee we raise this our grateful song of praise.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: For the joy of human love, brother, sister, parent, child, friends on earth and friends above,
Lord of all, to Thee we raise this our grateful song of praise.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: For the gift of Thy dear Son, for the hope of heaven at last, for the Spirit's victory won,
For the crown when life is past,
Lord of all, to Thee we raise Songs of gratitude and praise.

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Father, we thank You for the light that shines all the day;
For the bright sky You have given most like Your heaven;

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Father, we thank You for the lamps that lighten the way;
For human skill's exploration of Your creation;

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Father, we thank You for the friends who brighten our play;
For Your command to call others sisters and brothers;

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: Father, we thank You for Your love in Jesus today,
Giving us hope for tomorrow through joy and sorrow;

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Thou art the potter, I am the clay.
Mold me and make me after thy will, while I am waiting, yielded and still.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Search me and try me, Savior today!
Lord, wash me just now, as in thy presence humbly I bow.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Wounded and weary, help me I pray!
Power, all power, surely is thine!
Touch me and heal me, Savior divine!

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: Hold o'er my being absolute sway.
Fill with thy Spirit till all shall see Christ only, always, living in me!

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Make me a captive, Lord, and then I shall be free;
Force me to render up my sword, and I shall conqueror be.
I sink in life's alarms when by myself I stand;
Imprison me within Thine arms, and strong shall be my hand.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: My heart is weak and poor until it amaster find;
It has no spring of action sure, it varies with the wind.
It cannot freely move till Thou has wrought its chain;
Enslave it with Thy matchless love, and deathless it shall reign.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: My will is not my own till Thou hast made it Thine;
If it would reach a monarch's throne, it must its crown resign;
It only stands unbent, amid the clashing strife,
When on Thy bosom it has leant, and found in Thee its life.

translations.title: Pass Me Not, O Gentle Savior

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: O gentle Savior, hear my humble cry; while on others thou art calling, do not pass me by.

sections.label: Refrain
lines: Savior, Savior, hear my humble cry; while on others thou art calling, do not pass me by.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Let me at thy throne of mercy find a sweet relief, kneeling there in deep contrition; help my unbelief.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Trusting only in thy merit, would I seek thy face; heal my wounded, broken spirit, save me by thy grace.

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: Thou the spring of all my comfort, more than life to me, whom have I on earth beside thee?

translations.title: யேசு ஸ்வாமி! அருள் நாதா! கெஞ்சிக் கேட்கிறேன்

sections.label: சரணம் 1
lines: யேசு ஸ்வாமி! அருள் நாதா! கெஞ்சிக் கேட்கிறேன்,

sections.label: சரணம் 3
lines: தீய குணம் க்ரியை யாவும் முற்றும் வெறுத்தேன்;

translations.title: Yesu Svaami! Arul Naadhaa! Kenjik Ketkiren

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Yesu Svaami! Arul Naadhaa! Kenjik Ketkiren,

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Theeya Kunam Kriyai Yaavum Mutrum Veruththen;

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Not I, but Christ, be honored, loved, exalted;
Not I, but Christ, be seen, be known, be heard;
Not I, but Christ, in every look and action,
Not I, but Christ, in every thought and word.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Not I, but Christ, to gently soothe in sorrow,
Not I, but Christ, to wipe the falling tear;
Not I, but Christ, to lift the weary burden,
Not I, but Christ, to hush away all fear.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Christ, only Christ; no needless bustling sound;
Christ, only Christ, no self important bearing;
Christ, only Christ, no trace of 'I' be found.

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: Not I, but Christ, my every need supplying,
Not I, but Christ, my strength and health to be;
Christ, only Christ, for body, soul, and spirit,
Christ, only Christ, here and eternally.

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: What does the Lord require for praise and offering?
What sacrifice, desire or tribute bid you bring?

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Will God your pleading hear, while crime and cruelty grow?

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: How shall our life fulfill God's law so hard and high?
Let Christ endue our will with grace to fortify.
Then justly, in mercy we'll humbly walk with God.

translations.title: Give of Your Best to the Master

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Give of your best to the master,
Give of the strength of your youth;
Throw your soul's fresh, glowing ardor Into the battle for truth.
Jesus has set the example - Dauntless was He, young and brave;
Give Him your loyal devotion, Give Him the best that you have.

sections.label: Refrain
lines: Give of your best to the master,
Give of the strength of your youth;
Clad in salvation's full armor, Join in the battle for truth.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Give of your best to the Master,
Give Him first place in your heart;
Give Him first place in your service, Consecrate every part.
Give, and to you shall be given - God His beloved Son gave;
Gratefully seeking to serve Him, Give Him the best that you have.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Give of your best to the Master, Naught else is worthy His love;
He gave Himself for your ransom, Have up His glory above;
Laid down His life without murmur, You from sin's ruin to save;
Give Him your heart's adoration, Give Him the best that you have.

translations.title: I'll Go Where You Want Me to Go

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: It may not be on the mountain height Or over the stormy sea, It may not be at the battle's front My Lord will have need of me.
But if, by a still, small voice he calls To paths that I do not know, I'll answer, dear Lord, with my hand in thine;
I'll go where you want me to go.

sections.label: Refrain
lines: I'll go where you want me to go, dear Lord,
Over mountain or plain or sea;
I'll say what you want me to say, dear Lord;
I'll be what you want me to be.
