sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Perhaps today there are loving words Which Jesus would have me speak There may be now in the paths of sin Some wand'rer whom I should seek.
O Savior, if thou wilt be my guide,
Tho dark and rugged the way,
My voice shall echo the message sweet;
I'll say what you want me to say.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: There's surely somewhere a lowly place In earth's harvest fields so wide Where I may labor through life's short day For Jesus, the Crucified.
So trusting my all to thy tender care,
And knowing thou lovest me, I'll do thy will with a heart sincere: I'll be what you want me to be.

translations.title: O Master, Let Me Walk With Thee

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: O Master, let me walk with thee in lowly paths of service free; tell me thy secret; help me bear the strain of toil, the fret of care.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Help me the slow of heart to move by some clear, winning word of love; teach me the wayward feet to stay, and guide them in the homeward way.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Teach me thy patience; still with thee in closer, dearer company, in work that keeps faith sweet and strong, in trust that triumphs over wrong;

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: In hope that sends a shining ray far down the future's broadening way, in peace that only thou canst give, with thee,

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Let your heart be broken for a world in need: Feed the mouths that hunger, soothe the wounds that bleed,
Give the cup of water and the loaf of bread Be the hands of Jesus, serving in His stead.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Here on earth applying principles of love,
Visible expression ' God still rules above Living illustration of the Living Word To the minds of all who've Never seen or heard.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Blest to be a blessing privileged to care,
Challenged by the need apparent everywhere.
Where mankind is wanting, fill the vacant place.
Be the means through which the Lord reveals His grace.

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: Add to your believing deeds that prove it true,
Knowing Christ as Savior, make Him Master, too.
Follow in His footsteps, go where He has trod;
In the world's great trouble risk yourself for God.

sections.label: Verse 5
lines: Let your heart be tender and your vision clear;
See mankind as God sees, serve Him far and near.
Let your heart be broken by a brother's pain;
Share your rich resources, give and give again.

translations.title: Awake, Awake to Love and Work

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Awake, awake to love and work!
The lark is in the sky;
The fields are wet with diamond dew;
The worlds awake to cry Their blessings on the Lord of life,

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Come, let thy voice be one with theirs,
Shout with their shout of praise;
See how the giant sun soars up, Great lord of years and days!
So let the love of Jesus come And set thy soul ablaze.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: To give and give, and give again, What God hath given thee;
To spend thyself nor count the cost;
To serve right gloriously The God who gave all worlds that are,
And all that are to be.

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: In the heart of Jesus there is love for you,
Love most pure and tender, love most deep and true;
Why should you be lonely, why for friendship sigh,
When the heart of Jesus has a full supply?

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: In the mind of Jesus there is thought for you,
Warm as summer sunshine, sweet as morning dew;
Why should you be fearful, why take anxious thought,
Since the mind of Jesus cares for those He bought?

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: In the field of Jesus there is work for you;
Such as even angels might rejoice to do;
Why stand idly sighing for some lifework grand,
While the field of Jesus seeks your reaping hand?

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: In the home of Jesus there's a place for you;
Glorious, bright, and joyous, calm and peaceful too;
Why then, like a wanderer, roam with weary pace, If the home of Jesus holds for you a place?

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: So sent I you- by grace made strong to triumph O'er hosts of hell, o'er darkness, death, and sin,
May name to bear, and in that name to conquer- So send I you,

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: So send I you- to take to souls in bondage The word of truth that sets the captive fee,
To break the bonds of sin, to loose dearth's fetters- So send I you, to bring the lost to Me.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: So send I you- My strength to know in weakness, My joy in grief, my perfect peace in pain, To prove My power, My grace, My promised presence- So send I you, eternal fruit to gain.

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: 'Tis love that makes us happy, 'Tis love that smooths the way;
It helps us mind, it makes us kind To others every day.

sections.label: Refrain
lines: God is love; we're his little children.
God is love; we would be like Him.
'Tis love that makes us happy, 'Tis love that smooths the way;
It helps us 'mind,' it makes us kind To others every day.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: This world is full of sorrow, Of sickness, death, and sin;
With loving heart we'll do our part, And try some soul to win.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: And when this life is over,
And we are called above Our song shall be, eternally,

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: This little light of mine, I'm going to let it shine, (shine) This little light of mine, I'm going to let it shine, (shine) This little light of mine, I'm going to let it shine,
Let it shine, let it shine, let it shine.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Every where I go, I'm going to let it shine, (shine) Every where I go, I'm going to let it shine, (shine) Every where I go, I'm going to let it shine,
Let it shine, let it shine, let it shine.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: All through the night, I'm going to let it shine, (shine) All through the night, I'm going to let it shine, (shine) All through the night, I'm going to let it shine,
Let it shine, let it shine, let it shine.

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: When the church of Jesus shuts its outer door,
Lest the roar of traffic drown the voice of prayer: May our prayers,
Lord make up ten times more aware That the world we banish is our Christian care.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: If our hearts are lifted where devotion soars High above this hungry suffering world of ours: Lest our hymns should drug us to forget its needs,
Forge our Christian worship into Christian deeds.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Lest the gifts we offer, money, talents, time,
Serve to salve our conscience to our secret shame: Lord, reprove, inspire us by the way you give;
Teach us, dying Savior, how true Christians live.

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Working, O Christ, with Thee, working with Thee, Unworthy, sinful, weak, though we may be;
Our all to Thee we give, for Thee alone we live,
And by Thy grace achieve, working with Thee.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Along the city's waste, working with Thee,
Our eager footsteps haste, like Thee to be;
The poor we gather in, the outcasts raise from sin,
And labor souls to win, working with Thee.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Savior, we weary not, working with Thee,
As hard as Thine our lot can never be;
Our joy and comfort this, 'Thy grace sufficent is;' This changes toil to bliss, working with Thee.

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: So let us labor on, working with Thee,
Till earth to Thee is won, from sin set free;
Till men, from shore to shore, receive Thee, and adore,
And join us evermore, working with Thee.

sections.label: சரணம் 2
lines: உம் க்ருபை போதுமேன் உம் வாக்கே ஆறுதல்,

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Um Krupai Podhumen Um Vaakke Aarudhal,

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: You that know the Lord is gracious,
You for whom a cornerstone Stands, of God elect and precious,
Laid that you may build there-on,
See that on that sure foundation You a living temple raise.
Towers that may tell forth salvation,

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Living stones by God appointed Each to his allotted place,
Kings and priests, by God anointed,
Shall you not declare His grace?
Tell the tidings of your birth,
Tidings of a new creation To an old and weary earth.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Tell the praise of Him who called you Out of darkness into light,
Broke the fetters that enthralled you,
Gave you freedom, peace, and sight: Tell the tale of sins forgiven,
Till the earth, in tune with heaven,

translations.title: There's a Spirit in the Air

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: There's a Spirit in the air, telling Christians everywhere 'Praise the love that Christ revealed, living, working in our world.'

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Lose your shyness, find your tongue; tell the world what God has done: God in Christ has come to stay, we can see His pow'r today.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: When believers break the bread, when a hungry child is fed: Praise the love that Christ revealed, living, working in our world.

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: Still His Spirit leads the fight, seeing wrong and setting right: God in Christ has come to stay, we can see His pow'r today.

sections.label: Verse 5
lines: When a stranger's not alone, where the homeless find a home,
Praise the love that Christ revealed, living, working in our world.

sections.label: Verse 6
lines: May His Spirit fill our praise, guide our thoughts and change our ways.
God in Christ has come to stay, we can see His power today.

sections.label: Verse 7
lines: There's a Spirit in the air, calling people everywhere;
Praise the love that Christ revealed: living, working in our world.

translations.title: When Christ Was Lifted From the Earth

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: When Christ was lifted from the earth His arms stretched out above Through every culture, every birth, to draw an answering love.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Still east and west His love extends and always, near or far,
He calls and claims us as His friends and loves us as we are.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Where generation, class, or race divides us to our shame,
He sees not labels but a face, a person and a name.

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: Thus freely loved, tho' fully known, may I in Christ be free To welcome and accept His own as Christ accepted me.

translations.title: What Joy It Is to Worship Here

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: What joy it is to worship here,
Where God, who uses every gift,
Has room for all who come!

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Yet are no two of us alike Of all the human race,
And we must seek a common ground If we would share His grace.

translations.title: In Christ There Is No East nor West

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: In Christ there is no east nor west, In Him no south or north;
But one great fellowship of love Throughout the whole wide earth.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: In Him shall true heart everywhere Their high communion find;
His service is the golden cord Close binding all mankind.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Join hands, then, brothers of the faith,
Who serves my Father as a son Is surely kin to me.

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: In Christ now meet both east and west,
In Him meet south and north;
All Christly souls are one in Him Throughout the whole wide earth.

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Lord of all nations, grant me grace To love all people, every race,
And in each person may I see My kindred loved, redeemed by Thee.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Break down the wall that would divide Thy children,
My neighbor's good let me pursue;
Let Christian love bind warm and true.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Forgive me, Lord, where I have erred By loveless act and thoughtless word.
Make me to see the wrong I do Will crucify my Lord anew.

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: Lord, to speak Whenever strong oppress the weak.
Should I myself the victim be, Help me forgive, remembering Thee.

sections.label: Verse 5
lines: With Thine own love may I be filled And by Thy Holy Spirit willed,
That all I touch, where'er I be,
May be divinely touched by Thee.

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Hear and grant our heart's request For that gift supreme and best: Holy heav'nly love.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Tongues of earth or heaven above,
Knowledge, all things, empty prove If I have no love.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Though I as a martyr bleed,
Give my goods the poor to feed,
All is vain if love I need: Therefore give me love.

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: Love is kind and suffers long,
Love is pure and thinks no wrong,
Love than death it self more strong: Therefore give us love.

sections.label: Verse 5
lines: Prophecy will fade away, Melting in the light of day;
Love will ever with us stay: Therefore give us love.

sections.label: Verse 6
lines: Faith and hope and love we see Joining hand in hand agree- But the greatest of the three,

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: When we walk with the Lord in the light of his word, what a glory he sheds on our way!
While we do his good will, he abides with us still, and with all who will trust and obey.

sections.label: Refrain
lines: Trust and obey, for there's no other way to be happy in Jesus, but to trust and obey.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Not a shadow can rise, not a cloud in the skies, but his smile quickly drives it away; not a doubt nor a fear, not a sigh nor a tear, can abide while we trust and obey.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Not a burden we bear, not a sorrow we share, but our toil he doth richly repay; not a grief or a loss, not a frown or a cross, but is blest if we trust and obey.

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: But we never can prove the delights of his love until all on the altar we lay; for the favor he shows, and the joy he bestows, are for them who will trust and obey.

sections.label: Verse 5
lines: Then in fellowship sweet we will sit at his feet, or we'll walk by his side in the way; what he says we will do, where he sends we will go; never fear, only trust and obey.

sections.label: சரணம் 1
lines: தேவ சித்தஞ் செய்தால், பெரும் பாக்யம் பெற்றே வாழுவோம்.

sections.label: சரணம் 3
lines: அருள் நாதர் சகாயஞ் செய்வார்; வரும் சோதனையோ,

sections.label: சரணம் 4
lines: நம்மை முற்றிலும் ஒப்புவிப்போம்; பெரு நன்மை ஈவார்,

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Theva Siththanj Cheydhaal, Perum Paakyam Petre Vaazhuvom.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Arul Naadhar Sakaayanj Cheyvaar; Varum Sodhanaiyo,

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: Nammai Mutrilum Oppuvippom; Peru Nanmai Eevaar,

translations.title: In Our Work and in Our Play

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: In our work and in our play, Jesus, ever with us stay;
May be always strive to be True and faithful unto Thee.
Then we truthfully can sing, We are children of the King.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: May we in Thy strength subdue Evil tempers, words untrue,
All things hateful to Thy mind.
Then we truthfully can sing, We are children of the King.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Children of the King are we!
May we loyal to Him be;
Try to please Him every day, In our work and in our play.
Then we truthfully can sing, We are children of the King.

translations.title: Watchman, Tell Us of the Night

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Watchman, tell us of the night what its signs of promise are.
Traveler, o'er yon mountain's height, see that glory beaming star.
Watchman, does its beauteous ray aught of joy or hope foretell?
Traveler, yes; it brings the day, promised day of Israel.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Watchman, tell us of the night, higher yet that star ascends.
Traveler, blessedness and light, peace and truth its course portends.
Watchman, will its beams alone gild the spot that gave them birth?
See it bursts o'er all the earth.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Watchman, tell us of the night, for the morning seems to dawn.
Traveler, darkness takes its flight, doubt and terror are withdrawn.
Watchman, let your wanderings cease; hasten to your quiet home.
Traveler, lo, the Prince of Peace, lo, the Son of God is come!

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: In times like these you need a Savior,
In times like these you need and anchor;
Be very sure, be very sure Your anchor holds and grips the Solid rock!
This Rock is Jesus, Yes, He's the One;
This Rock is Jesus, The only One!
Be very sure, be very sure Your anchor holds and grips the Solid rock!

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: In times like these you need the Bible,
In times like these O be not idle;
Be very sure, be very sure Your anchor holds and grips the Solid rock!
This Rock is Jesus, Yes, He's the One;
This Rock is Jesus, The only One!
Be very sure, be very sure Your anchor holds and grips the Solid rock!

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: In times like these I have a Savior,
In times like these I have an anchor I'm very sure, be very sure Your anchor holds and grips the Solid rock!
This Rock is Jesus, Yes, He's the One;
This Rock is Jesus, The only One!
I'm very sure, be very sure Your anchor holds and grips the Solid rock!

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Heir of the kingdom, O why dost thou slumber?
Why art thou sleeping so near thy blest home?
Wake thee, arouse thee, and gird on thine armor,
Speed, for the moments are hurrying on.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Heir of the kingdom, say, why dost thou linger?
How canst thou tarry in sight of the prize?
Up, and adorn thee, the Savior is coming;
Haste to receive Him descending the skies.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Earth's mighty nations, in strife and commotion,
Tremble with terror, and sink in dismay;
Listen, 'tis nought but the chariot's loud rumbling;
Heir of the kingdom, no longer delay.

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: Stay not, O stay not for earth's vain allurements!
See how its glory is passing away;
Break the strong fetters the foe hath bound o'er thee;
Heir of the kingdom, turn, turn thee away.

sections.label: Verse 5
lines: Keep the eye single, the head upward lifted;
Watch for the glory of earth's coming King;
Lo! o'er the mountaintops light is now breaking;
Heirs of the kingdom, rejoice ye and sing.

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Let every lamp be burning bright, The darkest hour is nearing;
The darkest hour of earth's long night,

sections.label: Refrain
lines: Then trim your lamps, my brethren dear,
Then trim your lamps with godly fear;
The Master's coming draweth near, Let every lamp be burning.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Wel'll rest our living faith upon His promise of returning.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: His word our lamp, His truth our guide, We cannot be mistaken;
Though dangers rise on every side, We shall not be forsaken.

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: Then let good works with faith appear,
To help the world atound us;
Obedience bring the blessing near When faith has firmly bound us.

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Look for the way-marks as you journey on,
Look for the way-marks passing one by one;
Down through the ages, past the kingdoms four' Where are we standing?

sections.label: Refrain
lines: Look for the way-marks, the great prophetic way-marks,
Down through the ages, past the kingdoms four.
Look for the waymarks, the great prophetic way-marks;

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: First, the Assyrian kingdom ruled the world,
And after Greece held universal sway,
Rome seized the scepter'where are we today?

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Down in the feet of iron and of clay,
Weak and divided, soon to pass away;
What will the next great, glorious drama be?
Christ and His coming, and eternity.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Let all your lamps be bright,
Gird up your loins as in His sight,

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Watch, 'tis your Lord's command, And while we speak He's near;
Mark the first signal of His hand, And ready all appear.

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: O happy servant, he, In such a posture found!
He shall His Lord with rapture see, And be with honor crowned.

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Watch, ye saints, with eyelids waking;
The powers of heaven are shaking;
Keep your lamps all trimmed an burning,

sections.label: Refrain
lines: He come, He comes all glorious!
Jesus comes to reign victorious, Lo!

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Lo! the promise of your Savior,
Blood-washed robes and crowns of glory;

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Kingdoms at their base are crumbling, Hark!
Tell, O tell of grace abounding, While the seventh trump is sounding.

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: Nations wane, though proud and stately;
Earth her latest pangs is summing;
Shout, ye saints, your Lord is coming.

sections.label: Verse 5
lines: Sinners, come, while Christ is pleading;
Haste, ere grace and time diminished Shall proclaim the mystery finished.

translations.title: பக்தரே மேல் நோக்கிப் பாரும், ராஜ்யங்களே தள்ளாடுதே

sections.label: சரணம் 1
lines: பக்தரே மேல் நோக்கிப் பாரும், ராஜ்யங்களே தள்ளாடுதே,

sections.label: பல்லவி
lines: யேசுவாறார், ஆட்சி செய்ய! ஆம் வாறார், சீக்ரம் வாறார்.

sections.label: சரணம் 2
lines: இதோ, உங்கள் வாக்குத்தத்தம், பாவ மன்னிப்பும் பாசமும்,

sections.label: சரணம் 3
lines: க்ருபை காலம் முடிந்திடும், விரைந்தோடு அவர் பாதம்.

translations.title: Pakdhare Mel Nokkip Paarum, Raajyangale Thallaatudhe

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Pakdhare Mel Nokkip Paarum, Raajyangale Thallaatudhe,

sections.label: Refrain
lines: Yesuvaaraar, Aatchi Seyya! Aam Vaaraar, Seekram Vaaraar.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Idho, Ungal Vaakkuththaththam, Paava Mannippum Paasamum,

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Krupai Kaalam Mutindhitum, Viraindhotu Avar Paadham.

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Rejoice, rejoice, believers, and let your lights appear: The evening is advancing, and darker night is near.
The Bridegroom is arising, and soon He draweth nigh.
Up, pray, and watch, and wrestle, at midnight comes the cry.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: The watchers on the mountain proclaim the Bride-groom near.
Go, meet Him as He cometh, with hallelujahs clear.
The marriage feast is waiting, the gates wide open stand;
Up, up, you heirs of glory, the Bride-groom is at hand.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: You saints who here in patience your cross and suff'rings bore,
Shall live and reign forever, when sorrow is no more.
Upon the throne of glory the Lamb you shall behold,
In triumph cast before Him your diadems of gold!

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: Our hope and expectation, O Jesus, now appear;
Arise, O sun so longed for, o'er this benighted sphere!
With hearts and hands uplifted, we plead,
O Lord, to see The day of earth's redemption that brings us unto Thee.

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Sweet promise is given to all who believe' 'Behold I come quickly,
Hold fast till I come; the danger is great;
Sleep not as do others; be watchful, and wait.'

sections.label: Refrain
lines: 'Hold fast till I come,' sweet promise of heaven' 'The kingdom restored, to you shall be given.' 'Come, enter My joy, sit down on the throne;
Bright crowns are in waiting; hold fast till I come.'

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: We'll 'watch unto prayer' with lamps burning bright;
He comes to all others a 'thief in the night.' We know He is near, but know not the day' As spring shows that summer is not far away.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Yes! this is our hope, 'tis built on His word' The glorious appearing of Jesus, our Lord;
Of promises all, it stands as the sum: 'Behold I come quickly; hold fast till I come.'

translations.title: Watchmen, on the Walls of Zion

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Watchmen, on the walls of Zion, What O tell us, of the night?
Will the morn soon greet our sight?
O'er your vision Shine there now some rays of light?
O'er your vision Shine there now some rays of light?

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Tell, O tell us, are the landmarks On our voyage all passed by?
Are we nearing now the haven?
Can we e'en the land descry?
Do we truly See the heavenly kingdom nigh?
Do we truly See the heavenly kingdom nigh?

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Light is beaming, day is coming!
Let us sound aloud the cry;
We behold the daystar rising Pure and bright in yonder sky!

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: We have found the chart and compass,
And are sure the land is near;
Onward, onward we are hasting, Soon the haven will appear;
Let your voices Sound aloud your holy cheer;
Let your voices Sound aloud your holy cheer.

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: O brother be faithful! soon Jesus will come,
For whom we have waited so long;
O, soon we shall enter our glorious home,
And join in the conqueror's song.
O brother be faithful! for why should we prove Unfaithful to Him who had shown Such deep, such unbounded and infinite love Who died to redeem us His own.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: O brother be faithful! the city of gold,
Prepared for the good and the blest, Is waiting its portals of pearl to unfold,
And welcome thee into thy rest.
Then, brother be faithful! not long shall we stay In weariness here, and forlorn,
Time's dark night of sorrow is wearing away,
We haste to the glorious morn.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: While legions of angels His chariot attend,
And palm wreaths, of victory bring.
O brother be faithful! and soon shalt thou hear They Savior pronounce the glad word,
Well done, faithful servant, they title is clear,
To enter the joy of thy Lord.

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: O brother be faithful! eternity's years Shall tell for thy faithfulness now,
When bright smiles of gladness shall scatter thy tears, A coronet gleam on thy brow.
O brother be faithful! the promise is sure,
That waits for the faithful and tried;
To reign with the ransomed, immortal and pure,

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Christian, seek not yet repose, Cast thy dreams of ease away;
Thou aret in teh midst of foes;

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Gird thy heavenly armor on, Wear it ever, night and day;

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Still they mark each warrior's way;
All with one sweet voice exclaim: 'Watch and pray!'

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: Hear, above all, hear thy Lord, Him thou lovest to obey;
Hide within thy heart His word;

sections.label: Verse 5
lines: Watch, as if on that alone Hung the issue of teh day;
Pray that help may be send down;

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: We know not the hour of the Master's appearing;
Yet signs all foretell that the moment is nearing When He shall return 'tis the promise most cheering But we know not the hour.

sections.label: Refrain
lines: He will come, let us watch and be ready;
He will come in the clouds of His Father's bright glory but we know not the hour.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: There's light for the wise who are seeking salvation;
There's truth in the book of the Lord's revelation;
Each prophecy points to the great comsummation But we know not the hour.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: We'll watch and we'll pray, with our lamps trimmed and burning;
We'll work and we'll wait till the Master's returning;
We'll sing and rejoice, every omen discerning But we know not the hour.

translations.title: My Soul, Be on Thy Guard

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: My soul, be on they guard!
The hosts of sin are pressing hard To draw thee from the skies.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: O watch, and fight, and pray!
Renew it boldly every day, And help divine implore.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Ne'er think the victory won, Nor lay thine armor down;
Thy arduous task will not be done Till thou obtain the crown.

translations.title: Once to Every Man and Nation

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Once to every man and nation, comes the moment to decide,
In the strife of truth with falsehood, for the good or evil side;
Some great cause, some great decision, offering each the bloom or blight,
And the choice goes by forever, 'twixt that darkness and that light.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Then to side with truth is noble, when we share her wretched crust,
Ere her cause bring fame and profit, and 'tis prosperous to be just;
Then it is the brave man chooses while the coward stands aside,
Till the multitude make virtue of the faith they had denied.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: By the light of burning martyrs, Christ, Thy bleeding feet we track, Toiling up new Calv'ries ever with the cross that turns not back;
New occasions teach new duties, time makes ancient good uncouth,
They must upward still and onward, who would keep abreast of truth.

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: Though the cause of evil prosper, yet the truth alone is strong;
Though her portion be the scaffold, and upon the throne be wrong;
Yet that scaffold sways the future, and behind the dim unknown,
Standeth God within the shadow, keeping watch above His own.

translations.title: God of Grace and God of Glory

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: God of grace and God of glory, On Thy people pour Thy power;
Now fulfill Thy church's story, Bring her bud to glorious flower.
Grant us wisdom, grant us courage, For the facing of this hour.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Lo, the hosts of evil round us Scorn Thy Christ, assail His ways;
From the fears that long have bound us Free our hearts to faith and praise.
Grant us wisdom, grant us courage, For the facing of this hour.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Bend our pride to Thy control;
Shame our wanton selfish gladness Rich in goods and poor in soul.
Grant us wisdom, grant us courage,
Lest we miss Thy kingdom's goal.

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: Set our feet on lofty places,
Gird our lives that they may be Armored with all Christ-like graces In the fight to set all free.
Grant us wisdom, grant us courage, That we fail not man nor Thee.

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Encamped along the hills of light,
And press the battle ere the night Shall veil the glowing skies.
Against the foe in vales below, Let all our strength be hurled;
Faith is the victory, we know, That overcomes the world.

sections.label: Refrain
lines: Oh, glorious victory That overcomes the world.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: His banner over us in love, Our sword the Word of God;
We tread the road the saints above With shouts of triumph trod.
By faith they, like whirlwind's breath,
The faith by which they conquered death Is still our shining shield.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: To him who overcomes the foe White raiment shall be giv'n;
Before the angels he shall know His name confessed in heav'n.
Then onward from the hills of light, Our hearts with love aflame;
We'll vanquish all the hosts of night, In Jesus' conq'ring name.

translations.title: Am I a Soldier of the Cross?

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Am I a soldier of the cross, a follower of the Lamb, and shall I fear to own his cause, or blush to speak his name?

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Must I be carried to the skies on flowery beds of ease, while others fought to win the prize, and sailed through bloody seas?

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Are there no foes for me to face?
Must I not stem the flood?
Is this vile world a friend to grace, to help me on to God?

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: Sure I must fight, if I would reign; increase my courage,
Lord I'll bear the toil, endure the pain, supported by thy word

sections.label: Verse 5
lines: Thy saints in all this glorious war shall conquer though they die; they see the triumph from afar, by faith they bring it nigh

sections.label: Verse 6
lines: When that illustrious day shall rise, and all thy armies shine in robes of victory through the skies, the glory shall be thine

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: With helmet and shield, and a sword in thy hand,
To meet the bold tempter, go, fearlessly go,
Then stand like the brave, with thy face to the foe.

sections.label: Refrain
lines: Stand like the brave, stand like the brave,
Stand like the brave, with thy face to the foe.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: The cause of thy Master with vigor defend;
Be watchful, be zealous, and fight to the end;
Wherever He leads thee, go, valiantly go,
Then stand like the brave, with thy face to the foe.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Press on, never doubting, thy Captain is near,
With grace to supply, and with comfort to cheer;
His love, like a stream in the desert will flow;
Then stand like the brave, with thy face to the foe.

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Awake, my soul! stretch every nerve, And press with vigor on;
A heavenly race demands thy zeal, And an immortal crown.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: 'Tis God's all animating voice That calls thee from on high;
'Tis He whose hand presents the prize To thine aspiring eye.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: A cloud of witnesses around Hold thee in full survey;
Forget the steps already trod, And onward urge thy way.

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: Blest Savior, introduced by Thee, Our race have we begun;
And, crowned with victory, at Thy feet We'll lay our trophies down.

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Onward, Christian soldiers, marching as to war, with the cross of Jesus going on before.
Christ, the royal Master, leads against the foe; forward into battle see his banners go!

sections.label: Refrain
lines: Onward, Christian soldiers, marching as to war, with the cross of Jesus going on before.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Like a mighty army moves the church of God; brothers, we are treading where the saints have trod.
We are not divided, all one body we, one in hope and doctrine, one in charity.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Crowns and thrones my perish, kingdoms rise and wane, but the church of Jesus constant will remain.
Gates of hell can never 'gainst that church prevail; we have Christ's own promise, and that cannot fail.

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: Onward then, ye people, join our happy throng, blend with ours your voices in the triumph song.
Glory, laud, and honor unto Christ the King, this through countless ages men and angels sing.

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Fight the good fight with all thy might;
Christ is thy strength, and Christ thy right;
Lay hold on life and it shall be Thy joy and crown eternally.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Run the straight race through God's good grace;
Lift up thine eyes, and seek His face.
Life with its path before us lies;
Christ is the way, and Christ the prize.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Cast care aside, lean on thy guide,
Trust, and the trusting soul shall prove Christ is its life, and Christ its love.

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: Faint not, nor fear, His arms are near;
He changeth not, and thou art dear.
Only believe, and thou shalt see That Christ is all in all to thee.

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Sound the battle cry, See! the foe is nigh;
Raise the standard high For the Lord;
Rest your cause upon His holy word.

sections.label: Refrain
lines: Rouse, then soldiers! rally round the banner!
Ready, steady, pass the word along;
Christ is Captain of the mighty throng.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: While our cause we know Must prevail;

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: May we wear the crown Before Thy face.

translations.title: Rise Up, O Church of God

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Rise up, O men of God!
Bring in the day of brotherhood and end the night of wrong.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Give heart and mind and soul and strength to serve the King of kings.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: The church for you doth wait, her strength unequal to her task; rise up, and make her great!

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: Lift high the cross of Christ!
Tread where his feet have trod.
Disciples of the Son of Man, rise up, O church of God!

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Strong in the strength which God supplies Through His eternal Son Strong in the Lord of hosts,
Who in the strength of Jesus trusts Is more than conqueror.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Stand then in His great might,
But take, to arm you for the fight,
Ye may o'ercome through Christ alone,

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: From strength to strength go on,
Tread all the powers of darkness down And win the well-fought day.
Still let the Spirit cry In all His soldiers, 'Come!' Till Christ the Lord who reigns on high Shall take the conquerors home.

translations.title: We Are Living, We Are Dwelling

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: We are living, we are dwelling,
In a grand and awful time,
In an age on ages telling' To be living is sublime.
Hark! the waking up of nations, Gog and Magog to the fray;
Is creation Groaning for her latter day?

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Christian, rouse and arm for conflict,
Bear the helmet of salvation, And the mighty gospel shield;
Let the breastplate, peace, be on thee,
Take the Spirit's sword in hand;

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: And the prince of evil spirits, Great deceiver of the world!
He who at the blessed Jesus Once his deadly weapons hurled,
Knowing that his reign will cease When the kingdom shall be given To the mighty Prince of Peace.

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: Christians, rouse! fight in this warfare,
Cease not till the victory's won;
Till your Captain loud proclaimeth, 'Servant of the Lord, well done!' He, alone, who thus is faithful,
Hath the promise, in the kingdom An eternity to spend.

translations.title: Stand Up! Stand Up for Jesus!

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Stand up, stand up for Jesus! ye soldiers of the cross;
Lift high His royal banner, it must not suffer loss: From vict'ry unto vict'ry,
Till every foe is vanquished, and Christ is Lord indeed.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Stand up, stand up for Jesus!
The trumpet call obey: Forth to the mighty conflict, in this His glorious day;
Ye that are men now serve Him against unnumbered foes;
Let courage rise with danger, and strength to strength oppose.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Stand up, stand up for Jesus!
The arm of flesh will fail you, ye dare not trust your own;
Put on the gospel armor, and watching unto prayer,
Where calls the voice of duty, be never wanting there.

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: Stand up, stand up for Jesus! the strife will not be long;
This day the noise of battle, the next the victor's song;
To him that overcometh a crown of life shall be;
He with the King of glory shall reign eternally.

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Lead on, O King eternal, the day of march has come; henceforth in fields of conquest thy tents shall be our home.
Through days of preparation thy grace has made us strong; and now,
O King eternal, we lift our battle song.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Lead on, O King eternal, till sin's fierce war shall cease, and holiness shall whisper the sweet amen of peace.
For not with swords loud clashing, nor roll of stirring drums; with deeds of love and mercy the heavenly kingdom comes.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Lead on, O King eternal, we follow, not with fears, for gladness breaks like morning where'er thy face appears.
Thy cross is lifted o'er us, we journey in its light; the crown awaits the conquest; lead on,

translations.title: அநாதி நித்யராஜா, முன் செல்லும் நாளின் நாள்

sections.label: சரணம் 1
lines: அநாதி நித்யராஜா, முன் செல்லும் நாளின் நாள்

sections.label: சரணம் 2
lines: வாள் மோதும் சத்தம் அல்ல கொட்டும் முரசொலியல்ல

sections.label: சரணம் 3
lines: உம் இன்ப முகம் எங்கும் காண்பேன் பயமில்லை

translations.title: Anaadhi Nidhyaraajaa, Mun Sellum Naalin Naal

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Anaadhi Nidhyaraajaa, Mun Sellum Naalin Naal

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Vaal Modhum Saththam Alla Kottum Murasoliyalla

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Um Inpa Mukam Engum Kaanpen Payamillai

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: On Jordan's stormy banks I stand,
And cast a wishful eye To Canaan's fair and happy land,
I am bound for the promised land,
I am bound for the promised land;
O who will come and go with me?
I am bound for the promised land.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: O'er all those wide extended plain Shines one eternal day;
There, Christ, the Sun, for ever reigns, And scatters night away.
I am bound for the promised land,
I am bound for the promised land;
O who will come and go with me?
I am bound for the promised land.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: When shall I reach that happy place, And be forever blest?
When shall I see my Father's face, And in His kingdom rest?
I am bound for the promised land,
I am bound for the promised land;
O who will come and go with me?
I am bound for the promised land.

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: Filled with delight, my raptured soul Would here no longer stay;
Though Jordan's waves around me roll, Fearless I'd launch away.
I am bound for the promised land,
I am bound for the promised land;
O who will come and go with me?
I am bound for the promised land.

translations.title: நான் யோர்தான் கரையில் நின்று கானானின் காட்சியை

sections.label: சரணம் 1
lines: நான் யோர்தான் கரையில் நின்று கானானின் காட்சியை
விழித்து நின்று நோக்கினேன் அங்கே என் பொக்கிஷம்

sections.label: சரணம் 3
lines: நான் அந்த மேலோகத்திற்கு எப்போ போய்ச் சேருவேன்?

translations.title: Naan Yordhaan Karaiyil Nindru Kaanaanin Kaatchiyai

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Naan Yordhaan Karaiyil Nindru Kaanaanin Kaatchiyai
Vizhiththu Nindru Nokkinen Ange En Pokkisham

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Naan Andha Melokaththirku Eppo Poich Cheruven?

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Gracious Father, guard Thy children From the foe's destructive power;
Save, O save them, Lord, from falling In this dark and trying hour.
Thou wilt surely prove Thy people, All our graces must be tried;
But Thy word illumes our pathway, And in God we still confide.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: We are in the time of waiting;
Soon we shall behold our Lord,
Keep us, Lord, till Thine appearing, Pure, unspotted from the world;
Let Thy Holy Spirit cheer us Till Thy banner is unfurled.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: With what joyful exultation Shall the saints Thy banner see,
When the Lord for whom we've waited Shall proclaim the jubilee!
Freedom from all sin and pain;
Freedom from the wiles of Satan,

sections.label: சரணம் 1
lines: உற்றார், மேன்மை, ஆஸ்தி, கல்வி, ஞானம், லோகம் அனைத்தும்
அற்பக் குப்பை என்று எண்ணி, வெறுப்பேனே முற்றிலும்.

sections.label: சரணம் 2
lines: துஷ்டர் என்னைப் பகைத்தாலும், நீரே தஞ்சம் ஆகுவீர்!
கஸ்தி என்ன நேரிட்டாலும் இனி மேன்மை தருவீர்;
உமதன்பு என்னைத் தேற்ற துக்கம் பயம் இல்லையே;
நாதா, உம் ப்ரசன்னம் நீங்க, இன்ப மெல்லாம் துன்பமே.

sections.label: சரணம் 3
lines: நெஞ்சமே! கர்த்தரை நோக்கி பயம் யாவும் அகற்று,
எந்தக் கஷ்டத்தையும் தாங்கி அவரை நீ பின்பற்று
திவ்விய அன்பைச் சிந்தை செய்து நித்ய மீட்பை நினைப்பாய்
ஆவியின் சகாயம் நம்பு, நெஞ்சமே, கலக்கம் ஏன்?

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Utraar, Menmai, Aasdhi, Kalvi, Gnaanam, Lokam Anaiththum
Arpak Kuppai Endru Enni, Veruppene Mutrilum.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Thushtar Ennaip Pakaiththaalum, Neere Thanjam Aakuveer!
Kasdhi Enna Nerittaalum Ini Menmai Tharuveer;
Umadhanpu Ennaith Thetra Thukkam Payam Illaiye;
Naadhaa, Um Prasannam Neenga, Inpa Mellaam Thunpame.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Nenjame! Karththarai Nokki Payam Yaavum Akatru,
Endhak Kashtaththaiyum Thaangi Avarai Nee Pinpatru
Thivviya Anpaich Chindhai Seydhu Nidhya Meetpai Ninaippaai
Aaviyin Sakaayam Nampu, Nenjame, Kalakkam En?

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Come, come, ye saints, no toil nor labor fear;
But with joy wend your way.
Though hard to you the journey may appear,
Grace shall be as your day.
We will have a living lord to guide,
And we can trust Him to provide;
Do this, and joy your hearts will swell: All is well!

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: We'll find the rest which God for us prepared,
When at last He will call;
Where none will come to hurt or make afraid,
We will make the air with music ring,
Shout praise to God our Lord and King: O how we'll make the chorus swell: All is well!

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: I will follow Thee, my Savior, Wheresoe'er my lot may be.
Where thou goest I will follow;
Yes, my Lord, I'll follow Thee.

sections.label: Refrain
lines: I will follow Thee, my Saviour, Thou didst shed Thy blood for me;
And though all men should forsake Thee;
By Thy grace I'll follow Thee.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Though the road be rough and thorny,
Thou hast trod this way before me,

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Though I meet with tribulations, Sorely tempted though I be;
I remember Thou wast tempted, And rejoice to follow Thee.

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: Though Thou leadest me through affliction,
Thou wast destitute, afflicted, And I only follow Thee.

sections.label: Verse 5
lines: Thou hast crossed the waves before me,
And I still will follow Thee.

translations.title: ரட்சகா உம்மைப் பின்செல்வேன், எது என் பங்கானாலும்

sections.label: சரணம் 1
lines: ரட்சகா உம்மைப் பின்செல்வேன், எது என் பங்கானாலும்;
நீர் எவ்விடமே சென்றாலும் கர்த்தா உம்மைப் பின் செல்வேன்.

sections.label: சரணம் 2
lines: முள்ளும் கரடும் பாதையில் முன் வந்து மறைத்தாலும்;
நீர் நடந்த பாதை தானே, நாடியே நான் பின் செல்வேன்.

sections.label: சரணம் 3
lines: உம் சோதனையை நினைத்து களிப்போடு பின் செல்வேன்.

sections.label: சரணம் 4
lines: ஏழை நீரும் ஆனீரல்லோ, எண்ணி உம்மைப் பின் செல்வேன்.

translations.title: Ratchakaa Ummaip Pinselven, Edhu En Pangaanaalum

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Ratchakaa Ummaip Pinselven, Edhu En Pangaanaalum;
Neer Evvitame Sendraalum Karththaa Ummaip Pin Selven.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Mullum Karatum Paadhaiyil Mun Vandhu Maraiththaalum;
Neer Natandha Paadhai Thaane, Naatiye Naan Pin Selven.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Um Sodhanaiyai Ninaiththu Kalippotu Pin Selven.

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: Ezhai Neerum Aaneerallo, Enni Ummaip Pin Selven.

translations.title: I Want Jesus to Walk With Me

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: I want Jesus to walk with me. (walk with me) I want Jesus to walk with me. (walk with me) All along my pilgrim journey,
I want Jesus to walk with me. (walk with me)

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Lord walk with me. (walk with me) In my trials,
Lord walk with me. (walk with me) When the shades of life are falling,
I want Jesus to walk with me. (walk with me)

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Lord walk with me. (walk with me) In my sorrows,
Lord walk with me. (walk with me) When my heart within is aching,
I want Jesus to walk with me. (walk with me)

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: I'm pressing on the upward way,
New heights I'm gaining every day;
Still praying as I'm onward bound, 'Lord, plant my feet on higher ground.'

sections.label: Refrain
lines: Lord, lift me up and let me stand,
By faith, on Heaven's table land, A higher plane than I have found;
Lord, plant my feet on higher ground.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: My heart has no desire to stay Where doubts arise and fears dismay;
Though some may dwell where those abound,
My prayer, my aim, is higher ground.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: I want to live above the world,
Though Satan's darts at me are hurled;
For faith has caught the joyful sound,
The song of saints on higher ground.

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: I want to scale the utmost height And catch a gleam of glory bright;
But still I'll pray till Heav'n I've found, 'Lord, plant my feet on higher ground.'

translations.title: In a Little While We're Going Home

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Let us sing a song that will cheer us by the way,
In a little while we're going home.
For the night will end in the everlasting day,
In a little while we're going home.

sections.label: Refrain
lines: We shall cross the billow's foam;
When the stormy winds are past,
In a little while we're going home.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: We will do the work that our hands may find to do,
In a little while we're going home.
And the grace of God will our daily strength renew,
In a little while we're going home.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: We will smooth the path for some weary, wayworn feet,
In a little while we're going home.
And may loving hearts spread around an influence sweet!
In a little while we're going home.

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: There's a rest beyond, there's relief from every care,
In a little while we're going home;
And no tears shall fall in that city bright and fair,
In a little while we're going home.

sections.label: சரணம் 2
lines: செய்ய வேண்டிய வேலை யாவும் நாம் செய்வோம்

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Seyya Ventiya Velai Yaavum Naam Seyvom

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Sinner, do you love my Jesus?
Sinner, do you love my Jesus?
Sinner, do you love my Jesus?

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: If you love him, why not serve him?
If you love him, why not serve him?
If you love him, why not serve him?

translations.title: As Jacob With Travel Was Weary

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: As Jacob with travel was weary one day,
At night on a stone for a pillow he lay;
He saw in a vision a ladder so high That its foot was on earth and its top in the sky.

sections.label: Refrain
lines: Alleluia to Jesus who died on the tree,
And has raised up a ladder of mercy for me,
And has raised up a ladder of mercy for me.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: All may climb it who will;
For the angels of Jacob are guarding it still: And remember each step that by faith we passo'er,
Some prophet or martyr has trod it before.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: And when we arrive at the haven of rest We shall hear the glad words, 'Come up hither, ye blest,
Here are regions of light, here are mansions of bliss.' O who would not climb such a ladder as this?

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: O happy band of pilgrims, If onward ye will tread With Jesus as your fellow,

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: O happy if ye labor As Jesus did for men;
O happy if ye hunger As Jesus hungered then!

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: The manifold temptations That death alone can cure,

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: What are they but His jewels Of right celestial worth?
What are they but the ladder Set up to heaven on earth?

sections.label: Verse 5
lines: Where such a light affliction Shall win you such a prize!

translations.title: Rise, My Soul, and Stretch Thy Wings

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Rise, my soul, and stretch thy wings, thy better portion trace;
Rise from transitory things toward heaven, thy native place;
Sun, and moon, and stars decay; time shall soon this earth remove;
Rise, my soul, and haste away to seats prepared above.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Rivers to the ocean run, nor stay in all their course;
Fire ascending seeks the sun; both speed them to their source;
So a soul that's born of God, longs to view His glorious face,
Forward tends to His abode to rest in His embrace.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Cease, ye pilgrims, cease to mourn; press onward to the prize;
Soon our Savior will return, triumphant in the skies;
Yet a season, and you know happy entrance will be given,
All our sorrows left below, and earth exhcanged for heaven.

translations.title: When on Life a Darkness Falls

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: When on life a darkness falls, When the mist flows chilling, Paths and sign posts lost in doubt, Loveless, unfulfilling, Reach us, Jesus, from Your cross, Though we feel forsaken;
Keep us through the aching night Till new dawns awaken.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: When the dreams and vows of youth Painfully accuse us,
Stab our conscience, steal our worth,
Christ will not refuse us: Peace the world cannot provide,
Strong companion at our side For each new direction.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Thro' the gospel story: Open door to life and peace,
All who seek Him, soon are found,
Made His close relation: Christ our pathway,

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: My heart can sing when I pause to remember, A heartache here is but a stepping stone.
Along a trail, thats winding always upward, this troubled world, is not my final home.

sections.label: Refrain
lines: But until then, my heart will go on singing,
Until then, with joy I'll carry on,
Until the day my eyes behold the city,
Until the day God calls me home.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: The things of earth will dim and loose there value, If we recall they're borrowed for awhile;
And things of earth that cause the heart to tremble,
Remember there, will only bring a smile.

translations.title: When We All Get to Heaven

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Sing the wondrous love of Jesus;
Sing his mercy and his grace.
In the mansions bright and blessed He'll prepare for us a place.

sections.label: Refrain
lines: When we all get to heaven, What a day of rejoicing that will be!
When we all see Jesus, We'll sing and shout the victory!

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: While we walk the pilgrim pathway,
But when traveling days are over, Not a shadow, not a sigh.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Let us then be true and faithful, Trusting, serving every day;
Just one glimpse of him in glory Will the toils of life repay.

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: Onward to the prize before us!
Soon the pearly gates will open;
We shall tread the streets of gold.

sections.label: சரணம் 1
lines: அவர் வீட்டில் வாசஸ்தலம் ஒன்று ஆயத்தம் செய்வார்.

sections.label: பல்லவி
lines: கூடிச் சேர்ந்திடுவோம் நாம், என்ன பாக்கியமான நாள் அது

sections.label: சரணம் 2
lines: நாம் ப்ரயாணம் செய்யும் போது மேகம் நிழல் தந்திடும்.

sections.label: சரணம் 3
lines: அவர் மகிமையின் காட்சி கஷ்டத்தை நீக்கி விடுமே.

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Avar Veettil Vaasasdhalam Ondru Aayaththam Seyvaar.

sections.label: Refrain
lines: Kootich Cherndhituvom Naam, Enna Paakkiyamaana Naal Adhu

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Naam Prayaanam Seyyum Podhu Mekam Nizhal Thandhitum.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Avar Makimaiyin Kaatchi Kashtaththai Neekki Vitume.

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Come, all Christians, be committed To the service of the lord;
Make your lives for him more fitted,
Tune your hearts with one accord.
Come into His courts with gladness,
Turn away from sin and sadness, Be transformed with life anew.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Of your time and talents give ye, They are gifts from God above;
To be used by Christians freely To proclaim His wondrous love.
Come again to serve the Savior,
Tithes and off'rings with you bring.
In your work, with Him find favor, And with joy His praises sing.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: God's command to love each other Is required of every one;
Showing mercy to one another Mirrors His redemptive plan.
In compassion He has given Of His love that is divine;
On the cross sins were forgiven;
Joy and peace are fully thine.

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: Come in praise and adoration, All who in Christ's name believe;
Worship Him with consecration, Grace and love you will receive.
For His grace give Him the glory,
For the Spirit and the Word,
And repeat the gospel story Till mankind His name has heard.

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Lord of all good, our gifts we bring You now;
Use them Your holy purpose to fulfill.
Tokens of love and pledges they shall be That our whole life is offered to Your will.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: We give our minds to understand Your ways;
Hands, voices, eyes to serve Your great design;
Hearts with the flame of your own love ablaze: Thus for Your glory all our pow'rs combine.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Father, whose bounty all creation shows;
Christ, by whose willing sacrifice we live;
Spirit, from whom all life in fullness flows: To You with grateful hearts ourselves we give.

translations.title: God, Whose Giving Knows No Ending

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: God, whose giving knows no ending,
From Your rich and endless store: Nature's wonder,
Gifted by You, we turn to You,
Off'ring up ourselves in praise: Thankful song shall rise forever,

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Skills and time are ours for pressing Toward the goals of Christ,
Your Son: All at peace in health and freedom,
Races joined, the church made one.
Lest we strive for self alone: Born with talents, make us servants Fit to answer at Your throne.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Gain through pow'rs Your grace conferred: Ours to use for home and kindred,
And to spread the Gospel Word.
Open wide our hands in sharing, As we heed Christ's ageless call.
Healing, teaching, and reclaiming, Serving You by loving all.

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Source of life and truth and grace,
Work made flesh, whose birth among us Hallows all our human race,
You our head, who throned in glory,
For Your own will ever plead: Fill us with Your love and pity,
Heal our wrongs, and help our need.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Bind us all as one together In Your church's sacred fold,
Weak and healthy, poor and wealthy,
Sad and joyful, young and old.
Is there want or pain or sorrow?
Make us all the burden share.
Are there spirits crushed and broken?
Teach us, Lord, to soothe their care.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: As You, Lord, have lived for others, So may we for others live.
Freely have Your gifts been granted;
Yours the gold and Yours the silver,
Yours the wealth of land and sea;
We but stewards of Your bounty Held in solemn trust will be.

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: Come, O Christ, and reign among us, King of love and Prince of Peace;
Hush the storm of strife and passion,
By Your patient years of toiling,
By Your silent hours of pain,
Quench our fevered thirst of pleasure,
Stem our selfish greed of gain.

sections.label: Verse 5
lines: Source of life and truth and grace,
Word made flesh, whose birth among us Hallows all our human race: By Your praying, by Your willing That Your people should be one,
Grant, oh, grant our hope's fruition: Here on earth Your will be done.

translations.title: The Wise May Bring Their Learning

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: The rich may bring their wealth,
And some may bring their greatness,
And some their strength and health: We too would bring our treasures To offer to the King,
We have no wealth or learning' What shall we children bring?

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: We'll bring Him hearts that love Him, We'll bring Him thankful praise,
And young souls meekly striving To follow in His ways: And these be the treasures We offer to the King,
And these are gifts that ever The poorest child may bring.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: We'll bring the little duties We have to do each day;
We'll try our best to please Him At home, at school, at play: And better are these treasures To offer to the King Than richest gift without them: Yet these a child may bring.

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: A diligent and grateful heart Prompts me to sing Thy praise.
Thy love and mercies from the start Have blessed me all my days.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: I thank Thee for the means to serve With talents and with tithes,
For sharing brings the utmost joy When lifting other lives.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: My thanks I give you for stewardship To minister through deeds,
To serve and share with patient care Thy people in their needs.

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: O Lord, I dedicate my all In this response to Thee.
Help me to magnify this call In deep humility.

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: For beauty of meadows, for grandeur of trees,
For flowers of woodlands, for creatures of seas,
For all You created and gave us to share,

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: As stewards of beauty received at Your hand,
As creatures who hear Your most urgent command,
We turn from our wasteful destruction of life,
Confessing our failures, confessing our strife.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Teach us once again to be gardeners in peace;
All nature around us is ours but on lease;
Your name we would hallow in all that we do,
Fulfilling our calling, creating with You.

translations.title: God in His Love for Us

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: God in His love for us lent us this planet,
Gave it a purpose in time and in space: Small as a spark from the fire of creation,
Cradle of life and the home of our race.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Thanks be to God for its bounty and beauty,
Life that sustains us in body and mind: Plenty for all, if we learn how to share it,
Riches undreamed of to fathom and find.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Long have our human wars ruined its harvest;
Long has earth bowed to the terror of forced;
Long have we wasted what others have need of,
Poisoned the fountain of life at its source.

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: Earth is the Lord's: it is ours to enjoy it,
Ours, as His stewards, to farm and defend.
From its pollution, misuse, and destruction,
Good Lord, deliver us, world without end!

translations.title: We Praise Thee With Our Minds

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: We praise Thee with our minds,
O Lord Kept sharp think Thy thought;
Come, Holy Ghost with grace outpoured, To teach what Christ hath taught.
In all our learning may we seek That wisdom from above Which comes to all: the brave, the meek Who ask in faith and love.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: We praise Thee thro' our bodies, Lord, Kept strong to do Thy will;
Thy Spirit's temples, which afford A means to praise Thee still.
We give ourselves, a sacrifice, To live as unto Thee;
For Thou alone hast paid the price To bring salvation free.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: We praise Thee in our hearts, O king, Kept pure to know Thy ways;
And raise to Thee a hymn to sing Eternally Thy praise.
Altho adoring hearts will bow As age on ages roll;
We praise Thee in our beings now, Mind, body, heart, and soul.

translations.title: Father, Who on Us Do Shower

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Father, who on us do shower Gifts of plenty form Your dower,
To Your people give the power All Your gifts to use aright.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Give pure happiness in leisure Temperance in every pleasure,
Wholesome use of earthly treasure Bodies clean and spirits bright.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Lift from this and every nation All that brings us degradation;

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: Father, You who sought and found us, Son of God, whose love has bound us, Holy Spirit, in us, round us, Hear us, Godhead infinite.

translations.title: O God, Whose Will Is Life and Good

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: O God, whose will is life and good For all of mortal breath: Unite in bonds of servanthood All those who strive with death.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Make strong their hands and hearts and wills To drive disease afar,
To strive against the body's ills And wage Your healing war.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: By healing of the sick and blind,
Make known the great physician's mind,

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: Before them set Your gracious will,
That they, with heart and soul,
To You may consecrate their skill And make the sufferer whole.

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Whose almighty hand Leads forth in beauty all the starry band Of shining worlds in splendor through the skies Our grateful songs before Thy throne arise.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Thy love divine hath led us in the past, In this free land by Thee our lot is cast, Be Thou our Ruler, Guardian, Guide and Stay, Thy Word our law, Thy paths our chosen way.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: From war's alarms, from deadly pestilence, Be Thy strong arm our ever sure defense;
Thy true religion in our hearts increase,
Thy bounteous goodness nourish us in peace.

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: Refresh Thy people on their toilsome way,
Lead us from night to never ending day;
Fill all our lives with love and grace divine,
And glory, laud, and praise be ever Thine.

translations.title: To the Name That Brings Salvation

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: To the name that brings salvation Let the nations bow the head;
Let them kneel in adoration When this name of names is said;
Let them pray for restoration Of all things in Christ the head.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: He through every generation Rules in endless majesty;
May the kings of every nation Now foreswear their enmity,
And with humble veneration In the love of God agree.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Lord, we pray for upright rulers: Guard them surely in their need From the vanity of power And the emptiness of greed;
Let them see the truth of lowness, And on justice let them feed.

translations.title: Mine Eyes Have Seen the Glory

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Mine eyes have seen the glory of the coming of the Lord;
He is trampling out the vintage where the grapes of wrath are stored;
He has loosed the fateful lightning of His terrible swift sword;

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: He has sounded forth the trumpet that shall never call retreat;
He is sifting out the hearts of men before His judgment seat;
O be swift, my soul, to answer Him! be jubilant, my feet!

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: In the beauty of the lilies Christ was born across the sea,
With a glory in His bosom that transfigures you and me;
As He died to make men holy, let us live to make men free!

translations.title: I Vow to Thee, My Country

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: I vow to thee, my country, all earthly things above,
Entire and whole and perfect, the service of my love: The love that asks the reason, the love that stands the test,
That lays upon the altar the dearest and the best;
The love that never falters, the love that pays the price,
The love that makes undaunted the final sacrifice.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: And there's another country, I've heard of long ago,
Most dear to them that love her, most great to them that know;
We may not count her armies, we may not see her King;
Her fortress is a faithful heart, her pride is suffering;
And one by one and fervently we pray for her increase,
And her ways are ways of gentleness, and all her paths are peace.

translations.title: Lord, While for All Mankind We Pray

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Lord, while for all mankind we pray Of every clime and coast,
O hear us for our native land,
The land we love the most!

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: O guard our shores from every foe, With peace our borders bless;
With prosperous times our cities crown,

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Unite us in the sacred love Of knowledge, truth, and Thee;
And let our hills and valleys shout The songs of liberty.

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: Lord of the nations, thus to Thee Our country we commend;
Be Thou her Refuge and her trust, Her everlasting friend.

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Who dost in love proclaim Each family Thine own,
Bless Thou all parents, guarding well,
The homes in which Thy people dwell.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: O Christ, Thyself a child Within an earthly home, With heart still undefiled, Thou didst to manhood come;
Our children bless, in every place,
That they may all behold Thy face,
And knowing Thee may grow in grace.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: O Spirit, who dost bind Our hearts in unity,
Who teaches us to find The love from self set free,
In all our hearts such love increase,
That every home, by this release,
May be dwelling place of peace.

translations.title: Happy the Home That Welcomes You

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Happy the home that welcomes You, Lord Jesus, Truest of friends, most honored guest of all, Where hearts and eyes are bright with joy to greet You, Your lightest wishes eager to fulfill.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Happy the home where men and wife together Are of one mind believing in Your love: Through love and pain, prosperity and hardship,
Through good and evil days Your care they prove.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Where they are giv'n to You with hands of prayer,
Where at Your feet they early learn to listen To Your own words, and thank You for Your care.

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: There is beauty all around, When there's love at home;
There is joy in every sound, When there's love at home.
Peace and plenty here abide, Smiling fair on every side;
Time doth softly, sweetly glide, When there's love at home.

sections.label: Refrain
lines: Love at home, love at home;
Time doth softly, sweetly glide, When there's love at home.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Kindly heaven smiles above, When there's love at home;
All the earth is fill'd with love, When there's love at home.
Sweeter sings the brooklet by, Brighter beams the azure sky;
O, there's One who smiles on high When there's love at home.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Jesus, make me wholly Thine, Then there's love at home;
May Thy sacrifice be mine, Then there's love at home.
Safely from all harm I'll rest,

translations.title: Lead Them, My God, to Thee

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Lead them, my God, to Thee,
O, by Thy love divine, Lead them, my God, to Thee;
Lead them, my God, to Thee, Lead them to Thee.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: When earth looks bright and fair,
Let no delusive snare Lure them astray;
Lead them, my God, to Thee,
Lead them, my God, to Thee,

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: And in this world of sin Lived undefiled.
O, for His sake, I pray, Lead them, my God, to Thee, Lead them, my God, to Thee, Lead them to Thee.

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: Yea, though my faith be dim,
I would believe That Thou this precious gift Wilt now receive;
O take their young hearts now,
Lead them my God to Thee,
Lead them, my God, to Thee,

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Lord, bless our homes with peace and love and laughter,
May we together follow Christ the Master And know the blessing of His sov'reignty.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: May every heart receive His loving spirit And know the t

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: ruth that makes life truly free;
Then, in that spirit may we live united,
And find in God our deep security.

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: Forgive the hurts our selfishness inflicted On whose we love and those who love us best.
Christ, heal the scars and draw us all together In Him whose will is peace and joy and rest.

sections.label: Verse 5
lines: Father, in gratitude for homes and loved one,
We open now our hearts to all mankind.
Grand us Your spirit love for one another So in Your peace may we our concord find.

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Happy the home when God is there, and love fills every breast; when one their wish, and one their prayer, and one their heavenly rest.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Happy the home where Jesus' name is sweet to every ear; where children early speak his fame, and parents hold him dear.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Happy the home where prayer is heard, and praise is wont to rise; where parents love the sacred Word and all its wisdom prize.

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: Lord, let us in our homes agree this blessed peace to gain; unite our hearts in love to thee, and love to all will reign.

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: O perfect Love, all human thought transcending, lowly we kneel in prayer before thy throne, that theirs may be the love which knows no ending, whom thou forevermore dost join in one.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: O perfect Life, be thou their full assurance of tender charity and steadfast faith, of patient hope and quiet, brave endurance, with childlike trust that fears nor pain nor death.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Grant them the joy which brightens earthly sorrow; grant them the peace which calms all earthly strife, and to life's day the glorious unknown morrow that dawns upon eternal love and life.

sections.label: சரணம் 2
lines: ஆ! ஜீவ ஊற்றே இவரில் உம் நேசம்

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Aa! Jeeva Ootre Ivaril Um Nesam

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: O God from whom mankind derives its name;
Whose covenant of grace remains the same, Be with these two who now before You wait;
Enlarge the love they come to consecrate.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: May through their union other lives be blessed;
Their door be wide to stranger and to guest,
Give them the understanding that is kind,
Grant them the blessing of an open mind.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Preserve their days from inwardness of hear;
To each the gift of truthful speech impart.
Their bond be strong against all strain and strife Amid the changes of this earthly life.

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: From stage to stage on life's unfolding way Bring to their mind the vows they make this day,
Your Spirit be their Guide in every move,
Their faith in Christ the basis of their love.

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Heav'nly Father, hear our prayer As we bow before You: Bless them in the life they share,
Be their guide in all endeavors, Be their hope that nothing severs;
Constant source of love divine, Let Your love within them shine!

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: As they pledge their love this day Here before Your altar,
May their hearts,, upon You stayed,
Be their comfort in all sorrow;
Grant them strength to live each hour Trusting solely in Your pow'r.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Blest Creator, Lord of life, Hear our glad thanksgiving.
Husband You have joined to wife For their earthly living.
Justified by Jesus' merit, Life eternal they inherit.
When their days on earth have passed,
Take them to Your home at last!

translations.title: May the Grace of Christ Our Savior

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: May the grace of Christ our Savior And the Father's boundless love,

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Thus may they abide in union With each other and the Lord,

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Glory be to the Father, and to the Son, and to the Holy Ghost;
As it was in the beginning, is now, and ever shall be, world without end.

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Holy, holy, holy, Holy is the Lord!
Holy, holy, holy, Holy is our God!
Evermore the same Heav'n and earth He ruleth,

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Holy, holy, holy, Holy is the Lord!
Holy, holy, holy, Holy is our God!
Glorious adn beloved Is the One adored!
Holy, holy, holy, Holy is the Lord.

translations.title: Let All Mortal Flesh Keep Silence

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Let all mortal flesh keep silence,
And with fear and trembling stand;
For with blessing in his hand,
Christ our God to earth descendeth,

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: A-men, A-men, Amen, Amen, Amen, Amen, A-men.

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: O Lord; and of thine own have we given thee.

translations.title: Cast Thy Burden Upon the Lord

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Cast thy burden upon the Lord, And He shall sustain thee;
He never will suffer the righteous to fall;
He is at thy right hand.
Thy mercy, Lord, is great, and far above the heavens;
Let none be made ashamed, that wait upon Thee.

translations.title: Lord, Bless Thy Word to Every Heart

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Lord, bless Thy word to every heart In this Thy house today,
And help us each as now we part,

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: O Thou who hearest every heartfelt prayer,
Thou art our love and light,
O let this Sabbath hour with Him be bright.

translations.title: The Lord Bless You and Keep You

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: The Lord bless you and keep you, the Lord life His countenance upon you, and give you peace; the Lord make His face to shine upon you, and be gracious unto you, be gracious, the Lord be gracious unto you.

translations.title: We Give Thee But Thine Own

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: We give Thee but Thine own, What-e'er the gift may be;
All that we have is Thine alone, A trust, O Lord, from Thee.

translations.title: Now, Dear Lord, As We Pray

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Now, dear Lord, as we pray, take our hearts and minds far away from the press of the world all around to your throne where grace does abound.
May our lives be transformed by Your love, may our souls be refreshed from above.
At this moment, let people everywhere join us now as we come to You in prayer.

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Spirit of the living God, Fall afresh on me!
Spirit of the living God, Fall afresh on me!
Break me, melt me, mold me, fill me!
Spirit of the living God, Fall afresh on me!

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: May God be with you Till we meet again,
And may His blessings Be within your heart,
May God be with you While we're apart,

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: May God protect you in His tender love;
And with the dawning Of each bright, new day,

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Shalom, good friends, shalom, good friends, shalom, shalom.
Till we meet again, till we meet again, shalom, shalom.

translations.title: May the Lord Bless and Keep You

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: May the Lord bless you and keep you both now and evermore.

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Thy Word is a lantern unto my feet, And a light unto my path.

translations.title: Heavenly Father, to Thee We Pray

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Heavenly Father, to Thee we pray, On the holy Sabbath day;
Through Thy Word Thy will make known;
May each heart become Thy throne,
Let Thy living water flow That we Thy boundless love may know.

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: God be in my head, and in my understanding;
God be in mine eyes, and in my looking;
God be in my mouth, and in my speaking;
God be in my heart, and in my thinking;
God be at mine end, and at my departing.

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: And in my thinking. god be in my eyes,
God be in my mouth And in my speaking.
Oh, God be in my hear, And in my understanding.

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Breath into the music Of the praise we bring.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Holy Spirit, prompt us When we kneel to pray;
Nearer come, and teach us What we ought to say.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Holy Spirit, shine Thou On the Book we read;
Gild it's holy pages With the light we need.

translations.title: This Is the Day the Lord Hath Made

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: This is the day the Lord hath made; he calls the hours his own.
Let heaven rejoice, let earth be glad, and praise surround the throne.

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: You are letting Your servant go away in peace.
May eyes have seen You in broad daylight before all nations, planning salvation.
Light of revelation for the nations, and glory of Your people Israel.

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Jesus, stand among us In Thy risen power;
Let this time of worship Be a hallowed hour.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Breathe the Holy Spirit Into every heart;
Bid the fears and sorrows From each soul depart.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Thus with quickened footsteps We pursue our way,
Watching for the dawning Of eternal day.

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Hear Our Prayer, O Lord, Hear our prayer, O Lord;
Incline Thine ear to us, And grant us Thy peace.

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Cause me to hear Thy loving kindness in the morning, for in Thee do I trust.
Cause me to know they way where-in I shall walk for I lift up my soul to Thee.

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Bless thou the gifts our hands have brought; bless thou the work our hearts have planned.
Ours is the faith, the will, the thought; the rest,
O God, is in thy hand.

translations.title: The Lord Is in His Holy Temple

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: The Lord is in HIs holy temple,
The Lord is in His holy temple,
Let all the earth be silent be silent before Him.

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Surely, surely the Lord has been here,
I hear music soft on my ear, I feel His Spirit, I have no fear.

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Day by day, Dear Lord, of Thee three things I pray: To see Thee more clearly, Love Thee more dearly, Follow Thee more nearly, Day by day.

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Dismiss us, Lord, with blessing, we pray;
As from Thy worship we go our ways;
Guide in life's conflicts, all through the day;
Save in Thy kingdom, Thine be the praise.

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Lead me, Lord, lead me in thy righteousness; make thy way plain before my face.
For it is thou, Lord, thou, Lord only, that makest me dwell in safety.

translations.title: The Lord Is in His Holy Temple

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: The Lord is in His holy temple,
The Lord is in His holy temple,
Let all the earth keep silence,
Let all the earth keep silence, before Him,
Keep silence, keep silence, before Him.

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Almighty Father, hear our prayer, and bless all souls that wait before Thee.

translations.title: Praise God, From Whom All Blessings

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Praise God, from Whom all blessings flow;
Praise Him, all creatures here below;
Praise Him above, ye heavenly host;
Praise Father, Son, and Holy Ghost.
